### 1. [ThinkWise: Learning When to Think in Large Multimodal Reasoning Models via Visual and Difficulty Perception](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18685v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18685

**作者：** Wenkang Zhou、Chen Yang、Jiaheng Peng、Xitong Li、Hongzhi Yin、Yunke Zhang、Lu Yu、Peng-Fei Zhang、Xuhui Ren、Shijie Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18685v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18685v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ThinkWise，一个感知感知的 RLVR 框架，联合建模任务难度与视觉感知状态，并通过结构化奖励自适应调节多模态推理深度。

**相关性简评：** 与 THINK / STOP 的动态计算和视觉证据筛选直接相关；其「感知不确定性—推理深度错配」诊断及感知、难度条件化的长度奖励，可供核查停止决策与视觉 grounding 的联合建模，但未涉及 latent 状态表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ThinkWise: Learning When to Think in Large Multimodal Reasoning Models via Visual and Difficulty Perception

**abstract/A1：** Large Multimodal Reasoning Models (LMRMs) extend large language models to heterogeneous modalities, demonstrating strong potential across a wide range of open-ended tasks. Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been widely adopted to improve reasoning performance in LMRMs; however, existing approaches overlook the critical role of visual perception uncertainty in guiding reasoning processes. We term this limitation Reasoning Allocation Misalignment, where the misalignment between visual perception uncertainty and reasoning depth leads to over-allocation of deep reasoning under uncertain visual grounding, resulting in unnecessarily long reasoning trajectories and degraded performance. To address this issue, we propose ThinkWise, a perception-aware RLVR framework that jointly models task difficulty and visual perception state to regulate reasoning depth. Specifically, we introduce an instance-adaptive visual perception modeling mechanism that enables context-aware calibration of perception uncertainty, leading to more accurate perception estimation. We further design a structured reward formulation that jointly considers perception, correctness, and task difficulty. In particular, an answer reward provides supervision for correctness, a perception- and difficulty-conditioned length reward adaptively regulates reasoning depth, and a perception reward encourages trajectories with stronger visual grounding. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkWise consistently improves the trade-off between accuracy and reasoning efficiency across both 3B and 7B models. These results highlight the importance of perception-aware reasoning and establish a principled framework for advancing LMRMs.

</details>

### 2. [How VLMs Plan What's Next](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21600v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21600

**作者：** Rohit Gandikota、Arnab Sen Sharma、Adam Belfki、David Bau

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21600v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21600v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 Qwen3-VL（2B–32B）上用因果 patching 刻画 VLM 逐词描述图像时如何规划下一步看哪里：binding heads 把文本 token 解析为图像区域指针并为已写答案标注来源，形成「已写到何处」的 cursor 进度信号，再由 select 选取最近未写区域或停止，最后由 gaze heads 执行指向并取回该处概念转成词。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉证据筛选、区域—实体绑定、内部进度状态与停止决策，其「看哪里/何时停」的分解和替代假设检验可供核查，用于对照 LVR 中 latent 状态如何携带视觉内容并决定终止。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How VLMs Plan What's Next

**abstract/A1：** When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

</details>

### 3. [UMM-JEPA: Generative Pretraining via Masked Next-Scale Representation Prediction for Unified Multimodal Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18668v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18668

**作者：** Yucheng Zhou、Yunjia Xi、Di Yin、Jianbing Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18668v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18668v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 UMM-JEPA，把统一多模态模型的生成训练改为对连续视觉理解表征做由粗到细的多尺度渐进预测，并将像素渲染解耦后置，再以控制实验、线性探针和视觉证据干预比较其与离散 code、latent flow 目标的迁移差异。

**相关性简评：** 它直指「生成所监督的表征与理解所消费的视觉表征不匹配」这一 LVR 核心问题，其多尺度表征预测目标与图像特定信息使用分析可供核查生成 latent 是否保留并用于任务必要的视觉细节；但研究的是训练目标而非推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UMM-JEPA: Generative Pretraining via Masked Next-Scale Representation Prediction for Unified Multimodal Models

**abstract/A1：** Unified multimodal models can support both visual understanding and generation, yet generative training does not necessarily improve understanding. We argue that this limitation may arise from a mismatch between the representation targeted by generation and the perceptual representation used for understanding. Conventional generation objectives primarily optimize synthesis-oriented spaces such as discrete visual codes or generative latents. We therefore introduce UMM-JEPA, which reformulates generation as progressive prediction of continuous visual-understanding representations. The model constructs a multi-scale representation hierarchy from coarse to fine, while pixel rendering is decoupled from representation pretraining and attached only afterward. Controlled comparisons show that the representation-prediction objective accounts for most of the understanding improvement, while a data-matched control leaves the group means nearly unchanged. UMM-JEPA reaches a 16-benchmark visual mean of 51.71, against 46.36 for the understanding-only Qwen-VL baseline, and the text mean also rises. Compared with discrete-code and latent-flow generation objectives, perceptual representation prediction yields stronger and more consistent transfer to understanding. Linear probes and visual-evidence interventions further reveal richer object and spatial structure and stronger use of image-specific information. These results suggest that generation can benefit understanding when it directly supervises the perceptual representations that understanding consumes.

</details>

### 4. [Evidence-Calibrated Selective Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18670v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18670

**作者：** Shiyu Gu、Luis Miguel Santana、Rafael Enrique Cruz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18670v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18670v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「证据校准的选择性解码」框架，将 VQA 回答拆成三步：跨裁剪图像验证局部视觉支持（EVC）、在候选集内有界地进行对比修正（ACC）、以及在验证预算下校准回答放行阈值（BSA），并给出数学刻画与区分强制作答和选择性风险的评测协议。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 关注的视觉证据是否真正支持答案、语言旁路修正与 STOP/预算化弃答的收益成本权衡；但作者自述尚未做模型级实验，仅有对已发表基线数据的再分析，其证据度量与放行阈值能否反映内部状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evidence-Calibrated Selective Decoding for Reliable Visual Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Visual question answering systems can produce confident responses that are weakly supported by their input images. Contrastive decoding can reduce this dependence on language priors, but a fixed correction may also overturn a correct answer, while selective answering can conceal errors by reducing coverage. We develop evidence-calibrated selective decoding, a framework that separates three decisions: whether local visual evidence supports a candidate, how strongly to correct the original distribution, and whether the resulting answer should be released under a verification budget. Evidence Verification across Crops (EVC) measures visual support and disagreement; Adaptive Contrast Correction (ACC) applies a bounded modification within the backbone's plausible candidate set; Budgeted Selective Answering (BSA) calibrates an answer-admission threshold on held-out images. We provide a complete mathematical specification, bounded-perturbation analysis, and an evaluation protocol that distinguishes forced answering from selective risk. Our quantitative analysis re-examines published baselines on POPE instantiated over MSCOCO, A-OKVQA, and GQA, together with four MME subtasks. These public measurements reveal variation across backbones, tasks, and correction settings that motivates adaptive control. The proposed framework has not yet undergone model-level evaluation; its effectiveness remains a falsifiable hypothesis rather than an established empirical result.

</details>

### 5. [ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18696v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18696

**作者：** Xiang Zhang、Xiangyu Dong、Yang Lu、Xiaoguang Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18696v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18696v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ARC-VLN 面向空中视觉语言导航，提出按 token 类型区分的递归计算框架：文本与动作 token 走完整深度，视觉 token 自适应选择退出深度并保留其表示，配合 active-token compaction 缩短后续序列，并用专门训练策略缓解路由坍缩到单一深度。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接处理视觉 token 与语言 token 间的动态算力分配及共享参数递归块，可作为「视觉证据需要多深处理」「LOOK 的算力成本」的对照线索，也可核查视觉 token 早退后其表示是否仍被动作预测实际使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ARC-VLN: Adaptive Recursive Computing-based Visual-Language Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Efficient aerial visual-language navigation (VLN) requires reducing model storage and inference costs while maintaining instruction-conditioned action prediction. We present ARC-VLN, a token-type-aware recursive computation framework built on a language backbone with shared parameters. ARC-VLN retains full-depth computation for text and action tokens while adaptively selecting exit depths for visual tokens. Representations of early-exiting visual tokens are retained, and active-token compaction shortens the sequences processed by subsequent recursive blocks. To mitigate routing collapse to a single exit depth, we design a dedicated learning strategy that encourages the model to distribute visual tokens across multiple exit depths.On OpenFly's Test-Seen and Test-Unseen subsets, ARC-VLN achieves the lowest navigation error and the highest success rate and success weighted by path length among all compared methods. Meanwhile, it reduces the average number of decision steps per trajectory, total floating-point operations, mean model inference time per trajectory, and average GPU memory usage during inference, indicating its great potential as a VLN backbone for lightweight applications.

</details>

### 6. [What Does Hard-Negative Fine-Tuning Teach Multimodal Large Language Models? Controlled Evidence from a Compositional Benchmark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18701v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18701

**作者：** Ranjith Chodavarapu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18701v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18701v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 CompHall（2,860 道强制选择题，覆盖空间、属性、计数、部分-整体，每题含两个分级 hard negatives），在 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、Idefics2 上系统检验 hard-negative 微调究竟让模型学到了什么，并以灰图评测、多随机种子、选项顺序测试、不同类型题目对照臂和独立基准作为控制。

**相关性简评：** 属于 VLM 视觉推理的诊断与失败分析：指出部分-整体题可脱离图像作答、增益高度依赖空间题型且集中在关系词、并伴随 yes-bias，直接关联 LVR 关注的视觉证据使用、增益归因与训练监督设计；其灰图与文本-only 控制可供核查 latent 状态是否真正依赖视觉输入。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Does Hard-Negative Fine-Tuning Teach Multimodal Large Language Models? Controlled Evidence from a Compositional Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning on hard negatives is a popular way to improve the compositional reasoning of vision-language models, but when accuracy goes up it is rarely clear what the model actually learned. We ask this question for multimodal large language models. We use CompHall, 2,860 forced-choice questions (spatial, attribute, counting and part-whole) with two graded hard negatives each, three model families (LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT and Idefics2), and controls that such studies often lack: gray-image evaluation, three seeds, option-order tests, control arms trained on different question types, and independent benchmarks. We find four things. First, CompHall is not a pure test of vision: part-whole questions can be answered from the text alone (66-95% without the image), and per-image accuracy is unrelated to an object-hallucination probe (r = -0.05), so we see no evidence that compositional failures drive hallucination. Second, the original fine-tuning method scored mostly image-placeholder tokens and hurt both LLaVA models. With a corrected loss, fine-tuning raises accuracy on the spatial-relation questions of CV-Bench in all three families, by +3.2, +23.1 and +6.0 points (averaged over both option orders). Control arms show that the gain needs spatial training questions, and for LLaVA-NeXT about two-thirds of it appears even on relation words that were only wrong options in training. Third, the gain is not general: on CompHall itself it is significant only for LLaVA-NeXT (+6.9 points) and not detectable for Idefics2, it reaches about 3 points at most on true/false statements, and LLaVA-1.5 fine-tuned on other question types learns to answer "true" too often. Fourth, both losses raise the yes-bias of LLaVA-1.5 on POPE.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 10 figures, 26 tables

</details>

### 7. [LVRE: A Local Visual Reasoning and Editing Agent for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18717v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18717

**作者：** Bowen Lin、Lei Fan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18717v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18717v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无需训练的视觉智能体 LVRE，用于光学化学结构识别：它结合高分辨率局部裁剪、全局图像与局部图邻域提出对具名图记录的修改，并由确定性控制器以可回滚事务方式执行、由视觉复核模块决定提交或撤销。

**相关性简评：** 其局部视觉复检、编辑提交/回滚与修复-回归权衡，直接关联 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、状态更新和停止决策，可供核查“局部修正是否优于全图重生成”。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LVRE: A Local Visual Reasoning and Editing Agent for Optical Chemical Structure Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Optical chemical structure recognition (OCSR) demands strict all-or-nothing graph fidelity, where a single misidentified bond order or formal charge makes the predicted graph differ from the reference structure. While vision-language models (VLMs) can reinspect ambiguous visual regions, unconstrained full-graph regeneration often introduces regressive errors into previously correct substructures. We present LVRE, a training-free visual agent that refines molecular graphs via targeted visual inspection and reversible transactional editing. Rather than regenerating the entire graph sequence, LVRE examines a high-resolution crop alongside the global diagram and local graph neighborhood, proposing modifications to named graph records that a deterministic controller checks. A controller executes each proposed modification as an isolated transaction, and a visual review module arbitrates which edits to commit or roll back. Across four foundation VLMs, LVRE improves graph accuracy by 8.0-8.5 percentage points over single-pass recognition and by 3.0-3.3 points over fixed local review. In a paired evaluation of 1,000 diagrams using Gemini 3.8 Flash, LVRE achieves 100 successful repairs while introducing only 15 regressive errors, in contrast to global reflection which yields 65 repairs against 30 introduced errors. On this paired set, LVRE introduces half as many errors on initially correct predictions as global reflection.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IFTC 2026

</details>

### 8. [Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18718v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18718

**作者：** Dayu Wang、Shasha Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18718v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18718v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「可编辑视频上下文」：长视频按时间戳分段，模型在稀疏采样后自选片段以 4 倍帧率解码并删除其余段；通过给 M-RoPE 时/高/宽分量加同一偏移来旋转复用幸存段的 KV cache，并用内容哈希缓存避免重复视觉编码。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」的收益/成本：实验显示模型自选片段不能提升准确率、稀疏采样中缺失的针难以被找回，可供核查主动观看能否补足证据；其 KV cache 偏移复用也可能提示推理期状态复用的代价问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Editable Video Context: Mid-Context KV-Cache Reuse for Context-Managing Video LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Context Language Models let a model edit its own context, while Suffix Cache Reuse makes edits to text efficient by adjusting the positions of cached keys for surviving tokens. We extend these ideas to video language models with multimodal rotary position embeddings (M-RoPE). We represent a long video as timestamped segments. After viewing a sparsely sampled version, the model selects segments for decoding at 4x the frame rate, and the remaining segments are removed from its context. Our rebuild method reuses the KV cache of surviving segments by rotating their keys with a single offset shared by the temporal, height, and width components of Qwen2.5-VL's M-RoPE. A content-hashed cache also avoids repeating vision-encoder computation for those segments. In preliminary experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B on synthetic needle-in-a-video-haystack questions over public-domain films, the method reduces prefill tokens and end-to-end rebuild latency relative to full recomputation while usually producing the same answer. Densifying the segment containing the answer improves accuracy when that segment is known. When the model selects segments itself, accuracy does not improve: it rarely identifies a needle that was absent from the sparse sample. We release the code, raw logs, and scripts used to reproduce the paper's results.

</details>

### 9. [Is It Still There? Place-Registered Verification Makes VLMs Reliable Scene-Change Detectors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18734

**作者：** Jinjie Xie、Baihua Li、Qinggang Meng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18734v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断多图 VLM 在场景变化检测中主要因无法定位物体原位置而失败，提出 STILL：用 3D 几何把变化候选的位置配准到另一次拍摄，再让 VLM 结合场景视图与局部位置视图判断物体是否仍在原处，并以同形式监督训练。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接涉及 VLM 如何在多视角间选取和核验视觉证据，与「LOOK 哪里」、物体级验证及何时停止判断相关；其位置配准与局部视图是否真正被模型使用，可供核查，但不涉及 latent 推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Is It Still There? Place-Registered Verification Makes VLMs Reliable Scene-Change Detectors

**abstract/A1：** A robot that returns to a space must tell which objects were added, removed or moved since its last visit, while its trajectory, viewpoints and lighting differ between the two visits. We find that multi-image vision-language models (VLMs) fail at this task mainly because they cannot find the place where an object was. A VLM recognises what each frame shows but cannot check whether an object is still at its place in the other capture. It therefore reports objects that only one capture shows and misses most removed and moved objects. We propose STILL, which reformulates change detection as object verification at a registered place. 3D geometry registers the place of each change hypothesis in the other capture, and one VLM answers, from a scene view and a local place view, whether the object is still at that place, trained with supervision of the same form. Under the official SceneDiff protocol, STILL raises the main metric obj/sc AP from 24.0 to 37.8, and from 11.6 to 20.6 on the egocentric kitchen subset without any kitchen training data. It improves F1 by more than 21 points over a VLM fine-tuned on the same annotations and adds only about 11% to the runtime.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/Oran9er/STILL

</details>

### 10. [AITHER: Authority-Informed Evidence Routing for Mixed-Authority Vision-Language Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18735

**作者：** Xinjin Li、Haoyue Zhang、Xinyi Gou、Yuruo Gong、Yuanjian He、Muzi Li、Yujian Long、Yu Ma、Yiliu Xu、Tianxin Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18735v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文形式化「混合权威」视觉语言推理：判断图像、可推翻的文本声明与绑定式任务指令中哪一方有权决定答案，并提出免训练的 AITHER 语义框架路由器，按指令编译、空间框架恢复、语义极性判定和失败即关闭的候选路由四步做权威仲裁。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是「答案该由视觉证据还是文本/指令决定」，直接关联 LVR 中视觉旁路、证据筛选与答案是否真正使用视觉内容的诊断，其分步路由与 fail-closed 规则可供核查推理期证据选择的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AITHER: Authority-Informed Evidence Routing for Mixed-Authority Vision-Language Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Reliable vision-language reasoning requires a control decision that conventional grounding methods leave implicit: which input is entitled to determine the answer? Auxiliary text may be a defeasible claim about an image, a binding task instruction, or compatible context. Correcting every image-text conflict toward the image therefore repairs false claims but overwrites valid task rules. We formalize this setting as mixed-authority vision-language reasoning and introduce AITHER, an Authority-Informed Text-Image Hierarchy for Evidence Routing. Its final policy, the Semantic-Frame Router, is a training-free black-box control layer that (i) compiles explicit task directives, (ii) recovers standardized spatial frames from metadata-scrubbed pixels, (iii) resolves the semantic polarity of remaining notes, and (iv) routes among frozen observable candidates with fail-closed semantics. This ordered decomposition converts authority arbitration from an unconstrained prompt preference into a reproducible inference program. Across 1,620 MATRIX predictions, AITHER reaches 95.1% accuracy, exceeding the strongest task-and-frame baseline by 9.1 points with a 95% record-cluster interval of 6.8-11.5 points and no harmed records. It further reaches 100.0% on 1,800 controlled FRAME predictions and 93.3% on GQA-MATRIX. The results show that explicit authority routing can simultaneously improve false-claim correction, preserve task-defined answers, and eliminate clean-context overcorrection.

</details>

### 11. [Recognizing Events Is Not Enough: Why Streaming VLMs Struggle in Compositional Instruction Triggering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18743v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18743

**作者：** Yehua Huang、Penglei Sun、Xiang Li、Jinhao Zhou、Jiawen Wen、Qingqing Xiao、Zihan Yang、Wenqi Wang、Haolan Chen、Yu Xu、Xiaowen Chu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18743v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18743v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出现有流式 VLM 能识别单个事件却难以满足组合指令的时间约束，提出 CoTriggerBench 基准并用可执行事件计划检验通知时机与静默，同时给出实时 agent TEMPI：把指令拆成原子事件查询与时间约束，用 Scenario Memory 随证据到达持续维护任务进度。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据到达即更新场景状态、跨越检测器视觉窗口保留信息」的机制，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、内部状态维护和 STOP/触发决策直接相关，可供核查跨时间证据累积是否真正因果地决定通知时刻；同时含流式推理流水线重叠优化，可为成本评估提供参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recognizing Events Is Not Enough: Why Streaming VLMs Struggle in Compositional Instruction Triggering

**abstract/A1：** Recognizing individual events does not guarantee correct execution of compositional instructions in streaming video. For example, given the request "Notify me when the pot boils after someone turns on the stove and leaves the kitchen", existing models may recognize the individual events yet notify too early or miss the intended moment, failing to track how their temporal conditions are satisfied over time. To evaluate this gap, we introduce CoTriggerBench, which composes annotated video events into temporally constrained instructions and verifies notification timing and silence through executable event plans and source-event replay. To address this challenge, we propose a real-time VLM agent, TEMPI. TEMPI decomposes instructions into atomic event queries and temporal constraints, and uses Scenario Memory to continuously maintain task progress as event evidence arrives, allowing earlier observations to support subsequent decisions beyond the detector's visual window. Even when no notification is required, relevant events continue to update the scenario state. On CoTriggerBench, TEMPI achieves 44.4% instruction-level success, outperforming the strongest closed-source and fine-tuned open-source VLM baselines by 15.6 (Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash-Realtime) and 18.1 (MOSS-VL-Realtime) percentage points, respectively. To support efficient on-device streaming inference, we further optimize the streaming inference pipeline by overlapping partial visual encoding and LLM prefix prefill with frame arrival. On an 8 GB RTX 5060, our optimized detector implementation achieves a 4.90$\\times$ speedup.

</details>

### 12. [Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18790v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18790

**作者：** Nicolas Avelar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18790v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18790v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在60对具有扫描几何精确真值的NLST胸部CT上，检验VLM对图像质量缺陷的判定是否随CT图像与DICOM元数据的呈现顺序而改变。

**相关性简评：** 「后到证据获胜」直接指向答案是否真正使用视觉证据与冲突证据如何取舍，可核查该效应是否反映视觉旁路或信息坍缩，以及在工具结果、agentic管线中的稳定性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Evidence, Different Verdicts: Delivery of CT Images and DICOM Metadata Changes VLM Quality-Control Decisions

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are being proposed as automated checks on clinical imaging inputs, where a scan and its DICOM metadata can disagree; a truncated CT series wrongly admitted to volumetric follow-up, such as lung-nodule growth assessment in screening, biases the measurement. A natural safeguard is to let the model judge the image before it sees the metadata. We find this backfires. On 60 NLST chest CT pairs with coverage defects whose ground truth is computed from scan geometry, a false header that Claude Haiku 5.5 resisted when shown with the image (2% of its detections overruled) overturned 91% of them when it arrived after the model's answer (Nemotron-3.5-VL 43% to 100%). With the order reversed, the image overturned 98-100% of the header's errors (Claude models): whichever source came second won. This is not generic sycophancy: a neutral "please confirm" reversed 0 of 1,072 correct refusals, and the effect persisted when the header arrived as a tool result, as in agentic pipelines. One warning sentence cut sequential reversal to at most 9%, and the pattern held on 24 real mismatched pairs. Contributions: (i) evidence that VLM input-check decisions on identical evidence depend on delivery; (ii) a testbed with exact geometric ground truth; (iii) a validation protocol for clinical VLM input checks. Code, prompts and all call logs: https://github.com/nav92061/ct-vlm-delivery-order

**comment/C1：** 4 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027

</details>

### 13. [Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19184v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19184

**作者：** Shankar Gangisetty、Muskan Singh、C V Jawahar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19184v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19184v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出面向自动驾驶的诊断式评测框架，基于 BDD100K 与 DriveLM 标注构建恶劣天气、交叉路口及 nuScenes 空间推理任务，用「有图/无图对比、反事实天气敏感度、改写与否定鲁棒性、空间推理」四类协议检验开源 VLM 的安全决策是否真正依赖视觉证据。

**相关性简评：** 「有图/无图」与反事实敏感度直接对应视觉旁路和信息坍缩的诊断思路，可作为核查 VLM 是否使用视觉内容的证据来源；但论文未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与更新，其否定条件下近乎随机的表现可供思考证据筛选与语言先验的相对贡献。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do VLMs Really Look at the Road? A Diagnostic Evaluation for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being evaluated for autonomous driving through question-answering benchmarks, yet high benchmark accuracy does not necessarily reflect visually grounded reasoning. We present a diagnostic evaluation framework that systematically probes whether VLMs base safety-critical driving decisions on visual evidence or instead rely on language priors, answer biases, and dataset regularities. Our benchmark comprises two task categories, Adverse Weather and Junctions \\&amp; Intersections, with a nuScenes spatial reasoning extension, and evaluates open-source (general, driving, and spatial-reasoning) VLMs along four diagnostic protocols: image versus no-image evaluation, counterfactual weather sensitivity, linguistic robustness under paraphrasing and negation, and spatial reasoning. All ground-truth labels are derived programmatically from BDD100K and DriveLM annotations, enabling reproducible evaluation without manual labeling. Across all models, we find that competitive overall accuracy conceals systematic failure modes, including strong affirmation bias, limited sensitivity to counterfactual scene changes, near-chance performance on negated questions despite high paraphrase consistency, and confident driving decisions even without visual input. These results demonstrate that current open-source VLMs remain insufficiently grounded for safety-critical autonomous driving and underscore the need for diagnostic evaluation beyond aggregate accuracy.

</details>

### 14. [LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19200v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19200

**作者：** Yanjun Fu、Quanzeng You、Jiadong Guo、Yujie Lu、Sai Charitha Akula、Haiping Wu、Miao Liu、Sanghamitra Dutta、Lu Yuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19200v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19200v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** LogT 指出 SFT 数据质量是 VLM「thinking with images」的关键瓶颈，提出全自动数据引擎生成逻辑链引导的、视觉定位的难题与结构化工具调用轨迹，并在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 与 InternVL3.5-8B 上微调、在七个基准上评测，称以更少数据和算力超过需 SFT+RL 的既有方法。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉证据获取与工具调用轨迹的监督，其逻辑链轨迹构造及工具使用准确率/效率指标可供核查 LOOK/STOP 决策、停止时机与轨迹贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LogT: Logically Think with Images for Visual Search

**abstract/A1：** Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\\times$ less data and $&gt;120\\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 15. [SARGO: Agreement-Gated Reinforcement and Suppression via On-Policy Self-Guidance for Visual Hallucination Mitigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19388v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19388

**作者：** Jinyu Li、Zhiming Zhang、Hao Fang、Hongyao Yu、Bin Chen、Albert Ma、Shu-Tao Xia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19388v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19388v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SARGO 后训练框架，通过 on-policy 自引导对 token 做优势路由，配合整体优势与幻觉专用优势的一致性门控以及参考校准的响应级奖励，在降低视觉幻觉的同时保留有用视觉信息。

**相关性简评：** 其 token 级信用分配与「避免因抑制幻觉而丢失正确视觉信息」的取向，直接关联 LVR 中的贡献分配与视觉证据保留问题；但监督只在输出 token 层，未涉及内部 latent 状态，可供核查能否迁移为对 latent 证据使用的细粒度奖励。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SARGO: Agreement-Gated Reinforcement and Suppression via On-Policy Self-Guidance for Visual Hallucination Mitigation

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models remain susceptible to visual hallucinations, often mixing grounded information with unsupported claims in the same response. Response-level reinforcement learning assigns a shared advantage to all tokens in a response, causing negative updates to suppress correct information alongside unsupported claims. To reduce hallucination while preserving useful visual information, we introduce SARGO (Self-guided Advantage-Routed Grounding Optimization), a post-training framework for selective reinforcement and suppression through on-policy self-guidance. Direct and reciprocal weighting gives better-supported tokens stronger reinforcement on positive updates and weaker penalties on negative updates. Agreement between overall and hallucination-specific advantages selects when to apply this guidance. At the response level, a reference-calibrated reward couples factuality with the retention and expansion of grounded information, discouraging lower hallucination scores obtained through omission. Experiments on Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma3-4B demonstrate that SARGO outperforms the evaluated mitigation baselines across Obj-Hal, AMBER, THRONE, and SHR evaluations. SARGO achieves these gains while preserving useful visual information and general multimodal capabilities.

</details>

### 16. [Beyond Paired Inputs: Learning to Leverage RGB-T Cross-Modal Relations in Multimodal Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19493v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19493

**作者：** Tianyi Zhao、Qihao Xu、Jiawen Xi、Duanni Meng、Bo Zhao、Maoxun Yuan、Xingxing Wei、Bo Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19493v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19493v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RelMLLM，在 RGB-T 多模态大模型中把模态可靠性、跨模态关系与主导模态显式表示为可验证的决策状态，并以比较 RGB-only、TIR-only、成对输入任务结果的层次化关系引导奖励，监督模态证据、关系预测与最终输出的一致性。

**相关性简评：** 该决策状态与模态可靠性判断直接对应 VLM 推理中的视觉证据筛选和贡献分配问题，其基于任务结果的监督构造与传感器退化鲁棒性评估可供核查，尤其是该状态是否被后续推理真正使用、而非仅作辅助输出。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Paired Inputs: Learning to Leverage RGB-T Cross-Modal Relations in Multimodal Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** RGB and thermal infrared (TIR) sensors provide complementary observations, yet their distinct sensing characteristics make effective cross-modal coordination challenging. Although existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can process paired RGB-T inputs, they often fail to translate cross-modal relations into effective task-specific decisions, leaving the potential of these relations to improve task performance and robustness largely untapped. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RelMLLM, an RGB-T MLLM that explicitly learns to exploit cross-modal relations in task-specific decision making. It represents modality reliability, the cross-modal relation, and the dominant modality as a verifiable decision state. We derive task-grounded supervision for this state by comparing RGB-only, TIR-only, and paired RGB-T task outcomes. A hierarchical relation-guided reward supervises modality-specific evidence, relation-state prediction, and the final task output, while encouraging consistency across evidence, relation, and decision. We evaluate RelMLLM on natural RGB-T grounding, RGB-T visual question answering, and held-out sensor degradation. RelMLLM improves grounding accuracy and degradation robustness over its Qwen3-VL baselines while preserving performance on general RGB-T reasoning benchmarks. These results demonstrate that effectively exploiting cross-modal relations leads to more accurate and robust RGB-T decisions. Code and model weights are publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 17. [Read, Then Shade? How Visual Evidence Changes Incentive-Driven Misreporting in Vision-Language Advisors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19561v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19561

**作者：** Hamidreza Hasani Balyani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19561v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19561v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在合成场景中让四个小型开放 VLM 依据激励读取并报告轴上的数值，比较图像与文本两种输入下的虚报行为，并检验显式真值提示和输出顺序的影响。

**相关性简评：** 该工作提供了视觉证据是否真正进入报告、显式数值与输出顺序如何改变视觉依赖的行为诊断，可供核查 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、信息坍缩与证据使用；但未涉及 latent 推理状态机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Read, Then Shade? How Visual Evidence Changes Incentive-Driven Misreporting in Vision-Language Advisors

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person's. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. Adding the true value as text to the image prompt removed the gap in every model. For InternVL3 the gap vanished on scenes it read correctly when it wrote its reading first; for Gemma 3 it persisted. For Qwen2.5-VL 3B, which read every scene correctly, the gap held in four of five payoff paraphrases, nearly vanished when the model wrote its reading before its report or when the prompt stated that the client wants the truth, vanished with an unpaid goal, and persisted when the model reported before stating its reading; how often it shaded at all, even with text, depended strongly on the wording. When told that the client wants the true value, three of four models still shaded every text report. Visual input did not make these advisors reliably more truthful; it made compliance with a stated incentive depend on whether the read value is made explicit and on output order, a dependence that text-only evaluations and mean-shift metrics do not reveal.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19642

**作者：** Peize Ding

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19642v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19642v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究冻结视觉模型的隐特征是否编码两物体的相对视角方向：在相机移动而投影布局固定的渲染场景中，发现八个预训练模型均以共享的二维平面、按 (cosα, sinα) 形式编码该方向，并检验跨相机路径泛化及 PixArt-α 中该平面的形成与作用。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系视觉几何与任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态、以及读出能否外推到训练范围之外，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与表示压缩的基础；但不涉及推理状态生成或答案对 latent 的使用，联系偏表示诊断而非竞争。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the Training Cameras: Coverage-Controlled Probes of Viewing Direction in Frozen Vision Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision models are trained on 2D images of a 3D world. Do their hidden features encode the direction from which the camera views a scene, and if so, in what form? We study the relative viewing direction $α$ of two objects in rendered scenes where both object centres stay at fixed pixels while the camera moves, so that perspective, shading and shadows change but the projected layout does not. In eight pretrained models, from diffusion models to self-supervised and image-text encoders, $α$ is encoded in a strikingly simple form: a single two-dimensional plane in the hidden space, shared across scenes, in which the difference between the two objects' features traces $(\\cosα, \\sinα)$. The plane keeps its orientation when lighting, colours, floors and object shapes change. This encoding is more than a summary of a few visible measurements: readouts fitted on one set of camera paths stay accurate at camera positions outside their range in seven of the eight models, whereas decoders of the measured object and shadow geometry, equally accurate within that range, fail there. In the diffusion transformer PixArt-$α$, the plane forms abruptly at a single block and carries direction information to later blocks, yet editing it changes the objects rather than the generated viewpoint. We also examine how this encoding carries over to scanned real objects.

</details>

### 19. [TIVS: Mapping the Sensitivity Landscape of Visual Token Transformations in MLLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19745v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19745

**作者：** Yikang Qiao、Jianye Zeng、Duan Huang、Ziying Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19745v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19745v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练干预框架 TIVS，在冻结 MLLM 上分别施加序列置换、token 保留、数值精度与统计量替换，并在 192 道 POPE 题上量化准确率与个体预测的变化。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断下游利用的是视觉 token 的身份还是统计量（置换仅降 0.17 点却改变 4.69% 预测），与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留、视觉旁路和信息坍缩诊断紧密相关；但样本量小、模型单一，其敏感性景观能否外推待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TIVS: Mapping the Sensitivity Landscape of Visual Token Transformations in MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Recent efforts to improve the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have explored visual token pruning, quantization, and feature compression. However, the properties that determine whether transformed visual tokens remain usable by a frozen decoder are not well characterized. We introduce \\textbf{TIVS (Token Identity Versus Statistics)}, a training-free intervention framework that separately studies sequence permutation, token retention, numerical precision, and statistical replacement under controlled conditions. On 192 POPE questions, three token permutations change TinyLLaVA accuracy by only $-0.17$ percentage points on average, while changing 4.69\\% of individual predictions. Diagonal and rank-64 Gaussian replacements decrease accuracy by 25.0 and 28.1 points on the same subset. Further experiments with exact moment constraints, quantization error, token retention, and additional visual tasks reveal how strongly the effects depend on the original feature values and the evaluation setting. These findings provide an empirical basis for assessing visual token transformations in frozen MLLMs and designing more reliable multimodal interfaces.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables

### 20. [How Far Is Too Far? Object Recognition Declines Monotonically with Semantic Distance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19747v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19747

**作者：** Domenic Bersch、Hai Van Tran、Gemma Roig

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 ImageNet-OOC1k 基准，沿连续的物体-背景语义距离轴分级控制上下文关系，在 35 个 CNN、ViT 与视觉语言模型上发现识别准确率随语义距离单调下降，并借助 ViT 内部探针指出「聚合失败」：证据存在于 patch 层却未汇入最终预测，并用空间重排序部分纠错。

**相关性简评：** 该工作诊断的「视觉证据存在但未被最终答案使用」与 LVR 关心的视觉旁路、信息坍缩及答案是否真正利用视觉内容高度同构，其 patch 级探针与重排序可供核查能否用于评估多模态模型的 latent 证据筛选与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Far Is Too Far? Object Recognition Declines Monotonically with Semantic Distance

**abstract/A1：** Vision models are sensitive to object-background context, yet it remains unclear how recognition changes as the semantic distance between objects and backgrounds increases. We introduce ImageNet-OOC1k, a benchmark enabling graded control of object-background relationships along a continuous consensus visual-semantic dissimilarity axis. This formulation reveals a highly consistent monotonic decline in recognition accuracy across 35 models spanning convolutional neural networks, Vision Transformers, and vision-language models. Internal analyses of Vision Transformers reveal patterns consistent with aggregation failure, where object evidence is present at the patch level but not consolidated into the final prediction. Using this characterization as a diagnostic probe, a simple spatial re-ranking strategy recovers a subset of these errors and improves in-sample accuracy by up to 5.7 percentage points. These results establish context sensitivity as a continuous and predictable property of modern vision systems, with Vision Transformer analyses suggesting that aggregation limitations may contribute to some failure types even when object evidence remains available.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight)

</details>

### 21. [Fine-Grained RLAIF for Visual Safety: Learning to Zoom into Hazards for Multimodal Safety Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19786v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19786

**作者：** Chunxue Xu、Yiwei Wang、Yujun Cai、Songze Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19786v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19786v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对视觉风险细微、位于图像边缘导致多模态安全对齐失效的问题，构建1200样本细粒度安全基准，并提出FGR强化学习框架，把图像放大作为可学习的感知策略，用分解奖励分别约束「看哪里」「何时调用工具」和「如何给出有视觉依据的解释」。

**相关性简评：** 其「定位视觉证据—决定是否触发放大—再作答」的奖励分解，与关注的 LOOK/STOP 收益成本、视觉证据筛选及动态计算问题直接相关，可供核查该感知策略是否真被答案使用、以及局部放大带来的成本与泛化表现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fine-Grained RLAIF for Visual Safety: Learning to Zoom into Hazards for Multimodal Safety Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Recent multimodal safety alignment heavily relies on a text-centric paradigm, assuming risks are explicit in language or globally prominent in images. However, real-world hazards are often visually subtle or peripheral, causing existing models to fail due to their reliance on coarse, global visual representations. In this work, we study fine-grained visual safety alignment and introduce a challenging 1,200-sample benchmark across four domains, where hazards necessitate localized inspection. To address this, we propose Fine-Grained RLAIF (FGR), a reinforcement learning framework that casts image zoom-in as a learnable perception policy. FGR employs a decomposed reward design to jointly align three core safety behaviors: (i) where to look via a visual evidence reward, (ii) when to act via a tool-formatting constraint, and (iii) how to reason via visually grounded safety explanations. FGR achieves accuracy ranging from 86.71% to 93.00%, consistently outperforming strong multimodal and agent-based baselines.

</details>

### 22. [Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19803v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19803

**作者：** Rongxin Gao、Dongxuan Liu、Chu Li、Chengyang Ji、Jialing Huang、Runyu Chen、Kairun Wen、Chenxin Li、Jingrui Ye、Haosong Zhen、Xinghao Ding、Yue Huang、Yuzhi Huang、Xiaodong Tu、Jingyan Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19803v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19803v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Pros4D，把单目视频中的动态 4D 世界压缩为 latent observed states，并自回归滚动为 latent future states，同时用视觉-语义与几何的 4D Latent Alignment 和语言监督将其对接任务推理，覆盖观测动态理解与未来动态预测，并配套数据构造引擎与基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享内部 latent 状态＋前瞻滚动＋几何对齐监督」直接对应 LVR 关注的视觉几何信息是否保留在内部状态、状态如何更新及监督如何分配，可供核查 latent 状态是否真正承载几何证据而非退化为语言旁路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pros4D: Modeling Evolving 4D Worlds in Latent Space for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video enables vision-language models (VLMs) to understand how 3D environments evolve over time, supporting physical world understanding and embodied intelligence. Existing efforts primarily address observed-dynamics understanding, whereas agents in dynamic environments also require future-dynamics prediction beyond the observation boundary. Moreover, external geometric processing and textual descriptions can increase inference complexity or lose information when representing continuous dynamics. These limitations motivate a shared internal state that preserves observed dynamics and remains predictive beyond the input video. Accordingly, we present Pros4D, a framework for modeling evolving 4D worlds in latent space that unifies retrospective understanding of observed-dynamics with prospective reasoning for future-dynamics prediction. Specifically, Pros4D-Engine derives geometry-grounded supervision and constructs paired examples for both tasks, while Pros4D-Bench evaluates them across eight spatial task categories spanning dynamic cameras, objects, and scenes. At the model level, Pros4D compresses observed dynamics into latent observed states and autoregressively rolls them forward into latent future states. 4D Latent Alignment (4DLA) grounds these states through complementary visual-semantic and geometric supervision, while joint language supervision connects them to task reasoning. Experiments across benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines in both capabilities.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://pros4d.github.io/

</details>

### 23. [The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19822v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19822

**作者：** Mi Luo、Lijun Yu、Adams Wei Yu、Ang Cao、Baochen Sun、Ming-Hsuan Yang、Nan Hua、Yuan Hao、Alex Dimakis、Ya Xu、Ed H. Chi、Xuezhi Wang、Yinxiao Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19822v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19822v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FlipTest：以视觉最小对、匹配对照和密集扫描三层递进的反事实测试，在 1,680 帧、25 个仿真与真实任务上检验 11 个视频世界模型能否在「箱子位于桌沿前/后几毫米」这类边界处翻转未来预测，结果显示所有模型均失败；同帧上的 VLM 与测量图像的编码代理则能定位边界。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接诊断预测式模型是否把控制未来动力学的因果状态编码进内部表示，而非只生成合理像素；其最小对／密集扫描探针可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据与关键状态是否真正进入 latent 并影响输出，也提示「用反事实边界检验状态敏感性」这一评价思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Flip Test: Video World Models Fail to Learn the World State

**abstract/A1：** Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://flip-test.github.io/

</details>

### 24. [When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19827v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19827

**作者：** Zhizhang Hu、Yue Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19827v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19827v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在同一视觉-语言架构的三个检查点上比较十一种循环层设计与训练变体，用「是否用到额外一遍、图像状态是否随查询变化、更新是否提升检索」拆解复用层的作用，并在 MMEB-V2 上报告混合收益。

**相关性简评：** 其循环计算、查询到图像的信息通路与状态更新诊断，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 循环是否真正被使用、视觉状态是否受问题调制；但检索场景与推理仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Does Reusing Layers Help Multimodal Embeddings?

**abstract/A1：** We ask whether a compact universal multimodal embedding models can produce better search embeddings by running the same layers again. Looped transformers add computation with nearly unchanged model size, making them an appealing alternative to a larger encoder. Their success in language-model reasoning and recent use for retrieval motivate the idea, but higher retrieval scores alone do not reveal what an extra pass contributes. We study eleven loop designs and training variants on three checkpoints of one vision-language architecture. Our protocol distinguishes whether a model uses its extra pass, whether its image states respond to the query, and whether those updates improve retrieval. We prove that an image placed before the query remains query-independent through repeated layers when information only travels forward. We then open a query-to-image path in three ways, including order-alternating recurrence, which places the query first on the next pass. Each path produces query-sensitive image states. For bidirectional attention and order alternation, freezing later visual updates does not lower accuracy. On all 78 datasets of the Massive Multimodal Embedding Benchmark version 2 (MMEB-V2), a standard added loop loses 0.46 points against its trained control; an intermediate generative stage changes the effect to +0.36. A model pretrained with recurrence gains +4.23 points over its own loop-removed control and benefits from query-conditioned image updates when answering visual questions or locating objects from text.

</details>

### 25. [Glance, then Select: Evidence-Tempered Visual Token Selection for Extremely Compressed Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20006v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20006

**作者：** Yuxuan Wang、Guangxiang Zhao、Yuxuan Tian、Yahui Han、Xinyu Tan、Feiyu Wang、Zongwei Lv、Xiangzheng Zhang、Lin Sun、Tong Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20006v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20006v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Glance-ETD 两阶段视觉 token 缩减框架：先用低分辨率 glance 编码器仅重编码与问题相关的区域，再由问题条件打分器以多样性加证据的准则（ETD）选出最终 token，并配以单轨迹自蒸馏训练，宣称在 5% token 预算下保留约 91.6% 性能。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及视觉证据筛选与任务必要信息在压缩后的保留，可作为「哪些视觉细节必须留在内部状态」的对照基准；其问题条件证据打分是否真正被下游推理使用、而非仅作 token 选择依据，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Glance, then Select: Evidence-Tempered Visual Token Selection for Extremely Compressed Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode a high-resolution image into thousands of visual tokens, which dominate the cost of the prefill stage. Visual token reduction removes most of these tokens, but two problems remain at extreme budgets. The vision encoder still processes every patch of the image, and the few surviving tokens often miss the small regions that hold the answer. In this paper, we propose Glance-ETD, a two-stage token reduction framework guided by a lightweight question-conditioned scorer. In the first stage, a glance encoder views the image at low resolution and re-encodes only the question-relevant regions at native resolution. In the second stage, Evidence-Tempered Diversity (ETD) selects the final tokens by combining diversity with the evidence predicted by the scorer, so that the kept tokens cover the scene and retain the answer. A single-rollout self-distillation recipe trains the MLLM with the glance encoder. With only 5% of the visual tokens, Glance-ETD retains 91.6% of the full-token performance of Qwen3.5-4B across fourteen benchmarks and outperforms the strongest prior method, LT-OPD, by 17.3 points and the same training recipe with DivPrune by 6.0. It also speeds up the time to first token on 4K images by 3.1x and generalizes to three other MLLMs and to high-resolution document benchmarks, with the largest gains on text-rich tasks.

</details>

### 26. [ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20011

**作者：** Nikos Theodoridis、Reenu Mohandas、Sushil Sharma、Ciarán Hogan、Ganesh Sistu、Anthony Scanlan、Tim Brophy、Ciarán Eising

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20011v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ReactBench-AD 驾驶基准：在真实 NAVSIM 与 PhysicalAI 场景中，跨全部相机视角与历史帧一致地合成横穿行人、静止行人和静止车辆，形成像素级反事实对照，评估四个 VLA 与两个 WAM 对路径上突发物体的反应，并通过短微调检验该反应能否被教出。

**相关性简评：** 像素级反事实对可隔离视觉证据对输出轨迹的因果作用，为核查「答案是否真正使用视觉内容」及视觉旁路、信息坍缩提供可借鉴的评价范式；其反应微弱的结果也可供核查多模态模型是否忽略任务必要的视觉细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReactBench-AD: Do Driving VLAs and World-Action Models React to Imminent Hazards in Their Path?

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.

</details>

### 27. [GEM-MM: Reducing VLM Hallucination with Entropy-Guided Preference Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20016v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20016

**作者：** Yuanshan Chua、Xuejiao Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20016v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20016v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出多模态偏好预算有限时 DPO 类目标对策略不确定性「熵盲」，提出 GEM-MM：采样 on-policy 候选，奖励高熵推理分叉、惩罚不确定终答，并以组归一化策略梯度更新，在 MM-RLHF 预算下降低 AMBER、CHAIR 幻觉。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应推理轨迹的贡献分配与视觉证据使用：高熵分叉 token 正是视觉主张出现处，可供核查「THINK 是否有益」及幻觉成因，但其作用在显式 token 轨迹而非 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GEM-MM: Reducing VLM Hallucination with Entropy-Guided Preference Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) are routinely aligned with offline pairwise RLHF objectives, but multimodal preference data is scarce and treats every response token as equally informative. Under a small preference budget, pair construction becomes nearly irrelevant: standard DPO-style, image-conditional, and self-improvement objectives all perform within 1.1 points on MM-RLHF metrics and 0.5 points on hallucination rates, matching the SFT baseline. We call this entropy-blind preference optimization: the learning signal ignores policy uncertainty, which in chain-of-thought VLMs concentrates on specific fork tokens where visual claims are made. We introduce GEM-MM, extending entropy-guided preference modeling to VLMs. It samples on-policy candidates, rewards high-entropy reasoning forks, penalizes uncertain final answers, and updates the model via group-normalized policy gradients. On a 3000-prompt MM-RLHF budget with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, GEM-MM achieves the best entropy-depth preference score (61.7% vs. 57.3-58.4% baselines) and implicit-reward accuracy (41.4%). Crucially, it reduces AMBER hallucination from 23.4-24.0 to 20.6 and CHAIR from 5.0-5.1 to 4.6 at matched caption coverage. It also ranks best on all three HallusionBench granularities, with a conservative operating point raising the near-chosen rate to 62.4%. An off-the-shelf multimodal reward model ranks GEM-MM first, and two such models independently confirm our main ablations (p &lt; 0.001). We report confidence intervals, paired significance tests, metric-reward functional overlaps, and document a collapse mode when exceeding the fair budget. Code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/SNOWTEAM2023/GEM-MM

</details>

### 28. [Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20278v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20278

**作者：** Jiazhen Liu、Yanghao Wang、Chaolei Tan、Long Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20278v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20278v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SelfMark，让 MLLM 直接在原生视觉 token 网格上「画标记」，通过 locate-mark-read 流程构建带明确空间对应的中间视觉状态来引导推理，并在空间规划、密集计数、高分辨率 VQA、线条追踪上联合训练单一模型。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线高度相关：它明确把「无空间对应的 latent token」作为对照，主张中间推理状态需与输入图像保持空间对齐，可供核查视觉证据筛选、标记状态的读取方式及这类视觉旁路是否真被答案使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Marking as a Native Reasoning Capability for Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Visual reasoning often requires maintaining intermediate spatial states that are difficult to express in text. Existing approaches either rely on external drawing tools or image generators, or encode these states in latent tokens without explicit spatial correspondence to the input image. We introduce SelfMark, which enables MLLMs to construct and use visual marks directly in their native visual feature space. By treating the visual token grid as a canvas, SelfMark establishes explicit spatial correspondence between marks and images. This is achieved through a locate-mark-read procedure, where the model identifies relevant locations, constructs task-dependent mark features, and reads the resulting visual features to guide its reasoning. We jointly train a single model on spatial planning, dense counting, high-resolution VQA, and line tracing. Across six benchmarks, SelfMark outperforms state-of-the-art MLLM-based methods specialized for individual tasks. These improvements also persist with a stronger backbone, demonstrating the effectiveness of visual marking across different model capabilities. Overall, SelfMark provides a unified approach to visual reasoning by integrating spatially grounded marks directly into the visual feature space of MLLMs.

</details>

### 29. [Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20349v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20349

**作者：** Wenhao Li、Chong Xiao、Xiaokun Bai、Rundong He、Zhuang Qi、Xusheng Liang、Zhibin Wu、Qiangchang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20349v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20349v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发现以 LLM 作融合引擎的不完整多模态学习存在「语言捷径」：文本证据会压制模型本可读到的非语言证据，作者据此构建 MR-Bench（含 900 条人工校验片段）诊断该现象，并提出 CoVeR——把各模态视图训练成单模态评判者、在视图分歧处撤除融合监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「融合状态在解码后期逐渐向文本视图对齐」的状态分析与反事实视图监督，直接对应视觉旁路、信息坍缩及答案是否真正使用非语言内容的问题，可为 latent 证据留存与监督分配设计提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Words Speak Louder? Exploring the Language Shortcut of LLM-Driven Incomplete Multimodal Learning

**abstract/A1：** Is a face or a voice still heard once the words are known? Incomplete multimodal learning increasingly uses large language models (LLMs) as fusion engines: modality features enter as token blocks and missing modalities become placeholders. We find that LLM-driven fusion can override non-verbal evidence it can read. Contrasting its full-input prediction with counterfactual views, the same model shown one modality or no content, we identify language shortcuts. We build MR-Bench: MR-Bench-A types every test sample of four sentiment benchmarks; MR-Bench-H contains 900 human-validated clips (620 language-shortcut, LS; 280 non-verbal-shortcut, NS) from seven sources, and every model is scored on all of them. Zero-shot MLLMs solve at most 32.7% of the LS clips; adding the transcript to the muted video lowers vision-language accuracy by 46.1-53.1 points. Yet inverting a text-only model's answers solves 94.4%, so LS accuracy alone cannot establish use of non-verbal evidence. Inside the fusion LLM, fused states align increasingly with the text view late in the decoder. Counterfactual-View Reliability learning (CoVeR) trains views as unimodal judges and withholds fused supervision where they disagree. It achieves state-of-the-art results on five benchmarks without extra inference cost in accuracy mode. On MR-Bench-H, it reaches 61.7% LS and 93.6% NS accuracy; robust mode raises LS accuracy to 63.0% while lowering NS accuracy to 84.8%. Among LS clips solved without text, adding text causes errors on 30.1% with CoVeR versus 32.2% with LLM-Fusion. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/CoVeR/.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/CoVeR/

</details>

### 30. [EVIDENT: Evaluating Evidence Grounding in GUI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20488v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20488

**作者：** Yerin Nam、Minkyung Cho、MinKyu Kim、SeungWoo Song、Hangyeol Yoo、Jihyo Kim、KyungTae Lim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20488v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20488v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 EVIDENT，一个面向 GUI agent 的证据驱动基准，包含 220 个真实网页任务与人工标注的必要证据元数据，并用 TSR、ESR、GSR 三个指标区分「表层完成任务」与「答案确有观察证据支撑」。

**相关性简评：** 它把答案是否真正使用观察到的视觉证据单独度量，是可直接借鉴的失败诊断与评价框架，有助于核查 VLM 推理中视觉旁路与「答案不使用所获证据」问题；但任务为 GUI 导航，未涉及 latent 状态，需自行判断迁移程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EVIDENT: Evaluating Evidence Grounding in GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** GUI agents are increasingly evaluated by whether they complete web tasks, but surface success can hide a critical failure: the final answer may not be supported by evidence observed during navigation. We introduce EVIDENT, an evidence-driven benchmark for evaluating whether GUI agents ground their decisions in observable web evidence. EVIDENT contains 220 real-world English and Korean tasks spanning semantic grounding, contextual inference, and visual grounding, each paired with human-curated evidence metadata specifying what must be verified. We further separate surface task completion from evidence-grounded success using three metrics: TSR, ESR, and GSR, which respectively measure outcome success, required evidence observation, and claim-level evidence support. Experiments on commercial and open-source GUI agents reveal substantial gaps between surface success and evidence-grounded success, especially in contextual and visual tasks. These results show that current evaluations can overestimate agent reliability and highlight the need to assess not only whether agents answer, but whether they verify.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to EACL 2027 Findings. 36 pages

</details>

### 31. [How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20505v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20505

**作者：** Chaehee Song、Seokil Ham、KiHyun Seol、Jihyun Lee、Yubin Choi、Changick Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20505v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20505v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文系统检验 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝中「选择信号」的可靠性：在语义保持扰动下发现注意力重要性局部不稳，且不同准则选出的子集差异明显却性能相近，并据此提出免训练的 CoRePruner，将指令感知多样性与可靠性加权注意力结合。

**相关性简评：** 其「注意力显著性≠稳定证据」的诊断与「有用证据不唯一」的观察，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及注意力结构对 latent 内容的影响；但方法面向推理效率，未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Reliable Is Visual Token Selection? Rethinking Pruning in Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Visual token pruning improves the efficiency of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by removing redundant visual tokens, yet the reliability of existing selection signals has not been systematically examined. We analyze token selection under semantics-preserving perturbations and across representative pruning criteria, revealing two limitations. First, attention-based importance shifts non-uniformly under perturbations, so magnitude alone cannot distinguish stable evidence from unstable saliency (local instability). Second, attention- and diversity-based methods select substantially different subsets despite comparable performance, showing that useful evidence is not confined to a unique subset (global inconsistency). These findings motivate reliable token-set construction. We instantiate this perspective in CoRePruner, a training-free framework combining instruction-aware diversity with reliability-aware attention. Across image benchmarks, multiple MLLM architectures, and token budgets, CoRePruner improves performance, especially under aggressive pruning, and remains competitive on video benchmarks. Our results establish reliability as a central consideration in visual token selection.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027

</details>

### 32. [RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20653v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20653

**作者：** Jianye Zeng、Qiao Yikang、Duan Huang、Ziying Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20653v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20653v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RAMP 框架，在固定模型与配对视觉问题上系统比较 yes/no logit、表面形式分数和 typed/reversed A/B 等答案读出协议，并用 POPE、ChartQA 等展示读出方式可让准确率变动数十个百分点、且逐题预测大量翻转。

**相关性简评：** 这是多模态评价侧的诊断工作：它说明读出协议本身就能左右得分，可供核查 LVR 与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 类方法在准确率比较中是否被答案解析差异混淆，尤其涉及配对翻转与校准分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAMP: Rethinking Multimodal Evaluation through Answer Readout Protocols

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are often evaluated by converting model outputs into discrete answers. The conversion protocol determines which scores become predictions and can strongly influence the reported results. We introduce RAMP (Readout Aware Multimodal Protocol), a systematic framework that compares direct yes/no token logits, surface-form scores, and typed or reversed A/B interfaces under fixed model checkpoints and paired visual questions. On 500 POPE adversarial questions, typed versus bare readout changes accuracy by $-20.2$ percentage points for SmolVLM-256M, $-16.4$ for TinyLLaVA-1.1B, and $+1.8$ for Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Paired transitions reveal extensive prediction changes even when the net accuracy difference is small: 79 of 104 binary ChartQA items change correctness for SmolVLM-500M, despite a $+1.0$-point net difference. We further analyze prompt wording, candidate forms, option position, cross-task effects, and calibration. An independent offline replay reproduces 16,140 first-token decisions from saved raw scores with exact agreement. Our findings establish answer readout as a measurable component of multimodal evaluation and provide a reproducible protocol for analyzing model comparisons.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 9 figures, 1 table

</details>

### 33. [Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20897v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20897

**作者：** Sadia Parveen、Tehseen Zia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20897v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20897v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在基于单个门控双向选择性状态空间块、面向肺结节恶性的概念瓶颈模型中，检验「Delta 门控即解释」的假设，给出使输出对闭锁 token 精确不变的掩码条件及核查流程，并在 LIDC-IDRI 上以 15 个交叉验证模型的逐路径 knockout 做预注册审计。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接诊断「被门控排除的视觉 token 是否真的不影响预测」，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献归因的可解释性声明是否有精确保证，其「门控只是掩码监督产出的支持集、事后 ranker 排序更好」的结论也值得与 latent 证据选择机制对照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Certified, Not Explained: Exact Token Erasure in Gated Vision State Space Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision models built on Mamba are often explained through their selective step size Delta, on the assumption that a token the scan does not admit cannot influence the prediction. We test that in a concept bottleneck model for lung-nodule malignancy built on a single gated, bidirectional selective state-space block. The answer becomes an interpretability framework: a guarantee, a procedure that checks it, and a pre-registered audit of what it explains. For a fixed gate pattern, masking the input of the causal convolution of the block and giving closed tokens zero weight at readout makes the concept and task logits exactly invariant to the closed tokens. Gating Delta is neither necessary nor sufficient. On LIDC-IDRI, a path-by-path knockout over 15 cross-validated models agrees with this in every run: the largest logit change is exactly 0 whenever the conditions hold and between 4.1 and 6.7 when they do not. The gated model reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUROC of 0.8425 +/- 0.0085, level with an ungated Mamba bottleneck (0.8428). The guarantee belongs to the masked model, not to the gate as an explanation. Post-hoc rankers, which inherit the guarantee on this model, order tokens better than the gate. Gate maps from a model trained on permuted labels are as close to the real maps as two real-label seeds are to each other. Under retraining, the tokens of the gate carry more task information than random tokens and, on shifted crops, more than central ones, but no more than the tokens chosen by hidden attention. We therefore read the gate as a certified support set produced by mask supervision. Splitting the Oracle Impurity Score into own-concept and cross-concept parts reveals differences the aggregate score misses. Partitioning the readout reduced leakage slightly under an earlier recipe, and the final model sits at, rather than below, the level implied by correlations among the true concepts.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 34. [EviBridge: Encoding Predictive Visual Evidence for Proactive Interaction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20916v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20916

**作者：** Zhichao Huang、Changheng Cai、Song Ren、Zhichen Zhao、Hongsen Liu、Chaoyang Zheng、Wenxi Wu、Yichen Long、Yuan Fang、Luya Wang、Gufeng Liu、Yuchen Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20916v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20916v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 EviBridge 框架，将冻结 V-JEPA 2 编码器的预测性视觉特征经可训练「证据接口」注入视觉语言解码器，在流式视频中联合预测交互状态与工具，并判断证据是否足以响应或应取消；在 FuGIBench 上以两种实例化（E 区分近期与历史证据并编码时空位置，I 保留特征与轮次时序并生成交互 token）取得明显提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据接口」把预测性视觉 latent 保留时序送入解码器、并在交互决策中判断证据是否充分（响应/等待/取消），与 LVR 关注的视觉证据保留、STOP 决策及证据筛选直接相关，可供核查 latent 注入方式与停止判据；但任务目标是交互时机而非显式推理轨迹生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EviBridge: Encoding Predictive Visual Evidence for Proactive Interaction

**abstract/A1：** Tool-handover interaction calls for preparation before a response is warranted. The model waits until interaction cues appear, then prepares while assessing whether the accumulating evidence supports a response or calls for cancellation. We introduce EviBridge, a framework that integrates predictive visual representations into a vision-language interaction model for joint state and tool prediction. A trainable evidence interface maps features from a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder into the language decoder alongside native visual inputs, preserving their temporal context and using only observations available at each decision time. The framework has two instantiations. EviBridge-E distinguishes recent from historical evidence and encodes the timing and spatial location of each observation. EviBridge-I preserves the temporal order of pooled V-JEPA 2 features and interaction turns and generates dedicated interaction tokens. We evaluate on FuGIBench, a streaming-video benchmark for preparation, response, and cancellation in tool-handover assistance. The best-performing variants of EviBridge-E and EviBridge-I achieve Overall scores of 0.6448 and 0.5892, compared with 0.2178 and 0.5327 for their respective task-adapted native baselines. These gains span target handovers, long waits, and cancelled requests, demonstrating the value of predictive visual evidence for interaction decisions.

</details>
