### 35. [ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20936v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20936

**作者：** Tianhao Chen、Yilong Fan、Yuheng Wu、Xiaobin Hu、Dongman Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20936v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20936v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReAccess，在一次视觉 prefill 中构建紧凑关联记忆来保存并复用与问题相关的视觉证据，并通过渐进式证据检索调控注意力查询与隐状态，从而避免重复图像编码与显式推理轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「视觉证据能否留在内部状态并被答案真正使用」这一问题，其单次编码加记忆复用可作为降低 LOOK 成本、缓解视觉信息坍缩的可核查替代路径；记忆里究竟存了什么、以及答案是否因果依赖它，仍需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReAccess: Look Once, Stay Focused with Efficient Test Time Memory

**abstract/A1：** Despite recent advances, vision-language models (VLMs) still struggle with fine-grained visual understanding, often failing to effectively utilize critical evidence already encoded in their visual representations. Existing approaches address this limitation through repeated visual processing or explicit reasoning, introducing substantial computational overhead. In this paper, we propose ReAccess, a lightweight framework that preserves and reuses question-relevant visual evidence through compact associative memory. Constructed during a single visual prefill, the memory supports progressive evidence retrieval that steers both attention queries and hidden representations, enabling effective visual grounding without repeated image encoding or explicit reasoning traces. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in both general visual understanding and fine-grained perception, while achieving substantially faster inference than existing reasoning-intensive approaches, demonstrating a promising path to efficient multimodal reasoning.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://ryu1ion.github.io/reaccess/

</details>

### 36. [POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21033v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21033

**作者：** Jaehyuk Lee、Yeajin Lee、Suhyun Bae、Donghun Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21033v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21033v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** POKE 面向 VLA 模型的视觉 token 剪枝，提出以「换成该相机均值 token 时动作的一阶变化」定义 action sensitivity，指出在已剪枝计算图上打分会产生 scoring-graph lock-in（被删 token 后续失去直达路径、分数偏低而难以回归），改为在完整图上离线计算敏感度并蒸馏进不足 0.3M 参数的学生模型，推理时无需反传或历史掩码即可打分并做多样性选择。

**相关性简评：** 其核心正是「哪些视觉 token 真正影响输出」的因果式贡献度量与证据筛选，且对剪枝后自评分导致的偏差做了诊断，可供核查是否能用于 LVR 中视觉证据保留与 latent 内容坍缩的判断；但任务为机器人动作预测，与多步推理状态的联系仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models

**abstract/A1：** Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $π\_{0.5}$ at $1.85\\times$ and $1.26\\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.

</details>

### 37. [VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21392v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21392

**作者：** Yancheng Long、Xuanyu Zheng、Wei Chen、Luoyuan Zhang、Haoyang Xu、Bin Wen、Tingting Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21392v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21392v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** VideoNexus 是一个免训练的长视频问答框架：planner 决定查看何处、解析什么、以多大密度采样，perception 子代理在独立上下文中处理原始音视频，仅回传紧凑、时间定位的证据供迭代检索与验证，并在 LVBench 等设定上以更低 API 成本取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「视觉证据筛选＋压缩状态交换」问题：它把视觉细节留在子代理上下文、只向推理侧传递紧凑证据，其准确率—成本权衡可供核查 LOOK 密度、STOP 时机与上下文增长的取舍；但交换的是显式文本证据而非 latent 状态，能否迁移到内部表示需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context

**abstract/A1：** Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.

</details>

### 38. [Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21457v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21457

**作者：** Meng Tang、Siyuan Du、Yuxin Liu、Shuaishuai Cao、Di Wang、Haonan Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21457v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21457v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究超高分辨率遥感问答中，将高分辨率裁剪块编码为少量连续 visual latent memory token（冻结主干、丢弃裁剪 token）能否保留细粒度局部证据，并通过替换他图/他区域 memory、清零与恢复原裁剪的对照实验检验预测对 latent 内容的依赖。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 关注的两点：压缩 latent 状态是否保留任务必要的视觉细节，以及答案是否真正使用 latent 内容——其「替换来源」因果对照可供核查 latent 相似度与内容依赖诊断的设计，同时把证据可用性与区域选择解耦，可能有助于区分 LOOK 的贡献。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing

**abstract/A1：** Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.

</details>

### 39. [Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21485v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21485

**作者：** Henry Zheng、Weibo Gong、Yang Yue、Rui Huang、Yang Zhang、Gao Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21485v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21485v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReSpaceBench 基准，用 590 个合成与真实家居场景中的 3,244 个问题评估具身智能体跨多次到访的持久空间记忆，并提供无重叠训练集 RS-30K 及微调结果。

**相关性简评：** 其房间关联、跨会话状态跟踪及证据遗漏等失败分析，可供核查 VLM 在多次 LOOK 中如何保留和更新视觉证据、何时停止搜索，但研究对象是空间记忆而非 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits

**abstract/A1：** Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

</details>

### 40. [Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21539v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21539

**作者：** Zhaoning Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21539v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21539v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5、Gemma-3 上沿视觉 token 到答案字母逐层追踪跨图像匹配失败，指出两处断点——比较已发生但未被读出、语义对应未进入答案——并定位到 16-32 个承载比较的注意力头，仅训练其 query/key 投影（约 0.02% 参数）即显著修复 SPair-71k、HPatches 与 BLINK 表现。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「视觉证据是否保留在内部状态、答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」这一线索：探针可解码却超不过校准输出、剖面重分配注意力即抹去 17-32 点精度，可供核查 LVR 中「信息存在但未参与读出」的伪贡献与注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响，其低参数 QK 修复思路也可能与训练监督设计相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 3 figures, 19 tables

</details>

### 41. [BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness &amp; Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21553v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21553

**作者：** Kanchana Ranasinghe、Honglu Zhou、Dominick Reilly、Le Xue、Shusheng Yang、Juan Carlos Niebles、Silvio Savarese、Ran Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21553v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21553v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BLIP-Live 框架，把流式视频中的「主动响应」统一为数据（BLIP-Live-780K 标注内容与时序）、指标（PAUC-F 结合及时性与触发精度）、推理 harness 与训练流程，并发现滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆与结构化输出组合效果最佳。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是「证据是否充分、何时该响应/保持沉默」的因果触发决策，与 LVR 的 STOP 决策、证据筛选及动态计算成本直接相关，可供核查及时性—误触发权衡的度量与监督方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness &amp; Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents

**abstract/A1：** Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.

</details>

### 42. [ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21605v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21605

**作者：** Huawei Lin、Jinting Liu、Tongyan Wang、Xuyang Chen、Ruihua Shi、Zhichao Xu、Jiaxin Qin、Guoshenghui Zhao、Baijian Yang、Yingjie Victor Chen、Tan Yu、Weijie Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21605v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21605v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization（CrossRPO），用仅在某一小区域不同、答案各异的对比图像集训练超高分辨率视觉 agent，使其必须放大读取证据而非依赖常识作答，并构建 21–120 百万像素的训练集、编辑式评测集与真实拍摄评测集。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「LOOK」阶段的证据获取与奖励分配问题：集级对比奖励可抑制凭先验猜测，其对比集构造方式可供核查 agent 是否真正使用所获视觉证据，以及如何为视觉证据筛选设计监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ViRA: Toward Ultra-High-Resolution Visual Agents via Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.

### 43. [Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19122v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19122

**作者：** Rui Zou、Mengqi Wei、Xin Zhao、Ji-Rong Wen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19122v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19122v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Agent-Guided Process Verification（AGPV）：把数学解答拆成有序关键断言逐条核查（必要时调用共享数学工具箱），在首个错误处停止，再由摘要 agent 将失败证据转成诊断，指导修正 agent 从该点重新推导，并逐轮调整后续验证，此外还检验解答的完整性。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本的步骤级验证—首错停止—诊断驱动修正闭环，可作为 LVR 中何时停止思考、如何从局部证据定位并回写推理状态的参照，但其显式断言核查与 latent 状态生成差异较大，迁移可能性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent-Guided Process Verification for Mathematical Self-Correction

**abstract/A1：** Large language models have made substantial progress in mathematical reasoning, yet in complex multi-step reasoning, an error at any step may propagate along an incorrect path, and the resulting solution may omit necessary branches. Existing natural-language reflection methods often struggle to locate critical errors precisely, while outcome verification typically checks only whether the available candidate answers satisfy the problem conditions and can therefore overlook necessary branches. To address these limitations, we propose Agent-Guided Process Verification (AGPV) for mathematical self-correction. AGPV decomposes the current solution into an ordered sequence of key claims, verifies them individually while invoking a shared mathematical toolbox when needed, and stops upon detecting the first error. A summarization agent converts the failure evidence into a diagnosis that guides a correction agent to re-derive the subsequent solution from that point; AGPV then adapts the next verification iteration to the revised solution. AGPV also verifies solution completeness. We further prove that AGPV guarantees solution correctness and completeness when key claims provide sufficient coverage and local verification is reliable, provided that all key claims pass verification. The implementation compresses long working contexts and reuses successful tool results within each problem. We evaluate AGPV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with four models from DeepSeek, Qwen, and GPT. AGPV achieves an average accuracy of 63.8%, outperforming the strongest among the representative baselines evaluated (50.3%) by 13.5 percentage points, with higher repair coverage than the programmatic-verification baselines.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 44. [When Does Confidence Reveal Problem Difficulty?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19173v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19173

**作者：** Xiyu Bao、Langyuan Cui、Hwee Tou Ng、Chun Kai Ling

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19173v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19173v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文系统比较多种置信度相关信号（扰动不一致性、语义熵、解答长度、token 级不确定性）与群体问题难度的关联，并检验这些信号在推理时决策中的可用性与局限。

**相关性简评：** 其「难度探测信号」可供核查是否能用于 LVR 的 STOP 与动态计算分配，尤其是扰动不一致性和语义熵能否在视觉推理中稳定反映任务难度而非仅自我纠错。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Does Confidence Reveal Problem Difficulty?

**abstract/A1：** While confidence signals are commonly evaluated for their ability to predict a model's own correctness, their relationship with problem difficulty remains less understood. In this work, we investigate a wide range of confidence-related signals and whether they can serve as indicators of problem difficulty across various task domains. We find that perturbation inconsistency, semantic entropy, and solution length exhibit strong associations with population difficulty than token-level uncertainty. Notably, these relationships persist even when restricting the analysis to problems correctly answered by the focal model, suggesting that such signals capture information about difficulty beyond their ability to predict the model's own correctness. We further explore applications of these signals, illustrating the potential and limitations of using confidence-related signals to guide inference-time decisions. Our findings highlight the utility of model-specific signals as imperfect but informative proxies for population-level problem difficulty.

</details>

### 45. [Size-Matched Nulls Reveal What Block Ablation Measures in MambaVision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19248v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19248

**作者：** Tahmina Kousar、Tehseen Zia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19248v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19248v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 MambaVision 上用尺寸匹配的零对照（通道打乱或符号翻转）配对每个块消融，在 ImageNet 全验证集和三个模型尺寸上发现真实与零消融造成的损伤几乎无法区分，并据此提出混合网络的因果归因协议。

**相关性简评：** 其「对齐零假设」与成对块复合效应设计，可供核查 LVR 中消融式贡献分配是否混入了扰动规模、位置等混淆，为评价 latent 组件的因果作用提供方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Size-Matched Nulls Reveal What Block Ablation Measures in MambaVision

**abstract/A1：** Hybrid vision backbones interleave Mamba state-space mixers with self-attention, and a block's role is usually probed by removing it and measuring the damage. We test what that measurement means in MambaVision. On all 50,000 ImageNet validation images and three model sizes, every block ablation is paired with a size-matched null, the same perturbation with its channels shuffled or their signs flipped. In top-1 accuracy and in true-class rank, real and null damage are nearly indistinguishable in absolute terms: pooled over the blocks of MambaVision-T, the content effect lies within \[-0.044,+0.016\] percentage points (90% interval). Two attention-only controls show that the test detects content, with real ablations worse than their nulls by up to 4.2 points in DeiT-Small and 1.0 point in Swin-T. Part of MambaVision's near-equivalence reflects how little damage its blocks do (0.11--0.34 points on average, against 1.7 and 2.1). Scaled by damage, its content share is comparable to Swin-T's in accuracy, lower in rank, and far below DeiT-Small's: single-block damage in MambaVision is small and mostly positional. Ablation also hides what blocks carry together: removing all blocks of one type compounds damage to 3.7--8.4 times the sum of single effects, far more than size-matched nulls, including nulls that keep the alignment between the blocks' perturbations; for adjacent pairs, aligned nulls reproduce most of it. Freezing input-dependent selection in all Mamba mixers shows that it accounts for 20--32% of the Mamba contribution, mainly through the B and C projections. We turn these results into a protocol for causal attribution in hybrid networks.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 46. [Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19446v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19446

**作者：** Lucia Licakova、Niklas Schmidinger、Lukas Hauzenberger、Sebastian Böck、Sepp Hochreiter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19446v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19446v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在统一的深度循环框架下比较两类结构：一是重复 Transformer 层栈的 looped hybrid（用 mLSTM 或 Gated DeltaNet 替换多数注意力层、保留周期性注意力锚点），二是 Parcae 式专用循环工作区；并提出 recurrent KV replay，只让部分循环迭代写入 KV 供后续迭代复用，以削减自回归解码的显存增长。

**相关性简评：** 专用循环工作区与跨迭代 KV 共享直接触及迭代推理中缓存结构、注意力锚点频率与计算/显存成本，可供核查 LVR 多轮 latent 更新时状态复用与「LOOK/STOP」预算的设计；但该文为纯文本语言建模，未涉及视觉证据与推理行为，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid. Finally, we train a looped Transformer with recurrent KV replay, where only selected recurrence iterations write KV states that later iterations reuse. This trains the model to operate with the same shared KV topology used during inference. We find that looped hybrids require sufficiently frequent attention anchors, with performance depending strongly on the recurrent mixer. For cross-iteration KV sharing, recurrent KV replay allows multiple recurrence iterations to reuse the same KV states while retaining performance close to the full looped Transformer with separate KV caches for each iteration.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 - LIGHT Workshop

</details>

### 47. [Before the Word: Name Information in Description-Derived States of Small Language Models, With and Without Naming Failure](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19609v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19609

**作者：** Fernando Cardenas Piepereit

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19609v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19609v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究以「话到嘴边」为类比，在 Qwen2-0.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B、Phi-3-mini 三种小模型、200 个条目上检验：模型能否从无名称的描述中形成可预测名称的内部状态，并考察命名失败时该状态是否仍与描述复述一致；手段为相似度读出、Patchscopes 式读出与配匹配对照的激活 patching。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本探测，但其相似度读出与 patching 对层深、位置（多位点 vs 单一位点）高度敏感、且不同读出方法结论不一致，可供核查 LVR 中「latent 是否携带任务必要信息」的检验设计与读出可靠性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Before the Word: Name Information in Description-Derived States of Small Language Models, With and Without Naming Failure

**abstract/A1：** The tip-of-the-tongue (TOT) state, knowing an object but not its name, motivates this study as an analogy only. We ask whether small language models form a name-predictive state from a name-free description, and whether it differs when naming fails but description selection succeeds. In an internally pre-registered study (a frozen document, no external registry) of Qwen2-0.5B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Phi-3-mini with 200 items, we combine a similarity read-out, a Patchscopes-style read-out and activation patching with matched controls. H1 (name information in the state) was supported in all nine model-by-description-type combinations; the agreement rule was met by the similarity measure together with patching, while Patchscopes stayed near chance. Post-hoc robustness checks after internal review (logit lens, single-position patch, manipulation check) temper this reading: name information in middle layers is clearest under the multi-position patch and the similarity measure, and weak under single-position patching at 50% depth. H2' (description-paraphrase consistency of name-free states not lower in failure items) is mixed: the SmolLM2 deficit test is significant under the pre-registered specification but not robust; Phi-3 non-inferiority holds across margins and a word-overlap covariate, although its bootstrap interval includes zero; Qwen2-0.5B is inconclusive. A capacity explanation remains untested. We report vehicle-level signals only, not meaning.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 9 tables. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24228887

</details>

### 48. [The Sense Paradigm for World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19796v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19796

**作者：** Haidong Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19796v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19796v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Sense，用建立在有向距离上的单一交叉熵损失替代目标网络、方差惩罚或分布惩罚等防坍缩机制，训练潜空间世界模型的编码器，并将预测器事后回归拟合；在四个像素环境中检验不可逆转移识别与规划表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「单一损失即可防表示坍缩并让潜距离承载可解释语义」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的信息坍缩诊断、latent 相似度是否保留任务状态差异及转移可逆性提供方法线索，尚需核查该几何在视觉推理状态上的适用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Sense Paradigm for World Models

**abstract/A1：** Latent world models predict the future in an embedding space rather than in pixels. An encoder trained only to predict collapses and maps every observation to the same point, so existing models add a mechanism against collapse, such as a target network, a variance penalty or a distribution penalty. These mechanisms keep the embedding from collapsing, but they leave its distances without meaning, and the model cannot tell a reversible transition from an irreversible one. We propose Sense, a single cross-entropy loss over the directed distance $d(x\\to y)=\\sum\_i \\mathrm{ReLU}(y\_i-x\_i)$ that replaces these mechanisms. The loss avoids collapse on its own, and since the encoder no longer needs the predictor, the predictor is fitted afterwards to fixed embeddings by plain regression. On four pixel environments, the return distance learned by Sense detects irreversible transitions with an AUC between 0.95 and 1.00, where LeWorldModel stays between 0.39 and 0.59. On TwoRoom, the navigation benchmark of LeWorldModel, planning with Sense reaches the goal in 100% of episodes against 91% for LeWorldModel. As the goal moves farther away, the planning failure rate of every baseline grows, while that of Sense stays near zero in Cup, Cliff and Sokoban and is the lowest of all methods in Pendulum.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 49. [Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19871v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19871

**作者：** Peng Yu、Luoyi Fu、Xinbing Wang、Ying Wen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19871v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19871v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RISE，把结构化强化学习环境从上游预筛选的静态子图改为全规模交互式知识图谱，借助五阶段类型化意图适配器、受限调用预算与 grounding 奖励门控扩展决策空间，并用结构层级递进结合能力前沿 bandit 缓解组内方差坍缩。

**相关性简评：** 文中指出预筛选子图会通过局部拓扑泄漏答案位置，并把路径选择、候选剪枝与最优停止还原为真实策略决策；这一诊断与评测思路可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据预筛选或裁剪是否造成捷径，以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策是否被环境结构替代。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axes. First, Decision-Space Scaling exposes the unpruned knowledge graph via a five-stage graph-agnostic typed intent adapter under a bounded call budget and a multiplicative grounding reward gate. Second, Learning-Frontier Scaling overcomes within-group variance collapse under group-normalized objectives by uniting model-independent structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit. Across nineteen benchmarks and three model backbones, RISE substantially advances in-domain and unseen-schema knowledge-graph reasoning, transfers zero-shot to open-domain passage retrieval, and significantly enhances out-of-domain mathematical and logical deduction.

</details>

### 50. [Learning When to Continue and When to Stop: Termination-Aware OPSD](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19925v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19925

**作者：** Chaoqun He、Wannian Yi、Changyi Sun、Chaojun Xiao、Lijie Wen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19925v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19925v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文指出 on-policy self-distillation 存在终止不匹配，表现为过早停止与重复导致的过度生成，并据此提出 TA-OPSD，在原有目标上加入 stop/continue 蒸馏对齐与重复感知 unlikelihood 训练，在 Qwen3 数学推理上验证其优于 OPSD 等基线。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本自蒸馏，但其把「是否继续」作为显式对齐目标并对无效重复施加抑制，与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策、循环生成何时判定停滞的问题直接相关，可供核查停止信号与计算浪费的对应关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning When to Continue and When to Stop: Termination-Aware OPSD

**abstract/A1：** On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves language model reasoning by distilling from a frozen teacher initialized identically to the student and conditioned on privileged information. However, we identify an underexplored termination mismatch in OPSD: the student fails to reliably learn when to continue and when to stop. This mismatch manifests in two opposing failure modes-premature termination, where reasoning stops before sufficient progress is made, and repetition-driven over-generation, where the model continues generating after reasoning has stalled. Our analysis shows that the teacher-student discrepancy on EOS grows during OPSD training, while length-capped trajectories are frequently dominated by unproductive repetition. To address this issue, we propose TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation), which augments the original OPSD objective with two targeted objectives. Stop/Continue Distillation addresses premature termination by explicitly aligning the teacher and student on whether reasoning should continue, while Repetition-Aware Unlikelihood Training addresses repetition-driven over-generation by discouraging repetitive continuations in the student's failed trajectories. The resulting objective improves termination behavior from complementary directions: continuing when further reasoning is needed and stopping when reasoning becomes unproductive. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks with Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) show that TA-OPSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other baselines across all three model scales. Beyond the performance gains, ablation and behavioral analyses show that the two proposed objectives effectively mitigate their corresponding termination failures, reducing both premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation.

</details>

### 51. [Pretty Linear Liars: Unregularized Probes Favor Intervention-Unfaithful Features](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20371v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20371

**作者：** Karl Vilhelmsson Emneby、Julian Yocum、Cameron Allen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20371v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20371v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文系统研究线性探针正则化对干预忠实性的影响：理论上说明无正则 OLS 探针会放大与目标特征存在伪相关的低方差方向，并在 toy transformer 与 Llama-2-7B 上发现忠实性随正则强度先升后降，最优强度下的特征接近直接针对干预结果优化所得。

**相关性简评：** LVR 中常用探针或相似度判断内部状态是否保留视觉细节、答案是否真正使用 latent 内容，该文提示高「可解码性」可能只反映伪相关方向，可供核查 latent 读出结论与深度、位置差异是否受探针正则化与方差结构影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pretty Linear Liars: Unregularized Probes Favor Intervention-Unfaithful Features

**abstract/A1：** Linear probing is a common technique in mechanistic interpretability despite the fact that the decodability of a given feature does not necessarily imply the network uses that feature. Intervention faithfulness, not merely decodability, is the appropriate criterion for whether a feature serves a defined active role in the model. Meanwhile, probe regularization has been used for feature discovery, but the impact of regularization on feature causality remains unclear. We study probe regularization systematically, starting with unregularized ordinary least squares (OLS) regression and considering increasing amounts of regularization via ridge regression. We show theoretically that OLS probes amplify low-variance directions in activation space that have spurious correlations with the target feature, whereas regularization reduces influence from these directions. Empirically, we find in a toy transformer and Llama-2-7B that intervention faithfulness increases up to a point, and then decreases again, and that the optimal regularization strength leads to features bearing striking similarity (in both direction and variance) to those learned by optimizing for intervention outcomes directly. Together, these results provide mechanistic justification for regularizing regression probes.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 9 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science (InterpScience)

</details>

### 52. [Halting in Recurrent Sequence Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20377v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20377

**作者：** Simon Dräger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20377v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20377v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在「复制指定次数后输出 EOS」的最小任务上训练 tanh RNN 与线性 SSM，发现 RNN 在低维线性子空间（约两个主成分）中编码剩余 token 数，且剩余数相同的状态收敛为共享表示；在序列边界施加仿射变换把状态推移到「少一次」的表示，可使网络提前一轮停止并仍以 94.4% 复现目标序列，而 SSM 的停止则依赖二维旋转平面间相对相位的对齐。

**相关性简评：** 该文以因果干预而非仅相关性证据，说明循环状态中「剩余步数」子空间如何决定停止时机，与 LVR 关注的 STOP 决策、预测性工作区及 latent 状态比较维度（深度、位置、结构）直接呼应，可核查其线性子空间与相位对齐两类假设能否迁移到多步视觉推理的停止判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Halting in Recurrent Sequence Models

**abstract/A1：** Recurrent sequence models, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and state space models (SSMs), are often trained to emit an end-of-sequence (EOS) token when their output sequence is complete. During training, EOS is treated as another token without a special loss term or incentive. Although this training paradigm is widely used, it is not understood how models decide to output EOS. We study a minimal version of the EOS halting problem in which networks are trained to emit a given input sequence an instructed number of times, followed by EOS. We train tanh RNNs and linear SSMs on this task, finding that the RNNs encode the number of tokens left to copy in a linear subspace, of which two principal components capture most of the variation. Hidden states with the same remaining count converge to a shared representation regardless of their instructed repeat count. By modulating the hidden state using an affine transformation at the boundary between copied sequences, we shift the RNN's state to the representation shared by states with one fewer copy remaining. The unchanged network emits EOS one copy earlier while reproducing the shortened target sequence in 94.4% of new sequences, revealing that this representation causally determines the stopping time. In the SSMs, the difference between trajectories with different repeat counts is separated across two-dimensional rotation planes whose contributions to the EOS comparison cancel during copying and align near the stopping time. Rotating the planes independently removes most of the intended stopping while preserving the copied content, which shows that the stopping time depends on the planes' relative phases. These results identify two candidate primitives of EOS halting in recurrent models: a shared encoding of the number of remaining tokens in tanh RNNs and phase alignment across fixed rotations in linear SSMs.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science

</details>

### 53. [Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20404v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20404

**作者：** Benhao Huang、Chaitanya Dwivedi、Xuezhe Ma、Alexander Moreno、Hector Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20404v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20404v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在纯文本语言模型中比较 latent feedback（将每个 token 的顶层状态反馈到下一 token 输入）与在更多 epoch 上消耗同等算力的 vanilla Transformer，跨模型规模与数据重复次数拟合统一 scaling law，报告最多节省 48% 算力和 47% 唯一数据。

**相关性简评：** 该文的 latent 状态递归与算力/数据放大分析，可能为 LVR 的循环状态更新及 THINK 成本核算提供线索；但对象是文本 LM，视觉多模态迁移与推理期收益仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier

**abstract/A1：** When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train on it for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, is another way to spend that compute, yet it has not been tested against a vanilla Transformer that spends the same compute on more epochs. We run this test across a ladder of model sizes, unique data and epochs, tuning both models at every size and amount of unique data. Latent feedback makes every FLOP and every token count for more except when unique data is scarce relative to model size, a regime that today's models are far from. We find that latent feedback serves as an amplifier: with unique data fixed, it reaches a Transformer's loss with less compute; with epochs fixed, it reaches that loss with less unique data. Furthermore, both savings grow with unique data per parameter and with repetition, and downstream tasks agree. To go beyond our grid, we fit one scaling law to both models, in which latent feedback enters as a Transformer with more parameters; it predicts that both savings keep growing with unique data and repetition. Fitted on models from 60M to 271M parameters, the law predicts the losses at a held-out 778M size to within 0.3% and the gap between the two models to within 0.05%. At most, latent feedback saves 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data. When data, not compute, is the limit, latent feedback is the better use of a FLOP for a model of a given size.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages. Code: https://github.com/ifm-ai/LoRM

</details>

### 54. [SpeCal: Spectral Calibration for Unsupervised RLVR](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20691v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20691

**作者：** Kai Tang、Xing Zheng、Haobo Wang、Guangcheng Zhu、Shenzhi Yang、Zhengqing Zang、Yingfan Ma、Cheng Peng、Bowen Song、Weiqiang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20691v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20691v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SpeCal，从 rollout 隐藏状态谱的组级有效秩与组内留一子空间支持两方面校准无监督 RLVR 的奖励优势，以提升自生成监督的可靠性。

**相关性简评：** 其谱有效秩和留一子空间支持为衡量 latent 状态的结构可靠性与单条轨迹贡献提供了可核查线索，可能启发 LVR 中的轨迹贡献分配与监督筛选；但属纯文本训练方法，需确认向多模态 latent 推理的迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpeCal: Spectral Calibration for Unsupervised RLVR

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning abilities of large language models, but its dependence on ground-truth answers or external verifiers limits its ability to exploit abundant unlabeled reasoning data. Unsupervised RLVR alleviates this bottleneck by deriving scalar rewards from the model's own rollouts. However, the reliability of such self-generated supervision varies substantially across rollout groups and individual responses, while existing methods construct or refine their rewards mainly from decoded outcomes and reward statistics. These endpoint signals reveal what answers the model produces, but provide limited information about whether the underlying rollout representations form a reliable structure for learning. Our key observation is that hidden-state spectra offer a complementary view of supervision reliability by characterizing both the organization of a rollout group and the support received by each rollout within that group. Based on this observation, we propose SpeCal, a bi-level spectral calibration framework for unsupervised RLVR. At the group level, SpeCal combines spectral mass with a Gaussian band-pass gate over normalized entropy-based effective rank, favoring rollout groups with substantial representation variation whose effective dimensionality lies in a preferred regime. At the rollout level, the same group effective rank determines how many dominant directions are retained in a leave-one-out spectral subspace formed by the remaining rollouts, within which the conditional support of each held-out rollout is measured. The resulting signals calibrate the original reward-induced advantages at the group and rollout levels without redefining the underlying unlabeled reward.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to KDD 2027

</details>

### 55. [GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20736v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20736

**作者：** Kangwen Zhao、Jianfeng Cai、Ruopei Sun、Mingxiao Feng、Peng Zhang、Wengang Zhou、Houqiang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20736v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20736v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GainCtrl：用一个轻量 CPU 预测器从交互历史估计相对保留分数的期望正向增益，并以校准阈值决定何时停止重复尝试，从而在保持 Best-of-N 任务质量的同时减少 token 消耗。

**相关性简评：** 其「继续执行的期望增益 vs 成本」量化思路与校准停止准则，可能可供核查迁移到 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 何时停止的决策；但该工作为纯文本工具型 agent，未涉及视觉证据筛选或 latent 状态分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to power agents that interact with tools and environments to solve complex tasks. Repeated attempts improve the quality of tool-using agents, but continued execution incurs additional costs even when it is unlikely to improve the best result ultimately returned. This raises the question of when to stop an attempt to reduce execution cost while preserving task-level Best-of-N quality. To address this question, we introduce GainCtrl, a gain-based execution controller for LLMs. In GainCtrl, a lightweight CPU predictor uses interaction histories to estimate expected positive gains over retained scores, which are then used to guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds to limit the loss in mean Best-of-N task quality. We evaluate the controller through trajectory replay across three environments and three LLM actors. Comparisons of interpolated quality-cost Pareto frontiers show that GainCtrl generally uses fewer tokens than baselines at matched target quality. Fixed policies also achieve quality close to that of full execution while substantially reducing token consumption. The predictor runs at millisecond latency on a single CPU thread, supporting repeated monitoring without access to LLM internals.

</details>

### 56. [DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20844v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20844

**作者：** Hanlin Tian、Sihan Zhu、Zhao Yang、Yuxiang Wang、Zhiquan Hu、Yu Mi、Hongquan Zhu、Qiufei Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20844v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20844v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** DetourBench 将交互任务建模为有限部分可观测转移系统，用穷举搜索计算全信息最少动作数和残余工作量，从而分别评估成功率、达成度、残余进展与轨迹绕路。

**相关性简评：** 其精确最小动作界与残余距离可用于核查 LVR 中「是否获取了必要视觉证据、是否早停或少一步」及 LOOK/STOP 的成本收益，但需从文本交互环境向多模态推理迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DetourBench: Trajectory-Level Evaluation of Interactive Agents with Exact Minimum-Action Bounds

**abstract/A1：** Benchmarks judge language-model agents mainly by whether they reach the correct final state, not by how they got there. Endpoint scoring cannot separate an agent that retrieved exactly the evidence a decision required from one that read most of the environment, nor an agent that never located the evidence from one that stopped a single action short. Settling this needs a reference cost, and authored solutions establish only that a task is solvable, not that no shorter route exists. We present DetourBench, which constrains the environment until that minimum is computable. Each task is a finite, partially observable transition system with unit-cost accesses whose resources become globally addressable after discovery. Exhaustive search yields the full-information minimum action count $L\_0$ with a replayable witness; from graph-recoverable terminal states it also yields exact residual work $R\_T$, which separates an episode that stopped one access short from one that wandered, while an irreversible wrong commitment is recorded as having no finite residual distance rather than assigned one. Success, attainment, residual progress, and normalized detour are reported separately. Across 375 scored episodes --- five model endpoints, 25 integrated tasks, three repeats --- success ranges from 58.7% to 96.0% while conditional attainment ranges from 0.803 to 0.890 and orders the models differently. Among recoverable failures, residual work separates near-complete trajectories from costly incompletion and from irreversible commitment. We open-source the instances, oracle witnesses, and evaluation harness at https://github.com/DatagridsAI/DetourBench.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents

</details>

### 57. [Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21168v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21168

**作者：** Ye Xiao、Shesheng Song、Yi Ren、Shasha Li、Bin Ji、Xiaodong Liu、Jun Ma、Jie Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21168v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21168v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 BTS 视觉增强框架，用多尺度视觉调制在输入阶段注入视觉信息而不增加 token 长度，并用自适应融合特征校准在 FFN 层做逐通道仿射校准，以解耦视觉注入与分布对齐、保持语言先验。

**相关性简评：** 其「不加 token 的视觉调制 + FFN 注入」与逐通道校准，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何留在内部状态、避免视觉旁路导致信息坍缩提供可核查的架构与对齐线索，但未涉及 latent 推理状态生成或推理决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Token Stacking: Multi-scale Visual Modulation and Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration for MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly and follow two main paradigms: one involves concatenating visual and textual tokens for input into Large Language Model (LLM), while the other injects visual knowledge into Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) of the LLM. However, the former introduces a large number of redundant visual tokens, substantially increasing computational overhead. The latter reduces sequence length but removes images from the input stage entirely, which may hinder the activation of image-related knowledge. Moreover, naively injecting visual knowledge into the FFNs could induce activation distribution shifts due to cross-modal semantic discrepancies. To address these challenges, we develop Beyond Token Stacking (BTS), a novel visual enhancement framework for MLLMs. Specifically, we propose a Multi-scale Visual Modulation (MVM) mechanism that injects multi-scale visual information at the input stage via modulation without increasing the token sequence length. Furthermore, we develop an Adaptive Fused-feature Calibration (AFC) module that performs per-channel affine calibration to decouple visual injection from distribution alignment in the FFN layers, improving multimodal fusion stability while preserving language priors. Experiments show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>

### 58. [Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21241v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21241

**作者：** Xiaoyu Li、Jiangxuan Long

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21241v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21241v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文为自适应 test-time scaling 中采样预算、提示、验证器和停止规则的选择建立时间一致 PAC-Bayes 风险证书，并分析 self-consistency 的投票边际及算力分配的 oracle water-filling 规律。

**相关性简评：** 其处理自适应搜索后风险报告失效、数据依赖停止与算力分配的方法，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本评估和停止决策是否具有统计有效性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Anytime-Valid PAC-Bayes Certificates for Adaptive Test-Time Scaling

**abstract/A1：** Test-time scaling systems often choose how much to sample, which prompt to use, and which verifier or aggregation rule to trust after repeatedly inspecting a calibration set. Standard validation error bars are not valid after this adaptive selection. We model a test-time scaling recipe as a randomized predictor with a random cost and prove a time-uniform PAC-Bayes certificate that holds simultaneously over all calibration times, all posterior mixtures over recipes, and all data-dependent stopping rules. Thus the same event covers the recipe search that precedes deployment, not merely the fixed recipe finally reported. For a finite grid of budgets and verifiers, the penalty is the familiar $\\log M/n$, which in the worst case no certificate valid after selection can avoid, while non-uniform priors and localized posterior mixtures can give sharper certificates for structured searches. We specialize the result to self-consistency and show a complementary margin law: plurality voting improves exponentially in the sample budget only on examples where the correct answer is the generator's unique mode; otherwise more compute can provably amplify errors. The same margin analysis yields an oracle water-filling law for compute allocation. A synthetic audit quantifies the optimism caused by adaptive budget selection, and a 192-example GSM8K audit using gpt-4.1-mini generations illustrates risk-cost reporting for a real inference pipeline. At scale, with two models on GSM8K and MATH-500, selected-best error bars fall below the out-of-split GSM8K risk in up to 22.5% of random splits at a nominal 5% while the certificate never does, and on the full GSM8K test split it tightens to 0.109 (held-out risk 0.039). The results give a lightweight, distribution-free way to report risk and compute claims for adaptive inference systems.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Xiaoyu Li and Jiangxuan Long contributed equally. 31 pages, 7 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 59. [The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21251v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21251

**作者：** Xiaoyu Li、Jiangxuan Long

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21251v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21251v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把 prompt 构建形式化为自适应数据分析，以数据存储与最终 prompt 记录间的互信息定义 context capacity，证明 √(κ/k) 阶的上下文泛化界及匹配下界，并推导 PAC-Bayes 检索规则，在 Banking77 上做实证核验。

**相关性简评：** 其「自适应选取证据会带来上下文过拟合、需容量约束才可迁移」的度量与界，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据反复检索筛选后的证据可信度评估提供可核查的分析工具。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Price of Choosing Examples: Context Overfitting in Adaptive In-Context Learning

**abstract/A1：** In-context learning is usually analyzed as if the examples in the prompt were sampled before the learner is chosen. In deployed systems they are not: examples are retrieved, filtered, re-ranked, edited, and repeatedly tested after seeing the query and the data store. We formalize this gap by treating prompt construction as adaptive data analysis through a conditional stochastic-kernel calculus. Our main quantity is the context capacity, the mutual information or approximate max-information between the data store and the final prompt transcript. For any frozen in-context learner and any adaptive context pipeline with capacity $κ$, we prove a finite-sample context generalization bound of order $\\sqrt{κ/k}$, where $k$ is the number of selected examples whose losses form the reported score. We prove a matching lower bound, whose constant is exact when $\\log k\\llκ\\ll k$, and derive two PAC-Bayesian retrieval rules: a first-order Gibbs rule that charges data-dependent candidate gates their prior mass, and a self-normalized second-order rule. On Banking77 with 64 retrieval recipes and two model families, the certificates hold in all 24,000 resampled selection events, and from 64 (Qwen2.5-7B) or 128 (GPT-4.1-mini) reused validation queries the Gibbs rule certifies a risk below the zero-shot error in over 99% of validation draws. Finally, we instantiate the theory for Bayesian linear in-context regression, including an order-statistics analysis of query-aligned top-$k$ Gaussian retrieval. The results separate context quality from context certification: longer or more relevant contexts improve risk only when the procedure used to choose them is stable enough for selected-context evidence to transfer.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Xiaoyu Li and Jiangxuan Long contributed equally. 31 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 60. [Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21441v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21441

**作者：** Zhuoyang Li、Teng Shi、Jiakai Tang、Weijie Yu、Guofu Xie、Xiao Zhang、Lei Kou、Yang Yu、Lei Shen、Xin Chen、Bing Wang、Xiaoyi Zeng、Jun Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21441v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21441v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GainReason 训练框架，用「预测增益」（单句推理引起目标 Semantic ID 对数似然的变化）作为句子级、可区分的奖励来优化生成式推荐的推理，并配以因果注意力加速计算与辅助推理利用任务。

**相关性简评：** 其按句测量推理片段对目标预测贡献的做法，可为 LVR 中 latent/文本推理轨迹的贡献分配与「答案是否真正使用推理内容」的度量提供可核查的迁移线索，虽属推荐领域纯文本设定，仍需核查该增益是否只是相关性信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Reason with Predictive Gains for Generative Recommendation

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning-enhanced generative recommendation (GR) has attracted increasing attention for leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to improve next-item prediction. However, existing methods primarily optimize reasoning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with rule-based rewards determined by final recommendation performance, which faces two key limitations: (i) unmeasured predictive contributions within reasoning, where the predictive contributions of individual reasoning steps are not directly reflected in optimization signals, and (ii) weakly discriminative learning signals within groups, where different reasoning trajectories within the group often receive indistinguishable rewards, limiting effective policy optimization. In this paper, we propose GainReason, a simple yet effective training framework that optimizes reasoning through Predictive Gain (PG). Specifically, PG measures changes in target Semantic ID (SID) log-likelihood induced by individual reasoning sentences, providing contribution-aware and discriminative rewards. We further theoretically establish the alignment between expected PG and the recommendation ranking objective. Building on this signal, we develop PG-based Reasoning Optimization (PGRO) to optimize reasoning generation with sentence-level rewards, supported by a custom causal attention mechanism for efficient PG computation. Additionally, an auxiliary PG-based Reasoning Utilization (PGRU) task adaptively strengthens reasoning-conditioned prediction to complement PGRO. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that GainReason consistently outperforms competitive baselines and achieves substantial performance gains from reasoning.

</details>

### 61. [Differentiable Exact Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21486v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21486

**作者：** Hristo Papazov、Francesco D'Angelo、Nicolas Flammarion

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.FL、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21486v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21486v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出可微精确学习框架，将无界外部环境与状态跟踪神经控制器耦合，用策略轨迹观测训练，并引入支持 log-parallel 训练、可模拟任意有限状态控制器的可微有限状态转换器（DFST），在算术与通用模拟任务上实现极端长度泛化，还能从训练模型中提取可解释的离散控制器。

**相关性简评：** 其显式状态跟踪、极端长度泛化与潜在状态离散化提取，可能为 LVR 关注的状态抽象、组合泛化与 latent 可解释性核查提供方法线索，但材料无视觉或推理模态，需核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Differentiable Exact Learning

**abstract/A1：** We introduce a framework for differentiable exact learning that couples an unbounded external environment to a state-tracking neural controller, which we train on policy-trajectory observations (PTOs): expert behavior traces that expose observations and actions while hiding internal states. In addition to the learning framework, we introduce Differentiable Finite-State Transducers (DFSTs) which use multilinear updates, support log-parallel training, and emulate arbitrary finite-state controllers, yielding computational universality through environmental interaction. From tiny training datasets, compact DFSTs achieve extreme length generalization on arithmetic and universal-simulation tasks. We replicate the success of DFSTs on RNNs and GRUs, thereby supporting a broader learning recipe: State-Tracking Controller + Unbounded External Environment + PTOs = Extreme Length Generalization. Beyond length generalization, our metric-extraction protocol recovers interpretable discrete controllers from trained DFSTs, which we prove equivalent to the target arithmetic and universal-simulation algorithms. Furthermore, for our Softmax DFST models, simply taking $\\mathrm{argmax}$ over the transition probabilities yields discrete controllers which provably exactly perform universal Turing-machine simulation and binary arithmetic. Proving exact learning for the neural controllers requires assumptions, which we empirically support. We make our code, training recipes, model weights, and proof checkers publicly available at https://github.com/fanagor/DEL.

**comment/C1：** Accepted in NeurIPS 2026

### 62. [Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21538v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21538

**作者：** Arunkumar V、Manoranjan Gandhudi、Gangadharan G. R.、Arun Prakash、S. Senthilkumar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在过程级真实奖励可精确计算的可执行授权策略环境中训练 RLVR，沿七种现实方向削弱验证器，用精确 oracle 对照 rollout，归纳出四类失败表型（充足性代理被 padding 攻破、仅结果型饱和、噪声稀释等），并提出无模型验证器审计与饱和预实验来预判表型。

**相关性简评：** 其「代理验证器与真实过程奖励」的差距诊断，尤其充分性代理可被填充式推理蒙混，可能为 LVR 中轨迹监督、贡献分配以及「latent 是否真被使用」的归因核查提供可借用的问题框架与审计手段；但该工作属纯文本策略域，迁移到视觉推理需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimistic Verifiers Get Hacked: Reward Hacking Under an Exact Process Oracle

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards inherits whatever its verifier gets wrong. Outside mathematics and code the verifier is a proxy, a rubric, a learned judge or a hand-written checker, and its distance from the true objective is never measured, so a rising reward cannot be told apart from a hack. We build a setting where the true reward is exactly computable at the process level: executable authorization policies over 124,416 contexts admit an oracle that lists every minimal sufficient reason for every decision. We compile these policies into exact process rewards, degrade the verifier along seven realistic axes (outcome-only, sufficiency, recall-only, extraction noise, coarse taxonomy, stale policy, LLM judge), and train against each while the exact verifier scores every rollout. Four phenotypes appear. Optimistic verifiers are hacked by padding: the sufficiency proxy ends at 0.940 while true faithfulness falls from 0.731 to 0.667 on 96 held-out episodes. Outcome-only verifiers saturate and stop teaching, noise dilutes, and ranking-preserving gaps do no harm. A model-free audit of the verifier, its selection error and gap sign, together with a short saturation pilot, anticipates which phenotype a run will produce. Across nine configurations spanning two frameworks, two model vendors, two adapter sizes, three precisions, two initialisations and two seeds, the phenotypes recur, sufficiency damage is positive in all 10 replication cells and beyond two standard errors in 7, and optimistic gaps remain the steeper branch. The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. We release the testbed, the training instrumentation, and 14 real public policies (Cedar, OPA, Gatekeeper) ported to executable oracles.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages. A shorter version, "The Verifier Gap", appears at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Meta-Agents (non-archival)

</details>

### 63. [Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21408v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21408

**作者：** Javier Aguilar Martín

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.DL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21408v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21408v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用四项预注册检验评估「在 embedding 图中挑选远离已有工作的点再解码成新想法」这一构思配方，比较原始距离、空隙分数、LLM 续写与各类反馈相对后续真实工作的表现。

**相关性简评：** 其发现 embedding 距离更多跟随规模、位置与格式而非语义内容、远点难以解码成文本，可能可供核查 LVR 中以 latent 距离或余弦相似度充当内容与推理证据时的解读风险。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Embedding-Map Distances Guide LLM Ideation? Four Tests Against What Came Next

**abstract/A1：** A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target's neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up's title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.

**comment/C1：** 48 pages, 5 figures. Code, data pointers and pre-registrations: https://github.com/JaviMaligno/latent-gap-ideas

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VidEngram，一个长视频问答系统：在摄取阶段用 Qwen2.5-Omni 联合音视频字幕化并构建分层持久记忆（片段—事件—实体层），后续提问由纯文本 agentic planner 调用检索工具作答，并可通过网页界面查看记忆形成与证据轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 它把视觉证据一次性压缩为外部文本记忆、之后全靠文本规划检索，可作为「视觉旁路」「信息坍缩」与长视频证据筛选的对照方案，其长视频增益也提示上下文覆盖不足的问题；但状态是显式文本记忆而非 latent 推理状态，细节保留与检索充分性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VidEngram: Agentic Long-Term Video Understanding via Structured Hierarchical Memory

**abstract/A1：** Long-video question answering is wasteful and lossy when a multimodal model must re-encode the same video for every query: context limits force sparse sampling or truncation, and no reusable representation remains for later questions. We present VidEngram, an agentic video QA system that builds a persistent hierarchical memory once at ingest and answers later questions from that memory. VidEngram captions video and audio jointly with Qwen2.5-Omni, consolidates segment memories into episode and entity layers, and uses a text-only agentic planner with specialized retrieval tools to produce grounded answers. The web interface makes this process inspectable: users can watch memory formation, inspect retrieval traces, verify cited evidence in the video player, and explore entity relationships. On the full OmniVideoBench, VidEngram with a GPT-5-mini planner outperforms a strong single-pass Qwen2.5-Omni baseline (37.0% vs. 32.3%), with gains concentrated on longer videos where single-pass coverage becomes sparse. Because perception is paid once, subsequent queries use low-cost text-only planning.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Demo video and code are linked in the paper

</details>

**内容简述：** 该工作构建 LogicEye 系列资源：用双池推理验证 agent 同时核查阳性纳入征象与阴性排除标准，据此整理出 80 余万张眼底/OCT 图像及结构化病理报告的多模态数据集，并建立含类别约束损失的分层疾病识别与报告生成基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「阳性纳入＋阴性排除」双池验证把粗粒度标签落回可核查的视觉发现，可作为视觉证据筛选与抑制诊断幻觉的现成基准，但论文重点是数据与评测，未涉及 latent 状态生成，可供核查其证据验证流程。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LogicEye: Agent Driven Multimodal Dataset for Interpretable Ophthalmic Diagnosis

**abstract/A1：** Clinical adoption of ophthalmic Artificial Intelligence remains limited by low interpretability and a lack of finely annotated multimodal data. Most existing datasets provide only coarse disease labels without the granular pathological findings required for differential diagnosis. We present LogicEye$^{Agent}$, a dual-pool inference and verification agent that emulates clinical reasoning by jointly verifying positive inclusion signs and negative exclusion criteria. Using LogicEye$^{Agent}$, we curate LogicEye$^{Data}$, a large-scale multimodal dataset of 804,461 fundus and OCT images paired with structured pathological reports spanning 38 diseases and 29 subtypes, with quality assured through joint verification by multimodal large language models and clinical experts. Building on this dataset, we further develop LogicEye$^{Bench}$, which incorporates a category-constrained loss for hierarchical disease recognition and report generation. Grounding coarse labels into verified visual findings effectively curtails diagnostic hallucinations and establishes a solid foundation for interpretable vision-language modeling in ophthalmology. The code is available at:https://github.com/Eden35/LogicEye-Agent-Driven-Multimodal-Dataset-for-Interpretable-Ophthalmic-Diagnosis.

</details>

### 66. [Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18723v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18723

**作者：** Qiancheng Zhou、Wenhua Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18723v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18723v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ViCoR：主 VLM 负责常规游戏动作并制定/更新面向反复出现事件的情境指引，另设快速视觉反射分支，以 no-thinking 模式检查实时局部画面与运动线索，在亚秒级内决定最终动作，从而在 17 个 2D/3D 游戏中降低延迟与 token 消耗并提升成功率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关注的动态计算分配、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本、动作时刻视觉证据筛选直接相关；但反射分支不显式生成或复用 latent 推理状态，更接近把视觉检查外包给一次性快速调用，可供核查其是否真正依赖实时视觉证据而非退化为视觉旁路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Acting by Intent, Reacting by Sight: Visual Conditioned Reflexes for Real-Time VLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong capabilities as generalist agents that perceive, reason, and act in interactive environments. Yet real-time environments such as video games demand both deliberate control for exploration and split-second reactions to fast-moving hazards. Existing agents struggle to handle both: relying solely on direct VLM actions is too slow for sudden events, whereas delegating execution to fixed scripts leaves the agent blind at the moment of action, leading to frequent misfires whenever the scene shifts. Humans overcome this by pairing normal conscious control with conditioned reflexes-while the mind handles deliberate actions and shapes reflex rules, the reflex itself still relies on live vision to make the final instant decision. Emulating this mechanism, we propose ViCoR (Visual Conditioned Reflex). Alongside normal gameplay actions, the main VLM defines and updates lightweight situational guidance for recurring events, while a fast visual reflex branch (invoking the VLM in no-thinking mode) inspects live local views with motion cues to make the final sub-second action decisions. By offloading 67.8% of high-frequency reactions to the reflex branch (680 ms per check), ViCoR reduces average per-action decision latency by 2.6x (from 14.0 s to 5.4 s) and cuts token consumption by 36.9%. Across 17 diverse 2D and 3D games in the GameWorld benchmark, ViCoR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving task success rate by +11.8% (from 52.9% to 64.7%) and average normalized progress by +13.9% (from 66.5% to 80.4%) over the strongest deliberative VLM and script baselines. In fast-paced real-time games, ViCoR refines its reflexes across episodes to boost progress by 1.67x, and even with a low-effort main planner, surpasses high-effort deliberative baselines by +8.1% at one-third of the token cost.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 VTG-RAG 长视频问答框架：先用查询相关的两阶段粗到细采样挑选核心片段，再把字幕、语音转写、视觉描述与实体关系组织成时序多模态图，并做带时间过滤的两轮检索推理，在 Video-MME 与 LongVideoBench 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「查询自适应证据筛选＋时间约束过滤」与长视频中视觉证据获取、干扰抑制的关系较直接，可供核查采样与检索策略如何影响证据覆盖；但推理仍是外部检索-生成流程，未涉及 latent 状态或内部视觉信息保留，与 LVR 主线仅有间接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VTG-RAG: Long-Video Reasoning via Query-Adaptive Coarse-to-Fine Sampling and Temporal Graph Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Long-video reasoning requires a system to localize sparse evidence over extended temporal sequences, preserve temporal structure, and generate answers despite substantial multimodal distractors. Existing video retrieval-augmented generation methods typically build indexes from uniformly sampled video segments. In long-video settings, this design readily introduces irrelevant context and is unreliable for questions with explicit temporal constraints. We propose VTG-RAG, a framework for long-video question answering that combines query-adaptive coarse-to-fine sampling with temporal graph retrieval. First, a two-stage sampling strategy selects core segments with high mean query relevance or high intra-segment relevance variance. The framework then integrates subtitles, speech transcripts, visual descriptions, entities, and relations from these segments into a temporally ordered multimodal graph. Finally, it performs temporally filtered, two-pass retrieval and reasoning across frame, text, and graph evidence spaces. A lot of experiments have proven the effectiveness of the VTG-RAG. Specifically, we evaluate the framework on Video-MME and LongVideoBench. On LongVideoBench, the reported Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 72B results improve from 48.16% to 50.56% and from 52.13% to 53.32%, respectively, with 24 answer-input frames. These correspond to gains of 2.40 and 1.19 percentage points. The ablation experiments of VTG-RAG further support that the contributions of each component are very important.

</details>
