摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FiReIQ，从单次 VLM 生成中抽取与字段对齐的推理信号，并以质量条件化的视觉融合结合局部与全局图像质量特征，进行字段级置信度估计；同时构建覆盖财务收据与法律合同的 FiReIQ-Bench，评测置信度区分度与选择性预测。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 评价侧的停止／弃权决策及「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」问题相关，其字段级推理信号与图像质量门控可供核查能否用于诊断高置信误判与视觉旁路，但方法本身不涉及内部 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FiReIQ: Field-Level Confidence Estimation with Reasoning and Image Quality in Document Extraction

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in structured document extraction, yet their deployment in high-stakes applications requires reliable confidence estimates for individual fields. Existing uncertainty estimators often aggregate signals across an entire generation, obscuring field-specific reasoning uncertainty while overlooking visual degradations that may lead to confident extraction errors. To address these limitations, we introduce FiReIQ, a field-level confidence estimation framework that combines field-aligned reasoning signals from a single VLM generation with local and global image-quality features through quality-conditioned visual fusion. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we further introduce FiReIQ-Bench, a benchmark spanning financial receipts and legal contracts. Experiments with two reasoning VLMs show that FiReIQ consistently improves confidence discrimination, selective prediction, and probabilistic accuracy over existing estimators. These gains extend to private financial service data, where FiReIQ improves AUROC by 6.8% and coverage at 95% precision by 10.6% over an existing baseline. Together, these results highlight the potential of FiReIQ to reduce manual review while enabling more reliable document automation.

**comment/C1：** Work in Progress

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RAVEN-Bench：由 100 对时间对齐的低空航空 EO-IR 视频与 1,200 道人工审核的四选一问题构成，支持仅 EO、仅 IR 与 EO+IR 三种条件，并以分层能力等级与结构化问题组诊断配对输入增益、单模态依赖、目标一致性与证据链连贯性。

**相关性简评：** 其「配对输入相对更强单模态的增益」与证据区间标注，可供核查 VLM 是否真正利用视觉证据而非走旁路；但对象是航空跨光谱视频基准，未涉及 latent 状态或内部表示，联系限于评测设计层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yuhu990424/RAVEN-Bench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/TerraSenseAnalytics/RAVEN-Bench.

**title/T1：** Toward Planning Representations That Separate Task Structure from Visual Content

**abstract/A1：** Effective planning requires representations that preserve task-relevant geometry and object identity while ignoring visual variation that does not alter the task. Existing evaluations of visual generalization often change several factors simultaneously, making the source of a failure difficult to identify. We introduce a controlled evaluation of object-goal navigation (ObjectNav), the task of reaching an instance of a named object category, in procedurally generated ProcTHOR houses. Training and evaluation houses share floor plans, object locations, goals, and start states, while visual factors are changed individually or in combination. Across model-free reinforcement learning (RL), model-based RL, and agents using frozen pretrained visual representations, our results show that appearance changes impair navigation, but their effects differ sharply by factor. Surface material changes account for most of the average change in success, whereas clutter and lighting have little effect. The magnitude of a global image statistics shift does not reliably predict performance: changing only the goal object's appearance can substantially impair an end-to-end agent despite a small image-level change. We found that a model based agent that plans over frozen features from the pretrained DINOv2 image encoder achieves the highest success (0.83) under the full shift, but remains sensitive to surface appearance. Our experiments reveal an important requirement for planning representations: they must separate invariant spatial task structure from appearance.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19933

**作者：** Ruirui Shen、Jianqi Gao、Xiangfeng Luo、Yonggang Zhang、Muran Yu、Barney Haoyun Miao、Hang Yu、Yike Guo

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出免训练的 SAGE-VQA 智能体框架，用协同验证的视觉 grounding 模块获取并校验与问题相关的细粒度视觉证据，并借助自演化分层记忆复用、精炼经验，以缓解知识型 VQA 中视觉错误引发幻觉与泛化不足的问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「获取—验证视觉证据」与经验复用对应 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、证据可靠性和推理成本问题，但方法停留在外部智能体与文本流程层面，未涉及内部 latent 状态；可供核查多步推理中「看什么、何时停止」的收益与成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAGE-VQA: A Training-Free, Self-Evolving Agentic Framework with Grounded Evidence for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) aims to combine visual information with external knowledge to answer user questions. Existing methods face two main bottlenecks: visual perception errors can propagate into hallucinations, and generalization across scenarios remains limited. To address these issues, we propose SAGE-VQA (Self-evolving Agent framework with Grounded Evidence), a training-free agentic framework that combines evidence verification with experience evolution. Our key insight is to explore an Evidence-Driven Adaptive Reasoning (EDAR) strategy. It accurately acquires and verifies question-relevant fine-grained visual information. It also extracts and refines reusable experience to support robust reasoning across tasks. Specifically, we design a Co-verified Visual Grounding module that verifies question-relevant visual information and provides grounded evidence for subsequent reasoning. We further introduce a Self-evolving Hierarchical Memory (SHM) mechanism. SHM organizes experiences into declarative and procedural memories based on their nature. These memories can be reused in subsequent reasoning and continually refined through feedback, without updating model parameters. Experimental results show that our method outperforms competing methods based on lightweight open-source vision-language models (VLMs) as well as those based on closed-source VLMs. Moreover, our method can serve as a plug-and-play reasoning framework for existing VLMs without modifying their architectures.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「磨损先破坏检测、再破坏读取」的失败归因（漏检占读取失败的 78–87%，给出裁剪框后分类精度仍达 78%）可作为核查 VLM 流水线中视觉证据在哪一环丢失的对照线索，但不涉及 latent 推理状态本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Signs of Wear: Evaluating Intelligent Speed Assistance Under Synthetic Adverse Conditions

**abstract/A1：** Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) systems rely on cameras to recognize speed-limit signs, yet existing benchmarks underrepresent the weathered, dirty, and overgrown signs commonly encountered on rural roads. We use generative image editing to introduce different forms of wear into real street-level images of speed-limit signs. The resulting ISA-Wear dataset contains paired original and edited images. Guided by text instructions, a multimodal image-editing model adds snow, rust, vegetation, faded paint, or mud to the speed-limit sign in a street-level frame at three severity levels. Where appropriate, the surrounding scene is adapted as well, and the viewpoint is kept. Every edited frame has an unedited counterpart, and we only evaluate frames whose original is recognized correctly, so any failure can be attributed to the wear. Since the model alters the sign's geometry in 21\\% of the edits, all edits are filtered by a geometric check and a manual review. Severity is measured as the LPIPS distance between the original and the edited sign plate. On 716 worn frames, we find that in detect-then-read pipelines, wear breaks detection before it breaks reading. The detector finds only 62\\% of the worn signs, even though it finds every one of them in the original frames. Missed detections account for 78--87\\% of failed reads, a pattern that a zero-shot detector shares. Given the annotated sign box, as in the crop-based benchmarks, a classifier still reads 78\\% of the worn signs, but only 56\\% when it has to rely on the detector

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data

**abstract/A1：** Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamayo~2 Super gains 31 and 18 accuracy points at 15 and 5~m, while Qwen-Drive follows alternative maneuvers more reliably with a discrete command than with a sentence. We additionally collected retrospective annotations from four people for the driving recordings and describe controlled comparisons of annotation content, timing, and downstream learning; those analyses are pending. Our findings separate maneuver prediction from instruction-following and establish a framework for comparing prospective and retrospective supervision.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 结果显示序列推理是主要瓶颈，模型难以从稀疏结构化观测中推断数值关系，且数值先验与外部知识的收益取决于证据解读是否可靠，这与 VLM 能否保留并使用任务必需的视觉细节、如何筛选证据的问题相关，可供核查；但属领域专用评测，未涉及 latent 状态生成机制。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CivilBench: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Multimodal Information Integration in Civil Engineering

**abstract/A1：** Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model's ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/CivilBench.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 8 figures

**相关性简评：** 其「感知到现代物体却仍判场景历史一致」的发现直接对应 VLM 是否真正使用视觉证据、是否存在视觉旁路，可供核查 LVR 中的证据筛选与答案贡献分配；但未涉及 latent 状态，关联偏诊断层面。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 check token：在词表中加入功能性标记 &lt;CHECK&gt;，模型可在生成任意位置输出以触发自我检查（分析、定位、截断、重写），并借助 speculative forking 与分段奖励让触发时机端到端可学，以约 13% 开销提升推理正确率。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成中途触发自检并精确截断」与 LVR 的停止决策、动态计算分配相关，可学习触发时机与截断机制或可供核查如何用于 latent 推理流的 STOP 策略，但该工作面向纯文本链式推理、不涉及视觉状态表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Check Token: Real-Time Self-Verification and Precise Truncation in LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** ECC memory embeds 8 parity bits for every 64 data bits and automatically detects and corrects errors on each read. The parity bits carry no data and only safeguard integrity, at ~12.5% overhead. Yet the reasoning chains of large language models lack such built-in self-verification: once an error occurs it propagates along the chain, and existing methods can only verify externally after generation completes. We propose the check token, establishing built-in self-verification for language model generation streams for the first time: a functional marker &lt;CHECK&gt; is added to the vocabulary, and the model triggers self-checking (analysis, localization, truncation, rewriting) by outputting it at any position. The check token carries no reasoning content (discarded after triggering) and only safeguards reasoning correctness, directly corresponding to the role of ECC parity bits, also at only ~13% overhead. Speculative forking further eliminates false-positive latency, and segmented reward makes trigger timing end-to-end learnable. Experiments (Qwen3-32B / Qwen3-Next) show that the check token achieves +10.8 pp improvement on HMMT25 at 1.13x overhead, with token efficiency 88x that of Best-of-8, and the precise truncation advantage monotonically increases with chain length.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Skill-Latent Rewards: LLM-Guided Reward Formulation for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon reinforcement learning under sparse and delayed feedback remains an open challenge. Existing return-decomposition methods redistribute episodic rewards to ease credit assignment, but they operate on raw state--action transitions and disregard the subgoal structure that governs meaningful progress in complex tasks. We propose Skill-LR, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework in which a vision--language model identifies the agent's active subgoal at each timestep and a large language model generates a matching latent reward formulation through a two-stage prompting process. By conditioning reward signals on the currently active subgoal, Skill-LR produces stage-specific credit that evolves with the hierarchical plan, reducing temporal variance and improving sample efficiency. On multi-stage MiniGrid and BabyAI benchmarks, including DoorKey and Unlock-to-Unlock, Skill-LR converges faster and more reliably than sparse environmental rewards and strong credit-assignment baselines such as RUDDER and LaRe, demonstrating that subgoal-aligned latent rewards offer a principled path toward stable, interpretable credit assignment in long-horizon tasks.

**title/T1：** Multimodal Fusion with Pre-trained Models for Psychotherapy Outcome Prediction from Emotional Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** In-session emotional dynamics are associated with psychotherapy outcomes but difficult to measure at scale. Pretrained multimodal models provide automated access to facial, vocal, and textual signals, yet clinical datasets remain small. Our research question is how pretrained multimodal representations can best support psychotherapy outcome prediction under data scarcity. Three studies use 106 sessions from 88 patients and nine session-level outcome scales (HSCL-11, EPO-1, POMS). Study 1 asks whether deep learning outperforms classical machine learning: a two-stage deep pipeline, first predicting window-level valence/arousal and then session outcomes, transferred poorly (best single configuration, $r=.078$). Study 2 asks which representation and preprocessing choices work best: statistical pooling of frozen pretrained embeddings with regularized classical models achieved average $r=.406$ across nine scales under per-scale configuration selection, up to $r=.490$ for symptom distress, with complementary modalities and no significant benefit from manual affect annotations or therapist features. Study 3 asks whether deep learning remains inferior under these choices: classical models outperformed an optimized single-stage deep model at the single-configuration level ($r=.281$ vs. $.222$) and on all nine scales under matched per-scale selection ($.406$ vs. $.252$). The results suggest that under clinical data scarcity, pretrained representations with fixed statistical pooling and regularized classical models are more reliable than learned aggregation.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRAFT: Cross-Backbone LoRA Reuse for Continual Language and Multimodal Learning

**abstract/A1：** In continual learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables large language models to acquire new capabilities through lightweight adapters such as LoRA, yet the reuse of pretrained adapters is typically restricted to models sharing the same backbone. This limits the transfer of learned capabilities from language models to multimodal models. We propose GRAFT (Generalist Reuse of Adapters via Feature-space Transfer), a framework for cross-backbone LoRA reuse. GRAFT retrieves the most relevant pretrained LoRA adapter from a modality-aware library and maps it into the target backbone through a learned linear bridge between corresponding source and target feature spaces. We evaluate GRAFT on ten Super-NaturalInstructions text tasks, transferring Qwen2.5 LoRAs to Qwen2.5-VL, and five multimodal tasks, where Qwen2.5-VL LoRAs are directly reused. Compared with randomly initialized LoRA adapters, GRAFT improves performance on most evaluated tasks. These results show that GRAFT provides a simple and effective mechanism for reusing learned capabilities across language and multimodal models in continual learning.

</details>

### 80. [Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18642v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18642

**作者：** Yibo Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18642v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18642v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在56个含隐藏规则的交互世界中，比较单个 agent 连打八条命并保留完整历史，与八个 agent 各打一条命、每次继承300字符笔记；发现链式交接学到的东西明显更少，并把损失受控分解为更换 agent、单次压缩和反复压缩三部分，指出从完整历史重写笔记可挽回大部分损失。

**相关性简评：** 其“状态被压成短文本再多次传递”的受控拆解可供核查 latent 状态在多步更新与监督中的信息坍缩与贡献分配，但对象是纯文本 agent、无视觉与 latent 表征，迁移线索需人工评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agents Cannot Hand Over What They Have Not Yet Understood

**abstract/A1：** Agents that work beyond a single context window, or in teams, hand their work to a successor as a short written summary. Evaluation has focused on whether an agent can solve a task, and relatively little is known about how much of what an agent has learned survives being written down. We study this in 56 interactive worlds with hidden rules, where an agent that is told nothing fails and an agent given a 300-character statement of the rules succeeds. We compare one agent that plays eight lives and keeps its whole history with a chain of eight agents that each play one life and inherit a 300-character note. All six models we test learn less in the chain: after eight generations it stands where the single agent stood after about four lives. Controlled variants of the chain decompose this handoff loss into three components: none from changing the agent, a smaller loss from compressing to 300 characters, and a larger loss from compressing repeatedly. When each note is written from the full record of earlier lives instead of from the previous note, the same 300 characters recover 70% to 82% of the loss. The loss is robust across model sizes and is not alleviated by instructing the writer to record evidence, to revise the inherited note, or to keep a structured ledger. In simpler terms, an agent cannot hand over what it has not yet understood: a note holds what its writer has worked out, and a rule that takes several lives to see is lost with the lives that were not passed on.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 81. [FedFit: Federated Dynamic Sparse Training via Fisher Information scoring](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18643v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18643

**作者：** Meng Bi、Hong Huang、Jinlong Song、Charles Wang、Chengming Hu、Xi Chen、Ting Yu、Xue Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18643v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18643v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FedFit，用 Fisher 信息矩阵对损失曲面的二阶近似替代幅度启发式，在跨设备联邦学习中动态调整稀疏结构，并在视觉与 NLP 基准上缩小稀疏–稠密精度差距。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其以 Fisher 信息衡量重要性来决定结构保留，可能可供核查 latent 状态维度或视觉证据的筛选与计算分配准则。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FedFit: Federated Dynamic Sparse Training via Fisher Information scoring

**abstract/A1：** Cross-device Federated Learning (FL) is frequently bottlenecked by the prohibitive memory and communication costs of training deep neural networks on resource-constrained edge hardware. While federated dynamic sparse training aims to alleviate these costs by adjusting sparse structures during training, existing methods rely on magnitude-based heuristics that are fundamentally ill-suited for the non-convergent, heterogeneous environments inherent to FL. To address this challenge, we propose FedFit, a federated dynamic sparse training framework that replaces simple heuristics with optimization-centric criteria for structure adjustment. By leveraging a second-order approximation of the loss landscape via the Fisher Information Matrix, FedFit enables precise and efficient structure adjustment without the overhead of explicit Hessian computation. Empirical evaluations across computer vision and natural language processing benchmarks demonstrate that FedFit significantly narrows the sparse-to-dense accuracy gap, outperforming state-of-the-art methods while maintaining high communication efficiency. Our code is available at https://github.com/Serena-28/Fedfit.git .

**comment/C1：** The paper was accepted by ICML 2026

</details>

### 82. [RSIMed: Scaling Medical Foundation Models beyond Limited Clinical Data via Retrieval-Grounded Self-Evolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18646v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18646

**作者：** Wei Dai、Qianchu Liu、Guanghui Qin、Xing Han、Tristan Naumann、Sheng Zhang、Paul Pu Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18646v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18646v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** RSIMed 提出一个自进化训练流程：冻结的诊断求解器依据检索到的医学证据自动写出临床问题，使答案有来源可依，并据求解器仍答错的题目调整主题与难度，在 MIMIC-IV 罕见病诊断上超过多个现成模型设置。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据可溯源的自动出题＋按失败定向难度」的监督构造方式，可能为 LVR 的轨迹/自生成训练数据、贡献分配与证据筛选提供核查线索，但该工作面向医学文本问答、未涉及 latent 视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RSIMed: Scaling Medical Foundation Models beyond Limited Clinical Data via Retrieval-Grounded Self-Evolution

**abstract/A1：** Rare diseases are hard to diagnose, and the labeled clinical records needed to train models for them are few, private, and slow to extend, since a specialist must read every case. A model that writes its own training tasks could learn beyond these records, but no program can check a model-written diagnosis, and a wrong answer key corrupts training. To tackle this dilemma between data scarcity and difficulty of data annotations, we introduce RSIMed, Recursive Self-Improvement in Medicine, one of the first self-evolving pipelines in which a task proposer co-evolves in context with a diagnostic solver on real clinical records. Seeded by training admissions, a frozen copy of the solver writes each clinical question from retrieved medical evidence, so its answer rests on a source, and steers topics and difficulty toward what the solver still gets wrong. On rare-disease diagnosis from MIMIC-IV admissions, the accuracy of RSIMed-27B grows linearly with training compute, while a static pool of generated tasks collapses. Without any external model, RSIMed-27B and RSIMed-9B reach 0.516 and 0.488 diagnostic accuracy, above every off-the-shelf GPT-5.6 setting, whose best reaches 0.399 at 38 times the inference cost of RSIMed-27B. Tasks written by four external teachers, including GPT-5.5, train a less accurate diagnostician than the solver's own. Trained only on diagnosis, RSIMed-RL-27B also improves on the physician-written tasks of HealthBench Professional, from 0.291 to 0.303 in adjusted score.

</details>

### 83. [Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18648v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18648

**作者：** Qi Sun、Siyue Zhang、Tingyu Song、Yilun Zhao、Chen Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18648v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18648v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析离线 on-policy 蒸馏在 multi-turn agentic search 上劣于同教师 SFT 的现象，指出教师与参考轨迹不匹配及分布扁平化问题，并提出保存候选 token 概率、其余合并为残差 token 的 DistOPD 分布级监督方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「标量优势监督导致输出分布扁平化」的诊断与分布级残差监督，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的监督信号设计与信息坍缩核查提供线索，但该文未涉及视觉 latent 状态，需进一步核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens' teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher--reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. On agentic search, DistOPD achieves performance comparable to online OPD while improving student--teacher alignment and using training GPU-hours comparable to Lightning OPD.

</details>

### 84. [Algebraic Interaction: A Recipe for Neural Architecture Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18649v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18649

**作者：** Haonan Dong、Angelica I Aviles-Rivero

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18649v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18649v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出以「位置代数」与「特征代数」上的双线性算子组合统一表达卷积、注意力、状态空间模型与等变层；并在固定原架构路由与算子组合的前提下只替换特征代数，在线性注意力、Vision Mamba 与等变网络上验证精度、训练/推理效率与对称性。

**相关性简评：** 其把位置路由与特征交互拆为显式设计变量、用算子组合刻画信息流结构，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新与跨位置特征混合的结构化参数化提供方法线索，但是否有助于视觉证据筛选与动态计算尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Algebraic Interaction: A Recipe for Neural Architecture Generation

**abstract/A1：** We introduce an algebraic foundation for neural architecture design in which convolution, attention, state-space models, and equivariant layers are expressed through compositions of bilinear product operators over two structures: a position algebra governing positional routing and a feature algebra governing feature interactions. This decomposition makes routing, feature algebra, and operator composition explicit design variables.We focus on the feature-algebra axis through an Algebraic Recipe: fix the routing and operator composition of an existing architecture while replacing its feature algebra. This preserves the information-flow structure while allowing computational and symmetry properties to be modified through algebraic specification.We instantiate the recipe in linear attention, Mamba, and equivariant networks. Structure-constant and Clifford algebras improve accuracy at comparable parameter count in linear attention; structure-constant algebras yield up to $3\\times$ faster training and inference in Vision Mamba at competitive accuracy; and an $\\mathrm{SO}(3)$-representation algebra provides rotational equivariance by construction. These results demonstrate that feature algebra alone can control accuracy, efficiency, and symmetry without redesigning positional routing.This turns algebraic structure into an explicit design variable and reduces architecture design, within our framework, to algebraic specification.

</details>

### 85. [MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18652v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18652

**作者：** Jiyun Han、Seongjoon Cho、Seungkyu Choi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18652v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18652v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MeltKV，面向长上下文 LLM 服务对 KV cache 做可变比特向量量化：按分组 key 通道自适应分配位宽，将索引紧凑打包进标准数据类型以消除冗余位，并用逐头码本共享缩小码本总量，在困惑度相当下把 KV 压到 1–4 bit 以下并降低显存与延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其低位 KV 量化与码本共享可能为 LVR 中缓存视觉证据或 latent 推理状态提供存储与成本线索，但论文不涉及视觉推理，需核查量化误差是否损坏推理所需状态内容。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on long contexts, making Key-Value (KV) caches dominate memory usage and inference latency. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods effectively compress KV caches to sub-4-bit levels but often overlook inefficiencies in memory alignment and decoding speed. This work introduces MeltKV, a memory-latency co-optimized KV cache quantization framework for long-context LLM serving. MeltKV employs a memory-aligned variable-bit index packing scheme that adaptively assigns bit-widths to grouped key channels and compactly stores indices within standard data-types, eliminating redundant bits. Additionally, head-wise codebook sharing reduces the total codebook size while maintaining accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-of-the-art VQ methods.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. To appear in the IEEE/ACM International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD 2026)

</details>

### 86. [Earth World Model: Physics-constrained latent dynamics for forecasting and environmental scenario analysis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18654v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18654

**作者：** Huijun Qiao、Ziqiang Zhang、Jinnong Liao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18654v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18654v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以地球系统为中心的 Earth World Model：把多源观测压缩为可复用的低维 latent state，由共享转移算子在显式外部驱动下递推更新，并借助物理约束解码完成多步预测与环境情景干预分析，在光伏与风电场上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「预测拟合与干预响应须分开评估」以及 MLP 解码器下响应幅度明显塌缩（ρ 由 0.180 升至解析解码器的 0.922）的对照，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正承载且被答案生成所使用，类似信息坍缩与贡献分配的诊断线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Earth World Model: Physics-constrained latent dynamics for forecasting and environmental scenario analysis

**abstract/A1：** World models have been widely applied to multi-agent planning and forecasting, but exogenous environmental changes are rarely incorporated as replaceable drivers in a unified state-evolution process. This limits assessment of whether environmental perturbations propagate through physical systems with faithful dynamics. We propose the Earth World Model (EWM), an Earth-centred forecasting framework that compresses heterogeneous multi-source observations into a reusable low-dimensional latent state representing the system's history and current condition. Given explicit exogenous drivers, a shared transition operator recursively updates the latent state, and physics-constrained decoding produces multi-step forecasts. Replacing the drivers enables environmental scenario analysis and evaluation of dynamic-response fidelity. We evaluated EWM for power forecasting and environmental-perturbation response at six photovoltaic sites and one wind-power site. Across four photovoltaic sites and three forecast horizons, three independent training runs yielded mean $R^2$ values of 0.8578-0.9095. In a separate six-site decoder ablation, the mean net per-unit response $ρ$ under the prescribed irradiance intervention increased from 0.180 with a multilayer perceptron decoder to 0.922 with an analytic physical decoder, close to site- and horizon-specific analytic references. The wind model achieved an injection elasticity of $0.9990 \\pm 0.0006$, while pre-intervention outputs remained unchanged. These results show that forecast fit and intervention response should be evaluated separately and that the tested EWM configurations preserved response amplitude and temporal boundaries under the prescribed interventions.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables; includes Supplementary Information

</details>

### 87. [Beveridge: Open Weight System One Decision Models with Calibrated Probabilities](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18655v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18655

**作者：** Sathiskumar Jothi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18655v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18655v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Beveridge 提出一组开源「System One」文档决策模型：输入文档与至多 15 个类型化问题，一次前向即输出各选项答案及校准概率而不生成文本，核心包含问题到文档的证据注意力、三步入递归核心与学习式停机，并报告自动交接率与推理延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其递归核心中的学习式停机、证据注意力与校准概率可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 决策、视觉证据筛选与高置信自动交接阈值的借鉴；但对象为纯文本文档、无视觉内部状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beveridge: Open Weight System One Decision Models with Calibrated Probabilities

**abstract/A1：** Many production systems need a model to make a narrow decision about a document (route a ticket, check a limit, refuse a request, pick the next step of a browser agent) rather than to write text about it. We present Beveridge, a family of open weight System One decision models that take a document and up to 15 typed questions (yes/no, choice among described options, or a level on an ordered scale) and return, in one forward pass without generating text, an answer with a calibrated probability for every option. Beveridge-Large-C (398M parameters) adds a 3.5M parameter decision network to ModernBERT-large: typed number and date features in the input, exact facts from a rule engine, question-to-document evidence attention, a three-step recursive core with learned halting and an exact yes/no path. Beveridge-Pro-C adapts Gemma 4 26B-A4B with LoRA to score option letters, and Beveridge-Pro-C-Web extends it to the next step of a browser agent. On held-out tests the 0.4B model reaches 93.0% on our operations-document benchmark against 91.1% for the best of five general LLMs (31B-675B) and 87.9% for a commercial System One API, and, because its confidences are calibrated (ECE 0.029 on that benchmark), it can hand over 76% of decisions automatically at 95% accuracy, where no general LLM we tested can hand over any. It answers in 4.9 ms per decision on one NVIDIA H200 GPU and 60 ms on the 14 core CPU of an Apple M4 Pro laptop. Beveridge-Pro-C-Web raises next-step accuracy on web pages from unseen site types from 49.4% to 98.2% and completes live browsing tasks without losing document accuracy. We describe the models, the training recipes and an evaluation on 19 held-out test sets against a commercial System One API and five general LLMs, including where the models are weak. Weights and inference code are released under Apache 2.0.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 11 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/sathiskumarjothi0-oss/bev-decisions-pypi

### 88. [ECOD: Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18656v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18656

**作者：** Jie Jin、Shengqin Wang、Yan Gao、Xin Tan、Yuan Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18656v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18656v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ECOD，在 on-policy 蒸馏中按任务、轨迹和轮次三级分配教师监督：用匹配任务条件下师生成功率后验比较、仅对失败轨迹施加直接监督、并以成功教师轨迹长度构造时间先验，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上验证其可叠加于多种蒸馏目标。

**相关性简评：** 该工作面向纯文本多轮 agent、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其按「任务—轨迹—轮次」校准监督权重、只在失败轨迹上强监督的思路，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督稀疏问题提供可核查的借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ECOD: Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents

**abstract/A1：** Sparse and delayed rewards make reinforcement learning challenging for long-horizon language agents. On-policy distillation (OPD) complements environmental rewards with dense teacher feedback on student-generated contexts. Standard OPD can misalign supervision with relative teacher competence, student trajectory outcomes, and the temporal structure of task execution. Recent variants adjust guidance through divergence-based weighting and temporal schedules, while joint calibration from task-completion experience remains underexplored. We introduce Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (ECOD), which allocates teacher supervision at the task, trajectory, and turn levels. ECOD compares teacher and student success-rate posteriors under matched task conditions, restricts direct supervision to failed student trajectories, and derives a temporal prior from successful teacher lengths. The resulting weight applies to teacher losses or teacher-derived advantages. We evaluate ECOD on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Under matched teacher settings, ECOD improves standard OPD by up to 4.06% in relative ALFWorld unseen success. Across both model scales, ECOD-assisted SOD, TCOD-F2B, and ATOD configurations yield average paired relative gains of 6.20% on ALFWorld unseen and 7.05% on WebShop, with WebShop gains ranging from 2.29% to 21.60%. These results support experience-calibrated supervision allocation as a reusable mechanism across distinct distillation objectives.

</details>

### 89. [Rethinking the Verification of Machine Unlearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18658v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18658

**作者：** Lei Zhou、Youwen zhu、Rongke Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18658v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18658v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究机器遗忘的可验证性：提出输出级欺骗攻击 ODR，说明仅凭预测行为判定的验证器可在内部表示未变时被蒙混；进而提出灰盒验证器 RUV，对比原模型与遗忘模型的中间前向表示，沿激活重组、表示位移、邻域破坏与流形支撑丧失四个阶段取证，并用匹配保留对照与联合置换校准做自适应判定。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索「输出符合不等于内部状态改变」及用中间表示对比加对照控制区分目标特异反应与全局漂移的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正读取 latent 内容、以及表示级探测评价的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking the Verification of Machine Unlearning

**abstract/A1：** Machine unlearning claims require evidence that a model has removed the influence of specified training data. Yet widely deployable post hoc verifiers. infer unlearning largely from predictive behavior, the final model response that remains under the provider's control. We make this limitation concrete through Output-Level Deceptive Response (ODR), an attack that produces responses accepted by output based verifiers while preserving the original representation state. By separating output conformity from internal unlearning, ODR motivates a rethinking of machine unlearning verification, shifting the audit target from what the model returns to what changes inside it. We operationalize this shift through Representation Unlearning Verification (RUV), a gray box verifier that compares intermediate forward representations in the original and unlearned models. RUV traces a four-stage response through activation reorganization, representation displacement, neighborhood disruption, and loss of manifold support. Matched retained controls distinguish target specific responses from global model drift, while joint permutation calibration combines the four evidence views into an adaptive decision. Experiments spanning exact and approximate unlearning, class and sample level requests, multiple datasets, and diverse architectures show mean ODR deception success rates of $97.0\\%$ and $97.7\\%$, respectively. RUV achieves mean verification accuracies of $98.9\\%$ and $94.9\\%$, while rejecting $99.5\\%$ and $99.8\\%$ of the corresponding ODR submissions.

</details>

### 90. [Speaking-Clock Mamba: Phoneme-Conditioned State-Space Modeling for Visual Forced Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18667v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18667

**作者：** Nan Lu、Qifan Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18667v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18667v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Speaking-Clock Mamba，在视觉前端与 Conformer 之间插入选择性状态空间主干，用受监督的单调「说话时钟」条件化其输入相关扫描步长，定位静音说话视频中的音素与词边界，并以免训练方式在因果/双向变体间按置信度择一。

**相关性简评：** 将单调进度信号注入循环状态更新，可能与 LVR 中依赖长度的进度表示、状态演化与停止决策相关；因果与双向变体的互补误差及置信选择也可供核查多种 latent 假设的聚合与筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Speaking-Clock Mamba: Phoneme-Conditioned State-Space Modeling for Visual Forced Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Visual forced alignment (VFA) locates phoneme and word boundaries in a silent talking-face video given its transcript. Existing methods mainly enforce transcript order at the decoding stage, leaving the encoder without an explicit mechanism to anchor its temporally evolving representation to transcript progress. As a result, phoneme-specific evidence is blurred and alignment drift accumulates over long sequences. In this paper, we propose Speaking-Clock Mamba, which makes transcript progress part of the temporal recurrence. A selective state-space (Mamba) backbone is inserted between the visual frontend and the Conformer cross-attention encoder, and a Phoneme-Conditioned Selective Scan (PCSS) conditions its input-dependent step size on a supervised, structurally monotone speaking clock that estimates progress through the transcript. Since causal and bidirectional variants of this backbone make complementary errors, a training-free selector picks the more confident alignment per utterance. Experiments on LRS2 and LRS3 show consistent gains over protocol-matched baselines, and the supervised clock provides an explicit estimate of alignment progress.

</details>

### 91. [Robust-GCD](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18673v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18673

**作者：** Daniel Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18673v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18673v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 D-GCD 设定：无标注池中有一部分图像被未知算子损坏且比例未知；Robust-GCD 从无标注池中估计损坏程度，在特征空间的受污染区域构建已知类锚点与新颖类伪锚点，并用「信任课程」控制对无标注数据的依赖程度，配合配对对齐损失拉近干净图与损坏副本。

**相关性简评：** 视觉特征被损坏时的损坏估计与信任调度，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、不可靠视觉输入的降权与 latent 状态更新提供借鉴线索；但该工作是无生成推理的判别式分类，与 latent 推理状态的产生和停止决策无直接关系，需核查其锚点与信任机制能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Robust-GCD

**abstract/A1：** Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) classifies an unlabeled pool that contains both known and novel classes, given labels for the known classes only. Existing GCD methods assume that every un- labeled image is clean, but unlabeled data collected in the wild is often degraded by blur, sensor noise and compression artifacts. We formalize the setting in which an unknown fraction of the unlabeled pool is corrupted by an unknown operator as Degraded Generalized Category Discovery (D-GCD). To tackle it, we propose Robust-GCD, a framework that estimates the corruption directly from the unlabeled pool and uses the estimate to build labeled anchors for known classes and pseudo-anchors for novel classes inside the corrupted region of feature space. A trust curriculum controls how much the unlabeled pool is trusted while the anchors take hold, and a paired alignment loss keeps a clean image and its corrupted twin close in feature space. Across five datasets and multiple corruption families, Robust-GCD recovers between 43% and 96% of the All accuracy that SimGCD loses under contamination, and more than 60% on four of the five datasets, with the largest gains on the corrupted images themselves.

</details>

### 92. [Not All Steps Matter: Temporally Adaptive Spectral Control for Concept Removal in Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18678v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18678

**作者：** Chanaka Thushitha Bandara、Lakmali Nadeesha Kumari、Sen-Ching Samson Cheung

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18678v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18678v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文做去噪逐步的光谱分析，发现概念能量随 timestep 呈「内容—物体—风格」的时间层级，并提出 TASN：按每步概念能量调整抑制强度与光谱子空间，在免训练概念移除中兼顾攻击成功率与图像质量。

**相关性简评：** 其按步测量信号能量、并让干预强度与之成比例的自适应调度，可能为 LVR 中「每步 latent 内容贡献不均」的度量与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算分配提供参照，交叉注意力分解为概念对齐与正交分量也或可供核查任务必要信息与旁路干扰的区分；但任务本身是图像生成中的概念移除，与 VLM 推理状态无直接关联，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Steps Matter: Temporally Adaptive Spectral Control for Concept Removal in Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** As text-to-image diffusion models see widespread deployment, removing unsafe or undesirable concepts without retraining has become a pressing need. Spectral methods are attractive because they are training-free and reversible, yet current variants apply the same output-value (OV) circuit intervention at every denoising step, assuming concept information is temporally uniform. This wastes intervention where concept energy is low while degrading image quality, an inefficiency that compounds across concept types. Through timestep-resolved spectral analysis, concept-specific energy is found to follow a consistent temporal hierarchy: content concepts decay fastest, object concepts are intermediate, and style concepts persist longest. This paper proposes Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Nullification (TASN), which adapts suppression strength and spectral components to the concept energy profile. Cross-attention at each timestep is decomposed into concept-aligned and concept-orthogonal components, and it is proved that when the orthogonal component is approximately stable, the collateral-minimizing schedule sets suppression proportional to concept energy. TASN implements this with a timestep-adaptive spectral subset tracking only active concept directions, strictly generalizing uniform Spectral Nullification (SN). On five red-teaming benchmarks, TASN lowers attack success rate below uniform SN while recovering the majority of its quality loss; ablations confirm gains arise from temporal targeting rather than reduced suppression, generalizing across concept categories and architectures.

</details>

### 93. [Spread Too Thin: How Higher Resolution Dilutes a Vision Transformer's Attention, and a Training-Free Rescaling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18680v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18680

**作者：** Neil D. B. Bruce

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18680v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18680v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析 ViT 在高于训练分辨率下注意力行被大量 patch 摊薄的规律，据此提出一种无需训练的 logit 重标定（按测试与训练 token 数对数之比缩放所有分数），并在 DINOv2 等公开模型与受控模型中检验 register/sink 份额与准确率的部分恢复。

**相关性简评：** 其对「token 增多稀释注意力、固定分数通道（含 register/sink）份额下降」的刻画与测试时无训练重标定，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留与证据筛选是否随视觉 token 规模被稀释，以及注意力结构对 latent 相似度分析的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spread Too Thin: How Higher Resolution Dilutes a Vision Transformer's Attention, and a Training-Free Rescaling

**abstract/A1：** A vision transformer read at a higher resolution than it was trained at spreads each attention row over many more patches, yet every row must still hand out exactly one unit of weight. A law of softmax attention predicts that a growing crowd of bounded scores dilutes the attention on any patch or register whose score stays fixed. The same law gives a remedy that needs no training: multiply every score, the sink's included, by the ratio of the logarithms of the test and training token counts. Given sufficient margins at the training resolution, this keeps the attention on a match when one is present, and on a sink such as a register when none is, though trained models need not meet those margins. We test these predictions in public vision transformers and in controlled models read far above their training token count. Attention spreads as predicted. Registers lose their share, though production models compensate in part, and the rescaling holds the share of DINOv2's registers nearly level. Applied at test time without training, the rescaling recovers part of the lost accuracy in nearly every model, with absolute or rotary positions and with registers, and on images with native detail. The calibrated multiplier rises with the logarithmic ratio on average and varies across models. Its rise is steeper than the square-root rule used in image generators; in controlled models the log ratio is also more accurate, while in the public models the two rules' accuracy difference remains unresolved. The rescaling does not restore the attention a model learned, and why it helps, beyond countering the dilution, remains open.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, 11 additional appendix pages

</details>

### 94. [3D Cell Morphology--Clinical Text Contrastive Learning with Voxel Swin Transformer and Finding Encoder Domain-Adaptation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18686v1>)

**相关性简评：** 其「InfoNCE 正常下降但嵌入坍缩」的诊断以及 LoRA 依赖预训练主干的前提，可能为 LVR 中的 latent 信息坍缩、训练损失与表示可用性脱钩提供可核查线索，但领域与推理任务距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** 3D Cell Morphology--Clinical Text Contrastive Learning with Voxel Swin Transformer and Finding Encoder Domain-Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Our prior work adapted a 2D CLIP dual encoder with LoRA to a multi-source cell-microscopy corpus, reaching anomaly-scoring ROC-AUC up to 0.985. This paper advances the same contrastive-learning domain-adaptation methodology from 2D microscope images to 3D microscope volumes, pairing a 3D Swin Transformer voxel encoder (MONAI's SwinUNETR backbone) with ClinicalBERT as the finding-text encoder. We train on 3,000 single-cell 3D confocal fluorescence volumes (4 tagged organelle structures) from the Allen Institute's public hiPSC single-cell image dataset, paired with template-generated finding text, with mitotic (dividing) cells oversampled as an abnormal-like proxy class validated by ROC-AUC. Naively reusing work's freeze backbone, LoRA the attention projections recipe for the Voxel Encoder collapses voxel embeddings to near-input-invariance, since LoRA's low-rank delta cannot compensate for an otherwise-frozen, randomly initialized (not pretrained) 3D Swin backbone, even as InfoNCE loss decreases healthily. Switching the Voxel Encoder to full fine-tuning resolves this: 4-way zero-shot structure accuracy rises from 25.0% (chance) to 48.6%, and voxel anomaly-scoring ROC-AUC improves from 0.486 to a peak of 0.628 (still below the 0.70 sanity threshold), while bidirectional retrieval recall stays low (R@10 $\\le$3.8%). We further introduce a nearest-neighbor diagnosis-reason retrieval evaluation, reaching 29.8% hit-rate@{1,5} at its best scale while scoring 0.0% elsewhere. The central finding of this MVP is architectural: LoRA's parameter-efficiency assumption presumes a pretrained backbone worth preserving, and breaks down when the backbone is randomly initialized.

### 95. [Beyond Raw Similarity: Prior-Aware Fusion for Out-of-Distribution Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18692v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18692

**作者：** Lakpa Tamang、Mohamed Reda Bouadjenek、Saman Forouzandeh、Kamal Berahmand、Mahdi Jalili、Sunil Aryal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18692v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18692v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对视觉语言模型中的 OOD 检测，提出 MM-Log：在每个模态中同时保留冻结的零样本 CLIP 先验与任务适配分支，将四路跨模态相似度通道融合为单一 OOD 分数，并用 margin bound 说明零样本与适配分支的不一致会惩罚融合分数。

**相关性简评：** 其“冻结先验与适配分支一致性校验”及跨通道相似度融合，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度受几何漂移影响、以及依据内部状态可靠性做停止或证据筛选提供方法线索，需核查其分数校准方式是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Raw Similarity: Prior-Aware Fusion for Out-of-Distribution Detection

**abstract/A1：** Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in vision-language models presents unique challenges due to the reliance on cross-modal similarity. Even when embeddings are well separated for in-distribution (ID) data, similarity scores can remain overconfident for OOD inputs. A common remedy is to adapt the model on ID data, but adaptation discards the pretrained geometry that made the similarity meaningful. We propose multi-modal logit fusion (MM-Log), which keeps both by pairing a gradient-free zero-shot prior with a task-adapted branch in each modality and fuses their four cross-modal similarity channels into a single OOD score. Because the zero-shot priors are never adapted, the cross-channels act as a consistency check between the pretrained and adapted geometries: an OOD input that fools the adapted branch through a shortcut must additionally agree with frozen CLIP to retain a high score. We formalize this as a margin bound showing that the fused score is provably penalized by disagreement between the zero-shot and adapted branches, a signal to which adapted-only scores are structurally blind. MM-Log requires no auxiliary OOD data, negative prompts, or test-time adaptation, and trains on few-shot ID data alone. Across Far-OOD, Near-OOD, and Hard-OOD benchmarks, MM-Log consistently outperforms strong CLIP-based baselines.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Does an On-Device Prescription Reader Lose Medications? A Frozen-Replay Study, from a 270M Language Model to a 2B Vision-Language Model

**abstract/A1：** On-device models let a phone read a prescription without sending the photograph anywhere, but small models fail in ways that are hard to attribute: to the camera, the OCR, the model, or the rules around it. We study a phone-based pipeline that reads a prescription photograph with PaddleOCR, extracts medications with a 270M-parameter language model, and filters the result with a deterministic backstop before showing suggestions. Replaying identical frozen inputs through each configuration, with deterministic generation verified, we compare configurations with paired document-level intervals on 49 captures of 15 synthetic prescriptions (6 typed, 9 handwritten by one writer). Production recall is 8%, and 0 of 45 on handwriting. The backstop removes no correct medication and cuts unsafe outputs from 45 to 1. On handwriting nearly all medications never reach the model in readable form; on typed sheets the model mostly picks the wrong text. We trace much of the handwriting floor to a defect in our own crop step, then replace the pipeline: rotated-box crops, a 2B-parameter vision-language model that re-reads prescription lines and extracts the medications, and per-line numeric grounding. On the same captures recall rises from 8% to 67% (paired +59 points, 95% CI +40 to +78): typed 19% to 100%, handwritten 0 to 20 of 45, with no unsafe output. Rotated crops account for most of the reading gain and the model for most of the recall gain, and the OCR confidence gate is now the main limit. The cost is 61 s per photograph against about 12 s, and about 1.9 GB of memory. An earlier claim that better OCR lowered recall does not survive the controlled comparison, and we withdraw it. All results are in-sample, from one writer and one device.

**内容简述：** 在 4B 非蒸馏骨干、约 1400 训练对与 2K 分辨率的生产式设定下，比较通道堆叠与序列拼接两种源图条件注入方式用于结构保持型外观编辑，报告精度指标、训练配方和失败模式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Fusion: Channel Stacking for Structure-Preserving Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Instruction-based image editing models must condition on the source image, either by sequence concatenation, which appends source tokens to the target sequence (FLUX.1 Kontext), or by channel-wise concatenation, which stacks the source latent onto the noisy latent and widens the input projection (InstructPix2Pix, FLUX.1 Fill). The FLUX.1 Kontext report found channel-wise concatenation worse in initial experiments at 1K resolution with a 12B model and a large corpus. We explore channel-wise concatenation as the lower-cost option for a common production regime: structure-preserving edits that change appearance (sky, exposure, foliage, cleanup) but not layout, about 1,400 training pairs, a 4B non-distilled backbone, and 2K frames. It keeps the sequence at its original length, where sequence concatenation doubles it and roughly quadruples attention cost, and needs only single-scale classifier-free guidance (two forward passes per step instead of three). Starting from FLUX.2 Klein 4B base, we widen only the input projection and train both schemes with the same trainer, data, and hyperparameters. Channel-wise concatenation keeps the output pixel-aligned with the source; in our runs sequence concatenation, which must learn the correspondence between 10,880 target and 10,880 source tokens from fewer than 1,500 pairs, displaced structure, an observation we report without claiming a general ranking. On 29 held-out images the editor reaches 20.3 dB PSNR and 0.198 LPIPS against the human edit (unedited source: 15.0 dB), and counterfactual conditioning tests show it largely learned a global grade of the source rather than a selective edit, which we report as the open problem of this recipe. We also compare against an SD3.5-Medium editor trained with the same surgery and report the full training recipe, including failure modes. Code: https://github.com/complete-dope/LatentFusion

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/complete-dope/LatentFusion

### 98. [Target-Free Autocalibration of Stereo PIV Camera Systems via Persistent-State Motion Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18741v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18741

**作者：** Nabil Madali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18741v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18741v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种无需标定靶的立体 PIV 相机自标定方法：用循环 transformer 逐路累积粒子运动形成持久状态，解码为光流并由跨视角解码器回归双向点对应，再用五点 RANSAC 恢复相对位姿。

**相关性简评：** 以「匹配运动而非外观」的持久状态累积与跨视角查询解码，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何在内部状态中长期保留并被下游读出的问题提供可供核查的架构线索；但领域相距较远，可迁移性需阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Target-Free Autocalibration of Stereo PIV Camera Systems via Persistent-State Motion Representations

**abstract/A1：** Stereo Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) recovers three-component velocity fields by triangulating tracer particles observed by synchronized cameras. It requires an accurate extrinsic calibration, which is still obtained by inserting a physical target into the flow and must be repeated whenever the rig is moved. We present a target-free method that calibrates a stereo PIV rig directly from particle image sequences. Because tracer particles are visually indistinguishable, we match motion rather than appearance: building on CUT3R, each camera stream is processed by a recurrent transformer whose persistent state accumulates particle motion over time. The state is decoded into per-camera optical flow and queried by a cross-view decoder that regresses bidirectional point correspondences, from which the relative pose is recovered with a five-point RANSAC solver. We train on a new synthetic stereo PIV dataset with ground-truth poses and evaluate on standard PIV optical flow benchmarks and on 200 real rig placements. Our model achieves lower flow error than existing PIV networks, more accurate cross-view correspondences than COTR, and higher pose accuracy than the strongest detector-matcher pipelines on both synthetic and real data, without any calibration target.

</details>

### 99. [Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18747v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18747

**作者：** Guangzhi Sun、Zhonghao Zhai、Yixuan Li、Chao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18747v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18747v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VEX 框架，用视听理解把含画面演示与语音讲解的教程视频转成过程性指导，让 computer-use agent 按「看—做—重看」执行任务，并用重看自身执行视频的方式核查进度；同时提出 AGGO 强化学习，使视频得到的指导更利于下游动作预测，并在 OSWorld 等基准上验证增益。

**相关性简评：** 其把重看视频作为执行中自我核查的环节，可供核查 LVR 中何时重新获取视觉证据与停止决策的问题；用 RL 训练中间指导以服务动作预测，也与轨迹监督和贡献分配有相通之处，但该指导是显式文本而非 latent 状态，联系较为间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent's own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

</details>

### 100. [Feature-Space Latent Forecasting for Endoscopic Surgical Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18750v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18750

**作者：** Songtao Hu、Hang Su

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18750v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18750v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在内窥镜手术视频上提出特征空间语义预测框架：用冻结视觉基础模型的多层特征构建分层目标表示，把未来帧特征 token 替换为可学习 \[MASK\]，训练掩码 transformer 从观测上下文中预测未来 latent 特征，并接轻量下游头做阶段预判、器械存在与剩余时间估计。

**相关性简评：** 其「在冻结 VFM 特征空间而非像素空间预测未来状态」的做法，可能为 LVR 中预测式视觉表示如何组织多层目标、维持可被下游读取的内部状态提供核查线索；但此处的 latent 指连续视觉特征，不涉及推理轨迹或答案生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Feature-Space Latent Forecasting for Endoscopic Surgical Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Surgical workflow assistance is inherently anticipatory: systems must reason about how procedures evolve, not just recognize the current frame. However, many prior approaches perform prediction in pixel space by synthesizing future frames, which primarily focuses on appearance fidelity rather than the semantic representations required for downstream reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose a feature-space semantic forecasting framework that models temporal dynamics directly within the representations of a frozen Vision Foundation Model (VFM). Specifically, we build a hierarchical target representation from multi-layer VFM features, replace future-frame feature tokens with learnable \\texttt{\[MASK\]} tokens, and train a masked transformer to forecast the corresponding future latent features from observed context, thereby formulating procedural evolution as masked future feature prediction. Experiments on public laparoscopic benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in phase anticipation, multi-label tool presence prediction, and remaining-time estimation over RGB-based forecasting baselines, while enabling a plug-and-play representation interface for lightweight downstream heads.

</details>

### 101. [Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18768v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18768

**作者：** Javith Ranatunga、Paimon Goulart、Evangelos E. Papalexakis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18768v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18768v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用 Qwen3.5-27B 在五个合成聚类场景中做三项递进实验：从成对图中判别最优聚类、给聚类图打数值分数、再把该分数接入 agentic 循环以提出新超参数；结果显示清晰结构下判断可靠、噪声歧义场景较弱，最终配置的 silhouette 接近网格搜索与贝叶斯优化但迭代更少。

**相关性简评：** VLM 以可视化结果作为证据打分并驱动迭代与提前终止，可供核查视觉证据如何参与验证与 STOP 决策，但其状态仅为外部聚类配置、并非 latent 推理状态，与 LVR 的迁移联系仍属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?

**abstract/A1：** Clustering is a widely used unsupervised learning method, but selecting an appropriate algorithm and set of hyperparameters for a specific dataset can require many possible configurations and evaluations. In this work, we investigate whether a Vision-Language Model can instead visually evaluate clustering results and use those decisions to then tune an explicit clustering algorithm. We study this through three progressive experiments using Qwen3.5-27B and five controlled synthetic clustering scenarios. First, we test whether the VLM can distinguish the best clustering result from a pair of plots. Second, we test whether it can assign numerical scores to those plots where a higher score represents a better result. Finally, we use these judgments within an agentic loop in which the VLM scores a k-means clustering and proposes updated hyperparameters that may result in better clustering. Our exploratory results show that the VLM performs well when clear cluster structure is present, while struggling on more ambiguous and noisy settings. In the full agentic experiment, the VLM produces clustering configurations with silhouette scores relatively close to those of grid search and Bayesian optimization, while terminating in much fewer iterations. Overall, these results provide an initial proof of concept that VLM-based visual feedback can be used to autonomously tune an explicit clustering algorithm.

</details>

### 102. [Agri-MRAG: Parameter-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Agricultural Visual Question Answering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18771v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18771

**作者：** Fuyong Liu、Xiantao Lei、Xining Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18771v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18771v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Agri-MRAG 农业多模态检索增强框架：用语义一致性引导的聚类和加权相关性打分筛选知识子集并自适应确定检索规模 k，将检索到的农业知识编码为 LoRA 适配器并入 MLLM 的 FFN 层，并用困惑度引导的路由在参数化隐式推理与显式检索增强生成之间切换；同时构建了区域林业与果树 VQA 数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其中基于模型不确定性的「隐式推理 / 检索生成」路由可供核查是否能类比 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的证据获取与停止决策，参数级知识注入也涉及外部证据如何进入生成过程；但工作聚焦农业领域检索增强，未分析内部 latent 状态，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agri-MRAG: Parameter-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Agricultural Visual Question Answering

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has shown promise for Agricultural Visual Question Answering (Agri-VQA), but existing methods still face challenges in retrieving relevant knowledge while avoiding redundancy and in integrating retrieved evidence beyond simple prompt concatenation. To address these issues, we propose Agri-MRAG, a multimodal retrieval-augmented framework for agricultural VQA. Specifically, we first introduce a semantic-consistency-guided clustering mechanism that combines multimodal clustering and weighted relevance scoring to select high-confidence knowledge subsets and adaptively determine the retrieval size $k$. We then design a parameterized knowledge injection strategy, where retrieved agricultural knowledge is encoded into LoRA adapters and merged into the feed-forward network (FFN) layers of the MLLM, allowing external knowledge to influence generation through parameter-level adaptation. In addition, a perplexity-guided (PPL-guided) routing mechanism is employed to switch between implicit parametric reasoning and explicit retrieval-assisted generation according to model uncertainty, balancing inference efficiency and answer reliability. For evaluation, we use PlantVillageVQA as a broad agricultural benchmark and construct PlantVQA, a region-specific forestry and fruit crop VQA dataset containing 7,514 images and 15,028 expert-verified question-answer pairs. Experiments show that Agri-MRAG achieves ROUGE-L scores of 41.21 and 46.58 on the two datasets, outperforming mRAG by 11.70 and 4.51 points, and VisRAG by 8.80 and 3.39 points, respectively.

</details>

### 103. [Quantum-inspired orthogonal adapters for certifiably robust medical image classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18775v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18775

**作者：** Olga Tsurkan、Laia Domingo、Victoria Orlova、Asel Sagingalieva、Iris Zalaudek、Raffaele Dante Caposiena Caro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、quant-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18775v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18775v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出基于量子启发正交 butterfly 层的微调方法，在适配预训练认证鲁棒医学图像分类器时保持 Lipschitz 界，参数量仅 O(n log n)，并在 MNIST、MedMNIST 及毛发镜图像分类上对比常规微调与 LoRA。

**相关性简评：** 结构化正交层可参数高效地维持范数/Lipschitz 界，这一线索可供核查是否适用于 VLM 适配中的视觉特征或 latent 状态更新稳定性；但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Quantum-inspired orthogonal adapters for certifiably robust medical image classification

**abstract/A1：** Medical image classifiers require not only high accuracy but also reliable predictions under small input perturbations. Certified robustness provides mathematical guarantees of prediction stability, but preserving these guarantees when adapting pretrained models to new tasks remains challenging. We propose a fine-tuning approach based on quantum-inspired orthogonal butterfly layers that preserves the Lipschitz bounds of pretrained certified networks. Inspired by quantum circuits of reconfigurable beam splitters, these layers preserve orthogonality by construction using only $\\mathcal{O}(n\\log n)$ trainable parameters. Their structured design enables efficient classical implementation and offers a path toward future quantum implementations with logarithmic circuit depth under suitable connectivity assumptions. Controlled experiments on MNIST and MedMNIST demonstrate improved certified robustness compared with conventional alternatives and, in the DermaMNIST transfer, greater resistance to the tested attacks than low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We then apply it to trichoscopic image classification for alopecia diagnosis and alopecia areata activity assessment. By adapting a certified ImageNet-pretrained network, butterfly fine-tuning achieves approximately twice the certified accuracy of conventional fine-tuning and LoRA, with comparable classification accuracy on the same backbone and data split and similar empirical resistance to the tested adversarial attacks. Larger robustness guarantees, including certificates covering certain image-processing transformations, can be obtained at the cost of reduced accuracy. These results highlight the potential of quantum-inspired butterfly layers for parameter-efficient adaptation of medical image classifiers while preserving the mathematical guarantees underlying certified robustness.

</details>

### 104. [Recovered or Memorized? Investigating Dynamical Consistency and Faithfulness in World Model Latents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18807v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18807

**作者：** Jerome Francisco、Kyle Deng、George Flint、Kevin Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18807v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18807v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Anchored Recovery Certification（ARC），用离散 Fréchet 距离在仿射规范意义下衡量世界模型 latent 与真实动力系统的一致性，并在 TD-MPC2 单摆任务上通过 PCA 干预子空间检验其动态忠实性。

**相关性简评：** 「latent 是恢复动力学还是记住轨迹」的判据与干预式忠实性检验，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 是否真正承载任务动态而非记忆表面轨迹；但对象是 RL 世界模型，启发式迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recovered or Memorized? Investigating Dynamical Consistency and Faithfulness in World Model Latents

**abstract/A1：** World models develop internal simulators that can learn the structure and dynamics of an environment. It has been demonstrated that their internal representations are both meaningful and causal, but are these representations faithful to the governing dynamics of the environment they are learning? We introduce Anchored Recovery Certification (ARC), a procedure that utilizes a discrete Fréchet distance calculation with ground truth to evaluate dynamical consistency on candidate world models up to an affine gauge. We use the procedure on TD-MPC2 (decoder-free world model) that has learned the pendulum swing on an observation lift under varying hyperparameters at k = 5, 10, 25 steps. The model is then steered within a PCA-derived intervention subspace and compared against a ground-truth simulator using relative error to investigate dynamical faithfulness. ARC sufficiency held for TD-MPC2 most consistently at k = 10, with six of seven constraints statistically significant after Holm-Bonferroni correction, while the relative error between the simulator and the causal latent remained substantial. Further research could be conducted with decoder world models such as DreamerV3 (reconstruction loss) to investigate whether the results differ.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18809v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18809v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LEAP-LLM，用临床问题经任务训练的指令表示引导 ECG 特征提取，分 lead 分支与 temporal 分支保留导联与时间结构，压缩模态 token 后交由 LLM 作答，并在多个 ECG 基准上报告性能提升与可解释的导联重要性。

**相关性简评：** 其「问题条件化特征提取 + 保留结构的两路压缩」与 LVR 中按问题筛选视觉证据、避免无关细节淹没关键信息的问题相通，可供核查该蒸馏式指令表示能否迁移为视觉 latent 状态的筛选与压缩机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LEAP-LLM: Preserving lead-time structure for question-conditioned ECG interpretation

**abstract/A1：** The electrocardiogram (ECG) records cardiac electrical activity across multiple leads and is used for detecting cardiac abnormalities. Recent ECG-language models enable large language models (LLMs) to interpret cardiac signals and answer clinically relevant questions. However, existing ECG-language models typically encode the ECG independently of the clinical question, forcing the ECG representation to retain broad and potentially irrelevant signal information. Moreover, these models often aggregate information across leads which can obscure lead-specific details needed for a particular question. To tackle these limitations, we introduce LEAP-LLM, an ECG-LLM architecture for Lead-aware ECG Alignment with Prompt conditioning. LEAP-LLM uses the clinical question to guide ECG feature extraction while preserving explicit lead and temporal structure. Task-trained instruction representations distill information from the question and guide two complementary branches. The Lead branch captures question-relevant temporal patterns within each ECG lead, while the Temporal branch summarizes relevant information across leads at each temporal position. Together, they provide the LLM with compact, question-relevant ECG information while preserving lead and temporal structure. LEAP-LLM reduces modality-token count by 89.0% and prefill FLOPs by 7.2x on average relative to other ECG-LLMs baselines. Across four ECG benchmarks, LEAP-LLM achieves better performance, including a 3.4-percentage-point improvement in G12EC over the strongest prior ECG-specific method. We further show that the model adaptively emphasizes the clinically relevant anatomical lead groups for different cardiac abnormalities, with lead importance patterns consistent with established diagnostic knowledge, providing interpretable evidence that the predictions are supported by clinically meaningful ECG structure.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18811

**作者：** Yifan Jin、Tao Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18811v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18811v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移
