摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CARET，一种参数高效的医学图像侧适配方法：保留预训练图像与文本编码器，用成对正负临床陈述构造低维语义校正空间，以有界残差调整图像特征，并监督区分「明确存在、否定、不确定、未提及」四种断言状态，在 CheXpert 5×200 与 RSNA 零样本分类上优于 CLEFT-LoRA。

**相关性简评：** 其以有界残差沿语义方向编辑图像特征、并用断言状态监督避免无视觉依据的预测，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的视觉内容筛选与定向编辑提供方法线索；但该工作面向分类而非推理，校正方向是否真对应视觉证据需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CARET: Clinical Assertion-Aware Residual Calibration for Medical Image-Text Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Medical vision--language models align radiographs with free-text reports, but radiology language distinguishes explicit findings, negation, uncertainty, and omission. Treating these report states as interchangeable during feature adaptation can change image predictions without supporting visual evidence. We introduce CARET, a parameter-efficient image-side adaptation method that retains pretrained image and text encoders and uses paired positive and negative clinical statements to define a low-dimensional semantic correction space. A bounded residual adjusts image features along these directions, while assertion-aware supervision distinguishes explicitly present and absent findings from uncertain or unmentioned ones. At inference, the adapter requires only an image; textual references remain fixed. In zero-shot classification, CARET achieves 67.80\\% accuracy on CheXpert 5$\\times$200 and 65.20\\% on RSNA. These scores exceed the published CLEFT-LoRA results by 1.06 and 0.27 percentage points, respectively. Comparisons to literature baselines are informative but not controlled for differences in pretraining and evaluation protocols. Ablations across eight components identify the four-state distinction and assertion objective as major contributors, with task-dependent effects for nonmention preservation and pair alignment.

</details>

### 107. [What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18818v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18818

**作者：** Qijin Zhang、Hanzhen Wang、Yan Huang、Zhongxiang Dai、Shuang Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18818v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18818v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SPG-Select 框架，用 MIRT 从二元结果推断智能体的多维技能画像，以相邻画像估计之差作为「替代进展」来分配练习任务预算，并加入不确定性探索与周期重启以应对技能需求的非平稳性，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 虽不涉及视觉推理，但其从二元成败中估计多维 latent 能力状态并据此主动选择训练任务、用不确定性驱动探索的做法，可供核查是否用于 LVR 训练期数据/轨迹筛选与能力维度贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Task selection shapes the experiences available for skill evolution in LLM agents, yet fixed practice schedules overlook differences in skill requirements and evolving task value. Most existing methods, however, rely on fixed schedules or scalar measures of progress, leaving nonstationary skill demands unaddressed. We propose SPG-Select, a framework for allocating limited practice budget using a multidimensional profile inferred from binary outcomes via MIRT. The framework predicts surrogate progress, defined as the difference between consecutive profile estimates, and prioritizes progress in dimensions with larger estimated proficiency gaps. Our SPG-Select-R policy combines these predictions with uncertainty-based exploration and periodic restarting to accommodate nonstationarity. We evaluate SPG-Select on ALFWorld and WebShop with three skill-evolution backends. In the reported runs, SPG-Select-R achieves higher mean held-out terminal success than uniform sampling in all six backend-benchmark combinations, with gains of 1.49-13.18 percentage points on ALFWorld and 0.93-3.13 points on WebShop. Under a predictable linear surrogate model and boundedness assumptions, we establish a high-probability dynamic pseudo-regret bound for surrogate task allocation in terms of parameter path variation.

</details>

### 108. [Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18856

**作者：** Xin Yu、Fei Xia、Jiaqi Pan、Youbao Tang、Chengzhi Liu、Adams Yu、Sicong Jiang、Yanfei Chen、Lingzhou Xue、Ting Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18856v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Continual Recursive Self-Improvement 设定，研究在更换基准或策略模型后继续既有 harness 优化流程，并给出 Self-Improvement Memory：按反复出现的 harness 问题分组记录编辑理由、预测与实际结果及评测上下文，供后续优化复用。

**相关性简评：** 其「按问题分组记录改动理由、预测与实测结果」的记忆组织方式，可能为 LVR 中推理状态更新的贡献分配、轨迹训练数据的复用与跨任务延续提供核查线索，但对象是外层 harness 优化器而非模型内部 latent 视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed. In this work, we study Continual Recursive Self-Improvement (CRSI), a setting for continuing existing harness-optimization methods across compatible benchmarks or policy models. We propose Self-Improvement Memory (SIM) for the harness optimizer, rather than the task-solving policy. SIM groups edits by recurring harness problem and records their rationale, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation context. New attempts extend this history as optimization continues. In our experiments across four domains, SIM achieves higher final scores than harness-only and root-cause-only continuation in cross-dataset and pairwise cross-model comparisons. Across ten independent source runs in coding, paired continuations with SIM improve final scores by an average of 2.36 points over harness-only continuation ($p=0.003$).

</details>

### 109. [Guided Group Featurizers (GGF): Improving Block-Sparse Featurizers with Object-Guided Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18861v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18861

**作者：** Waldemar Chang、Andrii Krutsylo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18861v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18861v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Guided Group Featurizers（GGF），在保留 block-sparse featurizer 架构的前提下用物体标注引导初始化与训练，使每个稀疏方向组的强响应区域对应同一物体、部件或材料，并用盲评语义一致性、单组覆盖率与定位等指标评估响应集中度。

**相关性简评：** 其「概念信息是否被归并进单一稀疏组」的度量与组内响应集中性分析，可能可供核查 LVR 内部视觉证据是否保留、是否坍缩到少数子空间；但该工作纯属视觉特征可解释性，无推理与状态更新环节，映射关系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Guided Group Featurizers (GGF): Improving Block-Sparse Featurizers with Object-Guided Learning

**abstract/A1：** Block-sparse featurizers (BSFs) use groups of learned directions to capture the multidimensional structure of visual concepts. However, grouping alone does not ensure that information about a concept is consolidated within a single group. We introduce Guided Group Featurizers (GGF), a novel object-guided extension that uses object annotations for initialization and training while preserving the BSF architecture. We assess whether each group's strongest response regions share an object type, part or material across images. Blinded reviews give GGF groups an average semantic coherence score of $94.1\\pm0.9$%, versus $83.0\\pm1.9$% for SLiCS and $65.3\\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF. GGF's consolidation advantage extends to unguided categories: one selected group per category covers $65.6\\pm2.4$% of target-containing crops, versus $58.2\\pm2.2$% for supervised Vanilla BSF, at approximately 5% false-positive rates for both. Across COCO and VOC, GGF also improves single-group object Capture and localization over Vanilla BSFs, SLiCS and Concept-SAE. Its groups produce more focused and reproducible object responses while supporting recognition and retaining associations under rotation, scale and brightness changes. GGF also uses fewer learned parameters than Concept-SAE and shorter recorded VOC training loops than both supervised alternatives. These findings support object guidance for organizing more interpretable BSF groups and show that response concentration extends to categories excluded from guidance.

</details>

### 110. [SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18883v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18883

**作者：** Anish Acharya、Phillip Studans、Amit Dhanda、Sina Amini Niaki、Ninad Vivek Rao、Vishal Amarlal Khatri、Brian Verkhovsky

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18883v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18883v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPLICE，把自然语言提示优化表述为在块结构化、可选可变状态的编辑图上的约束组合搜索，用逐块冻结、带多样性槽的精英束搜索与长度比正则分别约束契约漂移、谱系坍塌和膨胀。

**相关性简评：** 其「块级可变状态+编辑图」、带多样性保持的精英束搜索及长度-精度权衡界，可能为 latent 推理状态的分块更新、推理轨迹搜索多样性与长度泛化控制提供可核查的借鉴线索，但需确认能否迁移到视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPLICE: Structured Prompt Local Iterative Combinatorial Evolution

**abstract/A1：** Natural language optimization (NLO) improves an agent by having a model critique and rewrite its natural language policy parameters: system prompts, tool instructions, reasoning directives, few-shot demonstrations. These artifacts are multi-section documents in which some sections encode contracts (safety clauses, tool schemas, output formats) that must not drift, while others are legitimate optimization targets. Most iterative NLO methods treat the artifact as a single editable string, producing three recurrent failure modes: unsafe global rewrites, beam collapse onto a single lineage, and unchecked bloat, none addressed by formal guarantees. We introduce SPLICE, a unified NLO framework that poses optimization as constrained combinatorial search over an edit graph of block-structured, selectively-mutable states. We map each failure mode to a matched guarantee: (i) per-block mutability preserves contract text verbatim, with a price-of-freezing bound; (ii) elitist beam search with diversity slots never lets the leader regress on validation, bounds regression under noisy re-evaluation by an exponential tail, and keeps a competitive candidate from a different parent whenever one exists; (iii) a ratio length regularizer comes with an explicit accuracy-length bias bound. Candidates are proposed from dual section-local textual gradients; under a proposer-competence condition whose proxy we measure, edit-graph reachability and a convergence rate bound how quickly improving children arrive. Across seven public benchmarks under five reproduced protocols, SPLICE wins on four and matches the strongest prior method on three. On a production-style contract stress test it keeps the contract clauses that unconstrained optimizers trade away to raise the proxy metric, and ablations attribute gains to critique and elitist search.

</details>

### 111. [Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18891

**作者：** Mohamed Salim Aissi、Olivier Sigaud、Laure Soulier、Nicolas Thome

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18891v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 VLA 微调导致原 VLM 语义与视觉 grounding 能力退化的问题，该文不重训模型，而是提取 VLM 到 VLA 的任务向量并用 SVD 分解，为各分量学习标量混合系数，以同时保留动作预测与视觉语言能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「微调后视觉 grounding 被覆盖」的诊断与参数子空间合并思路，或可供核查 LVR 训练中视觉信息坍缩、基座能力保持与旁路设计；但对象是机器人动作模型而非推理状态，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

**comment/C1：** Accept at EACL 2027 (Main)

</details>

### 112. [How Much Do Foundation Models Add to Gradient Boosting on Financial Event Sequences?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18914v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18914

**作者：** Carlos Eduardo Martins Relvas、Gustavo di Giovanni Bernardo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18914v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18914v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在信用卡、银行交易、贸易信用与 B2B 流失等序列数据上，比较预训练序列基础模型与「时点窗口聚合 + LightGBM」强基线的增益，并提出 TBS（对增强梯度提升与微调序列网络的输出排名取平均）的融合方案，配合多标签预算、五随机种子与配对 bootstrap 区间，同时复查 TabFormer、AML 两个基准的评测伪影。

**相关性简评：** 非视觉工作，但其「冻结自监督嵌入几乎不优于强基线、仅联合微调才有效」的对照设计，以及基准伪影与时点对齐基线的审查方式，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真被使用、增益如何归因以及评测是否存在捷径。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Do Foundation Models Add to Gradient Boosting on Financial Event Sequences?

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models pretrained on raw transaction sequences are proposed for credit, fraud and churn modeling, with reported gains over gradient boosting, but the data and baselines behind these gains are rarely public. We measure how much the pretraining and adaptation recipes of these models add to a baseline of point-in-time window aggregates and LightGBM, and we propose TBS (Temporal Boosting-Sequence ensemble), which averages the ranks of a boosting model enriched with label-free event-transition features and of a pretrained sequence network fine-tuned jointly with the aggregates. On a synthetic credit-card dataset, the public MBD-mini banking dataset and two proprietary datasets of trade credit and B2B churn, we compare 27 methods at three label budgets with five seeds and paired bootstrap intervals, using sequence models of about 0.4 million parameters pretrained per dataset. Frozen self-supervised embeddings rarely improve the baseline, and a fine-tuned sequence network alone clears it in 9 of 21 target-budget cells. TBS clears it in 19 of 21 cells (18 after FDR adjustment), with a median gain of +1.8 AUC points, and the controls suggest that combining boosting with the pretrained network is the main source of the observed gain. Gains shrink as labels grow and with rich tabular data: with both, the gain on the proprietary datasets is +0.7 and +0.8 points, the latter with an interval including zero. We also re-examine two benchmarks. On IBM TabFormer, the test follows a change in the fraud pattern and the published baseline has no history; with the training period the vendor states, our history-aware LightGBM and our own foundation model stay below the published scores of a commercial model. On IBM AML, a simulation artifact lets a date rule reach F1 0.482, and a point-in-time LightGBM reaches the F1 of graph neural networks whose test graph includes later transactions.

### 113. [Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18916v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18916

**作者：** Dingyang Chen、Jinfeng Xiao、Zhenyu Zhang、William Hu、Ziyu Wang、Yang Liu、Shirley Zhang、Yuan Ling、Xinyang Shen、Qi Zhang、Peijie Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18916v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18916v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 STONE：无标签自蒸馏框架，让模型自行改写生成更简单的「踏脚石」问题，只保留能稳定解出的那些，再将其解答（删去最终答案）作为教师上下文，学生仍只看到原题。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是把一致性筛选与去除答案的示例性解答用作训练监督，而非从答案投票取标签；这一「无标签构造可信过程监督」的思路可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练与监督分配，但论文为纯文本且不涉及视觉或 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Simplify, Agree, Distill: Label-Free Self-Distillation with Stepping Stones

**abstract/A1：** Can a language model teach itself to reason without labels? On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses the model as its own teacher, but strengthens that teacher with a ground-truth solution. The natural label-free substitute, voting over the model's attempts, fails precisely on hard problems: attempts disagree, and their most common answer is often wrong. We propose STONE, a label-free alternative that moves agreement to easier related problems. The model writes these stepping stones, keeps those it solves consistently, and shows the teacher their worked solutions, with final answers removed; the student sees only the original problem. No step reads a label, and inference needs no extra context or model calls. Across five math benchmarks, the proposed method achieves the highest average accuracy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode. Without thinking mode, it gains 13.2 and 22.7 points, 2.5 and 2.7 times the gains of OPSD with ground-truth solutions.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages

</details>

### 114. [Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18958v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18958

**作者：** Hyelin Nam、Jihoon Lee、Seung-Woo Ko、Jinho Choi、Seong-Lyun Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.IT、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18958v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18958v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向噪声信道下的 token 传输，提出接收端双阶段信道后验融合框架：由信道可靠性定位不可靠 token 并构造词表级后验，经 PWE 注入 MLM 输入嵌入、经 AOF 以信道自适应权重融合到输出 logits，从而单次双向推理重建多个错误 token。

**相关性简评：** 其「按可靠性把外部证据加权注入输入嵌入、再与输出分布自适应融合」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的可信度筛选与 latent 状态注入、输出侧证据融合提供可核查的机制线索，但任务与目标差异较大。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dual-Stage Channel-Posterior Integration for MLM-Aided Token Communications

**abstract/A1：** Token transmission over conventional digital modulation is vulnerable to channel impairments, leading to bit errors that cause received tokens to become contextually inconsistent. This paper proposes a receiver-side dual-stage channel-posterior integration framework for masked language model (MLM)-aided token reconstruction. In the proposed framework, the receiver detects unreliable token positions from channel reliability and constructs a vocabulary-level channel-posterior. In particular, within the receiver, Posterior-Weighted Input Embedding (PWE) injects this posterior into the MLM input, while Adaptive Output Logit Fusion (AOF) reuses it at the output with a channel-adaptive weight. Consequently, multiple unreliable tokens can be reconstructed in a single bidirectional MLM inference without retransmission, transmitter-side encoding, or additional MLM training. Experiments over noisy channels show up to a $67.2$\\% improvement in cosine similarity over context-only MLM reconstruction, with consistent gains across different MLM architectures and existing language-model-aided methods.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 5 figures, This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

### 115. [Bilateral Log-Linear Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18974v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18974

**作者：** Kazi Ashik Islam、Guojing Cong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18974v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18974v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 bilateral log-linear attention：在原有以近期查询为中心的对数级状态矩阵层次之外，再加一条以序列起点为锚的层次，合并两路读取，使早期与近期上下文都获得更细的访问分辨率，并给出递归与分块并行形式；在 MQAR 与长上下文 NIAH、检索任务上验证召回提升。

**相关性简评：** 双层次状态与 KV 缓存压缩涉及长上下文证据的保留与读取，可供核查 LVR 中早期视觉证据如何以对数级状态保存、以及缓存与注意力结构如何影响 latent 相似度和证据检索；但该文为纯文本架构与语言建模实验，向多模态推理迁移仍属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bilateral Log-Linear Attention

**abstract/A1：** Sequence models represent past context at different resolutions, using token-level keys and values, fixed-size recurrent states, or hierarchies of compressed summaries. Full attention supports strong associative recall but requires quadratic work during training and prefill and a linearly growing key-value cache during inference. Linear attention and state-space models reduce these costs through fixed-size recurrent memory, but this compression can limit recall. Log-linear attention offers a middle ground by maintaining logarithmically many state matrices. However, its hierarchy favors finer resolution near the current query while compressing earlier context into coarser summaries. To complement this allocation of resolution, we introduce bilateral log-linear attention, which pairs the existing hierarchy with a second hierarchy anchored at the sequence origin. By combining their reads, the two branches provide finer access to both early and recent context while remaining causal. We derive recurrent and chunkwise parallel formulations for the added branch, preserving log-linear training and prefill work, logarithmic decoding work per token, and logarithmic persistent state storage at fixed feature dimensions and chunk size. In multi-query associative recall, this design raises mean overall test accuracy from 76.37% to 96.12% over forward log-linear attention across multiple training seeds. For pretrained language models under approximate parameter matching, it raises the mean score on six selected RULER needle-in-a-haystack tasks from 26.97% to 50.03% at a context length of 6144 tokens. In the same setting, bilateral attention also outperforms forward log-linear attention on seven of eight downstream retrieval tasks, including question answering and information extraction.

</details>

### 116. [Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18979v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18979

**作者：** Yanbin Xu、Ming bo Cai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18979v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18979v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出局部化的 violation-of-expectation 评估框架，只在物理违规发生的空间区域与时间区间内比较可能与不可能事件的预测误差，并在 V-JEPA 上对比全局、时间局部与时空局部三种评估的判别结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「全局聚合可能掩盖或伪造局部证据」的诊断思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正承载任务必要的局部视觉证据，而不必依赖整体误差或成功率；具体迁移需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probing Where Surprise Happens: Localized Violation-of-Expectation Evaluation of Video World Models

**abstract/A1：** Violation-of-expectation (VOE) benchmarks evaluate intuitive physics in video world models by testing whether physically impossible events produce greater prediction errors than matched possible events. However, conventional VOE evaluations aggregate prediction errors across space and time, making it unclear whether successful discrimination reflects model's understanding of physical violations at the locations and time where they occur. To address this limitation, we introduce localized VOE evaluation, a framework that measures prediction error differences between possible and impossible events within spatial regions and temporal intervals associated with physical violations. We compare global, temporally localized, and spatiotemporally localized evaluations of V-JEPA models pretrained on developmental egocentric videos or large-scale natural video datasets. Our results reveal that global and localized judgments can diverge in both directions: global aggregation can either obscure correct localized discrimination or produce apparent discrimination without corresponding localized evidence. During continued pretraining on developmental egocentric videos, agreement between global and localized judgments changes non-monotonically, while confidence in localized judgments increases despite modest improvements in accuracy. Together, these findings establish localized VOE evaluation as a complementary diagnostic for assessing intuitive physics in video world models and demonstrate that global prediction errors do not necessarily reflect the spatiotemporal evidence of physical violations.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 117. [Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19009v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19009

**作者：** Zhiguang Liu、Yi Shang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19009v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19009v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RoSeDiT：将全局规则（类别条件）从图像 token 中隔离，引入 adaLN listening 机制使 adaLN 在控制器指令下计算，并给出 DSMC 两阶段训练以对齐去噪损失与图像流形。

**相关性简评：** 其「控制器通道与 token 流角色分离」的架构及熵分析，可能可供核查 LVR 中推理状态与视觉 token 的分工及共享规则扩散导致的信息坍缩；但原文面向图像生成，迁移价值需阅读正文后判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression

**abstract/A1：** We present Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers (RoSeDiT), a new diffusion transformer architecture that isolates the global rule from the image tokens. RoSeViT showed in visual reasoning that a vanilla ViT spreads a shared rule over all $L$ tokens at an entropy of order $Ld$, whereas an enforced controller route reduces it to order $d$. In class-conditional DiT and SiT, the class and the noise level are explicitly conditioned by adaLN, so a RoSeViT-style controller channel on the ViT side is insufficient to establish the full role separation. By introducing the adaLN listening mechanism, which makes adaLN compute under the controller's command, RoSeDiT brings the entropy theorem and role separation into the latent diffusion domain. Under the same SiT training and evaluation protocol at the same level of parameter count, RoSeDiT surpasses SiT at all four model scales at 400K steps, and RoSeDiT-L/2 even surpasses SiT-XL/2's 17.2 FID with 15.34 and 32% fewer parameters. RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT-XL/2's 7M-step FID of 8.3 at 1.4M steps with 7.98, using one-fifth as many training steps. We further observe that models with the same denoising loss can have a large FID gap, which indicates a misalignment between the denoising objective and the image manifold. We formalize this phenomenon into Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression (DSMC), a two-stage training schedule with which RoSeDiT-XL/2 surpasses SiT + REPA's 4M-step FID of 5.9 at 2.4M steps with 5.84.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Github Repo: https://github.com/lz7fd/RoSeDiT

</details>

### 118. [The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19037v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19037

**作者：** Gaoyuan Du、Xiaoyang Liu、Rex Zhou、Dengdu Jiang、Rong Fu、Meng Ding、Defu Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19037v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19037v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文通过四臂审计与受控故障注入，隔离 LLM critic 对 AutoML 迭代搜索的边际影响，发现较弱的 critic 会让搜索低于无 critic 的随机搜索基线，并分析方向性错误与有限搜索预算的关系，最后尝试用可观测验证门控与学习式检测器降低损失。

**相关性简评：** 其「反馈信号究竟帮忙还是致害」的消融审计、故障注入与门控检测，可供核查 VLM 推理循环中视觉或 latent 反馈通道的实际贡献及何时应屏蔽，属方法线索而非视觉推理研究本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Critic Can Hurt: On the Safety of Critics in LLM-Guided AutoML Search

**abstract/A1：** LLM critics increasingly steer iterative search in agentic AutoML, prompt optimization, and self-refinement--evaluated for whether they help, but rarely for whether they can hurt. We isolate the critic's marginal effect through a four-arm audit and characterize the loop's tolerance through controlled fault injection. We show a naive 8B critic drives search below the no-critic random-search floor on 7 of 8 tabular datasets, losing up to 0.245 AUC in the worst case; the magnitude varies strongly with dataset, frontier, and budget. When: stronger critics attenuate the loss on the evaluated suite, without establishing a universal capability threshold. Why: controlled fault injection shows that non-directional errors are nearly costless under best-so-far search, whereas directional errors consume finite search opportunities; an idealized effective-sample calculation yields a necessary condition, $q(m-1) &gt; β$, not a deployment certificate. How: a simple observable validation gate and a learned detector can reduce realized loss, but neither is guaranteed to preserve the full-budget no-critic baseline. We will release CRITFAULT, to our knowledge the first benchmark for detecting harmful critic feedback in AutoML. A critic is not a free addition: audit before trusting, and gate when capability or verification is insufficient.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at KDD 2027 Research track

</details>

### 119. [Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19042v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19042

**作者：** Jianhao Huang、Allan Zhang、Ali Payani、Baharan Mirzasoleiman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19042v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19042v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了原子事实全部参与训练、仅部分事实出现在推理链中的受控设定，从线性 transformer 推导出使未见的迁移误差最小的原子信号权重，并说明该权重随推理链长度上升、随事实覆盖率下降，随后在完整 transformer 和自然语言多跳、数学预训练中验证这些趋势。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本预训练数据配比分析，不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，但其关于推理链条长度与数据覆盖如何决定监督分配、以及原子信号与轨迹信号贡献权衡的结论，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练与监督分配的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding the Role of Reasoning Data in Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Reasoning data expose models to multi-step reasoning, but reasoning traces may cover only a subset of the available facts. How should pretraining balance atomic facts with reasoning traces? We study this question by constructing a setting in which every fact provides an atomic training signal, while only a subset appears in reasoning supervision, enabling us to measure generalization to transitions observed atomically but never used in training traces. For a linear transformer, we derive the weight assigned to atomic training signals that minimizes held-transition squared error and show that its leading-order optimum increases with reasoning-chain length and decreases with the fraction of facts held out from reasoning traces. These trends persist in a full transformer layer with an MLP, softmax attention, and cross-entropy loss. We further validate the role of reasoning complexity and data coverage in two natural-language settings: controlled multi-hop reasoning and mathematical pretraining. Together, our results provide a principled view of how reasoning-chain structure and data coverage should shape the allocation of training data during pretraining.

</details>

### 120. [Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19064v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19064

**作者：** Kai Yamashita、Shohei Taniguchi、Hiroki Furuta、Masahiro Suzuki、Yutaka Matsuo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19064v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19064v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对多验证器 RLVR 中把多维验证结果压成标量奖励的问题，提出 POLPO：用 Pareto 支配关系只对「满足更多要求且不丢失已满足项」的回复建立偏序，再以 listwise 似然最大化所有与该偏序一致的完整排序概率，从而在未达成完全成功前也能从部分改进中获得监督。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，但其「不先聚合奖励、直接用偏序验证信号做信用分配」的思路，可能为 LVR 中多约束下 latent 推理轨迹的部分成功监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Policy Optimization With Multiple Verifiers via Pareto Rankings

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. In tasks such as code generation and instruction following, multiple verifiers evaluate whether a response satisfies different requirements. Their outcomes provide detailed feedback about partial success, yet this feedback is commonly aggregated into a scalar reward for policy optimization. Rewarding only complete success discards distinctions among partial solutions, while counts and weighted sums impose comparisons between responses that satisfy different subsets of requirements. We introduce Partial-Order Likelihood Policy Optimization (POLPO), which learns from the comparisons established by verification without first constructing an aggregate reward. Pareto dominance identifies responses that satisfy additional requirements without losing any already satisfied, while leaving responses with conflicting outcomes incomparable. POLPO extends the listwise likelihood underlying Direct Preference Optimization by maximizing the total probability of all complete rankings consistent with these partial orders. This objective provides supervision from verified improvements even before complete solutions are available, without requiring a prescribed ordering of incomparable responses. Experiments on code generation and instruction following demonstrate improved learning efficiency and higher rates of complete requirement satisfaction compared with scalar-reward training. These results support partial-order likelihood as an effective approach to learning from multiple verifiers.

</details>

### 121. [Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19072v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19072

**作者：** Austin H. Cheng、Marcel Müller、Andreas Burger、Yeonghun Kang、Tsz Wai Ko、Marta Skreta、Luka Mucko、Ella Miray Rajaonson、Cher Tian Ser、Jérôme F. Gonthier、Alex Zook、Varinia Bernales、Alán Aspuru-Guzik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、physics.chem-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19072v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19072v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Nahual，一个仅解码器的自回归扩散模型，用「next-token diffusion」在因果 Transformer 中逐 token 去噪连续 3D 坐标，统一处理文本与分子序列。

**相关性简评：** 其连续坐标的因果扩散去噪可能为 LVR 中连续 latent 状态的逐步生成与更新提供机制线索，但原文面向化学生成，与视觉推理无直接关联，可供核查该设计能否迁移到 latent 推理 token。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Nahual: A Sequence Model for Language and Atoms

**abstract/A1：** Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at https://github.com/the-matter-lab/nahual.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 122. [SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19076v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19076

**作者：** Boyang Deng、Yuzhen Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19076v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19076v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SearchChord，一个免训练的一步图像编辑框架：先按文本相似度从 prompt-seed 候选池中预选少量候选，再用图像验证器打分对 latent field 做加权重组，取代均匀平均，并在成本、保留度与编辑保真度之间权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「候选搜索—图像验证—按验证得分加权重组 latent 场」可能为多 latent 假设的聚合与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但该工作属图像编辑，不涉及推理状态生成，迁移需谨慎。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Finding effective prompts and seeds for one-step image editors requires balancing edit fidelity, source preservation, and computational cost. To address this challenge, we explore a large collection of candidate edits, where each candidate is defined by a unique prompt-seed pair, and generate corresponding images on demand. We present SearchChord, a training-free framework that leverages a large pool of such candidates, combining text-based preselection, image verification, and latent-field recomposition. Our ablation studies across pool sizes up to 200 candidates show that a pool of 100 offers a cost-effective operating point. Compared with feeding all 100 candidates into recomposition, TextSim preselects a subset of 10 candidates. Rather than uniform averaging, we incorporate image-verifier scores to weight each candidate during recomposition. Experiments on PIE-Bench and the proposed CropWeed-EditBench reveal a trade-off: candidate selection improves target-text alignment, while recomposition better preserves unmodified source content. The oracle verifier achieves the best performance in both preservation and target-text alignment. Practical verification partially recovers semantic alignment, but recomposition still compromises edit fidelity, including in agricultural image edits. These results motivate text-first preselection and stronger verification to balance preservation, fidelity, and cost. Code and data will be made publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, conference

</details>

**title/T1：** DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators

**abstract/A1：** DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

### 124. [Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19108v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19108

**作者：** Hita Kambhamettu、Daniel Krashen、Lyle Ungar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19108v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19108v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「定理演化图」（TEG），把定理之间修改设定、加强结论、扩展范围等承接关系显式编码为图结构，并实现为 LLM agent 的在线搜索方法，用于生成值得研究的数学猜想；LLM 评判与专家更偏好该方法生成的猜想。

**相关性简评：** 非视觉工作，但其用外部图结构记录实体间「如何承接」的关系并据此控制搜索与扩展，可能为 LVR 中关系型内部状态的表示及探索、停止决策提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Guiding AI Agents to Generate Conjectures by Encoding How Theorems Build on One Another

**abstract/A1：** Recently, LLMs have been making headlines, and headway, in mathematical research. Much of this work focuses on proving existing open conjectures. Deciding what to prove is harder and less studied, because of the lack of a clear criterion for what makes a conjecture worth pursuing. We present a method for conjecture generation that builds on the observation that mathematical theorems build on one another: new theorems can modify the setting or hypotheses of earlier theorems, strengthen their conclusions, or extend their scope. We encode these relationships in a new kind of graph, the Theorem Evolution Graph (TEG), which we instantiate as an online search method for LLM agents. An agent builds a TEG in two steps: (1) identifying relevant theorems from papers found by following citations backward and forward from a seed paper; and (2) comparing those theorems to record how one builds on another. LLM judges and an expert mathematician preferred TEG-generated conjectures over those from an unconstrained baseline. LLM judges favored TEG conjectures for significance, ambition, and insight, and favored baseline conjectures for plausibility. Ablations suggest a benefit from constructing and using a TEG even when the available papers are fixed.

</details>

### 125. [A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19116v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19116

**作者：** Shrey Patel、Bhargav Srinivas Rao、Samet Ayhan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、physics.chem-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19116v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19116v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DecayFormer，一个紧凑的混合状态空间-注意力架构，用于从早期充放电循环预测电池完整 SOH 退化轨迹：以每通道单标量状态的循环选择性更新、由循环状态作为 query 的注意力，配合 SOC 区间统计与参数化单调曲线的输出头，在 BatteryLife 基准全部 22 个折上以单一固定配置评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「极紧凑循环状态 + 状态查询注意力 + 单调参数化轨迹头」可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态压缩、跨步状态更新以及带物理约束的 latent 轨迹解码；与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，迁移仅为可能线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Hybrid State Space-Attention Architecture for Forecasting the Trajectories of Battery Degradation

**abstract/A1：** Early-life battery degradation trajectory forecasting aims to predict a battery cell's full state-of-health (SOH) trajectory from its initial charge-discharge cycles, potentially reducing cell qualification and evaluation time from months to days. Despite recent advances, accurate forecasting remains challenging for emerging battery chemistries, data-scarce domains, and cells exhibiting degradation behaviors beyond those observed during training. Existing state-of-the-art approaches increasingly rely on model scaling, large language model-derived aging-condition embeddings, and extensive fold-specific hyperparameter tuning, raising concerns about computational efficiency, reproducibility, and generalization. This work introduces DecayFormer, a compact hybrid state-space and attention architecture designed for early-life degradation trajectory forecasting. DecayFormer combines cycle-level selective recurrence, using a single scalar state per channel, with an attention mechanism queried by the recurrent state. It further incorporates state-of-charge (SOC) interval statistics and a master curve head that jointly estimates a scalar lifetime and a monotonically non-increasing SOH profile parameterized by normalized lifetime. We evaluate DecayFormer on the BatteryLife benchmark using all 22 aging-condition-exclusive folds, with a single run per fold and one fixed configuration across all folds, without fold-specific tuning. DecayFormer achieves mean test MAPE values of 2.25% on Li-ion, 2.76% on CALB, 0.95% on Na-ion, and 7.19% on Zn-ion. These results demonstrate the potential of compact sequence models to deliver accurate early-life degradation forecasts across diverse battery chemistries and aging conditions, without relying on extensive model scaling or per-fold optimization.

</details>

### 126. [Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19127v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Leave-One-Out Transformer（LOOT），改进 hollow transformer 的左右上下文合并机制，并给出低方差的 MDM NELBO 估计以监督全部 token，使纯文本掩码扩散模型具备推理期自我纠错能力。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本扩散生成，但其「由上下文预测某位置、与输入无关」的独立预测与推理期逐 token 修正，可能为 latent 状态的迭代更新、视觉旁路下的信息坍缩诊断及全 token 监督的贡献分配提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better generation quality-diversity tradeoffs than prior remasking methods, using $8\\times$ fewer forward evaluations and $3.5\\times$ fewer inference FLOPs.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 127. [How Much Determinism Can Fine-Tuning Buy? Margin Regularisation Against Batch-Induced Token Flips](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19135v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19135

**作者：** Charan Teja Nagisettygari、Siva Raja Sindiramutty

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19135v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19135v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究零温度贪心解码在批内其他样本数不同时仍产生的 token 翻转，跨六个模型族与三种数值精度刻画该扰动，并对 top-1/top-2 logit 间隔施加按噪声分位缩放的 hinge 正则；在 GSM8K 上翻转减少 35%、发散率由 53.8% 降至 38.1%，代价是 1.3–2.9 个精度点。

**相关性简评：** 其训练期 margin 正则与「翻转 token 的 logit 间隔阈值未变」这一发现，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 步与停止决策的数值稳定性及评测可复现性，但该方法是表层 logit 层面的，是否影响推理轨迹而非仅输出 token 仍需确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Much Determinism Can Fine-Tuning Buy? Margin Regularisation Against Batch-Induced Token Flips

**abstract/A1：** Greedy decoding at zero temperature is widely assumed to be deterministic, although the exact same prompt may yield different tokens depending on the number of other prompts sharing the batch for inference. The currently available solutions operate during inference, trading determinism for throughput. Can we train a model in such a way that fewer decoding steps would be susceptible? We characterize the perturbation empirically across six model families and three numerical precisions and observe two empirical facts about the measurement: the perturbation depends exactly on the representable precision (8.00x for bfloat16 vs float16, 8192.0x for float16 vs float32, in line with predictions based on mantissa bits) and the batch invariance happens accidentally at certain tensor shapes, allowing a practitioner to achieve zero nondeterminism merely by setting the sequence length. Then we apply hinge penalization of the model's top-1 / top-2 logit gap, scaled to twice the measured noise quantile. On GSM8K dataset it leads to a 35% reduction in token flips and divergence from 53.8% to 38.1%, at the cost of 1.3 - 2.9 accuracy points, increasing monotonically with the margin size. It does not affect the gap threshold sufficient for determinism: the logit gaps of surviving flips are unchanged (median 0.125 for all arms), as the hinge is a soft penalty and the largest hardware perturbation remains the same. We reject seven hypotheses, including a per-model viability diagnosis, holding on six models and falsified on the seventh.

</details>

### 128. [Puzzle: One Pass Is Not Enough for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19146v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19146

**作者：** Wensong Xu、Siqi Lu、Jibao Yuan、Yongbin Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19146v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19146v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Puzzle：针对开放词汇遥感分割，用预测历史与视觉相似性先验驱动即插即用的迭代重推理，以轻量控制器调节各 patch 作为信息源及对相似 patch 的依赖，并由自适应停止规则决定何时结束，分割模型保持冻结。

**相关性简评：** 其「历史条件状态 + 自适应停止 + 相似证据复用」的迭代重推理结构，可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的方法线索，但作用于分割输出层而非内部 latent 状态，迁移价值待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Puzzle: One Pass Is Not Enough for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary remote sensing image segmentation (OVRSIS) enables the segmentation of unseen classes without additional annotation or retraining. By analyzing the predictions of existing OVRSIS methods, we find that many misclassified patches coexist with visually similar, correctly classified patches of the same class within the same image. Unfortunately, most of these methods stop after a single inference rather than using their predictions to guide further inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose \\textbf{Puzzle}, a plug-and-play iterative re-inference framework that combines prediction history with a visual-similarity prior to progressively refine patch-level attention. Puzzle employs a lightweight history-conditioned controller to regulate each patch's contribution as an information source and its reliance on visually similar patches, while an adaptive stopping rule determines when to stop. It keeps the segmentation model frozen and reuses the same controller across different models and datasets without retraining. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements across diverse OVRSIS models and datasets, highlighting the strong transferability of Puzzle. Moreover, Puzzle can further improve the performance of SOTA methods.

</details>

### 129. [On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19207v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19207

**作者：** Zane Fu、Yanzhao Zheng、Ziting Qin、Qianshan Wei、Yi Yu、Gongli Xi、Jihuai Zhu、Baohua Dong、Hangcheng Zhu、Ruohui Huang、Gang Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19207v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19207v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究 on-policy distillation 是否会把教师模型的条件后门迁移给学生模型，发现 OPD 的迁移效率显著高于常规蒸馏，并把传播归因于教师对触发与干净输入的条件概率异常差异，据此提出抑制该类信号的训练方法。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本安全研究，但其“教师条件概率差异逐步内化为学生内部表示”的机制分析，可供核查蒸馏式训练中 latent 状态是否真正承载被监督信息、以及监督信号如何被吸收的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On-policy distillation as a Backdoor Propagation Channel

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) is emerging as an important paradigm for the post training of large language models, improving student models by leveraging supervision generated online by teacher models. However, whether this process also transfers latent security risks from teacher models to student models remains insufficiently studied. In this work, we reveal a new security risk in which an attacker first implants a conditional backdoor into the teacher model through supervised fine tuning (SFT), after which OPD can transfer the backdoor to the student model with only an extremely small proportion of trigger prompt exposure. More concerningly, we find that such backdoor transfer is substantially stronger under OPD than under conventional distillation methods, suggesting that OPD may provide an efficient channel for propagating backdoors across models. Our mechanistic analysis shows that the backdoor signal is primarily transmitted through anomalous differences in the conditional probabilities produced by the teacher model for triggered and clean inputs, and is gradually internalized into the internal representations of the student model during training. Furthermore, we investigate how to suppress such anomalous conditional probability signals at the source of distillation supervision and, based on this analysis, propose an OPD training method tailored to this conditional backdoor propagation setting to mitigate the risk of backdoor transfer induced by untrusted teacher supervision.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19213v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19213v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究视觉语言模型的多域任务增量学习，提出 TSP-DLoRA，用任务特定子空间投影判别已见与未见任务，并按任务分布动态分配 LoRA，以缓解遗忘、零样本能力退化与新任务欠拟合。

**相关性简评：** 其子空间判别与按层动态分配适配器的思路，可能可供核查 latent 状态是否按任务或证据分布在可分量子空间中，以及动态计算分配方式；但论文未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Incremental Learning of Vision-Language Models via Task Subspace Projection and Dynamic LoRA

**abstract/A1：** Recent pre-trained vision-language models often encounter a Multi-Domain Task-Incremental Learning (MTIL) scenario in practice, where a set of classes of multi-modal tasks arrive incrementally. Due to privacy concerns and memory constraints, MTIL with pre-trained models encounters forgetting of knowledge from old tasks, degradation of zero-shot transfer capability, and underfitting of new-task knowledge. To overcome these challenges, previous MTIL methods attempt to learn a discriminative cross-task identification (CTI) module and an effective new-task adaptation (NTA) module. However, current CTI modules suffer from severe task confusion between seen and unseen tasks, and NTA modules cannot adaptively balance the performance and parameter cost while incorporating task-specific knowledge. To alleviate the above dilemmas, we propose an effective and efficient TSP-DLoRA method for MTIL, which consists of Task Subspace Projection (TSP) and Dynamic Low Rank Adapter (DLoRA) modules. Specifically, our TSP module includes a task identifier classifier based on task-specific subspaces and a feature projection strategy that can determine the identifier associated with samples from both seen and unseen tasks. Our DLoRA improves the knowledge adaptation from new tasks by dynamically assigning Low Rank Adapter (LoRA) across transformer layers based on the task distributions. Experimental evaluations across 11 datasets, using three performance metrics, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method. Code is available at https://github.com/FerdinandZJU/TSP-DLoRA.

**comment/C1：** Pre-peer-review version of an article accepted for publication in the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV)

**title/T1：** Neural Dual Bounds: Valid-by-Construction JGLP Warm-Starts for MAP and Constrained MAP

**abstract/A1：** We present Neural Dual Bounds, a calibration-free framework that produces deterministic upper bounds for MAP inference in probabilistic graphical models using a single neural-network forward pass. The framework trains a network to output the edge messages of a mini-bucket style upper bound on a given join-graph decomposition in a self-supervised manner by directly minimizing a smooth dual objective. The output of this network can be used at test time to warm-start a standard JGLP optimizer. Across diverse benchmarks, this warm start yields dual gaps that are orders of magnitude tighter than those from zero initialization, with the largest gains in the early-iteration regime. We also apply our framework for the constrained MAP (CMPE) task, where neural warm starts with test-time adaptation are comparable to the adaptive baseline on Bayesian networks and achieve the tightest dual gaps, by one to two orders of magnitude, on the grid and segmentation families.

**title/T1：** Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World

**abstract/A1：** Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. In two exposure-matched history conditions, increasing the budget from eight to 32 updates raises joint success from 6.25% to 94.79% and 91.15%, respectively, while exact obsolete-value outputs fall from 174/192 and 166/192 to zero. Constant32, which matches preparation steps but repeatedly trains on unchanged content during the first 32 events, achieves higher early joint success at eight steps (53.65%); at 32 steps, it reaches 85.42%, below both changing-history conditions. These results distinguish rapid correction under a small budget from simultaneous correctness of the new fact and the other three facts after further training. For both changing histories, most cases remain jointly correct at all subsequent measured points from step 16 onward. Output analysis shows that short-budget failures primarily retain the old value; repeated training on the new fact together with the other current facts progressively replaces these obsolete answers.

**title/T1：** CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First

**abstract/A1：** We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 EEG 到图像重建，实证发现增强跨模态对齐并不能带来同等重建增益，于是提出生成派生监督：用图像条件教师把静态图像编码器特征翻译为扩散 Transformer 的内部表示空间，在去噪过程中为学生生成器提供动态目标，推理时丢弃教师。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是「仅改进输入条件不足、需直接监督生成过程中的内部状态」，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态的轨迹级监督与贡献分配问题，但任务为图像生成，与 VLM 推理的可迁移性尚待判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Alignment: Supervising the Generator for EEG-to-Image Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Visual brain decoding translates neural activity into human-interpretable images. While recent EEG-to-image reconstruction methods rely on aligning EEG signals with pretrained visual embeddings to condition an image generator, we empirically demonstrate that stronger cross-modal alignment do not translate into comparable gains in reconstruction quality. This indicates that improving the input condition alone is insufficient; the generative process itself requires explicit supervision. Although Representation Alignment (REPA) offers a solution by guiding diffusion transformers with pretrained vision encoder features, we find that EEG-conditioned generators struggle to follow these fixed targets. To address this mismatch, we introduce generation-derived supervision (GDS): an image-conditioned teacher that translates static image-encoder features into the internal representation space of a diffusion transformer. Our EEG-conditioned student generator closely tracks these dynamic targets during denoising, discarding the teacher at inference. Evaluated on THINGS-EEG and THINGS-MEG, our approach consistently outperforms conditioning-centric baselines, achieving state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity.

</details>

### 135. [Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19244v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19244

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 on-policy distillation 如何改变 LLM agent 在数学、ALFWorld 与 τ²-bench 上的 ReAct 交互模式（推理、动作与观察获取），并提出依据教师偏好变化筛选位置的 selective OPD 以缓解跨域负迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其按教师偏好变化选择蒸馏位置、缓解跨域负迁移的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与监督分配提供可核查线索；但研究对象是纯文本 agent，与视觉状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $τ^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $τ^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $τ^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

</details>

### 136. [Learning Graph-Conditioned Predictors in Weight Space](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19250v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19250

**作者：** Zhewei Chen、Hao Zhu、Ahad N. Zehmakan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19250v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19250v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SCOPE：用小型生成器把每个节点缓存的结构指纹映射为共享低秩基上的系数，产出针对全局权重矩阵的上下文特定更新，使同一节点属性在不同结构环境下按不同方式被处理，且推理时无需在线消息传递。

**相关性简评：** 「以上下文指纹调制预测器权重、而非把上下文拼接到输入」这一线索可供核查 latent 视觉状态是否也应调制 VLM 内部计算，与视觉旁路、输入拼接式注入的对比问题相关；但该工作属图节点分类，迁移仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Graph-Conditioned Predictors in Weight Space

**abstract/A1：** The same node attributes can imply different labels in different structural contexts. Yet fast graphless models typically treat topology as additional evidence supplied to a globally shared predictor. This assumes that structure augments the available information, rather than determining how node attributes should be interpreted. We introduce SCOPE (Structure-COnditioned PrEdictor), in which a small generator maps each node's cached structural fingerprint to coefficients over a shared low-rank basis, producing a context-specific update to a global weight matrix. The base predictor, basis, and generator remain shared across all nodes, while the resulting transformation adapts how attributes are processed in each relational environment. Once fingerprints are cached, inference requires only a forward pass and no online message passing. This design combines context-specific specialization with global parameter sharing, compact low-rank adaptation, and message-passing-free inference. On two large OGB node-classification graphs, conditioning the weights with raw positional signals yields clear gains over supplying the same signals through input concatenation. Further results under a structure-transductive held-out-node protocol and in teacher-free graph classification show that the mechanism extends beyond a particular distillation setting. These findings establish graph structure not only as predictive evidence, but as context that determines the predictor used to interpret that evidence.

</details>

### 137. [Beyond Clumsy Agentic Tool Calling: How Cueing and Spotting Make the Difference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19275v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19275

**作者：** Xindi Yang、Yan Liu、Jiajun Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19275v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19275v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ToolPulse 在线中间件，在工具调用发出前和执行反馈返回后监测 agent 的执行状态与交互时序模式，结合规则、语义序列与相似度触发提醒或结构化反馈，并在 1350 条 bug 修复轨迹上做过程式评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「触发有效性—行为停止—实质纠正」的三层评估，以及「先检查执行反馈再恢复推理」的干预时机设计，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与 latent 内容是否被真正使用的因果判别提供可供核查的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Clumsy Agentic Tool Calling: How Cueing and Spotting Make the Difference

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based task-oriented agents depend on tools to interact with their environments, but may overlook execution feedback, repeat ineffective calls, or persist with unproductive strategies. These behaviors can hinder agents' ability to use tools autonomously and sustain task progress. We characterize tool-use symptoms at two temporal granularities: local clumsy tool-use behaviors and tool-use detours spanning multiple interactions. Towards greater autonomy in tool use, we present ToolPulse, an online middleware supporting autonomous tool use through cueing and spotting. ToolPulse tracks execution state and temporal interaction patterns, monitoring proposed calls before dispatch and inspecting execution feedback prior to the agent resumes reasoning. It combines state-based rules, semantic sequence analysis, and interaction-feature similarity to identify intervention opportunities and provide verbal reminders, structured feedback, or context-specific advice from auxiliary models. Our process-oriented evaluation distinguishes trigger validity, behavioral cessation, and substantive correction alongside task outcomes and resource costs. Using SWE-agent with three backbone models, we evaluate 1,350 trajectories on 90 Python, C++, and Java bug-fix tasks, comparing unassisted execution with four assistance strategies. Substantive responses follow 61.6-90.9% of valid triggers for tool-use detours. Concise reminders achieve the highest observed aggregate substantive-response rate; more elaborate assistance offers symptom-dependent benefits and can be less effective. Aggregate repair outcomes remain close to baseline, with token savings in selected settings. These findings support proactive runtime assistance for autonomous tool use. The gap between behavioral adjustment and aggregate repair gains calls for careful decisions on intervention timing and assistance strategy in autonomous agents.

**comment/C1：** The code of reference implementation and instructions for reproducing the experiments are available in the following repositories: https://github.com/Cindy02050/ToolPulse and https://github.com/Cindy02050/ToolPulse\_Reproduction

</details>

### 138. [Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19292v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19292

**作者：** Eduardo C. Garrido-Merchán

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19292v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19292v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 LLM 能否只给定小型监督数据集，就逐数字写出前馈网络的权重与偏置，全程无梯度、无代码执行；并在由玩具题、隐藏旋转的合成题到经典基准和真实工程回归组成的分级套件上，以预先密封的预期分数评估结果。

**相关性简评：** 「数据集到参数」的编译式设定与「隐藏层是否值得」的预测指标，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 计算是否真正被使用；其区分的「不输出参数」与「输出但劣于预测均值」两种失败，也与视觉证据是否落入答案、何时弃答的问题相邻。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zero-Shot Weight-Space Programming for Prediction and Classification of Target Variables in Structured Datasets

**abstract/A1：** Weight-space programming fixes every parameter of a feed-forward network by hand, with no gradient descent anywhere in the construction. Every demonstration so far starts from a target function handed to the model as a rule system, making it a compilation problem. A supervised dataset withholds that specification, so the procedure must do the statistical inference itself and then express the result in the parameterisation it was given. We ask whether a large language model can do both. It is shown a small dataset in full, with the architecture of a feed-forward network, and writes out every weight and bias as a literal number, with no optimizer, no gradient, no code execution, and no chance to evaluate it first. Each construction is sealed and pre-registers its expected score. The graded suite runs from two toy problems, through nine synthetic problems disguised by a hidden rotation, to the classical benchmarks and one real engineering regression. The frozen network matches the closed-form optimum wherever that optimum is linear, reaches the irreducible error of the generating process on three rungs where it is not, and beats every fitted baseline on two of those, including the same architecture trained by gradient descent. It fails on two rungs, both times because the structure to be found is oblique to the coordinates it analysed. Three further constructors separate two failure modes a single score conflates: one returns no parameter vector at all on the hardest rungs, another delivers everywhere while writing networks worse than predicting the mean. One of those failures proves avoidable: another constructor solves the oblique-hinge rung by a margin that survives multiple-comparison correction. What predicts whether the hidden layer earns its keep is the training error of a linear separator, which the composite complexity index misses.

</details>

### 139. [Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19299v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19299

**作者：** Zhiyang Niu、Huayuan Shen、Chuanjie Li、Mengmeng Zhao、Jiajia Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19299v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19299v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「分阶段语义蒸馏」：用冻结编码器把 LLM 教师各阶段输出压成 1024 维向量，配合阶段可见性与计划式自历史监督，训练一个 13M 参数、无解码器的确定性学生模型，并在单一市场模拟器 trace 上检验该通道是否被实际使用。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本模拟器、无视觉输入，与视觉推理主线无直接关系；但其「交换语义输入 vs 匹配供体」的探针、以及内容与自历史调度的五种子对照，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、还是仅靠位置或调度伪影，属于可借鉴的贡献分配线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent

**abstract/A1：** Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 \[0.766,0.791\] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 \[1.21,3.14\]. Against the teacher's own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% \[95.8,98.4\] and 92.3% \[89.0,95.4\]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 \[1.21,3.14\]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.

**comment/C1：** Main text 7 pages; 18 pages total; 3 figures, 16 tables

</details>

### 140. [SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19316v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19316

**作者：** Satabarto Sarkar、Debojyoti Ghosh、Subhranil Biswas、Kaustav Mandal、D. Sobya

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19316v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19316v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SAR-TopoGuard——冻结生成器上的免训练推理层：随机采样 K 个候选，用 speckle 感知验证器按与 SAR 输入的梯度幅值相关性和幻觉频率排序，并以 SAR 引导的频域门控仅在 SAR 边缘支持的位置放行高频细节；在多个生成器与数据集上带来小幅 PSNR/SSIM 提升，但边缘召回下降。

**相关性简评：** 「多候选采样—证据相关性打分—证据门控」的免训练筛选流程，可能为 LVR 中多假设 latent 的视觉证据筛选与幻觉抑制提供借鉴线索，需核查其指标能否从像素/频域迁移到内部状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAR-TopoGuard: Training-Free, Speckle-Aware Topological Verification for Structure-Preserving SAR-to-Optical Translation

**abstract/A1：** SAR-to-optical translators often synthesize detail that the radar measurement does not support, and pixel metrics alone cannot reveal it. We propose SAR-TopoGuard, a training-free inference-time layer for frozen generators: a stochastic sampler draws K candidates (Monte Carlo dropout for GANs, seed variance for diffusion), a speckle-aware verifier ranks them by gradient-magnitude correlation with the SAR input and a hallucination-frequency index, and a SAR-guided frequency gate admits high-frequency detail only where SAR edges support it. With all five hyperparameters frozen and three training seeds, we evaluate on 500 scene-disjoint SEN1-2 test patches, 500 patches of a held-out summer scene, and 200 cross-dataset SEN12MS winter pairs. The layer improves Pix2Pix by +0.060, +0.012, and +0.077 dB PSNR and by +0.0034, +0.0057, and +0.0135 SSIM, respectively (Wilcoxon p &lt; 1e-6), and it improves CycleGAN and CUT on all three sets (+0.013 to +0.076 dB). It raises edge precision at the cost of edge recall (edge F1 -1.3% on the test set). On the latent diffusion model COP-GEN, it adds +0.33 dB (base) and +0.16 dB (Beta) on the winter set, the only set with dual-polarization SAR. An ablation shows that the gate produces the gain for MC-dropout GANs, whose candidates are nearly identical, whereas verifier selection contributes up to +0.26 dB for diffusion, whose samples differ. The layer has zero trainable parameters and adds 0.4 ms per patch beyond the K=5 generator passes.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19329

**作者：** Akhil S. Anand、Xun Shen、Marc Peter Deisenroth、Sebastien Gros

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19329v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19329v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出基于梯度的系统—策略协同设计方法：把设计梯度拆为固定策略下的直接效应与经由最优策略的间接效应，并用隐函数定理从策略梯度平稳条件得到策略对设计的敏感度，在可微网络系统基准上显示优于 BO 与 ES。

**相关性简评：** 不研究 VLM 推理；其对收敛量做隐函数微分、在双层优化中回传梯度的思路，可能为迭代式 latent 推理（如循环精化至定点）的训练监督与贡献分配提供可供核查的技术线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators

**abstract/A1：** Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. The indirect effect requires the sensitivity of the converged policy to the design, which we obtain by applying the implicit function theorem to the stationarity condition of the policy gradient. Based on this sensitivity, we develop a proof-of-concept co-design algorithm with stochastic value gradient (SVG)-style policy optimization, prove that it converges to an approximately stationary design, and demonstrate on a differentiable networked-system benchmark with high-dimensional design spaces that it consistently outperforms BO and ES.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、q-bio.GN

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文评估十个临床语言模型在 1,464 个已证实耐药基因组案例上的判断，发现模型常在有耐药证据时仍推荐相应疗法；作者用基因与证据等级匹配对照、独立二次证据、重复或伪造模型自身结论、以及 oracle 提供正确证据等方式，区分「倾向于同意」与真正利用证据进行辨别。

**相关性简评：** 其匹配对照与反事实结论归因的评测设计可供核查：这类设置有助于在 LVR 中区分模型是否真正使用视觉证据、还是被输出偏向或上下文暗示驱动，从而检验证据利用的因果作用，但需迁移到多模态场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance

**abstract/A1：** Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. Measured failures depended strongly on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength. When a second source independently confirmed resistance, four models across three vendors endorsed at most 2.4% of cases; at weaker evidence tiers, discrimination was not measurable. Models sometimes acknowledged resistance yet recommended the therapy. Repeating a model's own resistance conclusion reduced endorsement to 0.0-3.5% on cases where it had stated resistance. Falsely attributing the opposite conclusion increased endorsement above baseline for all seven hosted models, reaching 95.2% for GPT-4o; an instruction without an attributed conclusion changed endorsement by only 0.9 percentage points. Providing the correct curated evidence reduced unqualified strong recommendations to 0.3-3.5%, testing evidence use under an oracle condition rather than retrieval.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) 2026 Symposium

</details>
