### 143. [Information Limits of Replay-Free Recurrent State Migration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19345v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19345

**作者：** Khizar Qureshi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19345v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19345v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究循环模型被替换时，无回放状态迁移至少需保留多少信息；对仿射线性族给出最小连续因果记忆维度与可达维数上界，并用小语言模型等实验比较不同状态表示。

**相关性简评：** 其关于循环状态信息量、缓存坐标与迁移误差的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的充分性、压缩及模型替换后的状态兼容性提供核查工具；但对象是线性动力系统，尚缺视觉推理证据。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Information Limits of Replay-Free Recurrent State Migration

**abstract/A1：** When a recurrent model is replaced, its old state may not determine what the new model would compute from the same history. We characterize the information that must be retained before the replacement is known. For a time-invariant affine linear family, the minimum continuous causal memory for order-$k$ local migration equals the reachable dimension of a lifted coefficient system minus the information in the anchor state. A controllable $d$-state model with scalar input needs at most $kd$ additional real coordinates, even when arbitrary matrix replacement directions are revealed only after streaming. A single rank-one direction can already require all $kd$. Conditional singular values and auxiliary-bit bounds distinguish this local information law from recovery at a fixed tolerance. We also give invariant-subspace and future-output constructions. Controlled experiments compare the resulting representations. In a small language model, equal-memory cubic interpolation improves mean state fidelity over third-order coefficients but provides no meaningful predictive gain. An analytic history basis preserves useful adaptation more economically in a coupled identification task. With repeated slow poles, eight history coordinates meet normalized output error $10^{-4}$ across five fitted seeds despite substantial full-state error. Splitting the poles raises the smallest tested successful width to 64.

</details>

### 144. [RETR: A Structure-Preserving RGB-Event Transformer for Robust 3D Lane Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19358v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19358

**作者：** Jingtao Dong、Hao Zhuang、Hao Yang、Liyuan Pan、Wei Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19358v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19358v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文首次将事件相机引入3D车道检测，构建两个带度量3D车道标注的多模态基准，并提出结构保持的RGB-Event Transformer：先做跨模态证据对齐的互上下文流融合，再以不确定性感知的结构整合保留细薄与不确定车道结构，最后由几何状态解码器通过提议条件初始化、参考条件查询演化和多假设几何探究输出有序车道结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「几何状态解码器」的迭代查询演化与多假设输出，以及显式保护细薄、不确定结构的做法，可能为LVR中几何与任务必要视觉信息在内部状态中的保留、信息坍缩与证据筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但具体状态表示与监督方式需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RETR: A Structure-Preserving RGB-Event Transformer for Robust 3D Lane Detection

**abstract/A1：** Robust 3D lane detection requires accurate metric road geometry recovery from visual inputs, yet conventional RGB-based approaches suffer from fragile lane evidence under adverse illumination, motion blur, and long-range perspective compression. Event cameras offer complementary high-temporal-resolution, high dynamic-range structural cues that are robust to these challenges, but their sparse, motion-dependent responses cannot be directly fused into consistent 3D geometry. In this paper, we present the first attempt to introduce event cameras into 3D lane detection. To enable systematic research, we first build two multimodal benchmarks with metric 3D lane annotations: DSEC-3DLD (real-world sequences) and Ev-OpenLane (large-scale simulated sequences). We further propose RETR, a structure preserving transformer that converts complementary RGB and event observations into coherent 3D lane geometry. RETR first aligns modality consistent evidence through Reciprocal Context Flow Fusion, then preserves thin and uncertain lane structures with Uncertainty Aware Structural Consolidation, and finally decodes ordered lane hypotheses using a Geometry State Decoder with proposal conditioned initialization, reference conditioned query evolution, and diversified geometric inquiry. Extensive experiments show that RETR achieves state-of-the-art performance on both benchmarks, especially showing strong improvements in challenging lighting and complex road geometry scenarios. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/duskswell/RETR.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NIPS2026

</details>

### 145. [One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19359v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19359

**作者：** Patrick Passos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19359v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19359v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在一个 Gemma 4 31B 编程 agent 上做预注册配对实验，检验「上下文被压缩时自动重新注入上一条发现」这一简单记忆修复是否提升 98 个编程任务的解决率，结果未检出可测量的差异。

**相关性简评：** 其「压缩时重新注入先前状态」的机制可与 LVR 中推理状态与视觉证据的跨步保存、注入位置和上下文成本对照；配对设计、A/A 校准与功效分析也提供了核查 latent 干预因果收益的测量线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Run Is Not Enough: Reminding a small Gemma 4 coding agent of its last finding made no measurable difference in a paired test

**abstract/A1：** When a coding agent runs out of room, its earlier findings are cut and it forgets them. We tested a simple fix: automatically putting the agent's last finding back in front of it. We fixed the rules in advance and ran 98 paired coding tasks with and without this reminder, using Gemma 4 31B (QAT, 4-bit) in the Gemma 4 Developer Agent harness. The reminder made no measurable difference: across all 98 tasks, 47 were solved with it and 48 without (-1.0 points, 95% interval \[-8.3, +6.3\], exact McNemar p=1.0). The primary outcome (a documented deviation from our preregistration), the first 48 pairs, was 29/48 with memory against 25/48 without (+8.3 points, \[-2.1, +18.3\], p=0.22); the extension of 50 tasks, decided after that result, pointed the other way (18/50 against 23/50, -10.0 points, p=0.125), so the sign did not replicate. With 19% of tasks flipping between two identical no-memory runs, the combined interval excludes harms larger than about 8 points and gains larger than about 6, and the design had 80% power only for effects of about +-12 points or more. The model almost never wrote notes (2 of 16 and 4 of 32 runs), and memory cost context: the first request is larger and something was injected at only 47% to 65% of compactions. The registered secondary, repeated actions per compaction, was also null. Two directional hypotheses found on Modal did not replicate on Kaggle. We also report an A/A calibration and a validity funnel (129 tasks, 105 valid). Together these results show that single-run memory claims on task sets of this size sit inside run-to-run noise. The treatment is a harness mechanism and does not test agent-written memory.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 2 figures. Code, data and the commit history of the pre-registration: https://github.com/renorai/gemma4-memory-study

</details>

### 146. [Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19380v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19380

**作者：** Braghadeesh Lakshminarayanan、Ojas Phadake、Qi Chen、Dominik Baumann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19380v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19380v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TCA-DPC：将预训练扩散预测控制器视为有限时域状态-输入序列上的先验，为应对部署时新增的安全约束而不重训，用基于约束违反惩罚的指数倾斜改造采样分布，并按生成序列未通过约束校验的比例在线调节倾斜强度，再在高斯噪声空间用 MALA 近似采样。

**相关性简评：** 该工作与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，但其「按验证失败率在线调整扩散采样分布并在噪声空间做 MCMC」的测试时机制，可供核查是否能借鉴为 LVR 中 latent 采样与验证反馈耦合、以及采样预算分配的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models can learn multimodal distributions over finite-horizon state-input sequences, providing a way to generate candidates for predictive control. However, sequences generated by a pretrained model may violate safety constraints introduced at deployment, for example when obstacles are added or repositioned. Retraining whenever these constraints change limits the usefulness of learned predictive controllers. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Constraint-Aware Diffusion Predictive Control (TCA-DPC), an algorithm for adapting the sampling distribution of a pretrained diffusion controller to newly introduced safety constraints without retraining. We treat the pretrained model as a prior over finite-horizon sequences and define an adapted distribution through exponential tilting based on a constraint-violation penalty. The tilt strength is adjusted online using the fraction of generated sequences that fail constraint verification. We approximately sample the adapted distribution using the Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm in the Gaussian noise space of the pretrained diffusion sampler.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 147. [PMR: MoE Routing with Shared Prototypes and Congestion Pricing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19413v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19413

**作者：** Wending Wang、Binqi Huang、Ju'an Li、Yu Guo、Lei Duan、Yuqi Ouyang、Dengchun Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19413v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19413v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PMR 两阶段 MoE 路由：先计算 token 在共享 prototype 上的分布，再按全概率公式混合 prototype 条件的专家分布，并用短期状态适配 prototype、用拥塞价格实现无损负载均衡；配合两遍分块近似提升吞吐，在 0.4B–1.2B 预训练与 7B–8B 微调上报告稳定增益。

**相关性简评：** 将输入匹配与专家分配解耦、并以压缩的短期状态驱动路由，或可核查其对多模态 MoE 中专家分工与推理状态更新的借鉴价值；两遍分块近似也可能与 latent 状态处理的缓存与效率设计相关，但原文不涉及视觉推理，属远距离方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PMR: MoE Routing with Shared Prototypes and Congestion Pricing

**abstract/A1：** Conventional linear routers in sparse mixture-of-experts models select experts directly from token-expert matching scores, coupling input matching with expert allocation. We propose Prototype-Mediated Routing (PMR), a two-stage router with shared prototypes. PMR first computes each token's distribution over prototypes, then uses it to mix prototype-conditioned expert distributions according to the law of total probability. This formulation models input matching and expert allocation separately, explicitly represents many-to-many associations between prototypes and experts, and provides separate interfaces for context adaptation and load regulation. Within this framework, short-term states summarize preceding tokens to adapt the prototypes, while congestion prices updated from dispatch feedback achieve loss-free load balancing by adjusting the conditional expert distributions. We use a two-pass blockwise approximation to accelerate short-term state processing, achieving over 20 times the training throughput of the eager tokenwise PMR implementation while maintaining high agreement in routing decisions. Across three pretraining configurations with 0.43B, 1.18B, and 0.48B total parameters, PMR improves mean zero-shot accuracy on seven benchmarks over linear routing baselines with matched expert architectures by 1.54, 2.65, and 1.45 percentage points (pp), respectively. The corresponding gains on ARC-Easy are 6.71, 5.80, and 3.92 pp. In parameter-efficient fine-tuning of 7B-8B backbones, PMR's improvements over MixLoRA vary across backbones, with gains of up to 1.76 pp in mean accuracy across four tasks.

</details>

### 148. [Memorization Lives in a Few Attention Heads: Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models via Projection-Based Suppression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19427v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19427

**作者：** Puwei Lian、Yujun Cai、Songze Li、Yuezu Lv、Guanghui Wen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19427v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19427v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文发现扩散模型的训练样本记忆主要由少数浅层 cross-attention head 驱动，提出用语义控制分数选出 top-k head 并通过条件／无条件表示间的方向投影抑制其条件分量，从而在推理期减轻记忆同时保留语义与画质。

**相关性简评：** 其「用打分定位稀疏 attention head、再以投影定向移除特定特征」的手法，可能可供核查为定位 VLM 中承载视觉证据或 latent 内容的少量头并做定向干预的线索，但研究对象是扩散图像生成，与 LVR 的状态生成和证据使用无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Memorization Lives in a Few Attention Heads: Mitigating Memorization in Diffusion Models via Projection-Based Suppression

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models can memorize and reproduce training samples during inference, raising serious privacy and copyright concerns. Existing inference-time mitigation methods often suppress conditional information globally, which may reduce memorization but can also harm semantic alignment and image quality. In this paper, we revisit memorization from the perspective of cross-attention heads. Through systematic analysis and targeted ablation, we find that memorization is mainly driven by a small subset of shallow-layer attention heads with abnormally strong semantic control, rather than by the entire cross-attention mechanism. Motivated by this finding, we propose Projection-based Top-k Attention Head Suppression, a targeted inference-time mitigation method. Our method first identifies the top-k attention heads most related to memorization using a semantic-control score, and then removes their condition-specific components through directional projection between conditional and unconditional representations. This design selectively weakens memorization-related features while preserving useful semantic information. Extensive experiments on different diffusion models and datasets show that our method effectively reduces memorization and achieves a better trade-off between memorization mitigation and image quality than existing approaches.

</details>

### 149. [Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19429v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19429

**作者：** Nhat-Quynh Le-Pham、Khoi Nguyen、Binh-Son Hua

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.GR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19429v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19429v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出免训练的开放词汇 3D 实例分割框架：用稠密像素级 CLIP 特征替代按掩码池化的嵌入，据文本查询在选定的 pivot 视图中定位目标，经视频分割器跨视角传播成 2D tracklets，再用可见性投票提升为 3D Gaussian 掩码。

**相关性简评：** 其"稠密特征优于掩码池化"与"pivot 视图选择+跨视角传播"可能为 LVR 中视觉细节保留和证据筛选/视角选择提供可核查线索，但任务本身是 3D 分割而非推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Prepare Lighter and Faster for Open-Vocabulary Queries: A Query-Wise 3D Segmenter for Gaussian Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary 3D understanding aims to localize and segment arbitrary objects beyond predefined categories. However, existing approaches based on Gaussian Splatting often rely on expensive preprocessing and lengthy training, limiting their applicability when fast and lightweight solutions are desired. We propose a lightweight, training-free framework for query-driven 3D instance segmentation on Gaussian Splatting. Instead of conventional mask-wise CLIP embeddings, we use dense pixel-level CLIP features to preserve fine-grained semantic information and enable flexible text-driven localization without relying on predefined instance proposals. Given a text query, we identify a high-quality target region in a carefully selected pivot view and propagate it across views using a video segmentor, providing consistent and comprehensive coverage of the target instance. We then lift the resulting 2D tracklets to 3D Gaussians through a novel visibility voting strategy, yielding accurate 3D segmentation masks with clean object boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on LERF-OVS, ScanNet, and ScanNet++, competitive results on 3D-OVS, and significant speedups over existing open-vocabulary 3D segmentation methods. These results highlight the effectiveness of our framework for efficient open-vocabulary 3D understanding without per-scene training.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at WACV 2027

</details>

### 150. [Few-Shot Visual Concept Extraction for Steering Diffusion Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19440v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19440

**作者：** Nabyl Quignon、Antitza Dantcheva

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19440v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19440v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种免训练的图像引导框架：从 Diffusion Transformer 的中间激活中用均值差估计器做少样本视觉概念方向提取，并对局部概念改用掩码均值差以避免被全局平均稀释，从而在推理时连续、可组合地操控概念。

**相关性简评：** 其在 patch 级激活中分离「分布式」与「局部」概念方向的做法，可能为 LVR 中探测内部状态是否保留视觉细节、按区域筛选视觉证据提供可核查的方法线索；但研究目标是图像生成控制，不涉及推理轨迹或答案对中间内容的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Few-Shot Visual Concept Extraction for Steering Diffusion Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Image steering aims to provide fine-grained control over concepts in generated images, enabling targeted and continuous manipulation without broadly altering the generation process. Recent steering methods for diffusion models primarily focus on the text-conditioning space or rely on costly auxiliary training. Deviating from that, we here propose a novel steering approach that extracts visual concept directions directly from the image-side activations of Diffusion Transformers. Specifically, we showcase few-shot concept extraction in the activation space using a simple difference-of-means estimator over intermediate residuals. We observe (a) scene-level concepts such as lighting, weather, and style are distributed across image tokens, as well as (b) local concepts such as object colors, textures, materials, and facial attributes are concentrated in specific regions. Towards controlling both concepts, we introduce a new unified training-free framework that uses global difference-of-means for (a) distributed concepts and masked difference-of-means for (b) local concepts, preventing local signals from being diluted by global averaging. Notably, using only a handful of positive and negative prompt pairs, our method identifies and extracts reusable concept directions that can be injected at inference for continuous steering. Quantitatively, our method outperforms text-encoder steering and training-free activation-editing baselines, as well as is competitive with specialized editing models. Our results suggest that as concept directions can be applied at patch level, our method enables precise targeted and compositional steering, manipulating multiple concepts in the same image.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track

</details>

### 151. [Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19461v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19461

**作者：** Pujun Zheng、Wanying Ren、Guoxiu He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19461v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19461v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Program Distillation，把 LLM 的任务知识与策略蒸馏成部署时执行的学生程序，并构建 PDBench 与 PDMetaHarness 在离散和连续控制任务上评估性能与推理成本。

**相关性简评：** 其将 System 2 显式推理迁移为快速 System 0 策略，可能为 LVR 把多步推理压缩进 latent 或轻量执行状态提供训练监督与成本对照线索，但材料未涉及视觉多模态状态，迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0

**abstract/A1：** Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. The strongest model achieves a normalized mean score of 0.728, surpassing PPO (0.656) and Jev-like decision models (0.239), while running exclusively on CPUs and reducing inference costs. Our analysis shows that performance is largely driven by the first breakthrough during learning, and structural modifications have a slightly lower success rate than parameter modifications but typically yield larger gains. We further introduce style distillation, which enables interpretable stylistic control over the learning process. Overall, we present an analytical framework for PD and demonstrate its practical viability.

</details>

### 152. [Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19466v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19466

**作者：** Samuel Younger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19466v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19466v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出在学得世界模型的 latent 空间中，用逐次凸化（SCP）求解安全规划，把学得的离散时间 control barrier function 作为每个时间步的约束，并通过平滑 MaxMin 激活与谱归一化层保证动力学平滑、给出线性化误差界。

**相关性简评：** 把 latent 状态当作可带约束优化的规划工作区，并在每步输出是否为可行一阶最优 KKT 点的证书，可能为 LVR 的 latent 推理约束化与「停止/验证」决策提供可核查线索，但属机器人世界模型控制，与 VLM 推理的联系仍需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning

**abstract/A1：** World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/scwm.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 13 figures. Under review at L4DC 2027

</details>

### 153. [InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19472v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19472

**作者：** Kazi Nabiul Alam、Omenuko Joseph Nwebonyi、Pooneh Bagheri Zadeh、Akbar Sheikh-Akbari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19472v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19472v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 InvarOrd，通过无标签源域光谱自监督预训练、仅在匹配新鲜度等级内计算的收缩协方差跨物种对齐，以及序数知识蒸馏到 423K 参数学生模型，实现仅用 30 个标注立方体的跨鱼种高光谱新鲜度评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「对等级均值不变、因而无动机压塌序数轴」的对齐目标，可能为核查 latent 状态对齐与蒸馏时任务必要结构是否被抹除（信息坍缩）提供方法线索，但领域相距较远，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InvarOrd: Self-Supervised Ordinal Knowledge Distillation with Rank-Invariant Alignment for Label-Efficient Cross-Species Hyperspectral Fish Freshness Assessment

**abstract/A1：** Hyperspectral models of fish freshness rarely transfer between species, and labelling a new species is slow and destructive. Freshness is also ordinal, and standard domain alignment can erase that order. We present InvarOrd, which adapts to a new species from 30 labelled cubes (5 per rank) in three stages: self-supervised spectral pretraining on unlabelled source cubes, cross-species alignment by a shrinkage covariance discrepancy computed only within matched ranks, and ordinal distillation into a compact student. The alignment term is provably invariant to the rank means, so it gives no incentive to collapse the ordinal axis. On paired salmon and cod data (800 cubes each, 16 days), a source-trained teacher reaches 1.6 to 1.9 days mean absolute error (MAE) on the other species, with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) below zero. The 423K-parameter student, 2.54 times smaller than its teacher, attains the lowest MAE (1.476 days) and highest within 1-day accuracy (56.1%) among 14 configurations, matching the best of six ImageNet-pretrained backbones (ConvNeXt-T, 1.503 days) at 66 times fewer parameters, 1.44ms per cube on a GPU and 5s re-adaptation. InvarOrd beats target-only training by 0.29 days (p = 0.031). Among alignment objectives, rank-invariant alignment retains the most ordinal structure (embedding rank correlation 0.183, QWK 0.112), whereas global discrepancy lowers the rank correlation to 0.049 and QWK to zero at only 0.014 days higher MAE.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at IEEE TAFE

</details>

### 154. [Grokking Can Be Steered: Selecting Desirable Solutions By Choice Of Learning Rule](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19477v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19477

**作者：** Pascal Sager、Benjamin Grewe、Pau Vilimelis Aceituno、Thilo Stadelmann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19477v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19477v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在模加任务上追问泛化电路大小由什么决定，发现学习规则（credit assignment 与优化器组合）是关键：神经元是否被使用取决于其 credit 相对自身更新中非梯度项的大小，据此可通过均衡各神经元 credit 或按 credit 缩放 weight decay 把有效电路从 60% 扩到 99%，并改变抗删除、可剪枝性与迁移速度。

**相关性简评：** 其中的 credit 分配与逐神经元归一化线索可供核查是否能用于调节 VLM 潜在推理中承载计算的状态单元分布，并与贡献分配、信息坍缩及集中/分布式表示的取舍问题相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Grokking Can Be Steered: Selecting Desirable Solutions By Choice Of Learning Rule

**abstract/A1：** During grokking, a network transitions from memorization to generalization, yet what shapes the neural implementation (circuit) of the generalizing solution and specifically the number of participating neurons (its size) remains unclear. We find that the learning rule, the combination of credit assignment algorithm and optimizer, controls this: On modular addition, every learning rule we study that groks recovers the same Fourier-based algorithm, yet implemented by circuits that differ in size. Why? A neuron stays in use when its credit is large relative to the non-gradient term of its own update, and this single condition unifies three routes to unused neurons: the coupled weight decay, Adam's $ε$ and the decay of a trainable per-neuron gain. Equalizing the magnitude of credit assigned to each neuron, or scaling each neuron's weight decay by its credit, expands the effective circuit size, measured from the outgoing weights, from 60% to 99% of the layer's neurons at similar training and test accuracy. We vary which neurons share one equalization factor, from the whole layer to individual neurons, and find that the circuit stays concentrated for groups of eight or more and fully distributes only when every neuron has its own factor. Credit magnitudes are usually set by the normalization of standard optimizers: Nero, which normalizes per neuron, distributes the computation, whereas Adam and seven others, including RMSProp, Muon, and Shampoo, use other normalization schemes and retain small, concentrated circuits. Distributed circuits tolerate neuron deletion better, while concentrated circuits can be pruned further and transfer about twice as fast to a task that recombines the same features, largely by recruiting their unused neurons. Learning rule choice thus steers circuit size, trading robustness against compressibility and transfer speed without changing the learned algorithm.

**comment/C1：** 40 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 155. [Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19525v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19525

**作者：** Nikita Gupta、Narayanan Unny Edakunni、Vikram Okaly、Suranjana Datta、Navya Penubadi、Karl Eric Swanson、Siddharth Sharma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19525v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19525v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向 AI 生成临床笔记的质量评估，提出先把从医生抱怨中挖掘出的复合评价标准「客体化」为限定范围、可判定的子决策，再用 LLM judge 在人工植入缺陷与真实生产笔记上检验其定位违规的能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「把笼统判据拆成逐 span 的确定性子判断、并保留实例级而非单一通过/失败位」的判据客体化与判定粒度设计，可能可供核查用于评估 latent 内容是否真正支撑答案、以及视觉证据归因的细粒度诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Objectify, Don't Delete: Complaint-Derived Evaluation of Ambient Clinical Notes

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating the quality of AI-generated clinical notes is hard: standard metrics like ROUGE measure lexical similarity to reference notes, while expert checklists encode what committees believe matters. Neither captures what clinicians actually complain about. Recent work has shown that evaluation criteria can be mined from user feedback and filtered to criteria that LLM judges can reliably enforce. We argue that this is where much of the value is lost. The criteria that fail enforceability are disproportionately the ones clinicians raise most often, because high-frequency complaints are stated as several questions glued together. No yes/no judgment can grade such composites as posed. We introduce an objectification step that rewrites such criteria into sets of scoped, determinate decisions. We demonstrate the approach through an evaluation pipeline that mines criteria from complaints, objectifies them, and deploys LLM judges against both planted defects and production notes. Across eleven defects planted into ACI-bench reference notes, objectified judges localize violations with median recall of 0.95, while reference metrics change by at most 0.037. Given the complaint as one broad question, the same judges still find every planted defect, but they also flag 70% of the unperturbed reference notes; one section-pair question per call raises Youden's J from 0.30 to 0.72 (by 0.19 to 0.26 with prompt effort matched). We release ACI-Defect, a perturbation benchmark; clinician-reviewed instance-level labels showing quality gaps in the ACI-bench gold standard (32 of 40 notes contain hallucinations; 40 of 40 omit discussed facts); and grounding-judge verdicts. On 1,446 production notes, mean instance-rate burden falls at every clinician-rating step (rho=-0.15), a small association. Defect counts have to be kept per span rather than collapsed into one pass/fail bit per note.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the Third Workshop on GenAI for Health (GenAI4Health), NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 16 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nikita0511/aci-defect

</details>

### 156. [PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19527v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19527

**作者：** Jincheng Li、Zhengyi Liu、Zelin Liu、Yihui Zhan、Yifei Sun、Xiangyu Li、Minye Shao、Lingyao Kong、Tao Hou、Xinheng Lyu、Lanfeng Zhong、Ziquan Zhu、Rongzhao Zhang、Rui Yan、S. Kevin Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19527v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19527v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PathLoop：面向全切片病理图像的多智能体框架，用组学信号引导切片、patch、像素三级区域选取，由判断智能体对照 Pathology-Wiki 核查证据一致性并触发复查，并以四级记忆复用推理轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 其分子引导的视觉证据筛选、证据不一致触发的复查与停止决策、以及轨迹记忆复用，可供核查与 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 及多轮证据获取作对照；原文不涉及 latent 状态或内部表示分析，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PathLoop: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Reasoning for Evidence-Grounded Whole-Slide Image Analysis

**abstract/A1：** Analyzing whole-slide images (WSIs) requires combining evidence across tissue regions and spatial scales. Multi-agent systems offer a promising approach to this task. However, existing systems make limited use of molecular evidence, often select visually prominent but less representative regions while overlooking global context, and struggle to reuse experience from previous cases. To address these challenges, we present PathLoop, a self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates omics data for evidence-grounded WSI analysis. Specifically, PathLoop coordinates visual and omics interpreters across slide, patch, and pixel levels, using molecular signals to guide region selection and combining local tissue details with global slide features. A judgment agent then checks the consistency of the collected evidence against Pathology-Wiki, a knowledge base built from 48 entries across 24 organ systems, and triggers re-examination when the evidence is inconsistent. To reuse past experience, a four-level memory stores reasoning trajectories, practical tips, skills, and tools to guide future cases, forming a loop of evidence collection, review, and memory update. We evaluate PathLoop on four TCGA cohorts with biomarker prediction, survival prediction, and subtype classification. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of PathLoop across these tasks and support its use for evidence-grounded WSI analysis.

</details>

### 157. [Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19537v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19537

**作者：** Víctor Gallego

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19537v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19537v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作在 Craftax 中用编码智能体迭代优化程序化策略：先以从回合回报到分层目标、信念更新的反馈级联获得长程能力，再把控制器分解为环境解释器与规则程序，并训练可复用的 goal compiler 将结构化任务映射为新程序，实现零样本长度迁移且推理时无需 LLM 调用。

**相关性简评：** 其「信念更新＋分层目标」的密集打分反馈与「固定解释器＋可编辑程序＋goal compiler」分解，可能为 LVR 的内部状态维护、贡献分配监督和长度泛化提供方法线索；但对象是游戏程序策略而非 VLM latent，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax

**abstract/A1：** Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at &lt;1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). Furthermore, to make this competence reusable towards new goals, we factor the previous controller into an environment interpreter $I$ (models, memory, skills) and a rule program $p\_0$, and we show that coding agents can optimize a reusable goal compiler $C\_θ$ that maps structured tasks $g$ into new rule programs $p\_g$. Across five independent compiler searches trained only on short tasks, the resulting compilers successfully transfer zero-shot to longer tasks without any task-specific tuning nor inference-time LLM calls: continuation-scored feedback and a fixed machine with an editable program together turn a single-task competent policy into a reusable one. Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/craftax-program-policies

**comment/C1：** Preprint

</details>

### 158. [Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19542v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19542

**作者：** Alejandro Moreno Arcas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、math.NA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19542v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19542v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Func-JEPA，在数学函数的符号形式上预训练一个 JEPA 式编码器，使 latent 空间模仿 Sobolev 空间 H^1，并把求导实现为学习到的 latent 算子；随后冻结编码器，用轻量模块完成解码、复合、积分与从噪声样本回归。

**相关性简评：** 其「latent 空间具有可解释几何、并在其中学习算子而非逐步生成」的思路，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的表示结构与状态更新算子设计提供核查线索，但与视觉证据、停止决策等主线问题距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Func-JEPA: Learning a Sobolev Space of Functions as Latent Vectors

**abstract/A1：** Pretraining an encoder once and reusing it across tasks is a widespread approach in vision and language. However, neural symbolic mathematics still trains a dedicated sequence-to-sequence model for each task, so that no representation of a function is shared. In this work, we propose the Function Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Func-JEPA, abbreviated f-JEPA): an encoder of mathematical functions, pretrained on their symbolic form, whose latent space imitates the Sobolev space H^1 and in which differentiation is a learned latent operator. The norm of a latent is computed exactly from the function, whereas its direction is learned to match Sobolev angles. The frozen encoder is then reused by lightweight modules for decoding, composition, integration, and regression from samples. The representation and four downstream tasks are evaluated within and outside the pretraining distribution. f-JEPA recovers exact formulas from noisy samples more often than the compared symbolic-regression methods, whereas computer algebra and task-specific models remain stronger on standard integration and differential-equation benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, 16 figures, 30 tables. Code: https://github.com/amorarc/Func-JEPA. Model and data: https://huggingface.co/amorarc/func-jepa

</details>

### 159. [Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19575

**作者：** Jayanta Mandi、Senne Berden、Victor Bucarey、Concepcion Dominguez、Tias Guns

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19575v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种风险敏感的 decision-focused learning 框架：从 CVaR 的对偶表示加熵正则导出光滑的 regret-CVaR 代理目标，其梯度在小批量内产生实例依赖重加权，从而把 SPO+ 等现有代理损失改造为风险敏感版本，同时推理时仍只做点预测与确定性优化。

**相关性简评：** 其「按风险对样本重加权」的训练监督思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练的贡献分配与高风险样本（如 LOOK/STOP 决策）加权问题，但与原论文的多模态推理主线无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret

**abstract/A1：** Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \\emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. We instead propose a DFL framework that achieves risk-sensitive behavior while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization at inference time. Starting from the dual representation of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) and adding entropy regularization, we derive a smooth surrogate for the CVaR of regret. Its gradient induces an instance-dependent reweighting within each minibatch that emphasizes high-risk outcomes, so the approach can turn existing surrogate-loss DFL methods, including the SPO+ loss, into risk-sensitive variants. When instantiated with SPO+, the resulting objective admits a generalization bound on the CVaR of the true regret. Experiments on knapsack, portfolio, shortest-path, and energy-aware scheduling problems show substantial reductions in tail regret when the uncertain parameters exhibit heterogeneous tail behavior.

</details>

### 160. [SLiDE: Structured Linear Dynamics for Forecasting with Exogenous Inputs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19586v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19586

**作者：** Sebastian Pütz、Theodore Glavas、Benjamin Schäfer、Boris N. Oreshkin、Mark Coates

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19586v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19586v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SLiDE，一种受 Koopman 启发的时序预测架构：用历史编码器把过去的目标与外生输入映射为隐状态，再以同一线性算子在潜空间中进行前向 rollout，并让编码与预测共享同一线性递推。

**相关性简评：** 其「编码与 rollout 共享线性算子」的一致性约束，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新一致性与长程外推提供可供核查的归纳偏置线索，但任务与视觉、多模态推理无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SLiDE: Structured Linear Dynamics for Forecasting with Exogenous Inputs

**abstract/A1：** Accurate time series forecasting with exogenous inputs is critical across domains, including energy and retail, yet modern deep learning models often overfit to correlations that do not generalize under shifts in these inputs. We propose SLiDE, a Koopman-inspired architecture for forecasting with exogenous inputs that imposes structure on latent temporal dynamics. SLiDE approximates nonlinear system evolution using a learned linear operator in a latent space, combining (i) a history encoder that reconstructs the current latent state from past targets and inputs with (ii) a shared linear rollout driven by future exogenous variables. By enforcing a common linear recurrence across encoding and prediction, SLiDE aligns how past information is encoded with how future states evolve, reducing parameterization and preventing reliance on spurious correlations in the input history. Empirically, SLiDE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on real-world benchmarks, including electricity price forecasting and retail demand, while maintaining a computational footprint comparable to lightweight MLP architectures. SLiDE is especially effective at generalizing to shifted exogenous inputs, reducing MSE by 20% on electricity price samples with out-of-range exogenous values and MAE by 30% in a synthetic transfer setting where the same dynamical system is driven by an unseen exogenous process. Ablations confirm the importance of both the structured history encoder and the linear latent rollout, suggesting that structured latent linear dynamics provide a useful inductive bias for forecasting with exogenous inputs.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 161. [LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19649v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19649

**作者：** Siqi Zhu、Suozhi Huang、Yi Zhao、Jiaxuan You

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19649v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19649v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LoopFill，一种免训练的推测解码算法：把多 token 后缀草稿与浅层循环预测合并进同一棵草稿树，让多个未来 token 并行进入流水线，再由共享块在不同循环深度批量打分、全深度验证以保持原自回归分布，在 Ouro-2.6B 与 Huginn-3.5B 上取得约 5 倍解码加速。

**相关性简评：** 其「不同 loop 深度批量打分 + 全深度验证」的草稿—验证结构，可能为 LVR 中循环深度与计算预算的取舍、以及基于浅层预测的提前停止决策提供可供核查的线索；但该工作只做文本解码加速，未涉及视觉证据或 latent 内容的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \\(40\\%\\) on Ouro-2.6B and \\(25\\%\\) on Huginn-3.5B.

</details>

### 162. [RIFT: Reward Improvement Field Transfer for Cross-Domain Offline RL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19681v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19681

**作者：** Jinhee Won、Mardavij Roozbehani、Munther Dahleh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19681v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19681v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RIFT：在共享 latent 空间中用最优传输配对源域低奖励与高奖励 transition，拟合二者位移的仿射「奖励提升场」，再把该场施加到目标域低奖励锚点上并解码，以增广目标数据，并给出合成误差与下游回报条件的理论分析。

**相关性简评：** 「在共享 latent 空间中学习低奖励→高奖励的位移场并迁移施加」这一机制，可供核查能否用来定义或迁移 LVR 中潜在的推理状态更新方向，以及用「改善方向」作为隐状态的监督与贡献分配信号；但该文属离线 RL 数据增广，与视觉输入无关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RIFT: Reward Improvement Field Transfer for Cross-Domain Offline RL

**abstract/A1：** Learning from limited target data is a central challenge in cross-domain offline reinforcement learning. Abundant source data can help, but dynamics differences can make direct transition reuse unreliable. We propose Reward Improvement Field Transfer (RIFT), which instead learns how low- and high-reward source transitions differ. RIFT encodes source and target transitions in a shared latent space, pairs low- and high-reward source transitions using optimal transport, and fits an affine field to their displacements. It applies this field to low-reward target anchors and decodes the results to augment the target dataset. The approach builds on the hypothesis that related domains can share useful low-to-high reward structure despite different dynamics. We bound synthesis error under shared class geometry, identify conditions favoring target anchoring over source-high transplant, and derive a conditional connection to downstream return. Experiments on dense-reward locomotion tasks under gravity, morphology, and friction shifts show improved aggregate performance over existing baselines.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 4 figures, 17 tables (10 pages main text; remainder references and appendices)

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用重训练检验基于影响函数（MAGIC）的轨迹数据归因：在 86M 与 152M 的 GPT-2 式模型上从零学习多步算术，发现全量运行的归因出现数值溢出且与重训练近随机相关，而短 checkpoint 窗口内预测稳定准确，单训练块的排序不跨种子与超参数迁移，仅格式层面的模式可复现。

**相关性简评：** 其关于轨迹贡献归因「仅在局部窗口有效、跨种子不迁移」的结论，可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中贡献分配与监督信号是否也只是局部或族层面可信，目前为纯文本算术设定，迁移到多模态 latent 轨迹尚需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MathaMAGICal: Validating Trajectory Data Attribution During Capability Acquisition

**abstract/A1：** Influence-function-based methods like MAGIC provide exact first-order scores for trajectory data attribution, yet only retraining indicates whether those scores accurately predict data removal. We evaluate MAGIC on $86$M- and $152$M-parameter GPT-2-style models learning multistep arithmetic from scratch on filtered web text and four synthetic math families. Full-run attribution at $86$M suffers from numerical overflow, and even with metagradient clipping, scores correlate near chance with retraining (linear datamodeling score, LDS, $0.17$--$0.22$). In contrast, short checkpoint windows yield stable, accurate predictions at both scales (LDS $0.86$--$0.99$ across four $100$-step windows at $152$M), whereas a single-checkpoint gradient-dot baseline shows near-zero correlation. Rankings of individual training blocks predict retraining only within that single run and do not transfer across seeds or hyperparameters ($ρ\\le 0.09$), whereas format-level patterns replicate across runs. Two data families, worked examples and primitive facts, occupy $2.1$--$2.6\\times$ their corpus share in both the helpful and harmful $5\\%$ score tails, reflecting strong bidirectional local sensitivity distinct from net benefit under multi-epoch family deletion. These results show that trajectory attribution is reliable within short, validated windows and yields family-level insights that generalize across runs.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19698v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19698v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇立场论文，主张预训练数据归因不止于一次性文档排序，而应提炼可跨语料与检查点检验、可复用的数据属性；并给出一个反馈闭环：解释被归因的数据来源、检验候选数据改动，逐类说明五类主张各需何种证据，最后提出与 perplexity、分类器、配比基线在总计算量匹配下的可反驳对比。

**相关性简评：** 其「贡献归因→可检验数据属性」的证据分级与等成本对比框架，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹训练、视觉证据筛选的贡献分配与监督评价提供方法线索；但工作限于文本预训练数据策展，向多模态 latent 推理的迁移尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what none establishes. We close with a falsifiable comparison against perplexity, classifier, and mixing baselines at equal total compute.

### 165. [Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19700v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19700

**作者：** Parsa Mirtaheri、Mohammadreza Armandpour、Keivan Alizadeh、Iman Mirzadeh、Parshin Shojaee、Aryo Lotfi、David Harrison、Mehrdad Farajtabar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19700v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19700v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在共享的在线测试时适应协议下，对比 ICL、GRPO 强化学习与 SDPO 自蒸馏及其组合在四个环境共 109 个任务上的表现，并借助轨迹分析说明 ICL 减少环境查询与尝试长度、但也削弱当前任务的检查与验证，而 GRPO 可部分恢复这些行为。

**相关性简评：** 其「上下文保留经验 vs 更新权重」两条测试时适应通道及配套的轨迹行为分析，或可为 VLM 推理中视觉经验该保留在 latent 状态还是参数、以及如何监督其使用提供核查线索，但论文本身不含视觉输入或 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

</details>

### 166. [Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19742v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19742

**作者：** Pengfei Zheng、Wuchao Li、Shiyao Wang、Honghui Bao、Hongyi Xie、Jiaxin Deng、Xingmei Wang、Jinghao Zhang、Yufei Ye、Ruiming Tang、Guorui Zhou、Han Li、Kun Gai、Defu Lian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19742v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19742v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以统一的 logit 梯度视角重审 GRPO 等比率型策略目标在生成式推荐中的问题，指出裁剪造成死梯度、负优势更新随重要性比率无界增长、以及缺乏对策略绝对置信度的敏感性三点缺陷，据此提出带 stop-gradient 归一化的 GBPO，使更新全梯度活跃、正负对称有界并按当前策略概率加权，在推荐场景取得有竞争力的效果且训练更稳定。

**相关性简评：** 非视觉推理工作，但其对优势更新有界性、死梯度与置信度加权的分析，可能为 LVR 的 RL 训练（如 latent 轨迹监督中的负样本主导、高置信样本更新不收敛）提供可核查的目标设计线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models

**abstract/A1：** Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality. We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence cases may fail to vanish. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \\emph{Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization} (GBPO), a simple objective with stop-gradient normalization that is simultaneously (a) fully gradient-active, (b) sign-symmetrically bounded for both positive and negative updates, and (c) explicitly confidence-weighted under current policy probabilities. This ensures that updates gracefully vanish for $π\\!\\to\\!1$ positives and $π\\!\\to\\!0$ negatives. Across the evaluated settings, GBPO achieves competitive recommendation performance with more stable training than competing RL methods.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 事件相机本身与 LVR 无直接关联，但按特征尺度做激活修补、定位「信号事件被噪声淹没」与细粒度信息丢失位置的分析，可能可供核查多模态模型内部视觉细节在哪一层坍缩。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Event-based object detection under adverse lighting and motion: lessons for construction sites

**abstract/A1：** Vision-based monitoring on construction sites fails at night, at dawn and dusk, in tunnels and under floodlights, when conventional RGB cameras under- or over-expose. Event cameras record per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond latency and over 120 dB of dynamic range, but their benefit for site-relevant object detection has not been quantified on real data. We compare three recent event-based detectors (SMamba, SATE and EvRT-DETR) with an RGB detector trained on the same data, using the pixel-aligned PEOD dataset. On low-light frames (70% of the test set) the best event detector reaches 27.2 AP against 21.3 AP for RGB, and a training-free late fusion of both sensors is the best option in every lighting condition (33.3 AP). An object-level analysis of 53,091 objects shows that brightness has little effect on event detectors, whereas fast motion matters: above 20 pixels per frame RGB finds 11-19% of medium-size objects and EvRT-DETR 39-60%. Activation patching locates the damage caused by losing events at the 1/16-resolution features, with small objects depending on the finest scale, and shows that event detectors fail when few signal events meet added noise. A model-agnostic pruning study keeps about 95% of accuracy with 60% of the input but halves small-object recall. On rendered construction sites, used zero-shot, dimming the floodlights drops RGB to near zero while the event detector keeps most of its AP50. We close with camera-placement guidance for construction sites.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 RAF-DB 上以匹配的骨干、训练预算与条件标注，控制对比输入空间多视图条件化与特征级 FiLM／Conditional BatchNorm 条件化在面部表情识别鲁棒性上的收益，并报告 FLOPs、延迟与训练时间代价。

**相关性简评：** 其「输入级条件化保留更多信息、特征级条件化增益甚微」的归因与显式成本核算，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据应经输入旁路还是隐状态条件注入，以及表征条件化是否造成信息坍缩；属较远任务的借鉴线索，需自行判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Input-Space versus Feature-Level Conditioning for Robust Facial Expression Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Facial expression recognition (FER) degrades sharply when illumination, exposure or resolution departs from the training distribution. Two remedies dominate practice: enriching the input signal, or conditioning intermediate features on an estimated image quality. The two are rarely compared under matched backbones, training budgets and condition annotations, and their cost is seldom reported. We present a controlled comparison on RAF-DB. Input-space conditioning uses four deterministic, label-free views (logarithmic stretching, inverse-logarithmic stretching, down-up resampling and identity), each processed by a shared backbone with a branch-specific BatchNorm and linear head, with the branch logits averaged. Feature-space conditioning is implemented as FiLM and Conditional BatchNorm under an identical protocol. Across six backbone architectures the input-space variant improves top-1 accuracy on every one (mean +0.94 percentage points; bootstrap interval \[0.51, 1.63\]; sign test p = 0.016), with a seed-controlled estimate of +0.42 percentage points on ResNet-18, whereas feature-level conditioning yields +0.10 and +0.03 percentage points. We attribute the gap to the information content of the heuristic condition label rather than to the conditioning mechanism. The gain costs 4.00x FLOPs, 4.18x latency and 3.79x training time, i.e. 0.26 percentage points per additional GFLOP, and we state an explicit rule for when the trade is worth making.

### 169. [Spatiotemporal Reconstruction of Auroral Precipitations with Neural Fields](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19757v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19757

**作者：** Nazar Misyats、Mizuki Fukizawa、Yoshimasa Tanaka、Satoshi Ikehata

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、physics.space-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19757v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19757v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把极光电子沉降场建模为时间条件神经场：每帧状态压缩为一个 latent code，由学习到的离散动力学在帧间演化，共享解码器将水平位置与 latent 映射为能谱，再经多波长辐射与延迟效应渲染成相机图像，在合成动态序列与真实多视角视频上验证重建的时间一致性与投影一致性。

**相关性简评：** 「逐帧 latent code + 离散状态转移 + 可微前向渲染反演」的结构可供核查是否能类比 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新与由观测反推状态的监督，但研究对象是极光层析物理反演，与 VLM 推理无直接联系，迁移性需较多判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spatiotemporal Reconstruction of Auroral Precipitations with Neural Fields

**abstract/A1：** Auroras provide remote optical observations of energetic electrons precipitating into the upper atmosphere, and whose energy distribution encodes key information about large scale magnetospheric processes. Recovering the underlying electron precipitation field from ground-based camera images of auroras remains a challenging inverse problem. Existing auroral tomography techniques are often limited to simplified static settings, discrete spatial and energy grids, or strong assumptions on the electron energy spectrum. We propose to model the dynamic auroral electron precipitation field via a temporally conditioned neural network. The state of the precipitation field at each frame is represented by a per-frame latent code driven by learned discrete dynamics. A shared decoder maps horizontal positions and latent states to electron energy spectra. The predicted flux is converted to multi-wavelength volume emission rates and rendered into camera images accounting for delayed emissions. We evaluate the method on synthetic dynamic auroral sequences and real multi-view auroral videos, showing that the proposed representation produces temporally coherent precipitation reconstructions and image projections consistent with the observations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027). Camera-ready version with supplementary material. 17 pages, 15 figures

</details>

### 170. [Exact Sparse Assignment with Costly Target Embeddings: Fixed-Realization Certificates and an Empirical Audit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19770v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19770

**作者：** Hamidreza Hasani Balyani、Mahtab Movahhedrad、Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19770v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19770v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究目标嵌入获取代价高时的稀疏一对一关联问题，为单位范数嵌入给出可证明「当前分配已最优」的证书，据此选择性获取目标嵌入并提前停止；并在四个文本实体匹配基准上审计该协议，发现节省集中于单一数据集、预设的运行时间收益被推翻，且缓存与批次不一致在近并列处引发分歧。

**相关性简评：** 其中「用证书判断是否还需取证据并停止」的判据可能可供核查 LVR 中证据获取与停止决策的成本核算，而其批量不变性与缓存近并列审计也提示 latent 相似度比较中缓存和批处理带来的伪差异，但方法与视觉多模态推理相距较远，需较多改造。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exact Sparse Assignment with Costly Target Embeddings: Fixed-Realization Certificates and an Empirical Audit

**abstract/A1：** Embedding-based one-to-one association is common in vision and data integration: detections are associated with tracks and records are linked across databases. Such pipelines often solve a sparse optional assignment whose edge scores add a cheap term to an inner product of neural embeddings. When target embeddings are costly, one can acquire them selectively and stop once a certificate proves that the current assignment is optimal. We give such a certificate for unit-norm embeddings. It bounds the unknown part of every reassignment by a support function and maximizes the resulting robust gains with a second sparse assignment; a shared owner-centred bound dominates any fixed-centre triangle bound. We make precise what is certified when network features are not batch-invariant: the realized values of the acquired rows and every unit-ball completion of the rest, not a second forward pass in a different batch. Auditing against a separately batched cache tests a different property; on our first pilot it produced a spurious $2.49\\times10^{-6}$ objective failure. We audit the corrected protocol on four public text entity-matching benchmarks with two frozen encoders; no image data is used. All 96 certificate simulations and 120 online selective timings were exact on their own realization (largest objective gap $6.82\\times10^{-13}$). At group size 8 the shared certificate acquires on average 60% of candidate-active targets, against 74% (mean centre), 69% (MEB) and 60% (zero centre): it beats the mean and MEB centres but not the zero centre, and savings concentrate in one benchmark (7% acquired). The prespecified runtime claim is contradicted: selective execution is +0.510 s slower per run (dataset-cluster 95% interval \[+0.248, +0.772\]). Uniform-microbatch re-encodings preserved the optimum in only 5 of 8 encoder-dataset cells, and 45 of 120 online runs disagreed with an eager cache at near-ties.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 2 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

</details>

### 171. [Multi-Branch Transformer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19800v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19800

**作者：** Gaotang Li、Lingjie Chen、Chunyuan Deng、Zhiwei Xu、Hongzheng Chen、Christopher De Sa、Jingrui He、Yingheng Wang、Hanghang Tong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19800v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19800v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出多分支 Transformer（MBT）：共享初始层后，并行运行多个参数独立的全 Transformer 块分支，在共享末端层前融合输出，并用 Joint-KV 在每一深度由分支表示构建共享 KV 缓存以提升长上下文推理效率。

**相关性简评：** 分支并行、逐深度融合与共享 KV 缓存可能为并行 latent 推理路径的状态聚合，以及缓存与注意力结构如何影响 latent 相似度比较和状态复用提供可核查线索，但论文本身只做纯文本语言建模的架构效率研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-Branch Transformer

**abstract/A1：** Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. Balanced MBTs improve further and retain comparable quality as the number of branches increases. To improve inference efficiency at long contexts, we introduce Joint-KV, which constructs a shared KV cache from branch representations at each depth. Our final recipe combines Balanced MBTs with Joint-KV, supported by an inference engine that exploits branch grouping and shared-cache reuse. Fitted scaling curves indicate that standard Transformers require up to 1.26x as much training body compute to match our final models' validation loss. These models reduce full-model KV-cache storage by up to 34% and deliver up to 51.4% higher decoding throughput on a single H200 GPU. Ablation studies show that branching yields gains beyond changes in width and depth, enables an effective KV-sharing strategy (Joint-KV), remains robust across fusion functions, and performs best in the middle layers. These findings show that branching offers a practical path for scaling language models toward both better modeling quality and faster inference.

**comment/C1：** Project: https://gaotangli.github.io/project\_page/Multi-Branch-Transformer/

</details>

### 172. [MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19807v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19807

**作者：** Sijie Ruan、Tingyu Xie、Mingfei Liu、Yicheng Tang、Haoyu Han、Jingnan Qi、Jingshu Zeng、Dongqi Xu、Jing Wang、Shuliang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.DB

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19807v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19807v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究从众包街景图像自动生产 POI 数据的问题，提出 MAPS 两级框架：SPICE 用轻量 VLM 重建并过滤文本、按 POI 分组并判断语义与完整性，RIMA 检索候选记录、做证据支撑的匹配与属性级推理并在必要时补充视觉、地理或外部证据，在人工复核评测中超过最强基线 21.8% 并已上线。

**相关性简评：** RIMA 的「按需获取互补证据」与 SPICE 的完整性判定，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供可核查线索；但论文是数据库维护应用，不涉及 latent 推理状态，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MAPS: A Multimodal Agentic Framework for POI Data Production Based on Crowdsourced Street-view Imagery

**abstract/A1：** Point-of-interest (POI) databases support location-based services, yet urban changes quickly make their records stale and manual maintenance is costly. Crowdsourced street-view images provide timely visual evidence, but converting them into database actions requires separating multiple POIs and irrelevant text in each image, then resolving incomplete observations against ambiguous records. We study Street-view Image-based POI Data Production and propose MAPS, the first framework to integrate structured POI extraction with database maintenance from such imagery. MAPS contains two cascaded modules. SPICE progressively adapts a lightweight vision-language model to reconstruct and filter text, group entries belonging to the same POI, and classify their semantics and completeness. RIMA retrieves candidate records, performs evidence-grounded POI matching and attribute-level reasoning, and selectively acquires complementary visual, geospatial, or external-source evidence when necessary. In human-reviewed full-task evaluation, MAPS outperforms the strongest baseline by 21.8\\%. MAPS has also been deployed in Kuaishou's large-scale POI production pipeline, reducing average processing time by 76.9\\% relative to manual annotation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and practical value of MAPS for scalable POI maintenance.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for presentation at the 33rd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2027), Cycle 1

</details>

### 173. [Conditional Optimal Transport and Triangular Maps for Imitation Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19815v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19815

**作者：** Mohammad Al-Jarrah、Yuhang Mei、Karen Leung、Bamdad Hosseini、Amirhossein Taghvaei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19815v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19815v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把模仿学习表述为条件采样问题，用三角映射把参考分布搬运为「观测历史→动作块」的条件分布，并给出最优传输、flow matching 与随机插值三种实例；在 Push-T 与 Square 上与 Diffusion Policy 竞争，且网络更小、训练更短。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是把参考分布从固定高斯改为示范经验分布、从而在极少网络评估下仍保持条件多模态采样，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态如何以数据/证据构成的参考分布初始化与少步生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conditional Optimal Transport and Triangular Maps for Imitation Learning

**abstract/A1：** We introduce a unified formulation of imitation learning from demonstrations as a conditional sampling problem solved by triangular transport: a policy is the second block of a triangular map that transports a reference distribution to the conditional distribution of the action chunk given the observation history. Unlike in Diffusion Policy, where it is a fixed Gaussian, the reference becomes a design variable; we take it to be the empirical distribution of the demonstrated action chunks and introduce three instances of the formulation: an optimal transport policy (OTP), a flow matching policy (FMP), and a stochastic interpolant policy (SIP). On the Push-T and robomimic Square tasks, the three policies are competitive in task performance with Diffusion Policy and Consistency Policy while using considerably smaller networks and shorter training, and the informative reference accounts for a substantial part of their performance when few network evaluations are used. The three instances offer different trade-offs rather than a single best method: OTP generates an action chunk with a single evaluation of the smallest network (0.23 million parameters on Push-T) and is suitable for settings in which inference time and model size matter, whereas SIP attains the highest scores among the proposed policies at a higher cost.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 174. [Foundation Pareto Flow Policy for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19825v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19825

**作者：** Zhanjiang Yang、Lijun Sun、Yueming Li、Meng Li、Yijun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19825v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19825v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FP2：以多模态 diffusion transformer 配合 flow matching 损失，加预训练—中训练—后训练三阶段流程做离线多目标强化学习，在连续控制任务上实现对新任务与偏好权衡的零样本插值与外推及少样本适配。

**相关性简评：** 偏好条件化的一次性整轨迹生成与分阶段训练，可能为 LVR 中并行生成、条件控制与轨迹监督提供可供核查的方法线索；但论文无视觉推理与显式 latent 推理状态，迁移价值需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Foundation Pareto Flow Policy for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** The overarching goal of reinforcement learning (RL) is to efficiently optimize the agent's policy for various environments, tasks, dynamics, and even user preferences, which often consist of multiple and potentially conflicting rewards/objectives. This necessitates the learning of Pareto-optimal policies that can navigate different trade-offs among objectives. However, existing multi-objective RL (MORL) methods, whether trained online or offline, are typically limited to task- or objective-specific policy learning and do not address generalization of learned trade-offs to unseen tasks/objectives. In this work, we propose the Foundation Pareto Flow Policy (FP2) for offline MORL in continuous robotic control, inspired by the pre-mid-post-training paradigm underlying recent foundation models. Specifically, we instantiate FP2 as a multi-modal diffusion transformer equipped with a likelihood-free flow matching loss, enabling unified, scalable, and instructable learning of diverse trade-off trajectories. We further develop a three-stage training pipeline to gradually optimize the policy: (1) pre-training on a large-scale MORL dataset, (2) mid-training on a carefully curated high-quality dataset, and (3) post-training on few collected trajectory data from new tasks and trade-offs. Empirical results demonstrate that FP2 outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on most tasks of the D4MORL benchmark, achieving superior zero-shot interpolation and extrapolation on complex Pareto manifolds as well as efficient few-shot adaptation of the learned trade-off prior to new continuous-control tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/FibonacciRabbit/FP2.

</details>

### 175. [Where Is Rank-1 DiM Refusal Intervenable in Multimodal LM Derivatives?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19826v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19826

**作者：** Chansu Han、Seok-Hwan Choi、Takeshi Takahashi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19826v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19826v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在统一的 mean / rank-1 difference-in-means 提取即干预协议下，比较开源权重多模态衍生模型中文本解码器 T 与编码器、投影器、融合路径 E/P/F 的因果可干预性，并配合匹配范数随机对照、margin-rank 与 leverage 探针；结果显示干预效果集中于 T，攻击随有害文本而非图像或音频内容迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「位点级因果干预＋杠杆/秩探针」可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据究竟在内部状态的哪个位点可被读取与介入；「随文本而非视觉内容变化」的负结果也可能与视觉旁路、信息坍缩问题相关，但研究对象是拒答安全干预而非推理，需阅读正文确认协议能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Is Rank-1 DiM Refusal Intervenable in Multimodal LM Derivatives?

**abstract/A1：** Open-weight model hubs now ship not only chat checkpoints but a long tail of derivatives---fine-tunes, safety guards, vision--language models (VLMs), audio wrappers, and generative heads---yet residual-stream safety audits still often intervene at a single site, usually the text decoder $T$. We ask a localization question under one shared mean / rank-1 difference-in-means (DiM) extract$=$intervene protocol, with matched-norm random and empty-rate controls: does causal chat attack lift concentrate at $T$, or do perceptual encoders, projectors, and fusion paths ($E$/$P$/$F$) supply a comparable bypass? On the mixed-input settings we stress-test---HADES adversarial images paired with harmful text prompts, and spoken AdvBench via text-to-speech (TTS) or silence---text DiM at $T$ raises attack success rate (ASR) while the same mean DiM at $E$/$P$/$F$ does not; attacks track harmful text rather than image or audio content. Margin-rank and leverage probes on a Vision leaf show that this recipe is extremal at $T$ and near chance at $P$/$E$, which pressures a weak-extractor reading of those flat cells for the DiM family we study. Catalog breadth and mapper-free base$\\to$derivative transfer when residual widths match provide supporting coverage under the same gates; generative U-Nets are a separate band under generation judges. The primary claim is this recipe-scoped $T$ vs.\\ non-text intervenability asymmetry---intervention accessibility under mean / rank-1 DiM, not a claim that refusal is absent or fully represented outside $T$ (text vs.\\ perceptual contrasts and pooling differ by site). On VLGuard Unsafe prompts ($n{=}200$; Llama-Guard), the same $T$ vs.\\ $P$/$E$ directionality holds at modest absolute ASR ($0.030{\\to}0.150$ at $T$). An intervention-oriented Class$\\times$site ledger records where this protocol still hooks as supporting coverage, not as a universal multimodal bypass.

</details>

### 176. [AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19836v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19836

**作者：** Xu Yang、Gady Agam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19836v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19836v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察特征金字塔中每个输出位置应聚合哪些尺度层级的信息，发现最细输出网格约 75% 的注意力落在粗两级的特征上，且随目标变大更偏向粗尺度；据此提出 AGPF，在保持原输出网格的前提下让每个位置从图像坐标对齐的多尺度记忆中动态选择上下文来源，在 COCO 检测与多种分割任务上稳定提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐位置跨尺度动态选择证据源」及注意力在各尺度上的分布测量，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与内部状态的尺度选择提供借鉴，可供核查该对齐记忆与选择机制能否迁移到 VLM 多层视觉特征的动态路由。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Feature pyramids provide dense predictors with features at several spatial resolutions. However, it remains largely unexplored which pyramid levels each output location should aggregate information from. We investigate this question by allowing each output location to attend to features from every pyramid level and measuring how attention is distributed across scales. Surprisingly, locations on the finest output grid allocate approximately 75\\% of their attention to features two levels coarser, rather than to the current or adjacent levels. Even on the same output grid, the balance shifts toward coarser features as object size increases. These observations motivate Asymmetric Global Pyramid Fusion (AGPF), a neck that preserves the original output grids while allowing each location to dynamically select its contextual sources across scales. Each location interacts with a multiscale memory whose features are aligned in image coordinates, enabling flexible cross-scale aggregation without altering prediction resolutions. Compared with FPN, AGPF improves all 19 object detection and all seven instance segmentation configurations evaluated on COCO. A single fusion block improves Cascade Mask R-CNN by 1.7 box AP and 2.3 mask AP, and the gains consistently transfer to semantic and panoptic segmentation.

</details>
