<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Passable for Whom? Few-Shot Personal Calibration of Sidewalk Accessibility Perception

**abstract/A1：** Whether a sidewalk is passable depends on who is trying to pass: people who use the same mobility aid disagree about the same image, so one label per scene, or per aid, is wrong for many of them. We introduce few-shot personal accessibility perception: from K answers of a person never seen before, predict their judgment of sidewalk scenes never seen before. PassCal separates a shared description of the scene from the person's interpretation of it. The description comes from the internal state of a frozen vision-language model (VLM) and from barrier type, severity and context properties predicted by a detector trained on 14.9k public audits; the interpretation, a calibration of the person's response style and a weighting of the properties, is fit from their answers. On 8,883 judgments in which each of 135 verified mobility-aid users rated the same 50 sidewalk scenes, with people and scenes both held out, eight answers lower the Brier score from 0.550 to 0.479. The same VLM prompted with those answers reaches 0.562, and the same calibration without the scene 0.521. Conformal risk control turns predictions into passable, blocked or "depends on you" statements with a bounded expected rate of wrong statements over people; at 5%, eight answers raise the share of decisive scenes from 27% to 42%. Audit-supervised properties improve all sixteen vision and VLM encoders we test and outperform attributes from a sidewalk navigation VLM.

</details>

### 178. [When Facts Change, Which Decisions Break? Dependency-Aware Context Graphs for Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19859v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19859

**作者：** Paul Deepakraj Retinraj

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19859v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19859v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在三个可执行工作流域、120 个流程上比较全量重算、滚动摘要记忆、词法检索与从 agent 读取轨迹抽取的字段级依赖图，考察事实变化后决策修复的正确性与总成本权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其依赖图、边删除与伪边、传递传播和上下文范围消融，为「证据变化时 latent 状态应选择性重算还是整体更新」及 STOP 成本核算提供可核查线索，但无视觉模态，迁移到 LVR 需另行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Facts Change, Which Decisions Break? Dependency-Aware Context Graphs for Agents

**abstract/A1：** When an observed fact changes, an agent must identify and repair the decisions that depend on it while preserving unaffected outputs. We investigate the reliability-cost trade-off of field-level dependency graphs extracted from actual agent read traces. A controlled benchmark spans three executable workflow domains and four successive updates, with independent imperative and expression-based references. Across 120 workflows, two models and two repeated runs, we compare full recomputation, rolling summary memory, lexical retrieval, trace-extracted dependencies and verified dependency upper bounds. Trace-derived graphs reduce reviewed decisions and estimated total cost, but omitted alternative supports and missing repair context can reduce complete-plan correctness. Paired ablations isolate the effects of edge deletion, spurious edges, transitive propagation and context scope. An exploratory enhancement supplies the existing record ID/field directory during extraction without revealing unread values or reference edges. We evaluate this enhancement on 60 fresh workflows with two repeats per model. On this fresh set, the directory-aware graph matches observed full-context complete-plan correctness for gpt-6.1-sol (100%) with an estimated 4.0% total-cost reduction, but reaches only 84.8% versus 99.6% for gpt-6-luna. The results distinguish potential dependency impact from actual decision invalidity and show why selective repair must be evaluated with both executable correctness and full memory-processing cost. The evidence concerns explicit procedural workflows; broad real-world agent-memory generalization remains untested.

</details>

### 179. [Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19889v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19889

**作者：** Sumit Tahiliani、Avi Mathur、Sandarbh Agarwal、Rakshith Sathish、Ashwathi Nambiar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19889v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19889v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文以 Sentinel-2 时序作物分类为任务，检验 GradientSHAP、Shapley 采样与 Occlusion 的波段归因是否真正反映任务必要性：发现三种方法虽与领域知识一致，但归因排名无法预测重训练结果，用最低排名波段重训练甚至不劣于最高排名波段，且全子集分析显示有效维度很低、谱段高度冗余。

**相关性简评：** 其「以重训练必要性而非归因一致性判定特征使用」的检验思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉 token 或特征是否被答案实际使用、贡献分配与视觉旁路问题；但领域相隔较远，与 latent 状态生成无直接联系，需人工判断迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Illusion of Explainability: A Sanity Check for Spectral Band Attribution in Satellite Time-Series Crop Classification

**abstract/A1：** Attribution methods are commonly validated through convergence across methods and consistency with domain knowledge, yet neither criterion establishes whether identified features are necessary for a task. This limitation is particularly relevant in multispectral remote sensing, where overlapping spectral information makes individual bands potentially substitutable. We investigate this gap in crop-type classification using GradientSHAP, Shapley sampling, and Occlusion on a U-TAE segmentation model trained on Sentinel-2 time series from the PASTIS benchmark. All three methods identify vegetation-sensitive spectral regions consistent with domain knowledge, while Shapley and Occlusion exhibit strong ordering sensitivity in deletion and insertion tests. However, these properties do not reliably predict retraining performance. Aggregate attribution consensus masks substantial per-class disagreement, with pairwise mean Spearman correlations ranging from 0.09 to 0.79. Models retrained from scratch using the five lowest-ranked bands perform comparably to or better than those using the five highest-ranked bands. Furthermore, attribution rankings from an independently trained model with identical configuration and seed identify a different top-five subset that yields better retraining performance. Analysis of all 252 five-band subsets reveals consistently low effective dimensionality (1.35 to 2.62), suggesting substantial spectral redundancy. These findings demonstrate that plausible and apparently faithful attribution rankings do not necessarily identify task-relevant bands for improved retrained performance, highlighting the limitations of band-level feature attribution in spectrally redundant input spaces.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 4th Computer Vision for Earth Observation (CV4EO) Workshop at WACV 2027

</details>

### 180. [LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19896v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19896

**作者：** Muhan Xiao、Shijian Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19896v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19896v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 Ouro、Raven 等循环语言模型提出 LoopSkim：以每个 loop 的浅层读出充当投机草稿、后续深度逐层校验并替换矛盾 token，仅全深度读出提交，从而在采样下保持无损，无需训练即获约 1.73 倍于 LoopSpec 的加速。

**相关性简评：** 将不同循环深度的读出视为可被检验和替换的候选、并用全深度提交的机制，可能为 LVR 的多深度 latent 假设筛选、深度作为验证器以及停止决策提供可核查线索；但对象为纯文本生成且无视觉证据，与主线联系偏弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopSkim: Lossless Multi-Depth Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. LoopSkim fixes the random draws of every position in advance, so each check compares two tokens and decoding stays lossless in exact arithmetic under sampling for any number of checks and draft chains. Without training, its speedup over AR averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec across greedy decoding and sampling, and its checks between the first loops and full depth speed it up on every model. An optional draft head adds a second chain and raises this average to 1.99x.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 3 figures, 16 tables

</details>

### 181. [Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19901v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19901

**作者：** Chenhao Ding、Jizhou Han、Lixin Xiu、Muyao Wang、Songlin Dong、Hideki Nakayama

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19901v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19901v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 R2A 在线 VLN 适应框架，用成功/失败导航记忆按指令检索经验，并以冻结预训练策略为锚强化成功轨迹、抑制失败轨迹，实现无源域数据的持续策略更新。

**相关性简评：** 其按任务检索正负经验并做对比式轨迹训练、辅以冻结策略约束行为漂移的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹级监督与贡献分配提供线索，可供核查；但本身不涉及 latent 视觉推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Remember, Replay, Adapt: Learning from Past Experience in Online Vision-and-Language Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Existing feedback-based methods for online vision-and-language navigation (VLN) primarily learn from current episode outcomes, leaving previously acquired feedback underutilized. Inspired by human episodic memory, we propose R2A, an online VLN adaptation framework that continually reuses successful and failed navigation experiences for policy learning. Specifically, Success-Failure Memory (SFM) retains successful and failed navigation episodes with acquired feedback and retrieves task-relevant experiences based on incoming instructions, enabling historical feedback to guide subsequent navigation. Prior-Anchored Adaptation (PAA) learns from these experiences by reinforcing successful trajectories and suppressing failed ones relative to a frozen pretrained policy, while regularizing behavioral drift. Together, these modules enable continual feedback reuse and stable policy adaptation without source-domain data or expert supervision. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks, REVERIE, R2R, and R2R-CE, and five navigation backbones demonstrate consistent performance gains. On the REVERIE validation unseen split, R2A improves DUET's SR from 46.98% to 69.84% and SPL from 33.73% to 50.98%.

</details>

### 182. [Two-Stage Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework for Person ReID without Clothing Hypothesis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19939v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19939

**作者：** Yuxuan Xiao、Shanshan Zhang、Shengcai Liao、Jian Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19939v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19939v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文面向行人重识别（ReID），提出两阶段提示学习框架 TSPL：第一阶段在冻结编码器下用外观分解式提示将服装与身份信息解耦，第二阶段以可学习上下文嵌入并借助第一阶段表示训练图像编码器，统一覆盖同服装、换装与未知场景。

**相关性简评：** 其可选择性保留或抑制特定属性线索的解耦式表示可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与任务必要信息保留提供借鉴，但属于 ReID 应用，与 latent 推理状态的联系尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two-Stage Prompt Learning: A Unified Framework for Person ReID without Clothing Hypothesis

**abstract/A1：** Person re-identification (ReID) in real-world scenarios involves three clothes conditions: the same clothes (SC), changed clothes (CC), and the unknown (GEN) scenario where clothes changes are not specified. Existing methods typically train separate SC- or CC-specific models, which limits generalization across all conditions. Meanwhile, pre-trained visual-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP have shown strong generalization ability in various vision tasks, motivating recent ReID methods to incorporate textual prompts. However, to distinguish SC and CC, prior approaches rely on fixed predefined instructions, which lack learnable context embeddings in prompts and cannot effectively handle the GEN scenario. To overcome these limitations, we propose Two-Stage Prompt Learning (TSPL), a unified framework that integrates clothes-identity decoupling and scenario-aware task prompts within VLMs. In Stage 1, appearance-decomposed prompt learning disentangles clothes and identity information under frozen encoders, producing stable embeddings where clothes cues can be selectively preserved or suppressed. In Stage 2, task-aware prompt learning trains the image encoder with learnable context embeddings guided by Stage-1 representations, enabling robust adaptation across SC, CC, and GEN conditions. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks show that TSPL achieves state-of-the-art performance under all scenarios, improving mAP by up to 9.2% on LTCC (SC) and by 6.4% on VC-Clothes (GEN), respectively. The code will be released at https://github.com/YuSuen/TSPL.

</details>

### 183. [The structure of variational autoencoder latent spaces and its consequences for representation and optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19972v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19972

**作者：** Sergei V. Kalinin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19972v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19972v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在原型数据、平方误差重构与最优解码器假设下，将 VAE 潜空间目标对应到 Flory-Huggins 正则溶液理论，分析正则化强度、后验分布与潜维度如何组织出类域、有限宽度壁、稀有状态岛及后验坍缩，并讨论其对插值生成与稀有状态发现的含义。

**相关性简评：** 其潜空间几何分析框架可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的类域分隔、维度不足导致的混合与折叠以及后验坍缩，但对象是科学数据 VAE，能否迁移到 VLM 推理状态表示仍需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The structure of variational autoencoder latent spaces and its consequences for representation and optimization

**abstract/A1：** Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are widely used to build low-dimensional representations of scientific data, with the expectation that regularization yields smooth coordinates for interpolation, generation and optimization. However, applications in microscopy reveal domains, narrow transitions and rare-state islands in VAE latent spaces that smoothness alone does not explain. We show that, for prototype data with squared-error reconstruction and an optimal decoder, the latent-space objective has a direct correspondence with the Flory-Huggins theory of a regular solution, and use it to analyze how the objective, posterior distributions and latent dimensionality organize the representation. Data families occupy domains separated by finite-width walls that broaden with increasing regularization until class separation is lost through posterior collapse. Class centroids behave like particles in a harmonic trap: the prior confines them, and structural dissimilarity sets a soft repulsion that determines which classes become neighbors and how far apart they sit, with separations growing only logarithmically with dissimilarity. Rare states can remain unresolved, form small islands, accumulate within walls or develop intervening domains, depending on their frequency and similarity to common states. The posterior covariance can align domains with the latent axes, but axis alignment does not imply separation of physical factors. Rotations can produce rings and encoder cuts that reflect data symmetry, while insufficient dimensionality can lead to suppression, mixing or folding of additional factors. Comparisons with flow models, deep kernel learning (DKL) and hybrid VAE-DKL models show how these structures change when reconstruction and prediction play different roles. We discuss implications for interpreting data, discovering rare states, generating intermediate states and optimizing properties.

</details>

### 184. [What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20000v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20000

**作者：** Yipeng Sun、Jiajun Wang、Siyuan Mei、Yan Xia、Siming Bayer、Vincent Christlein、Andreas Maier

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20000v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20000v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验无配对跨模态对齐在自然图像、音频、X 光与 3D CT 上的可行性，发现对齐须先定位模态共变子空间再定向映射，且医疗影像该子空间方差占比最小；据此提出 LightAlign，用少量配对在冻结编码器间拟合 ridge regression 并仅以报告文本训练分类器。

**相关性简评：** 「共享子空间方差占比」可作为量化诊断 latent 工作区中视觉细节保留与信息坍缩的线索，少量配对定位映射也可能用于视觉证据筛选，但论文不涉及推理期 latent 生成，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Matters for Cross-Modal Alignment

**abstract/A1：** The Platonic Representation Hypothesis posits that models trained on different modalities converge toward a shared representation. Related work aligns frozen image and text encoders on natural images without paired data. We test zero-pair alignment on five datasets across four modalities: natural images, environmental audio, chest radiographs, and 3D computed tomography (CT). It succeeds only on COCO and fails on the other four. We analyze the failures and find that alignment must first locate the subspace where the modalities co-vary and then orient the mapping within it. Consistent with previous studies, medical imaging is the hardest case: its shared subspace carries the smallest fraction of the variance. When this fraction is small, alignment needs image-text pairs, and random-matrix theory predicts how many pairs are needed. These findings motivate LightAlign: a few pairs let a ridge regression between two frozen encoders locate and orient the mapping simultaneously, and a classifier fitted only on report text then predicts findings from the mapped images. On 3D CT, LightAlign surpasses models trained end to end on image-report pairs without finding-level labels: with only 200 pairs, LightAlign outperforms CT-CLIP on CT-RATE (0.754 vs. 0.733 AUROC), and with only 100 CT-RATE pairs, it does so on RAD-ChestCT, an out-of-distribution dataset from a different hospital. On CheXpert, it reaches 0.862 mean AUROC with only about 5% as many pairs as models trained on MIMIC-CXR.

</details>

### 185. [D'BEAST: Logged Bad Experiences as Explanation for Autonomous Driving Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20019v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20019

**作者：** Ahmad Alfan Alfian Irfan、Nur Ahmad Khatim、Mansur Arief

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20019v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20019v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 D'BEAST，从同一初始 Q 表重放固定训练日志，在保留全部更新、跳过「坏经验」更新、保留更新但去除事件惩罚三种条件下对比，考察表格型 RL 智能体的决策能否由其安全事故相关训练转移解释，并在六个经典 MDP 与 CARLA 闭环驾驶中验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「删除或中性化小规模训练转移以检验其对具体决策的因果贡献」的消融式归因，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练监督与 latent 内容贡献分配的问题；但对象为表格 RL 与自动驾驶，与 VLM 推理的直接关联尚需阅读原文评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** D'BEAST: Logged Bad Experiences as Explanation for Autonomous Driving Agents

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning agents learn from mistakes, yet their decisions can be difficult to trace back to those experiences. We investigate whether a tabular agent's decisions can be explained by its bad experiences, defined as the training transitions associated with safety or task events. A fixed training log is replayed from the same initial Q-table under three conditions. FULL retains all updates, SKIP omits bad-experience updates, and NEUTRALIZE retains those updates without their event penalties. We illustrate the method on six classic Markov decision processes and evaluate it in closed-loop driving in CARLA. On the full driving task, FULL reached the goal from 33 of 40 test starts, whereas SKIP and NEUTRALIZE reached it from none, indicating that the bad experiences carry decision-relevant information. At the local level, for 47 decisions shortly before a failure of SKIP or NEUTRALIZE, removing or neutralizing a small group of bad experiences, with a median size of one, caused the trained agent to select the failing policy's action in 46 cases. For this agent, the results indicate that its decisions can be explained by its bad experiences.

</details>

### 186. [FastGRN: Few-Step Generative Refinement Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20021v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20021

**作者：** Haoyang Hu、Masataka Seo、Liang Li、Yen-wei Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20021v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20021v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 对离散 latent 图像生成器 GRN 做少步蒸馏：借助其均匀态损坏在 token 上做分布匹配，按 rectified flow 方式配噪，并用过采样、非均匀步采样和「refinement confidence keeping」把信息与修复负载重新分配到少数步，3 步 FID 超过原 GRN。

**相关性简评：** 该文发现各去噪步的信息量与修复负载并不相同，并以「只训练最后一步、把信息集中在采样末端」「保留已确定的 token」来压缩步数，这些机制可能为 latent 推理中的步间计算分配、状态更新与提前停止/冻结提供可核查线索；但研究对象是图像生成，与视觉推理的迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FastGRN: Few-Step Generative Refinement Networks

**abstract/A1：** Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) generate an image by repeatedly re-predicting and refining every token of a discrete latent. They reach high fidelity, but need dozens of Markov steps. We therefore train few-step GRNs on the distribution of their own samples. We use its own uniform-state corruption to perform distribution matching on discrete tokens, which lets a discrete generator learn by backpropagation, and we pair noise with samples in the manner of rectified flow. We find that the steps of a few-step GRN do not carry the same amount of information or the same repair load. We therefore exploit its discrete refinement during training and build few-step GRNs in three parts. Oversampling samples the student with more steps than it was trained for and refines its judge on these samples. Non-uniform sampling trains only the last step and hands it most of the information at sampling time. Refinement confidence keeping holds on to the tokens the student is already sure of. We train a fast class-conditional generator on ImageNet 256 and, with the same method, a 2B text-to-image model. On ImageNet 256, the 3-step FastGRN beats the FID of GRN. On a 2B binary-token text-to-image GRN, a 4-step student also nearly matches the GenEval of GRN-T2I 2B.

</details>

### 187. [The Frontier Must Grow - Self-proposed, interpreter-labelled training roughly doubles a 4B model's accuracy on a fresh exam as its verified frontier grows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20049v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20049

**作者：** Martin Schroder

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20049v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20049v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文让 Qwen3-4B 自我提出 Lua 程序题，由解释器提供可执行答案构成逐轮倍增的题目池，每轮从基座重训适配器，检验这种「验证前沿」增长能否提升新考试准确率；随访集上准确率由 8.3% 升至 16.7%，但注册判据未全满足，同等数据单次拟合达 14.6% 使轮次优势不确定，另有仓库任务与 27B 设定下的负结果。

**相关性简评：** 自提议数据加可执行验证器标注、逐轮扩池并从基座重训的做法，可能为 LVR 中缺少中间状态标签时的轨迹自生成、验证信号使用与轮次贡献核查提供参照线索；但属代码文本任务且结果不稳，是否可迁移仍需核查原文。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Frontier Must Grow - Self-proposed, interpreter-labelled training roughly doubles a 4B model's accuracy on a fresh exam as its verified frontier grows

**abstract/A1：** A model can learn from problems it poses itself when an executable oracle supplies the answers. Qwen3-4B proposed Lua 5.1 programs; those it predicted wrong at least once in four samples joined a pool labelled by the interpreter, each round adding twice as many programs as the last (300, 900, 2100 in total), and each round trained a fresh adapter from the base on the pool. On the original exam the procedure met its registered criterion, an item-level test of each adapter against its predecessor. On a 2340-item exam drawn afterwards, accuracy rose from 8.3% to 16.7%; that follow-up's registered criteria were not met because round 1 gained nothing, while rounds 2 and 3 added 5.0 and 2.9 points on average, both intervals above zero. One fit on the same amount of base-proposed frontier data reached 14.6%, so the rounds' 2.1-point advantage is inconclusive. Three earlier registered series met no per-lineage criterion, and the same loop showed no gain on repository tasks or for a 27B agent in those configurations.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 「先出草稿、后用完整证据复核」的流程可为 LVR 中候选推理状态与视觉证据的验证、停止决策提供方法线索，但论文属语音识别且不涉及视觉 latent 推理，其精确一致条件能否迁移尚需核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decode Early, Verify Late: Streaming Offline Speech Recognizers Without Accuracy Loss

**abstract/A1：** Voice agents need accurate transcripts soon after a user stops speaking. We propose Decode Early, Verify Late (DEVL), a training-free framework for streaming inference with offline ASR models. The server keeps partial transcripts as drafts and verifies the latest against the complete audio in one forward pass at turn end. Under stated input and decoding conditions, the final equals the model's greedy offline output in exact arithmetic. We adapt DEVL to four model families. In our five-recognizer comparison, 95-100% of final transcripts are byte-identical to the offline transcripts, WER stays within 0.13 points of offline, and single-stream time to final falls 1.5-7.3x. Serving Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on one A100, DEVL returns finals a median 22-26 ms after turn end at up to 64 streams, 2.7-3.9x sooner than the official streaming mode. It is the only system we tested that meets a 100 ms p99 target, up to 80 streams on Pipecat-STT and 64 on WildASR.

### 189. [Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20078v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20078

**作者：** Chenhao Tong、Steffen Müller

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.MA、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20078v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20078v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究高速公路匝道合流，提出由路侧基础设施汇集所有联网车辆状态、再用 transformer 注意力编码器筛选相关车辆信息并下发控制指令的多智能体强化学习模型，在 SUMO 中对比邻车观测、全局观测和规则基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「从全局状态中学习筛选任务相关信息并可视化相关性权重」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与冗余信息抑制提供可供核查的方法线索，但场景与多模态推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Infrastructure-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Attention for Highway Ramp Merging

**abstract/A1：** On-ramp merging is a typical safety and throughput problem on highways. Without proper coordination, human drivers and self-interested autonomous vehicles may make risky manoeuvres and cause accidents or congestion. With recent advances in connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) and multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), vehicles can be trained to coordinate for safe and efficient merging. However, in dense traffic, forming an effective observation of the traffic state is challenging. For example, observing only the neighbouring vehicles may lead to locally optimal decisions, while observing the entire traffic can introduce much irrelevant information. In this paper, we propose a transformer-based MARL vehicle control model to address these problems. A roadside infrastructure controller receives the states of all CAVs via vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication and sends control commands back to them. An attention-based observation encoder is designed where each vehicle can filter the relevant vehicle information from the global traffic state. The proposed model is evaluated in SUMO against three baselines: a model that observes only the neighbouring vehicles, a model that encodes the global traffic information, and the rule-based SUMO model. The results show that our model achieves the highest traffic flow, safety and smoothness. Furthermore, in a four-hour simulation with dynamic traffic demand, our model successfully avoids traffic jams, while other baseline models fail at high traffic flow. We also show that our model remains effective when human-driven vehicles are present. We further show that our model, trained in ideal communication conditions, can still remain collision-free and maintain throughput under realistic V2I communication errors. Finally, we visualise the relevance weights that an ego vehicle assigns to other vehicles in multiple traffic situations.

</details>

### 190. [Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20090v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20090

**作者：** Zhuoyue Zhang、Jian Liu、Jihua Zhu、Ajmal Saeed Mian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20090v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20090v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析点云视频掩码建模中存在的位置信息泄漏：查询目标自身坐标即可泄露几何位移，双向可见帧也使潜在预测退化为插值补全；为此提出 PointWM，仅用更早帧的位置与时间戳查询未来帧特征与几何，并无监督学习潜动作，在 HOI4D 动作分割上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「补全 vs 预测」的泄漏分析和只用过去上下文预测未来潜在特征、以潜动作承接未定部分的设定，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态生成与监督信号的信息泄漏、捷径问题提供可核查的参照；但对象是点云视频预训练，与 VLM 推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent World Modeling for Point-Cloud Video Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud videos.Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/InitalZ/PointWM.

</details>

### 191. [QA-CMIF:Accurate and Lightweight Cross-Modal Latent Imputation and Fusion for Fault-Tolerant sEMG-Inertial Hand Gesture Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20124v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20124

**作者：** Xinyu Tao、Shuang Huang、Yeyun Cai、Fang Deng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20124v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20124v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 QA-CMIF，用于 sEMG 与惯性信号融合的手势识别：逐通道独立编码、软门控评估通道可靠性、以置信度加权残差旁路保护完好通道，并用跨注意力在 latent 空间借惯性流修复受损通道，配合坏通道对齐损失；在 Ninapro 多个子集上验证轻量化与抗通道损坏性能。

**相关性简评：** 与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「可靠性打分＋置信度加权旁路＋跨模态 latent 填补」可能为 LVR 中视觉证据受损/缺失时的筛选与旁路设计提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QA-CMIF:Accurate and Lightweight Cross-Modal Latent Imputation and Fusion for Fault-Tolerant sEMG-Inertial Hand Gesture Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Fusing surface electromyography (sEMG) with inertial measurements is widely used for myoelectric prosthesis control and wearable human-machine interfaces. In daily wear, however, socket micro-displacement, electrode lift-off, and wire failures often corrupt an unknown subset of sEMG channels through burst artifacts, lift-off shocks, or open-circuit dropouts. Existing fusion networks mix all channels in the first convolutional layer, so a few corrupted electrodes contaminate the entire latent representation, whereas gate-only attenuation of corrupted channels discards the co-activation cues needed to separate fine-grained gestures. We propose QA-CMIF, a quality-aware cross-modal latent imputation and fusion framework that encodes each sEMG channel independently, scores its reliability with a soft gate, and protects intact channels via a confidence-weighted residual bypass, while a cross-attention imputer repairs degraded channels in latent space using the inertial stream and remaining reliable sEMG channels under a bad-channel alignment loss. Across within-subject evaluations on 29 participants from Ninapro DB3, DB2, and DB5 spanning 17-52 gesture classes, QA-CMIF outperformed the gate-only baseline under 50% channel corruption by 1.29-2.65 percentage points, denoted pp, across all three 17-class cohorts with paired-t Holm-adjusted p&lt;0.002, widened this margin to 2.59-4.15 pp on the 40- and 52-class tasks, and surpassed corruption-augmented conventional fusion by 4.61-19.85 pp. Requiring only 0.175-0.185M parameters and 2.45-2.63M multiply-accumulate operations across the 2000 Hz and 200 Hz setups, QA-CMIF saves 46%-55% in parameters and 72%-81% in compute over recent baselines with a 1.44 ms 99th-percentile single-thread CPU latency.

</details>

### 192. [Weights &amp; Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20174v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20174

**作者：** Shi Bin Hoo、Magnus Buehler、Omar Swelam、Frank Hutter、Lennart Purucker

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20174v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20174v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文展示 LLM（GPT-6 Astra）无需梯度优化即可直接编程表格基础模型：从零初始化权重生成 nanoTabPFN、诊断并修复预训练 TabPFN-3.5 的回归失败，并编写 KV-cache 编辑程序在不改权重的情况下改变模型预测行为。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉多模态推理主线无直接关联；但「用语言程序编辑 KV-cache 以定向改变输出」可能为 LVR 中核查 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用、以及对内部状态做干预式验证提供线索，其因果解释与跨模态可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Weights &amp; Caches: LLMs Can Program Tabular Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Neural networks are typically programmed through optimization, rather than by explicitly specifying their computations. Recent work on weight-space programming suggests that large language models (LLMs) can instead reason about and manipulate neural-network weights directly. In this work, we show that LLMs can directly program statistical computations in tabular foundation models (TFMs), whose parameters enable inference across different datasets. We investigate three complementary settings using GPT-6 Astra, without gradient-based optimization. First, Astra directly programs nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights, achieving a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, compared to 0.876 for a pretrained baseline. Second, Astra diagnoses and repairs a signed-product regression failure in pretrained TabPFN-3.5, restoring near-perfect predictions on held-out synthetic datasets while preserving performance on TabArena-Lite, with only a 0.08% average relative increase in error. Third, it writes KV-cache-editing programs that steer TabPFN-3.5's predictions on unseen synthetic datasets, demonstrating transformations such as reversing linear trends and converting sine waves into approximate square waves, without modifying model weights. Together, our findings suggest that LLM-driven programming could complement gradient-based optimization across TFMs' development and usage, while offering a new way to investigate and intervene in their internal computations.

</details>

### 193. [DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20196v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20196

**作者：** Jiahang Liu、Wenbo Zhang、Junsong Wang、Zhenzhi Ying、Siqi Hou、Naohiko Sugita、Liming Shu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.HC、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20196v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20196v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种融合自我中心 RGB 图像与 128 通道前臂 HD-sEMG 的多模态框架，用视觉与肌电两个 Transformer 编码器加 DoF query 融合解码器，为每个自由度设独立可学习 query，实现上下文自适应的连续 20 关节角回归。

**相关性简评：** 逐 DoF 的可学习 query 在跨模态注意力中自适应分配视觉与肌电证据权重，与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、模态旁路和信息坍缩问题有可供核查的相通之处；但其任务是连续回归而非潜在推理，迁移性需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics

**abstract/A1：** Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为调用工具与执行任务的智能体构建双部件情景记忆：以 delta 规则写入的联想矩阵负责检索适用流程，有序可寻址的步骤记录负责顺序、计数与删除，且仅当成功由外部检查或工具结果确认时才入库。

**相关性简评：** 其「自判成功与外部核验的成功率差距」及可寻址步骤检索，可能为 LVR 中停止决策、latent 内容的验证式监督与按状态检索提供核查线索，但工作在无视觉的多模态之外。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Matrix with Steps: An Episodic and Procedural Memory Method for Tool-Using Agents and Robots

**abstract/A1：** Agents that call tools and robots that execute tasks are challenged by two shortcomings: they repeat what failed before, and they learn from runs that they only believe succeeded. We describe the construction of a memory that addresses both, built for a production agent platform. Every run is recorded as an episode, and only an outcome confirmed by an external check, a test, a tool result or a person counts; the agent's own claim never does. What is learned from episodes is kept in a memory with two parts: an associative matrix, written with the delta rule, which finds the procedure that applies to a situation; and a section of ordered, addressable step records that answers what comes after a given step, where a step is a goal of the agent, not a motion. Because the matrix sums its associations, it keeps no order and cannot return or delete a single one; it serves as the finder, and order, outcome counts and deletion live in the records. We describe how execution outcomes are stored, how episodes are recalled and used for solving tasks, and the file format that stores the memory. In simulation, a robot that judged its own success and stopped when it believed it was done reported $96\\%$ of its tasks as done and solved $35\\%$; with external verification it solved $79%$. In a store of $100000$ synthetic episodes ($457$MB on disk), the oldest episode was still found first, no episode from another person's memory was returned, and a success vouched for only by the model was never recalled; a lookup took $16$ms on a laptop and $40$ms on a server node (median). Task outcomes were measured up to about $10000$ confirmed records, where the exact records solved every revisit at the first attempt.

**相关性简评：** 其“缓存潜表示＋按视觉状态变化分配深度＋补偿陈旧几何”的组合，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的跨步复用、动态计算预算与旧表示内容衰减的可核查线索，但任务本身并非推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EvoMem3D: Adaptive-Depth Temporal Representation Memory for Multi-Camera 3D Detection

**abstract/A1：** Modern multi-camera 3D detectors increasingly rely on large Vision Transformer (ViT) image encoders, making repeated full-depth encoding a dominant inference cost even though adjacent driving frames are highly redundant. We present EvoMem3D, an adaptive-depth temporal framework that caches the most recent full-depth detector-interface appearance representation as a read-only anchor and combines it with policy-selected partial features from the current frame. A lightweight pre-encoding controller chooses among semantic encoder exits before image processing, allocating shallow computation to stable frames and deeper computation when the visual state changes. To reuse appearance without carrying stale geometry, we decouple temporal appearance from geometric alignment: current-frame calibration defines the decoder geometry at every timestamp, while a motion-conditioned positional adapter accounts for anchor-to-current ego motion. On nuScenes, EvoMem3D achieves 61.50 NDS and 52.76 mAP while reducing end-to-end latency from 364.4 to 168.7 ms (x2.16) relative to standard dense DETR3D. With StreamPETR, it reaches 61.36 NDS and 52.55 mAP at a x1.92 speedup. Controlled studies isolate the effects of current evidence, temporal reuse, memory correction, and adaptive routing, while our audit confirms that the policy learns to distinguish semantic driving regimes.

</details>

### 196. [Protecting Safety during Reasoning Training with Low-Rank Fisher Regularisation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20288v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20288

**作者：** Neel Rajani、Ivan Titov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20288v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20288v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对推理能力微调时安全护栏退化的问题，重新审视 EWC 的对角 Fisher 近似局限，提出 SP-EWC：将梯度投影到安全相关的低秩子空间以高效捕捉非对角曲率，并比较通过 LoRA 微调更新、安全相关激活的 SVD（ActSVD）与安全/效用数据的对比表征（cPCA）三种子空间识别方式。

**相关性简评：** 其 ActSVD、cPCA 等低秩子空间识别与投影正则手段，可能可供核查用于定位 VLM 内部承载视觉细节或任务必要信息的方向；但该方法作用于参数更新而非推理期 latent 状态，视觉与 LVR 联系需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Protecting Safety during Reasoning Training with Low-Rank Fisher Regularisation

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are trained to have safety guardrails, but these can be compromised while fine-tuning for new capabilities, such as reasoning. One way to mitigate this degradation is to modify the fine-tuning objective to preserve safety behaviour, but doing so effectively and efficiently remains challenging. We revisit Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which penalises parameter updates based on sensitivity estimates from the diagonal of the Fisher information matrix (FIM). While EWC provides some protection, the diagonal approximation ignores interactions between parameters. We address this limitation by exploiting recent findings that safety-relevant behaviour is located in a low-rank subspace within models. Our method, Subspace-Projected Elastic Weight Consolidation (SP-EWC), projects gradients onto this subspace to capture non-diagonal curvature efficiently. We investigate three different ways of identifying the safety subspace: through safety fine-tuning updates (LoRA), safety-related activations (ActSVD), and contrastive representations of safety and utility data (cPCA). We find that this choice substantially affects performance, with SP-EWC using cPCA comparing favourably against existing methods by better maintaining safety guardrails without introducing excessive over-refusal.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 197. [Attention Sinks as Spectral Spikes: A Mechanism Analysis of Gated Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20403v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20403

**作者：** Seojin Kim、Yehjin Shin、Noseong Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20403v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20403v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 attention sink 形式化为 token 空间协方差中与高注意力列对齐的低秩模态，分析 post-SDPA gating 如何在前向衰减 sink 的谱能量、在反向削弱经 sink 列的 value 梯度，并用随机矩阵诊断与训练期指标验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「有效秩、sink 子空间对齐、梯度集中」诊断与模态收缩视角，可能可供核查 VLM 推理中注意力结构如何吸收视觉证据、造成表示坍缩，但需确认这些文本模型指标能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attention Sinks as Spectral Spikes: A Mechanism Analysis of Gated Attention

**abstract/A1：** Transformer attention exhibits attention sinks, where a small subset of source tokens absorbs disproportionate attention mass across layers. Recent work shows that post-SDPA output gating strongly reduces attention-sink behavior, while separate studies link attention sinks to gradient sinks and massive activations through backward training dynamics. Yet how the same gate affects forward sink structure, backward gradient concentration, and training-time representation signatures remains unclear. We address this gap by formulating attention sinks as sink-induced low-rank modes in token-space covariance, with directions aligned to high-mass attention columns. Under this view, post-SDPA gating acts as a mode-dependent contraction: it attenuates sink-induced spectral energy in the forward pass and locally reduces value-path gradients routed through sink columns in the backward pass. Empirically, random-matrix diagnostics show that gating reduces outlier mass, weakens sink-subspace alignment, and increases effective rank, while backward analyses show active-gate attenuation of first-token value gradients. Training-time diagnostics further show that gating suppresses the co-emergence of attention concentration, value-gradient amplification, and representation dominance.

**comment/C1：** The 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 198. [Reasoning Again with a Quarter of the Experts: Retry First, Then Train](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20419v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20419

**作者：** Anik Jha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20419v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20419v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 122B MoE 推理模型上删除四分之三路由专家并做 2-bit 量化后，模型在 LiveCodeBench 上陷入逐字重复循环；论文比较采样惩罚、检测到循环即停止并重抽、以及逐层拟合 rank-8 适配器恢复部分专家三种补救方式，并用预注册对比检验其增益。

**相关性简评：** 其「循环检测—停止—重抽」策略与压缩后逐层适配器修正在概念上可供核查 LVR 的停止决策与压缩/剪枝下任务必要信息保留问题，但材料为纯文本代码推理、无视觉或多模态状态分析，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reasoning Again with a Quarter of the Experts: Retry First, Then Train

**abstract/A1：** Removing three quarters of the routed experts from a 122B-parameter reasoning mixture-of-experts model makes it fit in a 12 GiB file, and breaks it in a specific way: on LiveCodeBench it enters verbatim reasoning loops that run to the token limit on 44 of 120 development problems, where the unpruned model at the same 2-bit quantization loops on none. We study how much of that loss can be recovered without changing the kept experts' quantized bytes, in three steps of increasing cost. On development problems, a sampling penalty recovers part of it. Stopping a reply when it starts to loop and drawing again recovers more on top of it, with no weight change. Our method, B, adds rank-8 trained corrections to the kept experts, loaded as an adapter, and restores two experts per layer; it is fitted layer by layer to the unpruned model's expert block on the pruned model's own activations. In a pre-registered comparison on 130 easy and medium LiveCodeBench problems that no part of the study had touched, with both arms given the same sampling penalty and the same stop-and-redraw policy, B solves 116 problems against 104 (+9.2 pp, 95% CI \[+3.1, +15.4\]; 15 problems gained, 3 lost). A training-free weight edit aimed at the loops, tested the same way earlier, did not help. B removes more wrong answers than loops, and costs 1.7x the wall time. On two older benchmarks used as regression checks, B stays inside a pre-set 2 pp tolerance but shows no gain (HumanEval+ +0.6 pp, MBPP+ -1.9 pp). The evidence is one model, one quantization and one benchmark family; we state what it does and does not show.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 199. [FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20423v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20423

**作者：** Mao Guan、Qian Chen、Ge Meng、Xiao-Yang Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20423v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20423v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 FinVerify，一个面向金融 agent 数值主张的「证据接地」验证框架：先基于 190 条错误轨迹归纳五类错误，再由 LLM 结构化主张与支撑证据、确定性校验器检查财务要求、必要时用 Z3 校验公式一致性，最后按「接受／拒绝／证据不足弃权」三态裁决。

**相关性简评：** 其「LLM 结构化证据＋确定性校验器＋证据不足即弃权」的分工式验证与三态决策，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 结论的证据核验、弃权/停止判据，以及验证成本与覆盖率权衡；但任务领域为金融文本，与视觉推理的迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FinVerify: A Verification Framework for Financial Agents

**abstract/A1：** Financial agents produce numerical claims that can be wrong even when their calculations execute correctly, due to mismatched reporting periods, unsupported sources, incompatible units, or incorrect financial definitions. We introduce FinVerify, an evidence-grounded framework for verifying financial agents' numerical claims. Based on an analysis of 190 incorrect trajectories from the Agent Finance Reasoning dataset, we define five error categories--temporal integrity, source fidelity, comparability, accounting integrity, and financial-model fidelity--and operationalize them as verification protocols. An LLM structures claims and supporting evidence, while deterministic validators check financial requirements; when authoritative formulas are available, Z3 checks consistency with grounded inputs. FinVerify accepts only if all applicable checks pass, rejects proven violations, and abstains when evidence is insufficient. We evaluate the framework against a Direct baseline and an LLM judge across five fixed-candidate benchmarks. On Agent Finance Reasoning, accepted-claim precision increases from 56.4% for the LLM judge to 76.7% at 81.2% coverage. On XBRLFiling, FinVerify achieves 99.8% accepted-claim precision and 97.0% decision accuracy; on FinanceBench-67, it reaches 87.9% accepted-claim precision versus 69.7% for the judge. Improvements are smaller on FinQA and TAT-QA, where authoritative evidence is limited. These results suggest that explicit, evidence-backed verification can improve financial-agent reliability while exposing trade-offs between correctness, false rejection, and abstention.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development

</details>

### 200. [TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20430v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20430

**作者：** Xuannan Liu、Tian Lan、Zekun Li、Xing Cui、Zhengfeng Yu、Feihu Jiang、Qianghuai Jia、Longyue Wang、Zhao Xu、Weihua Luo、Peipei Li、Ran He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20430v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20430v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TrainExplorer 多智能体框架，通过基于文献的策略规划与规划—执行解耦，自主探索 LLM 后训练方案，并在 PostTrainBench 上以加权总分 39.02 超过若干强基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「单组件干预＋归因」的解耦执行思路，可能可供核查用于 LVR 训练监督中的贡献分配与干扰因素隔离；但研究对象是纯文本后训练策略搜索，与视觉推理状态生成无直接关联，线索需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TrainExplorer: Autonomous LLM Post-Training via Plan-and-Decouple Exploration

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based agents can automate model post-training, accelerating progress toward recursive self-improvement. Despite their promise, existing approaches remain under-explored and face two main challenges: (1) strategy lock-in that limits exploration beyond the initial strategy; and (2) coupled execution that obscures the effects of individual modifications. To address these challanges, we propose TrainExplorer, a multi-agent framework for autonomous post-training, that incorporates strategy planning and execution decoupling, to achieve broaden strategy exploration. First, strategy planning draws on scientific literature to construct a candidate search space of training strategies. Then, decoupled execution enables single-component interventions and attribution to guide strategy exploration. Extensive experiments on PostTrainBench demonstrate that TrainExplorer achieves a weighted aggregate score of 39.02, outperforming Claude Code using the same LLM by 7.32 and surpassing GPT-5.6 Sol-powered Codex, which scores 36.23. Code will be available.

</details>

### 201. [ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20433v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20433

**作者：** Wei Qin Chuah、Zeji Hui、Amirali Khodadadian Gostar、Alireza Bab-Hadiashar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20433v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20433v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 ReScene，把每次稀疏回访对场景的改变存为不可变的紧凑增量，按序重放即可精确恢复任一历史状态；并用合成权重把新旧图像的差异归因到单个 Gaussian，以抑制过时元素、细化持续元素，同时发布 Multi-State 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其“按合成权重把重建与观测的不一致分摊到各基元”的做法可能为 latent 状态的贡献分配与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，增量可重放存储也与推理状态的历史保存有形式相似，但任务本身属三维场景重建，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReScene: Incremental Scene Chronology from Sparse Revisits

**abstract/A1：** Scene chronology aims to reconstruct a scene across visits separated by hours or days, during which objects may change in position, presence or shape. Such reconstruction must retain every earlier state, yet each revisit often provides only a few images. Storing a complete model for each visit duplicates the unchanged scene, whereas updating a single shared model alters earlier states. We present ReScene, which stores each visit as an immutable compact update, so that any earlier visit can be recovered exactly by applying the stored updates in order, without retaining past images. To localise each update, ReScene attributes the disagreement between the preceding reconstruction and the new images to individual Gaussians through their compositing weights. This attribution guides the suppression of outdated Gaussians and the refinement of persistent ones, while newly visible surfaces are initialised from learned multi-view depth. We also introduce Multi-State, a benchmark of non-rigid deformation and partial material removal, including synthetic scenes with ground-truth geometry. ReScene achieves quality higher than sequential 3DGS checkpointing with 2.5--4.8$\\times$ less uncompressed history storage. At comparable PSNR, it also reduces foreground depth error by 3.2$\\times$ relative to sequential ChronoGS, showing that accurate rendering does not necessarily imply accurate geometry. Code and benchmark are available at https://waychin-weiqin.github.io/ReScene/.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages

</details>

### 202. [LEDGE: Separating Critic and Editor Failures in Text-to-Image Self-Correction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20446v1>)

**作者：** Vyom Agarwal、Mokshda Gangrade、Samet Ayhan、Giacinto Paolo Saggese

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LEDGE 框架，用 GenEval 编译的 oracle 编辑指令固定图像与编辑器，把 text-to-image 自纠正的失败拆成「VLM 评论者诊断错误」与「编辑器无法执行」两类，并用 oracle 标签监督评论者的结构化诊断。

**相关性简评：** 其把诊断与执行解耦、以 oracle 标签监督 VLM 评论者的思路，可能为 LVR 中推理状态与答案生成的贡献分配、视觉证据筛选质量的评估提供可核查线索，但研究对象是图像编辑流程而非 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LEDGE: Separating Critic and Editor Failures in Text-to-Image Self-Correction

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-image (T2I) self-correction combines a vision-language model (VLM) critic that diagnoses errors and proposes instructions with an image editor that executes them. End-to-end evaluation obscures whether failures arise from incorrect diagnoses or an editor unable to execute valid instructions. We introduce LEDGE (Learning Error Diagnosis in Generation and Editing), a framework that separates these bottlenecks. LEDGE compiles oracle edit instructions from GenEval while holding the generated images and the editor fixed, isolating the editor's correction capability from the critic's diagnostic accuracy. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, oracle instructions raise GenEval from 72.0% to 81.2%, versus 74.1% for the baseline VLM critic. Yet 435 of 644 failed images remain unrepaired, exposing a substantial editor gap. We also use oracle labels from disjoint training prompts to supervise the critic. Oracle supervision raises exact diagnosis from 33.3% (the same VLM with our structured output, untrained) to 70.8%. With the same editor, the resulting critic improves GenEval from 42.2% (uncorrected) to 59.4% on Stable Diffusion 1.5, against 50.9% for the baseline critic, and from 72.0% to 76.0% on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, despite training only on Stable Diffusion 1.5. Improvements transfer to unseen object classes, a second editor, and independent T2I-CompBench judges and prompts. A small human evaluation confirms the ranking in estimated net corrections but suggests a smaller gain than detector-based evaluation. LEDGE thus distinguishes two limits of self-correction: knowing what to fix and being able to fix it.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建受控变量基准，以不同长度的演绎链、干扰项和矛盾前提检测，评测十六个开源模型的推理退化，并采用基于弃答的评分规则。

**相关性简评：** 其链长缩放、冲突前提检测与弃答评分可供核查 LVR 中证据矛盾识别及 STOP/停止决策的评价设计，但该工作为纯文本基准，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Logic Chain Breaking Point: A Controlled-Variable Benchmark for Reasoning Degradation in Open-Weight Language Models

**abstract/A1：** We introduce The Logic Chain Breaking Point, a controlled-variable benchmark for deductive reasoning in open-weight language models. It spans three phases: (i) pure modus-ponens chain scaling, (ii) distractor resilience with a fixed core chain, and (iii) contradiction detection under primacy versus recency placement. Independent variables follow a powers-of-two sequence $v \\in \\{1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128\\}$, with ground truth known by construction. We evaluate sixteen open-weight models across instruction-tuned and reasoning-tuned panels, including a small-model suite and a larger local-model extension. All models are evaluated with greedy decoding under model-appropriate context and output budgets, while context- and length-limited trials are quarantined from the valid accuracy denominator. Our results reveal a sharply non-monotonic difficulty surface: pure deductive chains up to $L=128$ remain near saturation for most models, and distractor noise causes only model-specific degradation at high $D$, while the inconsistent premise condition has the lowest accuracy. Instruction-tuned models, including larger 24B--27B baselines, score essentially zero on inconsistent premise sets, while reasoning-tuned models recover only partially and remain below reliable accuracy. Within this benchmark, inconsistent premise sets are associated with the strongest degradation under the benchmark's abstention-based scoring rule.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VISTA: A Framework for Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness

**abstract/A1：** The Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming intelligent transportation systems by connecting roadside cameras, edge computing units, vehicles, and traffic infrastructure into a shared sensing and decision-making ecosystem. However, transmitting raw traffic video over vehicle-to-everything (V2X) links is bandwidth-intensive, while deploying large multimodal models directly on resource-constrained vehicles is often impractical. To address these limitations, this article proposes VISTA (Vision-Informed Semantic Traffic Awareness), a multimodal vision-language edge-intelligence framework that combines predictive video representation learning with lightweight language-based reasoning to provide communication-efficient traffic situational awareness. In the proposed architecture, roadside surveillance units employ the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) and an attentive-pooler module to convert traffic video clips into compact future-scene embeddings. These embeddings are transmitted through V2X links to vehicle-mounted systems, where a TinyLlama small language model, enhanced with a custom visual adapter, interprets the embeddings alongside natural-language (NL) traffic queries. VISTA enables vehicles to obtain interpretable traffic information, reason about upcoming scene dynamics, and identify potential collision risks without receiving raw video streams. Experimental results in a digital-twin urban traffic environment show that VISTA achieves 97.77% accuracy and an 89% F1 score for future collision prediction while reducing the communication payload by several orders of magnitude compared with raw RGB video transmission. These results demonstrate the feasibility of embedding-based multimodal intelligence for low-latency, communication-efficient, and safety-oriented IoT-enabled transportation systems.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 4 figures, Accepted for publication in IEEE Internet of Things Magazine, 2026

</details>

### 205. [LiveView: Real-Time Camera-Controlled Re-filming of Streaming Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20461v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20461

**作者：** Youcan Xu、Xinjie Huang、Jiaxin Shi、Hengye Lyu、Zhen Wang、Jun Xiao、Long Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20461v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20461v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究流式视频的实时相机可控重拍摄，提出 teacher-to-student 框架，将高保真双向教师的生成能力蒸馏为少步因果自回归学生，并用跨帧注入、Shared Relative RoPE 与循环流式微调维持长时序的时空一致性。

**相关性简评：** 其「将同步目标 latent 与源帧交错注入以建立跨视图对应」和「约束时间索引在预训练范围并做循环轨迹训练以抑制长程漂移」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与视觉证据的对齐、长序列长度泛化提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LiveView: Real-Time Camera-Controlled Re-filming of Streaming Videos

**abstract/A1：** Real-time camera-controlled video re-filming aims to synthesize target views from a streaming source video under online user-specified camera trajectories. This task poses two key challenges: maintaining synchronization and content consistency across views, and achieving low-latency rendering with long-horizon stability. Existing approaches are predominantly designed for offline full-sequence processing and rely on bidirectional attention or costly depth-based geometric preprocessing, making them unsuitable for low-latency streaming scenarios. To address these limitations, we develop a teacher-to-student framework that distills a high-fidelity bidirectional re-filming teacher into a few-step causal autoregressive student. We introduce Cross-Frame Injection to interleave each incoming source frame with its synchronized target latent, thereby establishing direct cross-view correspondence and improving content consistency. To ensure stable long-horizon generation, we further propose Shared Relative RoPE, which bounds temporal indices within the pretrained range, and Cycle Streaming Tuning, which exposes the student to extended cyclic trajectories during streaming training. These designs enable low-latency online video re-filming with precise camera control and sustained spatiotemporal consistency over long streaming rollouts.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20476

**作者：** Abdulaziz Alqahtani、Qasim Umer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**内容简述：** 该研究在 Cascade Mask R-CNN 框架中引入共享的 point-based mask refinement 模块，跨级联阶段与细化层级复用，逐步更新不确定的掩码位置并将掩码分辨率从 28×28 提升到 112×112，在 PIXray 上以三个随机种子比较 transformer 与 MLP 变体的分割收益。

**相关性简评：** 其按不确定性挑选局部点并反复细化、共享细化模块的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、细节保真与迭代状态更新的设计可供核查，但属 X 射线分割任务，与推理期 latent 机制联系间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving X-Ray Baggage Instance Segmentation with Shared Point-Based Mask Refinement

**abstract/A1：** Overlapping projections and complex object contours make prohibited items difficult to delineate in X-ray baggage images. This study investigates shared point-based mask refinement to improve instance segmentation within Cascade Mask R-CNN. The framework combines a ResNet-101 backbone with an attention-based feature pyramid and progressively updates uncertain mask locations, increasing mask resolution from $28 \\times 28$ to $112 \\times 112$. A single refinement module is shared across cascade stages and refinement levels, with transformer and multilayer perceptron (MLP) variants used to examine the role of interactions among selected points. Ten configurations were evaluated on the official PIXray split across three training seeds using the original target-instance annotations for evaluation. The transformer and MLP refiners achieved mean mask average precision (AP) of 71.79 and 72.47, respectively, compared with 70.50 for the unrefined detector, yielding gains of 1.29 and 1.97 AP points. The MLP achieved the highest mean mask AP among the evaluated configurations. Both variants also improved boundary agreement on commonly detected objects, supporting improved mask delineation, while detection diagnostics did not establish a corresponding positive gain. These findings demonstrate that shared point-based refinement can improve segmentation quality in the tested cascade architecture using existing target-mask annotations, without additional occluder supervision. Evaluation on independent X-ray datasets is needed to determine how well these improvements generalize.

**相关性简评：** 其细粒度偏好对与严重度加权监督可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据贡献的标注与训练线索；作者报告的去幻觉伴随视觉覆盖下降，可能涉及「保留视觉细节」与「抑制幻觉」的权衡，是否等同于信息坍缩有待核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Seeing: Fine-Grained Preference Validation and Severity-Aware Alignment for Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Large vision-language models can produce fluent responses containing objects, attributes, or relations unsupported by the image. We study an implemented alignment pipeline that normalizes released fine-grained hallucination supervision, validates chosen-rejected preference pairs with vision-language judges, repairs rejected chosen responses, and trains LLaVA adapters with standard or severity-aware direct preference optimization. The study uses 16,143 normalized feedback records and 8,386 released preference pairs, comparing direct training with zero-shot and two-shot judged severity-margin variants. The zero-shot variant reduces Object HalBench CHAIRs from 53.00 to 36.00 and CHAIRi from 15.72 to 10.41. Across aligned models, AMBER-Hal decreases from 35.90 to 25.10-26.90, accompanied by reduced visual coverage. In contrast, the base model retains the highest valid POPE adversarial F1, 84.18 versus 83.87-83.91 after alignment. These results support benchmark-dependent reductions in generative hallucination rather than uniform superiority of severity-aware alignment. We distinguish implemented pipeline components from the preference paths used in the reported experiments and discuss the limits of attributing gains to judging, repair, or the training objective individually.

### 208. [VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20507v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20507

**作者：** Mengfei Duan、Yuheng Zhang、Guoqiang Zhao、Yuanfan Zheng、Kailun Yang、Zhiyong Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20507v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20507v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VoxSAOR 框架，用特征空间代理建模 aleatoric uncertainty：先量化局部语义一致性得到体素级结构稳定性先验，并用跨视图语义共识过滤不可靠对应，再以类条件对角高斯刻画由稳定到模糊体素的特征位移与离散度，据此用递增尺度的特征扰动训练多个预测头，推理时关闭采样并平均各头概率。

**相关性简评：** 该文面向纯 3D occupancy 预测、无推理期 latent 状态生成，主线联系间接；其跨视图共识过滤与不确定性代理分布可供核查是否能作为视觉证据筛选与可靠 latent 表示加权的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR.

**comment/C1：** The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR

</details>

### 209. [GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20524v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20524

**作者：** Yuanhang Gao、Xiangrui Yang、Lingyuan Meng、Yuanfeng Chen、Dongsheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20524v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20524v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画 latent KV 表示何时可直接充当预训练 RoPE 的执行状态（要求潜到原生映射以交错关系保持旋转作用），并据此提出免训练的 GaugeRoPE：用 RoPE 兼容载体加近似位置无关的 RKV 修正，在无需逐 token 重建历史 K/V 的情况下执行，Mistral-7B 上达 5.85× 压缩并提升解码吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 其对压缩 latent 状态能否保留位置结构、并在不重建的情况下直接执行的刻画，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的缓存与位置信息保持及效率成本分析；但该工作面向 KV 缓存效率，不研究视觉推理本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GaugeRoPE: RoPE-Compatible Executable Latent Attention

**abstract/A1：** Latent KV cache compression reduces memory footprint by mapping historical keys and values into compact representations. However, generic compressed key states require reconstruction to native dimension before applying RoPE and computing attention scores, adding sequence-scaling overhead to the decode path. We characterize when a latent KV representation can serve directly as the execution state of pretrained RoPE. For RoPE-based transformers, exact static linear execution of the rotary key path requires the latent-to-native map to preserve the pretrained RoPE action through an intertwining relation, restricting exact mixing to coordinates that share the same RoPE frequency. Guided by this characterization, we build GaugeRoPE, a training-free executable latent KV representation. It combines a RoPE-compatible carrier that preserves the rotary action with an approximate position-independent residual key--value (RKV) correction for complementary key and value information, both evaluated without per-token dense historical K/V reconstruction. On Mistral-7B, GaugeRoPE achieves $5.85\\times$ KV compression while maintaining quality close to the full-cache baseline. Additional MHA results validate the construction beyond GQA. GaugeRoPE achieves up to $2.48\\times$ the decode throughput of the vanilla uncompressed baseline through direct latent execution.

</details>

### 210. [Learning a Task-Adaptive Low-Dimensional Semantic Space for Improved Visual Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20553v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20553

**作者：** Nikalal Kaldera、Wanqing Li、Chris Bunn、Philip O. Ogunbona

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20553v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20553v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TaSS，通过对预训练文本嵌入做参数化几何变换，学习任务自适应的低维语义空间，并用距离重塑与原型约束增强类间可分性，再以轻量 MLP 将冻结视觉特征对齐到该空间，用于多类视觉分类。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及 latent 推理状态或证据使用，但其用低维可分几何重塑语义空间、并以原型约束控制类内方差的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的表示几何与紧凑性约束提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning a Task-Adaptive Low-Dimensional Semantic Space for Improved Visual Classification

**abstract/A1：** Semantic visual classification commonly aligns visual embeddings with semantic spaces induced by pretrained text encoders. However, such spaces are typically high-dimensional, weakly aligned with visual feature geometry, and insufficiently discriminative for downstream classification tasks. We propose TaSS, a framework for learning a task-adaptive low-dimensional semantic space that preserves semantic structure while explicitly optimizing class separability. TaSS is constructed through a parameterized geometry transformation of pretrained text embeddings that enlarges inter-class margins via distance reshaping and improves intra-class compactness through prototype-preserving semantic constraints. The resulting semantic space maintains meaningful semantic relationships while producing a discriminative geometry tailored for classification. Frozen visual encoder features are subsequently aligned to TaSS using a lightweight MLP, enabling improved discriminative learning without fine-tuning pretrained backbones. We further provide theoretical analysis showing that TaSS preserves semantic consistency while enforcing enhanced inter-class separation and controlled intra-class variance. Extensive experiments on skeleton-based human action recognition, video classification, and image classification benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing semantic alignment approaches, with gains exceeding 3 percentage points on average and up to 8.5 points on challenging datasets.

### 211. [One-Shot Calibration via Model Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20562v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20562

**作者：** Jiaxing Qiu、Luke Hakso、Roxana Daneshjou、Ahmed Alaa、Thomas Hartvigsen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20562v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20562v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SoftEdit，一种模型编辑器：把用户反馈中的多个合理答案视为目标分布，通过答案间的共合理性关系，在一次性编辑中同时纠错与校准，并在通用性与局部性之间取舍；在三个语言模型和三个视觉语言模型上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其用分布型目标替代单一答案的监督思路，可能为 LVR 中答案分布监督、贡献分配与校准评价提供可供核查的线索，但不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One-Shot Calibration via Model Editing

**abstract/A1：** Model editing aims to correct errors in large, pretrained models by replacing model generations with user-provided responses. Existing editors assume a single target answer for each edit. However, many real tasks inherently entail uncertainty, resulting in multiple plausible answers with varying likelihoods in user feedback. Such feedback forms a target distribution to not only correct but also calibrate model generations. We therefore propose SoftEdit, the first model editor to leverage uncertainty in user responses and perform one-shot calibration during editing. To generalize calibration to unseen samples, SoftEdit uses co-plausibility relationships between answers while preserving real distributional shifts, balancing the new distributional generality-locality tradeoff. Across three language models, three vision-language models, and two large datasets, SoftEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance, ultimately showing that uncertainty in user responses enables generalizable calibration of pretrained models beyond single-answer corrections.

</details>

### 212. [Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20565v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20565

**作者：** Saksham Gupta、Michael Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20565v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20565v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究推测解码中草稿模型 KV cache 的量化：先在 12-bit 预算下比较 K/V 精度分配，发现分组 per-channel key 量化会改变甚至反转 K8V4 与 K4V8 的偏好，最终采用 K4V4（per-channel keys、per-token values），使草稿缓存内存降 66.20%，平均接受率从 57.93% 降到 57.14%。

**相关性简评：** 草稿-验证式解码加接受率诊断，可能可供核查压缩后状态保真度如何影响验证与纠正环节，以及量化布局与精度预算的耦合是否有类比的 latent 表示设计线索；但原文面向文本生成的内存效率，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Memory-Efficient Speculative Decoding with Quantized Draft KV Cache

**abstract/A1：** Speculative decoding reduces generation cost, but it stores two KV caches: one for the target model and one for the draft model. We reduce this extra memory by quantizing the draft cache. The target cache and verifier remain in BF16, so that compression cannot change the target model's final correction rule. We first study how to divide precision between keys and values. A naive per-token quantizer makes keys appear much more sensitive: splitting a 12-bit budget, K8V4 beats K4V8 in acceptance by 10.87pp. However, with grouped per-channel keys, the gap becomes -0.25pp. A controlled Qwen test confirms that changing only the key quantizer can erase or reverse the preferred bit split. Hence, following KIVI, we propose K4V4 quantization with per-channel keys and per-token values. Across six model pairs, our method reduces draft cache memory by 66.20%, and combined memory across both caches by 23.95%. Mean acceptance drops from 57.93% to 57.14%, only 1.36% relative. Overall, quantized draft caches can make speculative decoding more memory efficient; as a predictive principle for efficient AI design, key and value precision must be co-designed with the quantizer layout.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the AXIOM Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning Workshop at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把工具目录一次性编译成带权依赖图 ToolGraph，并将图中路径组合成目标条件下的多步动作价值 Q(s,a,g)，比较动态规划、GraphSAGE 蒸馏和读取图证据的 LLM 打分器三种估计器，并在两个工具使用基准和三个骨干模型上与 PageRank 检索及直接、反思式 agent 对照。
