<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ToolGraph as a Q-Function for Test-Time Scaling of Tool-Use Agents

**abstract/A1：** Tool-use agents must chain interdependent calls, yet which outputs satisfy which later inputs in a deployed catalog is not something a general-purpose language model reliably infers from tool descriptions alone. We compile that structure once into a reusable external representation. ToolGraph is a directed, weighted dependency graph over a tool catalog: parameter matching and interventional probes, which execute a candidate chain with and without its proposed predecessor, propose edges whose evidence is combined into an edge confidence. Prior work uses such graphs to retrieve tools, search for tool paths, or score the next call. We ask instead whether the same structure can supply a \\emph{multi-step} value by composing graph paths into a goal-conditioned action value \\(Q(s,a,g)\\). We study three estimators (dynamic programming over entity sets, a GraphSAGE estimator distilled from it, and an LLM scorer conditioned on graph evidence) plus a verbalizer that returns action--goal feedback to the agent, which keeps final action selection. Across two tool-use benchmarks and three backbones, we compare value ranking against personalized-PageRank retrieval over the identical graph, and against direct and reflective agents. Composition pays off only when the estimator also reads the concrete state: the LLM estimator improves on PageRank in every benchmark--backbone setting, by \\(8.3\\) points on average, while the two purely structural estimators fall below it, because a value defined over tool types cannot separate a correct tool called with a wrong argument. Graph construction is a one-time cost; we report it separately rather than assume it amortized away (at our scale it is comparable to request-time cost) and sweep four knobs controlling how much graph evidence to expose against success and tokens.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents (PTA)

</details>

### 214. [AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20605v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20605

**作者：** Runzhe Wang、Huilin Lu、Shengjie Liu、Li Dong、Zhihuai Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20605v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20605v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对跨任务记忆反而使智能体变差的现象，提出 AdMem：动作前承诺预期结果，由并发 critic 比对实际结果，将二值奖励与反思写入过程性记忆条目，并用在线更新的效用值联合相似度做检索、淘汰与合并，在 AgentBoard 八领域验证。

**相关性简评：** 逐动作信用分配与记忆条目生命周期可为 latent 推理步骤的贡献分配、状态保留与合并提供可核查线索，但其面向纯文本任务记忆，与视觉证据筛选和 latent 状态生成无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AdMem: Expectation-Grounded Procedural Memory for Long-Horizon Task-Solving Agents

**abstract/A1：** An agent that carries memory across tasks is only as good as the entries it keeps. We begin from an observation that is easy to reproduce and uncomfortable for the field: naively accumulating cross-task experience can make an agent \\emph{worse} than one with no memory at all. On AgentBoard, a workflow-induction memory solves fewer tasks than a memoryless ReAct agent in seven of eight domains, and a per-step procedural store with no surrounding structure loses half of ReAct's completions on Jericho. We argue that the missing ingredients are per-action credit assignment and an explicit life cycle for stored entries, and present AdMem, which supplies both. Before each action the actor commits to an expected outcome; a concurrently running critic scores the realized outcome against that expectation and writes a procedural entry carrying a binary reward and a reflection, so credit lands on the action that earned it and no environment reward is required. Each entry then carries a scalar utility, updated online under a noisy-OR reward model, that ranks retrieval jointly with context similarity and drives eviction and merging, giving the store a forgetting and consolidation policy instead of unbounded growth. Across 707 tasks in eight AgentBoard domains AdMem solves 441 against 388 for ReAct and 312 for the workflow-induction baseline --- a pooled gain significant under a two-sided Fisher exact test, concentrated in the domains that supply transferable cross-task structure. All memory stays human-readable text, which is what makes the failures above diagnosable --- and, as we discuss, also makes the store an auditable but attackable surface.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20616

**作者：** Linliang Chen、Yan Zhong、Wang Kang、Sai Li、Ji Wu、Ji Liu

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 MoE LLM 专家剪枝后被剪专家的贡献被直接丢弃的问题，提出无需训练或额外专家计算的 GEAR，用被激活专家的缩放输出重建其功能，并以超轻量残差 GEAR$^2$ 补足复用表达不了的部分，在 16B–106B 的五个 MoE 模型与九个零样本基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「门控复用可靠激活专家的输出＋轻量残差补偿缺失贡献」的做法，或可为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的门控聚合、以及潜空间表示信息坍缩后的残差补偿提供可核查线索，但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移需自行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GEAR$^2$: Pruned Experts Live On through Gated Reuse of Activated Experts and a Missing-Mass Residual

**abstract/A1：** Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) activate only a few experts per token while generally keeping all the experts in GPU memory for high efficiency. Expert pruning reduces this GPU memory footprint cost, yet discards the contribution of pruned experts. Existing remedies either rely on static substitutes, merge experts at the cost of altering their functions, or require costly recovery training. In this paper, we find that the functionalities of pruned experts can be efficiently reconstructed from the activated remaining experts. We propose GEAR (Gated Expert Activation Reuse), which reuses the scaled outputs of reliable activated experts without any training or additional expert computation. In addition, we propose GEAR$^2$ to further recover what reuse cannot express with an ultra-lightweight residual. On five MoE LLMs from 16B to 106B parameters with 25% and 50% of experts pruned, GEAR improves over its training-free counterparts in nearly every setting (up to 4 pp.) in terms of accuracy, and GEAR$^2$ outperforms baseline approaches (up to 2.75 pp.) in every setting on nine zero-shot benchmarks, with larger advantages (up to 2.72 pp. higher) under more aggressive pruning (up to 50%).

</details>

### 216. [From Joint Risk to Decision Invariance: Decision-Preserving Regularization for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20619v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20619

**作者：** Qi Zhu、Ziang Gan、Wanting Zhang、Libao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20619v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20619v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对无样本类增量学习，提出决策保持正则（惩罚旧类成对 logit margin 变化，等价于中心化相对 logit 惩罚），并用闭式仿射映射把旧类高斯均值与协方差搬运到更新后的特征空间以校准全局分类器。

**相关性简评：** 其分布搬运与谱白化去尺度偏置的做法，可能为表征更新后 latent 状态的一致性维持与相似度度量中的尺度、漂移影响提供可供核查的线索，但并非直接研究 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Joint Risk to Decision Invariance: Decision-Preserving Regularization for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning

**abstract/A1：** Exemplar-free continual learning seeks to minimize joint risk over all seen tasks, yet historical data are unavailable for direct optimization. We observe that, for classification, preserving the model's decisions on previously learned classes helps retain old knowledge. This motivates Decision-Preserving Regularization (DPR). Penalizing changes in all pairwise old-class logit margins reduces algebraically to a centered relative-logit penalty. We further apply spectral whitening to remove the classifier's spectral scale bias. Because the global classifier supplies the decision constraints for the next stage, it must remain calibrated across all seen classes despite the drift of stored old-class statistics during representation updates. We therefore fit a closed-form affine map from paired current-task features to transport old-class Gaussian means and covariances into the updated feature space, then calibrate the global classifier using these distributions and current-task features. Across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-1K under cold-start protocols, comparisons with state-of-the-art methods show that DPR achieves higher accuracy in most settings while remaining highly efficient. Code is available at https://github.com/bnufw/dpr.

</details>

### 217. [Counterfactual Feature Steering for Adjacency-Preserving Identity Unlearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20637v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20637

**作者：** FNU Shivam、Layth Sliman、Ramana Reddy、Donald Adjeroh、Binod Bhattarai、Prashnna Gyawali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20637v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20637v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究文生图扩散模型的身份遗忘：在文本编码器所挂 SAE 的潜空间中，由 forget/retain 分布对比导出目标方向并做有界的推理期编辑，同时提出 AWUS 指标衡量目标擦除与相邻身份保留的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「对比分布导出方向 + 有界潜空间编辑」可能可供核查用于抑制 latent 中的干扰内容或调制推理状态，但任务本身是图像生成遗忘，与 VLM 推理期状态生成与证据使用相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Counterfactual Feature Steering for Adjacency-Preserving Identity Unlearning

**abstract/A1：** Identity unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models is increasingly important for privacy, safety, and ethical deployment, as it aims to remove the model's ability to generate specific individuals. In this work, we study identity unlearning with \\emph{adjacency preservation}, where the goal is to remove a target individual's identity while preserving related non-target identities. We propose Counterfactual Feature Steering (CFS), a method requiring one-time SAE training that performs bounded inference-time concept editing in the latent space of a sparse autoencoder attached to the text encoder. CFS derives a target direction by contrasting forget and retain distributions, then applies a per-token projection proportional to each token's current alignment with this direction, yielding counterfactual representations that suppress the target while limiting collateral damage. To evaluate adjacency preservation, we introduce the Adjacency-Weighted Unlearning Score (AWUS), which measures the tradeoff between target erasure and collateral damage, and extend it to face-specific identity similarity using ArcFace. Across 4,000 prompts derived from Celeb-100, spanning 100 celebrity identities, CFS achieves the strongest evaluated tradeoff between identity erasure of target identities and preservation of adjacent and generic concepts, while remaining stable across intervention strengths where other steering-based methods degrade. Independent ArcFace evaluation and a 10,000-caption COCO study further examine identity and general preservation. Quantitative nudity-suppression benchmarks and qualitative artistic-style examples provide evidence of transfer beyond identities on SD~1.4.

</details>

### 218. [Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20648v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20648

**作者：** Barkin Dagda、Vinal Asodia、Iman Sharifi、Peng Wei、Saber Fallah

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20648v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20648v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出规则引导的 VLA 框架，用 PyReason 将英国 Highway Code 部分条款形式化为一阶逻辑规则，并由冻结的 VLM 抽取场景谓词、预测候选控制动作的后果以计算合规奖励；在专家示范监督微调基础上用三种 group-based RL 方法进行离线精调，在 CARLA 留出数据上报告动作精度与规则通过率的提升。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「用可执行符号规则检验候选动作的预测后果并转为奖励」可供核查作为 latent 推理轨迹的验证式监督与贡献分配线索；其冻结 VLM 输出场景谓词的做法也可能为视觉证据筛选提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.

</details>

### 219. [Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20666v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20666

**作者：** Mike Hänseroth、Niklas Wahlström、Thomas B. Schön、Thomas Seel、Jan-Hendrik Ewering

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20666v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20666v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把 HMM 中的贝叶斯系统辨识当作一般贝叶斯逆问题，在短模拟轨迹段上一次性训练 transformer 扩散模型来近似隐状态与参数的联合后验，并借助 Markov 性质诱导的注意力掩码与相对时间编码，在任意长度的新观测上完成联合推断、状态平滑、参数推断和缺失测量重建。

**相关性简评：** 其「短段训练、长记录部署」的摊销后验采样与相对时间编码可为 LVR 中 latent 状态采样、长度泛化与推理期证据使用提供可核查的方法线索，但不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conditional Diffusion Models for Amortized Bayesian System Identification

**abstract/A1：** Generative diffusion models rapidly solve Bayesian inverse problems, such as image restoration and inpainting, with a single trained model and without retraining for each new observation or task. Bayesian system identification, which typically involves inferring the hidden states and parameters of a dynamical system from measurements, poses a closely related inverse problem. Yet it is often addressed with computationally heavy Monte Carlo methods that must be rerun for every new measurement record. Moreover, these methods are restricted to a single inference task, and their cost grows with the state dimension and the record length. To alleviate these restrictions, we interpret Bayesian system identification in hiddem Markov models (HMMs) as a general Bayesian inverse problem, taking advantage of conditional diffusion models. Specifically, a transformer-based diffusion model is trained once on short segments of simulated trajectories to approximate the joint posterior of states and parameters. Through an attention mask induced by the Markov property and a relative time encoding, it can then be deployed on any new measurement record of custom length. At inference time, the same model can flexibly and rapidly be conditioned for joint state and parameter inference, state smoothing, parameter inference, or reconstructing missing measurements, without retraining. We demonstrate these capabilities on four benchmark systems and examine how the length of the training segments affects state and parameter inference. On records five times longer than the training segments, the model maintains its state accuracy, whereas comparison methods either show a more than tenfold error increase or require ten times as much sampling time.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 220. [Room for Supervision: Training-Free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20680v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20680

**作者：** Ziang Gan、Qi Zhu、Libao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20680v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20680v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GRASP，一种无需训练与模型推理的目标检测数据集蒸馏方法：通过凸优化分配子问题联合搜索图像选择与空间布局，将围绕标注对象裁剪的区域按原比例拼入少量蒸馏图像，保留框与类别标注，在 COCO、VOC 上取得 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 其“按对象裁剪扩上下文、惩罚对象分辨率不足”的像素/分辨率分配搜索，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与有限视觉预算下如何保留任务必要细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Room for Supervision: Training-Free Dataset Distillation for Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Dataset distillation (DD) reduces storage and training costs by compressing large datasets into small collections. Most existing methods focus on image classification, where each image typically has a single category label. In contrast, object detection requires accurate category and bounding box annotations for multiple objects, together with visual content consistent with those annotations. Existing detection distillation pipelines rely on learned models and can alter the spatial relationships between objects and their backgrounds. We introduce GRASP, which packs dense native supervision into limited pixels without network training or inference. GRASP jointly searches over image selections and spatial layouts using convex allocation subproblems that penalize insufficient object resolution, excessive image compression, and padding that source context cannot fill. During composition, each selected image is cropped around all annotated objects and expanded into surrounding context without reducing object scale. The resized regions are then combined into distilled images, preserving the spatial layout within each region and retaining all original class labels and bounding box annotations. We evaluate GRASP on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC with compression ratios ranging from 0.25\\% to 2\\%. GRASP constructs the 1\\% MS COCO dataset in under two minutes. Under a common training protocol using hard labels, GRASP achieves the state of the art with both CNN and ViT backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/tade1s/GRASP

</details>

### 221. [Rethinking Supervision Scaling in On-Policy Distillation: From Dense Supervision to Stochastic Horizons](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20687v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20687

**作者：** Xinhao Yao、Zhenxing Dou、Yong Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20687v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20687v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究 on-policy distillation 中监督效用随轨迹长度的变化，通过受控实验发现增加被打监督 token 的收益递减、深层位置仍可学习且存在跨位置监督迁移，并提出 SH-OPD：按 batch 随机采样共享的 rollout horizon，以减少冗余监督并换取约 45%–60% 的单次更新成本。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本蒸馏工作，但其关于监督深度收益递减、跨位置更新的共享与位置特异成分，以及计算—监督配比的权衡，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的监督分配、深度相关贡献归因与计算预算取舍提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Supervision Scaling in On-Policy Distillation: From Dense Supervision to Stochastic Horizons

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, yet the learning benefits of longer trajectories may not scale proportionally with their computational cost. We investigate how supervision utility evolves with trajectory length. Controlled experiments reveal diminishing returns from additional supervised tokens, while showing that later positions remain learnable and exhibit substantial cross-position supervision transfer. Gradient analysis further identifies shared update components across response positions and diverse position-specific residuals whose cross-rollout consistency decreases at greater depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Stochastic Horizons On-Policy Distillation (SH-OPD), which reduces redundant supervision by randomly varying rollout horizons while preserving access to deeper response states. SH-OPD samples a shared horizon for each training batch, enabling efficient parallel generation without per-sequence horizon scheduling overhead. We characterize the resulting reweighting bias and derive a compute-reweighting trade-off under standard optimization assumptions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation demonstrate that SH-OPD achieves slightly higher mathematical reasoning accuracy at approximately 45% of the per-update cost of standard OPD, while maintaining competitive code generation performance at around 60% of the baseline cost. These results highlight the benefits of efficient supervision allocation across response depths.

**comment/C1：** Work in progress

</details>

### 222. [Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20703v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20703

**作者：** Wei Tan、Kunming Luo、Hongyu Yan、Yu Zhang、Zihao Zhang、Xiatian Zhu、Lei Xie

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20703v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20703v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Global-Local Proxy Attention（GLPA）：在每个视角内保留全分辨率注意力，跨视角仅通过紧凑的全局 proxy 交换信息，并在单次去噪步内用更新后的特征重建 proxy、复用同一套注意力参数迭代精化；在 FLUX 与 Stable Diffusion 上取得注意力加速与质量提升。

**相关性简评：** 其“压缩 proxy 承载跨视角信息 + 迭代重建并复用参数”的机制，可能为 LVR 中多视图 latent 状态的紧凑交换与多步状态更新效率提供借鉴线索，但该文属图像生成任务，无推理状态或答案使用分析，需核查 proxy 是否保留任务必要细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention

**abstract/A1：** Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is available as an ancillary file

</details>

### 223. [QASK-Edit: Adaptive Sparse Attention Across Queries and Key Sources for Efficient Video Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20704v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20704

**作者：** Hengrui Liu、Wenbo Xu、Ziqi Sheng、Wei lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20704v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20704v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架 QASK-Edit，针对 DiT 视频编辑，按每个 query 与每种 key source（源视频、参考图、音频、文本、生成帧）分别评估注意力质量与近似风险，在风险预算下选择路由阈值以分配精确或近似计算，从而降低推理延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其「按 query 与证据源分配计算并在风险预算下动态路由」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据源筛选与动态计算预算分配提供注意力结构层面的可核查线索，但属视频生成加速场景，迁移需较多验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QASK-Edit: Adaptive Sparse Attention Across Queries and Key Sources for Efficient Video Editing

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in generation based video editing, but suffer from high inference latency due to the long token sequences formed by conditioning inputs and generated videos. Although training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, existing methods typically apply a fixed retention ratio or a single threshold shared across all tokens. In this work, we view video editing as conditional generation and identify a key insight: attention demand varies significantly both across different key sources (e.g., source videos, reference images, audio, text, and generated videos) and across queries within each source. Motivated by this, we propose QASK-Edit (Query-Adaptive Sparsity over Key Sources for Video Editing), a training-free sparse attention framework that allocates computation independently for each query and key source. Specifically, for each query, QASK-Edit considers both the attention mass and approximation risk of each block. It then evaluates candidate routing thresholds against each key source's risk budget, choosing exact computation or approximations to dynamically adjust sparsity for each query. Extensive experiments on three video editing models demonstrate that QASK-Edit achieves up to $1.46\\times$ end-to-end speedup over dense attention pipeline while preserving both editing quality and unedited region fidelity. Furthermore, QASK-Edit generalizes directly to Reference-to-Video generation, delivering up to $1.36\\times$ speedup while maintaining generation quality.

</details>

### 224. [MSAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Forecasting for Time Series via Modular Multi-Scale Decoupling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20714v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20714

**作者：** Fanda Fan、Kuiye Ding、Liming Mao、Bingsong Wang、Yao Wang、Xiaorui Wang、Ruijie Jian、Zhipeng Liu、Luqi Gong、Zhenghua Lu、Chunjie Luo、Jianfeng Zhan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20714v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20714v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MSAR，一个模型无关的模块化框架：在多个时间分辨率上由粗到细逐级自回归预测，使各尺度的输入与输出对齐，并可接入 CNN、MLP、Transformer 等骨干。

**相关性简评：** 其「尺度自回归 + 模块化解耦」的由粗到细信息流，可能为 LVR 中多粒度 latent 推理状态的逐级生成与更新提供结构线索，但尺度层级与推理抽象层级是否同构、能否迁移到视觉证据筛选仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MSAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Forecasting for Time Series via Modular Multi-Scale Decoupling

**abstract/A1：** Time series forecasting underpins critical applications in finance, energy, healthcare, and transportation. Although deep models have achieved strong results, most adopt single-scale modeling or restrict multiscale processing to the input side, causing a misalignment between multiscale inputs and single-scale outputs and limiting predictive power. We introduce the Modular Scale-wise Autoregressive Framework (MSAR), a model-agnostic design that forecasts progressively across multiple temporal resolutions. MSAR offers three advantages: (1) scale-wise aligned modeling, which disentangles heterogeneous temporal patterns by aligning inputs and outputs at each scale; (2) scale-wise autoregression, where coarse-scale predictions guide finer-scale forecasting through hierarchical information flow; and (3) a modular architecture, enabling seamless integration with diverse backbones such as CNNs, MLPs, and Transformers. Extensive experiments across a broad set of datasets and forecasting models demonstrate that MSAR achieves consistent improvements in both accuracy and inference efficiency, validating the effectiveness of scale-aligned autoregression for multiscale time series forecasting. The code is available at: https://github.com/Oryxo/MSAR.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 main track. 26 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Oryxo/MSAR

</details>

### 225. [Calibrate Once, Grow the Vocabulary: Candidate-Independent Scores for Conformal Risk Control in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20715v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20715

**作者：** Md Tanveer Hossain Munim、Bijoy Ahmed Saiem、Muhammad Abdullah Adnan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20715v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20715v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出开放词表分割中，共形风险控制的保证在标定后扩充类别名时会失效，原因是剪枝、跨标签注意力和词表归一化使每个标签得分依赖其余候选；作者不改训练，改为对固定参考名称库打分，使单标签得分与词表无关，从而一次标定即可跨词表规模保持风险上界。

**相关性简评：** 「候选无关打分 + 分布无关风险控制」这一线索可供核查：能否让 LVR 中对候选答案或证据的评分不随候选集合变化，从而为 STOP 决策与答案集给出可迁移的校准保证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Calibrate Once, Grow the Vocabulary: Candidate-Independent Scores for Conformal Risk Control in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary segmenters accept class names at inference. Conformal risk control can bound how often their prediction sets miss the true label, but we show that this bound breaks when names are added after calibration. On ADE20K, a threshold calibrated for 10% risk at 150 names reaches up to 15.4% risk at 845 names in released CAT-Seg models. The risk exceeds the target on every calibration split, yet the prediction sets grow far less than the target requires. In SED they instead grow larger than needed. The cause is that pruning, cross-label attention and vocabulary normalisation make each label's score depend on the other requested labels. Scores can move either way, so a threshold recalibrated at a larger vocabulary need not hold at smaller ones. We remove this dependence without training by scoring each label against a fixed reference bank of names. A label's score then stays the same when names are added, so one calibration keeps its guarantee as the vocabulary grows. The guarantee holds whatever names are added, even ones chosen per image after seeing it. On three benchmarks and five segmenters, the converted models meet the target at every vocabulary size we evaluate. For CAT-Seg and SED at alpha=10%, they use at most one more label per pixel than the released models recalibrated at the grown vocabulary. Treating names instead of images as calibration samples also bounds the miss rate of added names. If the annotated names are a random sample of the names in the calibration images, an added name's expected miss rate on those images is at most the target. For harder added names, the excess is at most their gap in mean miss rate. Applied to Grounding DINO, which splits large vocabularies into chunks, the conversion also makes inference about six times faster.

**comment/C1：** 44 pages: 8 pages main text, 4 pages references, 32 pages supplementary material. 8 figures, 52 tables. Code: https://github.com/munim110/open-vocab-crc

</details>

### 226. [UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20767v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20767

**作者：** Tao Tao、Anke Tang、Enneng Yang、Zhi Hou、Xiaogang Wang、Dacheng Tao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20767v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20767v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** UNITE 将四个具身 VLM 专家的 FFN 块保留为可路由专家，用「共享浮点锚点＋专家专属行缩放二值偏差」做单比特分解，免校准数据、闭式交替优化，再冻结主干与专家仅训练轻量 router，把多专家整合为约 20.3 GB 的共享骨干 MoE，并在 22 个基准与导航任务上评估最佳专家能力保留度。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身是权重合并与低比特存储压缩，不是 LVR 推理状态生成；但「互补专家＋token 级路由」可供核查多假设 latent 内容的保留与路由选择，且其 VSI-Bench 上跨帧证据使用退化的现象，可能与视觉证据筛选和信息坍缩诊断相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization

**abstract/A1：** Embodied capabilities such as visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding are often developed in separate vision-language specialists fine-tuned from a common pretrained model.Deploying the specialists separately multiplies storage, whereas merging them into one dense model forces conflicting task updates to share parameters and loses part of each specialist's expertise.We introduce UNITE, a framework that consolidates such specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts. UNITE keeps the feed-forward block of each specialist as a routable expert and represents the expert bank through a shared-anchor one-bit factorization: a shared floating-point anchor plus expert-specific, row-scaled binary deviations.The anchor is optimized jointly with the scales and signs through closed-form alternating updates, using only source weights and no calibration data.Router adaptation then adjusts token-level expert selection with the backbone and experts frozen, updating fewer than $0.6$M parameters ($&lt;0.01\\%$ of the $8.8$B active parameters). Built from four Qwen3-VL-8B specialists, the complete UNITE model occupies $20.3$ GB, $1.16\\times$ the storage of one dense specialist and $59.6\\%$ below the uncompressed MoE. Across $22$ benchmarks and R2R Val-Unseen, UNITE matches six static merging methods in mean retention of best-specialist performance, leads all of them on Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and all four navigation metrics, and surpasses every source specialist on all five 3D scene understanding benchmarks (up to $+19.1$ on Scan2Cap) and on R2R navigation. Relative to the uncompressed MoE, factorization is nearly lossless on $21$ of $22$ benchmarks; the exception is VSI-Bench, where frame-count experiments suggest impaired use of cross-frame evidence.UNITE thus consolidates complementary embodied capabilities near single-model storage.

</details>

### 227. [ThermoSight: From Appearance to Internal Thermofluid Fields via Physics-Guided Neural Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20786v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20786

**作者：** Yuhao Fang、Chenglin Lu、Hefei Ling、Chun Lou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、physics.app-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20786v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20786v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 ThermoSight，一个物理引导的神经重建框架，从有限标定火焰图像中联合重建三维温度场与碳烟体积分数场；核心是用可微分光谱模型将两个场经热辐射、自吸收和相机响应映射到 RGB，并用波长分辨的衰减与色度一致性缓解温度—碳烟歧义。

**相关性简评：** 其「用可微分前向物理模型约束两个纠缠隐场的分离」思路，或可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据如何约束内部状态、以及信息坍缩与贡献分配问题，但任务本身不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ThermoSight: From Appearance to Internal Thermofluid Fields via Physics-Guided Neural Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Most neural reconstruction methods focus on reproducing scene appearance, yet inferring physical states from visual observations is essential for machine understanding of the physical world. Reconstructing the internal temperature and soot fields of radiating thermofluids such as flames is challenging yet essential for improving energy efficiency and assessing heat exposure and fire spread. In flames, temperature and soot concentration jointly govern visible emission, and soot self-absorption alters the light that reaches each camera. With limited views, changes in the two fields can offset one another in the recorded RGB images, making temperature and soot difficult to disentangle. ThermoSight, a physics-guided neural framework for scientific imaging, jointly reconstructs continuous three-dimensional temperature and soot volume fraction fields from limited calibrated flame images without field-level ground truth during optimization. A differentiable spectral model links these fields to measured RGB through thermal emission, self-absorption, and calibrated camera responses. Temperature-dependent emission spectra and wavelength-dependent attenuation constrain shared fields across RGB channels, reducing temperature-soot ambiguity. Chromaticity consistency, observation-derived spatial constraints, and soot regularization complement intensity fitting. In a synthetic ablation, wavelength-resolved attenuation reduces temperature RMSE in the hot, sooty region from 234 to 112 K relative to a three-channel approximation, with nearly identical RGB PSNR (65.23 vs. 65.24 dB). Measured data yield coherent fields and competitive RGB reconstructions. These results demonstrate that physics-guided neural fields recover interpretable internal physical quantities beyond visually consistent appearance.

</details>

### 228. [PhaseCLIP: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Remote-Sensing Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20787v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20787

**作者：** Mehmet Sergen Catal、Abdurrahman Gumus、Mehmet Zübeyir Ünlü

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20787v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20787v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对少样本遥感场景分类，在冻结的 CLIP 视觉编码器中插入相位感知的频域谱模块与特征门控模块，仅训练约 1.3% 参数，并通过相位与幅度共享同一套权重的两阶段方案提升分类精度。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身是面向分类的 CLIP 参数高效适配，不涉及 latent 推理状态；但其中把相位承载的空间结构信息单独成路并加门控注入冻结编码器的做法，可能为 LVR 中「视觉细节是否保留在内部状态」及视觉通路门控提供可核查的机制线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhaseCLIP: Phase-Aware Frequency-Domain Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Few-Shot Remote-Sensing Classification

**abstract/A1：** Remote-sensing (RS) image scene classification aims to assign a semantic category to an overhead image, and in practice must often do so from only a handful of labelled examples, since annotation requires expert interpretation and the resulting labels transfer poorly across sensors and regions. Recent progress has come from adapting vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP, through learned prompts or feature adapters. Although effective, these methods construct their representation entirely in the spatial domain. RS scenes are dominated by periodic texture and regular geometry, which the Fourier spectrum describes compactly through an amplitude component, carrying texture and contrast statistics, and a phase component, carrying spatial structure. Existing frequency-domain adaptation of VLMs either exploits amplitude alone or does not separate amplitude from phase, leaving the structural component unused. In this article, we propose PhaseCLIP, which inserts phase-capable spectral modules and a feature-gating module into a frozen CLIP visual encoder and trains only 1.30% of its parameters. Because the amplitude and phase pathways share an identical parameter layout, a single weight set is learned on phase and transferred exactly to amplitude, giving a two-stage scheme that adds no parameters. Experiments on five public RS datasets, EuroSAT, PatternNet, UC Merced, LSRS and RSSCN7, against eight baselines under a matched protocol, show that PhaseCLIP attains 84.28% mean accuracy and is the best method in 23 of 30 dataset-by-shot cells, with phase contributing 1.93 points overall and 4.36 points on the most difficult dataset. Because the modules act on the spectrum of image patches and transformer tokens and leave the text encoder untouched, the approach can be extended to other RS sensors and tasks, and to other domains in which class evidence lies in spatial structure.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code will be released at https://github.com/miralab-ai/PhaseCLIP upon publication

</details>

**内容简述：** 针对 LLM 编码商品文本的 uplift/CATE 估计中「treatment 泄漏」造成的捷径问题，提出 LULR：冻结 LLM 编码器，对因果头共享的可训练表示施加 CLUB 互信息惩罚，并用代理实验、百万级工业定价 RCT 与一周在线 A/B 评估。

**相关性简评：** 以 CLUB 惩罚抑制共享表示中与干扰变量（treatment）相关的可预测信息，可供核查作为约束 latent 推理状态保留哪些证据、剔除虚假线索的表示正则手段；但论文非多模态、无推理期状态生成，迁移到 LVR 属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Regularizing Treatment Leakage for LLM-based Uplift Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Uplift modeling estimates the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) and supports industrial decisions such as promotional pricing. When large language models (LLMs) encode product text, treatment-revealing content can introduce shortcuts that do not transfer to deployment. We propose \\emph{LLM-based Uplift Leakage Regularization} (\\textsc{LULR}), which uses a CLUB-based penalty on the causal head's trainable shared representation while keeping the LLM encoder frozen. Controlled proxy experiments show a positive ranking-score interaction and higher scores than the tested weight-decay configuration; treatment-dependent evaluation limits their interpretation to exploratory model behavior. Structured-only comparisons provide reference performance, without establishing a general advantage over tree-based estimators. On a million-record industrial pricing RCT, \\textsc{LULR} improves offline $\\text{lift@}0.3$ in $4/5$ seeds, although the difference is not statistically significant and estimated policy values are near-tied. A separate one-week online A/B experiment records $5.45\\%$ higher sales volume and $1.91\\%$ higher GMV than the control arm. These aggregate results provide short-term business evidence for the complete deployed pricing policy; they do not isolate the regularizer's contribution.

</details>

### 230. [Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20797v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20797

**作者：** Subhransu S. Bhattacharjee、Dylan Campbell、Rahul Shome

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、cs.RO、eess.IV、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20797v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20797v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出无需对应的盲 PnP 位姿估计方法 MomentPnP：用十四阶以内的置换不变图像矩在观测 2D 点与投影 3D 点之间匹配以初始化位姿，再用 EM 迭代精化位姿与对应权重。

**相关性简评：** 置换不变矩提供了紧凑的集合级几何表示、EM 的软对应权重可作为视觉证据筛选与对应关系的线索，但该工作为纯几何位姿求解、不涉及 VLM 推理，可供核查的迁移价值有限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correspondence-Free Camera Pose Estimation by Matching Moments

**abstract/A1：** The blind perspective-$n$-point (PnP) problem is to estimate the pose of a calibrated camera from 2D and 3D point sets with unknown correspondences. We show that, for complete, noiseless observations, fourteen permutation-invariant image moments up to order four identify a fixed camera pose for almost every 3D point set containing at least twenty points. Our learning-free method, MomentPnP, matches these moments between the observed 2D points and the projected 3D points to initialize a camera pose without correspondences and refines the pose and correspondence weights using expectation--maximization. Across the test sets of three benchmarks, our method reduces median rotation error by $5$--$170\\times$ relative to the best learned baseline, both with and without outliers. We recover accurate poses even with as many outliers as inliers. On dense ETH3D scans, pose accuracy improves as the point sets grow, even as individual correspondences become harder to resolve.

### 231. [ForeSay: Tell the Future in Words, Branch the Details in Noise for Precipitation Nowcasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20815v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20815

**作者：** Xudong Ling、Wenjie Luo、Chaorong Li、Tianxi Huang、Tao He、Guiduo Duan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20815v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20815v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 ForeSay 降水临近预报框架，用视觉语言模型先预测未来风暴演变的文本情景作为宏观先验去条件化 Rectified Flow，并让集成成员共享早期采样步、仅在后期分支出新噪声，再以支持度投票解码代替像素平均。

**相关性简评：** 其「宏观情景先验 + 局部随机细节」的解耦与共享前缀采样后分支的做法，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要状态与随机细节、以及共享 latent 轨迹下的多分支探索与成本—多样性权衡提供可核查线索，但不直接研究多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ForeSay: Tell the Future in Words, Branch the Details in Noise for Precipitation Nowcasting

**abstract/A1：** Precipitation nowcasting involves two distinct scales of uncertainty: macroscopic storm evolution and fine-scale local convective variations. Current generative ensemble methods entangle both scales within independent random noise draws. This coupling causes two practical limitations: every ensemble member must execute the full sampling trajectory from scratch, so an N-member ensemble costs N times a single forecast; moreover, divergent trajectories spatially misalign heavy-rain echoes across members, causing standard pixel-wise averaging to blur critical high-intensity extremes. We present ForeSay, a generative nowcasting framework that decouples macroscopic evolution prediction from local stochastic detail generation. Given historical radar frames, a vision-language model first predicts a textual scenario of future storm dynamics to condition a Rectified Flow generator. Guided by this shared macroscopic prior, ensemble members share early trunk sampling steps to establish the storm trajectory and branch with fresh noise only in later steps to explore local convective details. Because members then differ mainly in local details, self-anchored support-consensus decoding replaces pixel averaging with discrete support voting to preserve sharp heavy-rain cores. Across six datasets, ForeSay achieves the best CSI at the highest precipitation thresholds, with relative improvements over the strongest baseline on each dataset ranging from over 10% to 84%. Our 8-member ensemble retains the forecasting skill and diversity of eight independently sampled runs while reducing computational cost from 8x to 5.2x that of a single forecast.

</details>

### 232. [Interpretable deep concepts of organoid morphology](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20840v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20840

**作者：** Lion Jasper Gleiter、Tingying Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20840v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20840v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 DINOv3 与类器官专用 ViTAMIn-O 两个基础模型上训练稀疏自编码器，提取可解释的类器官形态概念，并为其标注空间位置、统计数据集特异性和五个任务上的相关性。按空间标签筛选概念可提升部分任务的下游 AUROC，并借助概念分析定位到预处理引入的混淆因素。

**相关性简评：** 用 SAE 分解基础模型视觉特征、再按空间与任务相关性筛选概念的流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中「内部状态保留了哪些视觉证据、如何筛选证据」的问题；但该文属生物图像分类，不涉及推理生成或 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interpretable deep concepts of organoid morphology

**abstract/A1：** Image-based classification of organoid morphologies can indicate drug response, viability, or successful differentiation. In recent work, learned representations outperform handcrafted features as the basis for downstream classifiers. However, their black-box nature hides the morphological cues a classifier relies on. Based on the foundation models DINOv3 (general-purpose) and ViTAMIn-O (organoid-specific), we train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to learn interpretable concepts related to distinct organoid morphologies. We annotate concepts with spatial labels (organoid, organoid wall, background) and compute their dataset specificity and task relevance across five tasks. The spatial labels of DINOv3 concepts yield coarse organoid segmentations on out-of-domain datasets. Filtering concepts by spatial label in the DINOv3-SAE improves downstream AUROC for three of the five tasks. Qualitative analysis of the most relevant concepts further reveals a confounding factor introduced by our preprocessing in one task. Through such insights, interpretable concepts could help improve the reliability of classifiers and guide the future development of organoid representation models. The trained SAEs will be made available upon publication.

</details>

### 233. [Motor Imagery Classification Using Hybrid Cross-Subject Class Mixup and Selective Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20853v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20853

**作者：** Jiwon Kim、Chae-Won Lee、Jong-Seok Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20853v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20853v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出将跨被试类别 Mixup（CSCM）与选择注意力结合的运动想象分类框架，用于 EEG-fNIRS 双模态解码；在 28 名被试的 LOSO 评估中平均性能高于五个复现基线，并通过模态混合策略、时序策略、跨模态路径干预和组件消融分析各组成部分的作用。

**相关性简评：** 其「EEG 保留因果时序自注意力、仅由 CLS 整合两模态、不做直接跨模态 token 注意力」的非对称融合设计与跨模态路径干预消融，可能为核查 VLM 中视觉证据是否被旁路、模态信息如何汇入潜在推理状态提供方法线索，需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Motor Imagery Classification Using Hybrid Cross-Subject Class Mixup and Selective Attention

**abstract/A1：** Motor imagery (MI) enables a brain-computer interface (BCI) to decode movement intentions without overt movement. Hybrid electroencephalography (EEG) and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) classification combines complementary signals, but inter-subject variability and the design of information exchange between modalities affect generalization to new subjects. We propose a framework that combines Cross-Subject Class Mixup (CSCM) with Selective Attention. CSCM aims to construct new training data to make the model robust against inter-subject variability. It independently selects EEG and fNIRS donor trials from other training subjects within the anchor class and mixes each modality while preserving the original label. Selective Attention provides an effective way to simultaneously model the temporal signal characteristics and fuse the two modalities. It retains causal temporal self-attention for EEG and uses a classification token (CLS) to integrate both modalities, without fNIRS attention updates or direct cross-modal temporal-token attention. Leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation across 28 subjects on a public EEG-fNIRS dataset yields a mean balanced accuracy (BA) of 76.85% and a macro-averaged F1 score (Macro-F1) of 76.58%. The proposed model achieves the highest mean performance among five reimplemented baselines. We also examine the contributions of CSCM and Selective Attention through modality-specific mixing and donor-policy comparisons, temporal-policy comparisons, interventions on direct cross-modal paths, and component ablations.

</details>

### 234. [When Is the Expensive Method Worth It? A Content-Driven Analysis of Classical Bayer Demosaicing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20854v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20854

**作者：** Taranum Wasu、Harsh Kashyap、HS Pannu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20854v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20854v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在80张基准图像上比较六种经典 Bayer 去马赛克方法，量化边缘感知昂贵方法相对最佳廉价线性方法的逐图像质量增益，并用预先固定的图像内容描述子（如平均饱和度）与深度2决策树预测该增益是否为正。

**相关性简评：** 其「用内容描述子预判昂贵计算是否值得」的轻量决策线索，可供核查 LVR 中按需触发昂贵推理模块或额外计算步的内容判据；但任务与模态差异大，迁移性仅属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Is the Expensive Method Worth It? A Content-Driven Analysis of Classical Bayer Demosaicing

**abstract/A1：** Demosaicing reconstructs a full-colour image from a single-sensor colour-filter-array (CFA) mosaic, where only one colour is measured per pixel. Classical methods make different assumptions about images, from simple averaging to directional edge-aware interpolation, and the directional methods cost markedly more compute. We ask a practical question that a per-image quality ranking does not answer: for a given image, is the expensive directional method worth its cost? Using a controlled simulate-reconstruct pipeline on 80 benchmark images from four public datasets (Kodak, McMaster, BSD100, Urban100), six classical methods, and image-content descriptors fixed before any results were seen, we show that the quality gain of the edge-aware method (Menon 2007) over the best cheap linear method is not constant. It ranges from $-6.6$ to $+6.8$ dB, and on 31% of images it is zero or negative, meaning a cheap method matches or beats the expensive one. The gain is also predictable from content: it correlates with mean image saturation at $r=-0.86$ ($p&lt;10^{-6}$). We then build an interpretable depth-2 decision tree that recommends the best cheap method from image descriptors, beating an always-pick-the-most-common baseline by 20.0 percentage points under leave-one-image-out validation. The analysis uses no deep learning, and every step can be inspected.

**comment/C1：** Preprint. 14 pages

</details>

### 235. [LiDSeg: Linear DehazeFormer Guidance for Efficient Semantic Segmentation in Adverse Weather Conditions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20864v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20864

**作者：** Yobsan Bayisa Leta、Christos Kyrkou、Maria K. Michael、Theocharis Theocharides

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20864v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20864v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LiDSeg：训练时让轻量去雾引导编码器与分割分支联合优化，并附加重建辅助目标；推理时丢弃重建解码器，仅保留引导编码器，通过门控融合把天气鲁棒特征注入分割分支。

**相关性简评：** 属恶劣天气语义分割的工程方法，不直接研究 latent 推理；但「训练期重建监督、推理期只留特征」的安排可供核查分割是否真正用到鲁棒视觉证据，并与显式先复原再分割的视觉旁路形成对照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LiDSeg: Linear DehazeFormer Guidance for Efficient Semantic Segmentation in Adverse Weather Conditions

**abstract/A1：** Robust semantic segmentation in adverse weather is essential for safety-critical autonomous systems. Existing restore-then-segment pipelines introduce latency and prioritize pixel-level restoration over semantic discriminability, while domain adaptation methods often face representation bottlenecks and computational complexity. We introduce LiDSeg, a framework that uses reconstruction-informed guidance to improve segmentation under adverse weather. During training, a lightweight guidance encoder is jointly optimized with the segmentation branch using segmentation and auxiliary reconstruction objectives. At inference, the reconstruction decoder is discarded, while the guidance encoder is retained to extract weather-robust features. A lightweight gated fusion module integrates these features into the segmentation branch, preserving clear-weather accuracy while improving adverse-weather robustness. On Foggy Cityscapes, LiDSeg limits the clear-to-dense-fog mIoU degradation to 2.5-2.8 percentage points, reducing the baseline performance drop by more than fivefold. On the official ACDC test server, LiDSeg-PIDNet achieves 75.07% pooled all-condition mIoU, comparable to supervised HRNet-W48 at 75.0%, while remaining substantially smaller. The gains generalize zero-shot to Foggy Driving and Foggy Zurich without training on real-fog images. LiDSeg adds only 1.9-3.1M parameters across several models, with total model sizes of 5.2-39.5M parameters and no inference-time reconstruction overhead. It delivers real-time inference on the NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Code: https://github.com/yobsanb/LiDSeg

**comment/C1：** Includes supplementary material

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20885

**作者：** Jiameng Li、Minye Wu、Matthew B. Blaschko

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ProSE，一个免训练、语义引导的 MoE-MLLM 专家跳过框架：用 query-aware 语义掩码标出关键视觉 token，并以逐层掩码重构误差最小化来校准各层的跳过阈值，在给定激活预算下保持表示一致性。

**相关性简评：** 其以重构误差探测跳过后的表示一致性、按语义重要性筛选视觉 token 并在预算内分配计算，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与动态计算成本权衡提供可核查线索；但该工作面向推理加速，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，迁移需自行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProSE: Probing Reconstruction Error for Semantic-guided Expert Skipping in MoE-MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Mixture-of-Experts Multimodal Large Language Models (MoE-MLLMs) offer scalable inference through sparse expert activation, yet substantial computational redundancy remains among the activated experts. Existing expert skipping methods typically calibrate thresholds based on target skipping ratios or final-output divergence, overlooking the accumulation of skipping-induced error across layers and the varying semantic importance of individual tokens. To address that, we propose ProSE, a training-free, semantic-guided expert skipping framework that probes layer-wise reconstruction error to promote representation consistency compared with default activation. Specifically, we construct query-aware semantic masks to identify salient visual tokens and progressively calibrate modality-specific skipping thresholds for each MoE layer. By minimizing masked reconstruction error under a given budget, ProSE maintains semantic consistency after skipping and allows adaptive expert allocation under limited activation budgets. Extensive experiments on 9 benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements on average over existing expert skipping methods, particularly under aggressive skipping settings. ProSE maintains over 96\\% performance on KimiVL-A3B-Inst with 83\\% expert skipping and accelerates prefilling by $1.7\\times$.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages

</details>

### 237. [From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20891

**作者：** Zheng Wang、Yuang Liu、Sachith Abeywickrama、Yangkai Ding、Tao Yu、Xinyu Zhang、Hongbo Wang、Qi Ye、Xuefeng Jin、Zhangchun Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20891v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ConvRSI，用「卷积」替代递归式多智能体自我改进：智能体内卷积联合精化相关特征，智能体间图卷积按协作拓扑聚合消息，两阶段均在 latent 空间完成，从而并行更新、避免反复解码重编码中间消息，在 MATH-500 上兼顾效果与推理成本、延迟。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本多智能体工作，无视觉成分；但其「在 latent 空间做并行状态更新并避免解码-重编码」的机制，可作为 LVR 中 parallel 生成与计算成本、长度权衡的借鉴线索，图卷积聚合也可能对应实体关系在内部状态中的传播，尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Recursion to Convolution: Parallel Self-Improvement for Multi-Agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent self-improvement enables agents to improve through interaction and feedback. However, sequential dependencies across agents and refinement rounds can propagate errors, increase computational costs, and limit parallelism. Moreover, refining individual features or agents in isolation can overlook their dependencies and restrict collective coordination. To address these challenges, we propose ConvRSI, a framework for parallelizing multi-agent self-improvement through convolution. ConvRSI couples intra-agent convolution, which jointly refines related agent features, with inter-agent graph convolution, which aggregates messages according to the collaboration topology. Both stages operate in latent space, enabling parallel updates without repeatedly decoding and re-encoding intermediate messages. Experiments on MATH-500 show that ConvRSI achieves 5.04% performance improvement while reducing 17.27% inference cost, and 45.11% latency compared with RecursiveMAS. It also supports diverse collaboration patterns by representing their topologies as adjacency matrices. These results demonstrate the potential of convolutional co-evolution for efficient multi-agent self-improvement. Our code and datasets are provided in https://github.com/LYA2333/ConvRSI.

</details>

### 238. [Palmprint Decomposer: Interpretable and Editable Factorization via Synthetic Learning and Instance-Wise Refinement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20913v1>)

**作者：** Licheng Yan、Yuqi Wang、Jingtao Wang、Bob Zhang、Andrew Beng Jin Teoh、Lu Leng、Shuyi Li、Ziyuan Yang

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20913v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20913v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Palmprint Decomposer，用颜色图、光照图、结构图与全局纹理强度以乘性组合表示掌纹图像，仅在合成数据上做因子监督训练，并配合实例级细化在测试时直接优化各因子，实现纹理与基础外观的可解释、可编辑分离。

**相关性简评：** 其非对称解码路径与分解约束用于抑制细纹理泄漏进基础外观，可能为 LVR 中防止视觉细节坍缩或被旁路吸收提供约束设计线索；实例级 test-time 因子优化也值得核查能否迁移为推理期状态细化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Palmprint Decomposer: Interpretable and Editable Factorization via Synthetic Learning and Instance-Wise Refinement

**abstract/A1：** Palmprint recognition and synthesis methods focus on extracting discriminative textures or generating images with varied textures and appearances. However, they do not generally provide an explicit image-level representation that separates palmprint texture from its underlying base appearance for independent analysis or controlled editing. We introduce Palmprint Decomposer, an interpretable framework that represents a palmprint through independently editable factors and reconstructs the image through a multiplicative composition model. A color map and a light map characterize the base appearance, while a structure map and a global texture strength parameter describe texture modulation. However, accurate reconstruction alone does not guarantee separation of palmprint texture from base appearance, as fine palmprint textures may leak into the estimated base appearance. To mitigate this ambiguity, we train the decomposer exclusively on synthetic data with direct factor supervision, using asymmetric decoding paths and decomposition constraints to suppress texture leakage. Instance-Wise Refinement further improves real-image reconstruction by directly optimizing the predicted factors for each input without relying on the trained network. Experiments across seven datasets demonstrate high reconstruction fidelity, with the extracted structure maps generally achieving verification performance comparable to the original images. Compared with existing methods, our approach achieves better factor separation while preserving more discriminative palmprint texture information.

</details>

### 239. [Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20937v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20937

**作者：** Wei Tang、Tong Wei、Jiahao Zhang、Min-Ling Zhang、Lijie Hu、Fakhri Karray

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20937v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20937v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PACIL：在每类只给类名与无标签图像的类增量学习设定下，用先验选择规则校正 CLIP 零样本预测的类别比例，再以白化特征上的固定先验 vMF 混合模型精炼为标签后验软标签，并用这些软标签训练分类器、以闭式留一交叉验证选择与零样本 CLIP 的融合权重。

**相关性简评：** 其以软后验替代硬伪标签、并用后验信号决定两个预测源融合权重的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理与视觉旁路之间的贡献分配和权重确定提供可核查线索；但该文研究类增量学习而非推理期 latent 状态，联系属于方法借鉴层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning What the True Labels Would Teach: Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning with Unlabeled Data

**abstract/A1：** In class-incremental learning with unlabeled data, each task brings only class names and unlabeled images, so CLIP's zero-shot predictions replace labels. Existing methods train on hard pseudo-labels, but a wrong one gives the true class zero probability, which self-training often confirms. We argue that each image should carry its label posterior, as an analytic classifier trained on posteriors equals the true-label one in expectation. The zero-shot prediction is not this posterior, as its class proportions confound name bias with true imbalance and it ignores other images. We propose Posterior Analytic Class-Incremental Learning (PACIL), which corrects the class prior with a prior selection rule and refines each distribution by a fixed-prior von Mises-Fisher mixture on whitened features. These soft labels train the classifier and replace labels to select its fusion weight with zero-shot CLIP by closed-form leave-one-out cross-validation. We prove that posterior targets minimize the mean-square gap to the true-label prediction and that their argmax widens this gap only through ambiguous images. The fusion weight selected with soft labels loses at most their distance to the posteriors in expected correct decisions. PACIL has the best average incremental accuracy among methods trained without labels on all 18 settings.

</details>

### 240. [vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20942v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20942

**作者：** Masahiro Ryo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20942v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20942v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 forced focused attention（FFA）：推理期把冻结编码器依次作用于放大、重叠的局部裁剪，对反向对齐的反射结果取平均，再重建回源坐标形成特征场，以恢复高分辨率自然照片中被弱表达的密集重叠结构，并在五类生态图像上以 RGB 边缘 F1 对比直接编码与 SAM3 掩码。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理期局部裁剪重编码＋回投影取平均」的处理方式，可供核查作为 VLM 视觉细节保留与证据筛选的旁路线索；但论文仅评估 RGB 边缘保真度与提取成本，未涉及 latent 推理状态或答案对该内容的实际使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention

**abstract/A1：** Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages including supplementary material; 6 numbered figures and a graphical summary

</details>

### 241. [FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20971v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20971

**作者：** Qixuan Wu、Xiaole Yang、Yuguang Yang、Canyu Chen、Linlin Yang、Haixia Pan、Guodong Guo、Baochang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20971v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20971v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出轻量框架 FAVR，为冻结的 VLA 策略做视觉条件适配：用线性 test-time training 维护紧凑时序视觉状态，在 flow 式动作生成的各步检索 action 条件视觉特征，并把通道门控写成盒约束优化以提升机器人操作成功率。

**相关性简评：** 其「按生成步筛选并注入视觉特征、并分析注入特征如何影响预测速度」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与逐步贡献分配提供可核查线索；但工作属机器人策略工程，与推理机制的关联需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies

**abstract/A1：** Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures. Equal contribution: Qixuan Wu and Xiaole Yang. Corresponding authors: Yuguang Yang and Baochang Zhang

</details>

### 242. [Breaking feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20981v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20981

**作者：** Özgün Turgut、Daniel Rueckert

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20981v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20981v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文诊断掩码数据建模下时序编码器输出 token 出现部分特征坍缩，提出 OTISv2，在输入空间重构目标之外加入对 EMA 教师的自蒸馏损失和 KoLeo 正则，以降低 token 余弦相似度、提升有效秩并在更大参数规模下保持可扩展。

**相关性简评：** 其「仅监督输入空间、特征空间冗余维度缺乏约束」的诊断与特征空间正则手段，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态信息坍缩与表示退化问题；但属非视觉时序任务，迁移线索尚需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Breaking feature collapse in self-supervised time series encoders

**abstract/A1：** General-purpose time series encoders promise a single backbone that generalises across tasks and domains; however, they currently do not scale. We trace this down to a critical point of failure: under the predominant masked data modelling supervision, the encoder's output tokens partially collapse. This is the natural consequence of supervising encoders only in the input space, which leaves no constraint against redundant token dimensions in the feature space. We introduce OTISv2, which suppresses the collapse by complementing the reconstruction objective in input space with two objectives in the feature space: a self-distillation loss against an exponential-moving-average teacher, and a KoLeo regulariser. Under matched training, the resulting encoder reduces the cosine similarity and lifts the effective rank of its output tokens relative to its predecessor, and it scales monotonically from 7.1 M to 116 M parameters where its predecessor declines. It matches or surpasses existing general-purpose time series encoders across 143 uni- and multi-variate datasets. To foster further research, we release our code and pre-trained weights.

</details>

### 243. [GRACE: Parallel Best-of-N Multi-Agent Analysis of Closed-Form Questions over Dataframes with Guardrail Selection and Adaptive Retry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20983v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20983

**作者：** Fabio Picariello、Salvatore Cipolla、Susanna Bonura、Vito Morreale

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20983v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20983v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GRACE，一个面向 dataframe 封闭式问题的并行 best-of-N 多智能体流水线：并行生成多个代码候选，用成对锦标赛预筛、领域护栏选出最优或整体弃权并给出诊断，进而触发带逐智能体反馈的自适应重试；在 DAEval 上把答案匹配率从约 39% 提到 71%。

**相关性简评：** 「并行候选生成 + 判别式护栏筛选/弃权 + 自适应重试」这一组合与 LVR 中多假设推理状态的取舍、停止决策和计算分配问题可能相通，护栏判别可作为候选验证思路供核查；但论文处理的是表格代码与标量答案，不涉及视觉 latent 状态或视觉证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRACE: Parallel Best-of-N Multi-Agent Analysis of Closed-Form Questions over Dataframes with Guardrail Selection and Adaptive Retry

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents answer closed-form questions over a tabular dataframe by writing and executing Python, almost always as a single rollout: one interpretation, one script, one result, accepted without comparison. The few pipelines that produce several candidates reconcile them by answer-agreement voting, which needs a single comparable scalar and always returns one, even when every candidate is wrong. We present GRACE (Generative, Ranked, Adaptive Code Ensemble), a production-oriented pipeline that instead runs parallel best-of-N selection specialised to dataframe code. N agents run concurrently under a strict, machine-checkable output contract, diversified by persona hints, per-retry rotation, and a two-regime temperature schedule. Rather than vote, GRACE judges the executed artefacts: a pairwise tournament pre-filters the pool and a domain-specialised guardrail either selects the best candidate or, when none is defensible, rejects the whole pool and abstains with a diagnosis (an option voting structurally lacks), which in turn drives an adaptive retry with per-agent feedback. On InfiAgent-DABench (DAEval, M = 246), using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as the backbone, GRACE raises answer match from 39% for a single-rollout baseline to 71% (+32 pp, 1.8x), recovering 53% of previously wrong answers. On the same DAEval task, the smaller dense Qwen3.5-9B lifts answer match from 38% to 63% (+25 pp, 1.7x). A controlled 3 x 3 study that sweeps the number of parallel agents against the retry budget finds, on the 35B backbone, the two levers largely substitutable: once either one is generous, the other adds little, identifying a cheap operating point for deployment. The same directional pattern replicates on the independent DataBench benchmark, again on the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone, where answer match rises by 15 percentage points (from 70% to 85%) across 400 sampled questions.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 5th Italian Conference on Big Data and Data Science (ITADATA 2026). To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** VASR 将专用 SVG 编码器与预训练 VLM 的视觉表示融合，用于从零件和目标图示推断家具装配层级，并提出带层级保持等价奖励的 RHPO，用修复代价在等价性相当的候选间做二次择优。

**相关性简评：** 其“多解等价”奖励与修复代价排序可能为 LVR 中多条 latent 推理路径的等价监督和按下游修正成本重排候选提供借鉴线索，但任务本身与视觉推理机制距离较远，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VASR: Vector-Aware Assembly Planning with Equivalent Structures and Repair-Cost Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. To avoid penalizing valid alternatives to a reference assembly tree, we propose Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards. RHPO further uses repair-cost feedback to favor decisions with lower downstream correction costs among candidates with comparable equivalence-aware rewards. VASR achieves the highest Equivalent-Hard F1 among the evaluated methods, outperforming GPT6-Astra by 17.69 percentage points on the IKEA-derived test set while maintaining strong performance on an independent furniture dataset.

</details>

### 245. [MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20992v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20992

**作者：** Fan Zhang、Hao Wu、Jinyang Wu、Hongyu Qu、Zheng Lian、Dongfu Yin、Qingsong Wen、Pheng-Ann Heng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20992v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20992v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MedJev，在裁剪掉上层语言层与生成通路的 VLM 主干上，保留完整视觉通路与视觉 token，用预训练 query–key 匹配加轻量 MLP 残差对候选答案打分，单次前向直接给出医学图像理解决策。

**相关性简评：** 「不做自回归生成、直接从多模态内部状态读答案」的做法，可供核查 latent 表示是否已足够支撑决策，以及生成式解码中的信息坍缩问题；但该文属效率导向的判别式分类，无推理状态更新与证据筛选，联系仅为方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \\textsc{MedJev}, a \\emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \\textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \\textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \\textbf{7.93\\%} and a \\textbf{6.04$\\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \\textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

</details>

**内容简述：** 研究面向软件工程智能体的 on-policy 蒸馏（SWE-OPD）：学生模型与可执行仓库交互，教师在学生访问到的前缀上进行监督，跨三组师生模型、两种训练来源与三个 SWE 基准验证能力迁移，并给出用缓存教师分数的离线变体与跨 tokenizer 扩展；同时报告损失下降与智能体表现脱节的现象。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本智能体编码任务，但其「在学生实际访问前缀上做教师分布监督」及缓存离线监督，可能为 LVR 中潜在推理轨迹的逐步监督与贡献分配提供借鉴；损失下降却性能退化及 support-mass 梯度项的诊断也值得核查是否对应潜状态信息坍缩。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SWE-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Coding

**abstract/A1：** In this work, we study on-policy distillation (OPD) for transferring agentic coding capabilities from a large teacher model to a smaller student model. Prior work has focused primarily on reasoning and short-horizon agentic tasks. We present SWE-OPD, a minimal OPD study for software engineering, where the student interacts with executable repositories and the teacher supervises the prefixes visited by the student. Across three teacher--student pairs, two training sources, and three SWE benchmarks, we find that on-policy supervision transfers coding capability: supervision from Qwen3.6-27B increases the SWE-bench Pro resolve rate of Qwen3.5-9B from 35.9% to 39.4%. Refreshing trajectories is not strictly required either, as an offline variant with cached teacher scores still improves over the student baselines while cutting end-to-end GPU-hours by 59.4%--72.6% and halving peak GPU allocation, at benchmark-dependent accuracy. Furthermore, we extend the offline variant to corss-tokenizer scenarios: distilling GLM-4.5-Air from DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 raises its SWE-bench Pro and Multilingual resolve rate from 35.8% to 39.7% and from 41.8% to 46.2%, around 4% and 4.6% improvement, respectively. We also find that a decreasing loss, however, does not necessarily indicate improved agent performance: under top-$K$ reverse-KL loss, one student exhibits severe repetition despite a decreasing loss. We identify a support-mass gradient term as a potential mechanism underlying this failure.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21029
