**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21029v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21029v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该综述以「4+1+3」框架梳理视觉生成中的稀疏注意力：静态与动态方法如何依据来源信息及由证据判断保留哪些 query-key 交互与粒度，并讨论复用与误差补偿，再对应到数据组织、执行与数据流等系统维度及评测指标。

**相关性简评：** 其按证据动态筛选 token 交互、以 reuse/correction 补偿稀疏化漏失的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 latent 注意力结构（内容、位置、缓存）分析提供借鉴线索，需核查能否迁移到推理期状态更新。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sparse Attention for Visual Generation: Toward Algorithm-System Co-Design

**abstract/A1：** Rapid advances in image and video generation have enabled high-fidelity synthesis at higher resolutions and longer durations, making the quadratic cost of dense self-attention a major bottleneck as visual token sequences grow. Sparse attention seeks to preserve generation quality at lower computational cost by retaining informative query-key interactions and omitting less consequential ones, with end-to-end gains depending on the cost of constructing sparse support and the efficiency with which the system maps the resulting workload to hardware. We survey sparse attention for visual generation through a 4+1+3 analytical framework that links algorithmic design to system implementation. The framework examines how static and dynamic methods use source information and the evidence derived from it to decide which interactions to retain and at what granularity, while accounting for the roles of reuse in reducing repeated computation and correction in compensating for omitted contributions. We relate these algorithmic choices to their implementation on hardware through the framework's three system dimensions of data organization, execution, and dataflow. We summarize common evaluation metrics and discuss open challenges and research directions, providing researchers and practitioners with a reference for the joint design of sparse attention algorithms and systems.

</details>

### 248. [ScoutCache: Efficient Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Conditional Readout and Selective Caching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21038v1>)

**作者：** Hao Tan、Jinghui Qin、Xuming Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 ScoutCache 视频扩散加速框架：用浅层特征变化估计中间去噪更新，按注意力输出扰动为各层/头分配历史 KV 读取预算，并筛选高信息量且保持空间覆盖的稀疏缓存。

**相关性简评：** 其「依赖随层与注意力头变化但跨片段稳定」的观察及按输出扰动分配历史读取预算的做法，可供核查是否适用于 LVR 中历史 latent 与视觉证据的保留及缓存结构分析；但论文本身面向视频生成加速，与推理机制无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ScoutCache: Efficient Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Conditional Readout and Selective Caching

**abstract/A1：** Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient long video generation, but inference still incurs substantial computational costs from repeated denoising and KV cache operations. Existing acceleration methods reduce parts of this overhead, while historical KV reading and cache construction remain costly across video chunks. To address these challenges, we propose ScoutCache, a training-free framework that jointly optimizes denoising, historical KV reading, and cache construction. We observe that shallow feature changes provide useful information for estimating clean latent updates, while historical KV dependence varies across Transformer layers and attention heads but remains relatively stable across video chunks. Based on these observations, we develop Conditional Denoising Readout (CDR) to estimate intermediate denoising updates from shallow feature changes and known noise variations. We further introduce Output Risk Guided Historical KV Reading (ORHR) to allocate historical reading budgets based on attention output perturbations, and Content and Coverage Guided Sparse Cache Construction (CCSC) to reduce cache construction costs by selecting informative spatial tokens while maintaining spatial coverage. Extensive experiments on Self-Forcing and LongLive using VBench and MovieGen demonstrate that ScoutCache achieves up to 2.28$\\times$ and 1.86$\\times$ speedups, respectively, while consistently improving generation quality without modifying pretrained model parameters.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21044

**作者：** Erik Brorsson、Kilian Freitag、Josef Bengtson、Kristofer Bengtsson、Lars Hammarstrand、Knut Åkesson、Fredrik Kahl

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21044v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21044v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出多视角 3D 人体姿态估计器 BoE：为各相机预测关节深度，以先前重建的 3D 人体几何作为上下文深度线索，并用可学习深度感知三角化把深度约束并入可微三角化，使深度估计与 3D 几何交替细化。

**相关性简评：** 深度预测与几何重建交替细化、以及用预测深度弥补单视角证据不足的做法，可能为 LVR 中多轮 latent 状态更新与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索，但该任务本身并非 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Body of Evidence: Triangulating 3D Human Pose with Geometry-Conditioned Depth

**abstract/A1：** Even in multi-camera setups, occlusions can leave individual body joints with only a single usable 2D observation. Such an observation defines a viewing ray but leaves the joint's depth undetermined. We introduce Body of Evidence (BoE), a multi-view 3D human pose estimator that predicts per-camera joint depths alongside 2D joint locations. To reduce monocular depth ambiguity, we propose geometry-conditioned depth prediction, which combines image features with previously reconstructed 3D body geometry as contextual depth cues. We further introduce learnable depth-aware triangulation (LDAT), which augments differentiable algebraic triangulation with predicted depth constraints, enabling reconstruction even from a single contributing camera while preserving the benefits of geometric triangulation when multiple views are available. The reconstructed 3D poses subsequently guide depth prediction in the next iteration, allowing depth estimates and 3D geometry to progressively refine each other. Experiments on CMU Panoptic demonstrate state-of-the-art in-domain performance and superior average performance across evaluated camera subsets and unseen camera arrangements. BoE is particularly effective under sparse camera coverage, outperforming the previous state of the art by 10.6 AP25 points in the challenging three-camera setting.

</details>

### 250. [System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21053v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21053

**作者：** Eleftherios Tzanis、Michail E. Klontzas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21053v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21053v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「System 1 agents」：用一个确定性编译器把工具 schema 与用户请求转成多选题，再由单次前向的决策模型选择工具并填写参数，从而在本地不生成自由文本地完成工具调用；在 157 个生物医学工具的 1,952 条请求上评测了正确率与参数填写情况。

**相关性简评：** 将自由生成替换为「候选选项 + 单次打分」的受限决策，可能为 LVR 中约束推理状态输出、抑制被编造内容进入后续步骤提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向纯文本工具调用，缺乏视觉输入与 latent 状态设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI

**abstract/A1：** Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents

</details>

### 251. [MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21060v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21060

**作者：** Yibo Bai、Likui Zhang、Jinglei Zhang、Zhengbin Pang、Xingshen Song、Xiaoqing Yin、Jinsheng Deng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21060v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21060v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MetricHand，用几何感知的 flow matching 在度量世界空间中做 4D 手部重建：把手物交互区域的深度先验编码为保持局部空间结构与尺度的关节关联表示，与视觉特征融合后条件化时间生成，联合恢复世界坐标平移、全局朝向、MANO 关节与形状。

**相关性简评：** 不涉及 VLM 推理，但「将几何/度量先验写入结构化关节表示并逐步条件化生成」可能为 latent 推理状态中几何证据的注入与保持提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space

**abstract/A1：** Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

</details>

### 252. [SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21079v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21079

**作者：** Pan Liu、Dongxin Lyu、Yusen Tan、Yifan Li、Hai-tao Yu、Yunhua Zhong、Zikun Wang、Tianze Ling、Jun Xia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21079v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21079v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SemiNovo 半监督去新肽测序框架：构建大规模质控的未标注谱库 DarkSpec，结合质量约束的逐步自回归解码与累积路径置信度从无标注谱中提取可靠监督，并用头级化学证据门控改善噪声、不完整碎片下的证据聚合。

**相关性简评：** 用路径置信度从无标注数据筛选伪监督、以及在证据噪声与缺失下做门控聚合，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与贡献分配、视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的机制线索，但领域与模态差异较大，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing

**abstract/A1：** Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. To address this challenge, we propose SemiNovo, a semi-supervised framework that learns jointly from identified and unlabeled spectra. SemiNovo first constructs DarkSpec, a large-scale quality-controlled corpus of unlabeled spectra collected from diverse public proteomics projects, thereby extending training beyond search-identified spectra and mitigating the resulting shift in DNPS supervision. It then combines stepwise mass-constrained autoregressive decoding with cumulative path confidence to derive reliable supervision from unlabeled spectra. Moreover, SemiNovo introduces head-wise chemical-evidence gating to improve spectral evidence aggregation under noisy and incomplete fragmentation. Experiments show that SemiNovo performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset are publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages. Accepted as an oral presentation at KDD 2027, AI for Sciences Track

</details>

### 253. [State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21085v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21085

**作者：** Hang Xing、Yan Xia、Yongjiang Liu、Siqi Zhang、Xueming Ding

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21085v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21085v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 State-Message Interaction Adapter（SMIA），在冻结的 DINOv3 中于逐头聚合之后，用共享低秩双线性映射让每个 head 的聚合消息依据接收 patch 的注意力前状态产生位置相关的更新，用于跨域小样本医学与工业分割。

**相关性简评：** 其「中间层逐头注意力消息已含目标-背景区分、但末层相似度未反映」的观察与「消息条件于状态再做低秩更新」的结构，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据在内部状态里的定位与位置相关状态更新；但论文任务是判别式分割适配，并非推理期 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables, including the appendix

</details>

### 254. [Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Aligned Action Spaces for Cross-Game Generalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21094v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21094

**作者：** Jing Yi、Cehao Yang、Hualei Zhang、Haitao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21094v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21094v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CAMOPD，一个面向 VLM 跨游戏零样本泛化的多教师 on-policy 蒸馏后训练框架：先用完整动作对齐把子词级似然归一为校准的动作类别分布，再跨源游戏互评视觉专家，压制相互冲突的教师纠正。

**相关性简评：** 其用不确定性边际筛选 on-policy 样本、以跨源互评衡量教师兼容性的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督筛选与贡献分配提供可核查线索；但论文本身研究像素到动作的控制迁移，不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation in Aligned Action Spaces for Cross-Game Generalization

**abstract/A1：** Zero-shot cross-game generalization aims to consolidate accessible source-game experts into a single vision-language model (VLM) that controls unseen games from raw pixels without target-game parameter updates. While multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) mitigates offline exposure bias and single-game reinforcement learning (RL) overfitting, scaling it to autoregressive VLMs faces two bottlenecks. First, token-to-action misalignment from subword length bias distorts discrete action probabilities and uncertainty margins. Second, multi-teacher policy conflict arises as source teachers under incompatible dynamics issue contradictory closed-loop corrections, causing negative transfer. We propose CAMOPD (Conflict-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation), a post-training framework that resolves multi-teacher policy conflict within an aligned semantic action space. CAMOPD first uses complete-action alignment to normalize command completion likelihoods over each game's legal action set, forming a calibrated categorical policy that provides reliable uncertainty margins for selective on-policy retention and visual specialist probes that can be evaluated across source games. To resolve policy conflict without target-game data, conflict-aware multi-teacher consolidation cross-evaluates these specialists across source games to capture both visual identifiability and inter-teacher compatibility, upweighting compatible teachers while suppressing conflicting corrections. On GameWorld's temporal and directional transfer suites with Qwen3.5-4B, CAMOPD achieves 26/30 (86.7%) and 24/30 (80.0%) Task-1 zero-shot success on unseen GeoDash and Doodle Jump, outperforming prompting, weight-merging, and multi-task baselines.

</details>

### 255. [MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21098v1>)

**作者：** Huiting Zhang、Yingxin Cai、Siyuan Wang、Xi Yang、Yuyao Yan、Rui Zhang、Kaizhu Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21098v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21098v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MedicalDPO，在 CT→PET 图像合成中利用配对数据自动构造多维保真度偏好对，将相对去噪误差偏好优化与原始 Brownian Bridge 目标联合训练，并在多个 CT 条件下平衡轮换偏好监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「同条件多候选排序＋跨指标严格筛选偏好对＋锚定原训练目标」的监督构造方式，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的偏好式训练与避免基础能力退化提供可供核查的线索，但本身不涉及推理状态或证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MedicalDPO: Multi-Objective Direct Preference Optimization for CT to PET Translation

**abstract/A1：** CT-to-PET synthesis estimates functional PET images from anatomical CT scans for auxiliary analysis, representation pretraining, and missing-modality completion. Brownian Bridge diffusion models can produce multiple PET candidates of different quality under the same CT condition, exposing an intra-condition quality hierarchy. Candidate quality spans complementary spatial, structural, and intensity dimensions, while DPO-only fine-tuning may compromise absolute synthesis fidelity. We propose MedicalDPO which converts this hierarchy into preference supervision automatically constructed from paired CT-PET training data. Multiple candidates are ranked across the three fidelity dimensions, and strict cross-metric verification retains preferred-rejected pairs with consistent quality separation. Relative denoising-error preference optimization is jointly trained with the original Brownian Bridge objective to anchor the pretrained CT-to-PET mapping, while condition-balanced multi-pair rotation distributes preference supervision across CT conditions. Experiments on BBDM and CPDM show improvements across LPIPS, MAE, SSIM, and PSNR. Further analyses demonstrate metric complementarity and clear pair separation, while ablations show that the original training objective prevents the substantial degradation caused by DPO-only fine-tuning.

</details>

### 256. [Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21107v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21107

**作者：** Salih Numan Büyükbaş、Erchan Aptoula、Mamatha Thota、Petra Bosilj

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21107v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21107v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文为多标签图像分类建立首个无源域适应基准，覆盖六个数据集上的五个迁移任务，将四种单标签 SFDA 方法扩展为基线，并指出最近质心伪标签、softmax 置信度与信息最大化多样性项在多标签下失效；进而提出基于 mean-teacher 的 MPACT，重新设计目标、原型构建与对齐项。

**相关性简评：** 文中区分「特征空间对齐」与「与分类器自我强化的一致」的原型一致性诊断，以及置信度伪标签筛选的负结果，可能为核查 latent 状态是否真正使用视觉证据、而非自我确认提供诊断思路，可供人工核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Source-Free Domain Adaptation for Multi-Label Image Classification: A Framework, Baselines, and Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a model trained on a labelled source domain to an unlabelled target domain without access to the source data. Almost the entire SFDA literature assumes mutually exclusive classes, yet many deployed settings are multi-label. This paper formulates SFDA for multi-label classification and establishes the first benchmark for it: five adaptation tasks over six datasets spanning remote sensing, natural, clipart-style and driving imagery, with four single-label SFDA methods extended to provide the first baselines and a published multi-label method run alongside them, over three seeds. The benchmark shows that extending a single-label method is unreliable rather than merely suboptimal: half of the extended baselines fail to improve on the unadapted source model at all, and on two of the five tasks none of them does. The failures are not incidental. Nearest-centroid pseudo-labelling, softmax-based confidence, the diversity term of information maximization and confidence-weighted prototype construction each rely on mutual exclusivity, and each fails differently without it, so replacing the softmax with per-class sigmoids is a valid but insufficient extension. Multi-label Prototype Alignment with Contrastive Teaching (MPACT) is proposed in response, a mean-teacher framework whose objective, prototype construction and alignment term are each reconsidered for overlapping label sets. It attains the best average on every reported metric and is the only method that improves on the unadapted source model on all five tasks. The analysis further introduces a prototype-agreement diagnostic separating feature-space alignment from self-reinforcing agreement with the classifier, and reports a negative result for confidence-based pseudo-label filtering.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21111v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21111v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把具表达力的 einspace 搜索空间扩展到序列建模，提出 einspaceAR，使自回归模型可直接由基本算子组合而成并从零搜索，而不必依赖强结构先验。

**相关性简评：** 其「从基本算子组合搜索 AR 架构」的搜索空间设计，可能为 LVR 中系统比较状态生成与更新方式（如 AR、循环等原语组合）提供线索，但论文不涉及视觉证据或 latent 推理状态，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations

**abstract/A1：** Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence models from scratch--i.e., without imposing strong inductive biases. We believe that our einspaceAR search space will be a useful part of the NAS toolbox and that the techniques described in this work can serve as a blueprint for the integration of autoregressive modelling in other expressive search spaces.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21131v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21131v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ETU，一个与分类器无关的审计框架：将视频特征映射为「主体→动作→结果」的离散依赖图，在图条件扩散重建特征时遮蔽选定节点，再用冻结 VAD 检测器异常分数的变化衡量各语义节点的忠实贡献，并以随机删除等对照实验排除替代解释。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结模型＋latent 特征空间反事实干预＋同规模随机删除对照」的因果检验程序，可能可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正依赖被遮蔽的视觉证据与特定语义节点，并为 latent 状态的贡献分配提供可迁移的测量线索；但研究对象是视频异常打分而非多模态推理，迁移可行性有待阅读正文评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How to Explain your Unexplainable Video Anomaly Detector

**abstract/A1：** Weakly-supervised Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) models assign anomaly scores from high-dimensional features, and their predictions remain unexplained. Saliency maps show where a model looks but not what it relies on, and the descriptions produced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are generated by branches that the anomaly score never reads. To address this faithfulness gap, we propose \\textbf{Explain The Unexplainable (ETU)}, a classifier-agnostic framework that audits frozen VAD models through counterfactual interventions in their feature space. ETU maps video features to a discrete dependency graph of agents, actions and outcomes ($A\_r \\to A\_a \\to A\_o$), regenerates the features by graph-conditioned diffusion with selected nodes of the graph masked, and measures the change in the score of a frozen detector; one set of interventions is applied unchanged to every detector. The generator is trained only to reconstruct the input features, so it cannot learn the contrast it is asked to measure, and we validate the audit with experiments that test every alternative explanation of its results, from the cost of regeneration to random deletions of matched size. On UCF-Crime features obtained from a CLIP encoder, we show that substituting the scene semantics results in the largest drop for most detectors, and that removing the outcome chain of the graph ($Δ\_{rel}$) changes the anomaly score of all six audited detectors far more than removing the same number of random nodes, even though the random deletion perturbs the features about as much. We show that this targeted behavior comes from the divergence objective of the graph embedding. Without it, the two interventions become indistinguishable, and with a divergence objective in the generator as well, the score change of the detector follows the displacement of the reconstruction rather than the semantics that were removed.

**comment/C1：** This paper has been accepted at the RWS workshop WACV 2027

</details>

### 259. [Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21132v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21132

**作者：** Giacomo D'Amicantonio

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21132v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21132v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Region-VAD：先在冻结基础模型的 token 网格上按跨段时间特征的投影变化穷举搜索出显式矩形区域，再仅用框内 token 经注意力池化和时间头打分异常，仅训练池化与时间头，在五个数据集上取得更强的异常定位。

**相关性简评：** 「先选区域、且训练组件不读取选区外 token」的设计，可为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、抑制背景捷径与信息坍缩提供可核查线索；但该文是视频异常检测而非多模态推理，选区准则能否对应推理期状态更新仍需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Region-VAD: Video Anomaly Localization and Detection via Region Selection

**abstract/A1：** Anomalies are local events, yet weakly supervised video anomaly detection scores them globally. Most methods pool an entire frame into a single vector, rank frames by that vector, and derive a location afterwards as a saliency map of the score. Full-frame pooling mixes the anomaly with its background, so a detector can reach competitive benchmark scores from scene context without being able to show where in the scene the anomaly occurs. We introduce Region-VAD, which first selects a region and then detects the anomaly from that region alone. Region-VAD selects an explicit rectangle over the tokens of a frozen foundation model and scores anomalousness only from the tokens inside the box, through attention pooling followed by a standard temporal head. The rectangle is not learned, it is the box in which the frozen tokens change most between consecutive segments, in all four feature projections of the encoder, and it is found by exhaustive search over the rectangles of the token grid. Only the pooling and the temporal head are trained, from video-level labels without boxes, masks or frame-level annotations, and no trained component reads a token outside the selected region. Experiments on five datasets, with one localizer configuration shared by all datasets and backbones, show that Region-VAD achieves state-of-the-art anomaly localization on UCF-Crime and MSAD at competitive detection performance.

**comment/C1：** This paper has been accepted in the RWS workshop at WACV 2027

</details>

### 260. [When Feature Representation Changes Local Explanations: A Controlled Comparison of SHAP and LIME under Numerical Discretization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21159v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21159

**作者：** Parv Patel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21159v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21159v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在一个冻结的随机森林（UCI Adult）上，将连续特征 age 做等宽或分位离散化，比较 KernelSHAP 与 LIME 的局部归因变化，并用重复运行的噪声下限与类别翻转率作对照，指出 KernelSHAP 的改变量在全部条件下超过噪声而 LIME 不稳定。

**相关性简评：** 论文说明局部归因高度依赖输入表征而非仅解释器本身，这一线索可供核查：若用 SHAP/LIME 类方法给 latent 视觉状态或量化 token 分配贡献，需区分真实证据贡献与表征离散化带来的伪变化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Feature Representation Changes Local Explanations: A Controlled Comparison of SHAP and LIME under Numerical Discretization

**abstract/A1：** Local feature attributions are computed over a feature representation chosen by an upstream data-engineering step, yet they are read as statements about the underlying quantity. We ask how discretizing one continuous feature changes local KernelSHAP and LIME explanations when the classifier is held fixed, and whether the two explainers respond differently. A random forest is trained on UCI Adult and frozen; age is collapsed onto equi-width or quantile bin representatives (k in {3,5,10}) before the model receives it, and the same 120 held-out instances are explained in every condition across multiple seeds. We show analytically and numerically that for KernelSHAP this is exactly equivalent to explaining the unchanged model at the quantized instance against a quantized background, so the comparison is between two effective inputs rather than a pure explainer effect; for LIME no such equivalence holds. Each attribution change is compared with a seed-noise floor from re-running the explainer on the unchanged condition. KernelSHAP's age attribution exceeds its noise floor in all 6 pre-specified conditions (median ratios 2.4-59, all significant after Holm correction); on the raw scale LIME's exceeds its floor in only 2 of 6 and in the rest is no larger than its own run-to-run variation. SHAP's normalized change exceeds LIME's in every condition (rank-biserial 0.81-1.00), while LIME is 2.5-4.6x less consistent across repeats. Predicted classes change for only 0.8-5.8% of instances and held-out ROC-AUC never falls below 0.9097, yet 45-94% of instances show a large SHAP attribution change with no class flip. Feature-importance rankings barely move (median Spearman &gt;= 0.979, top-3 overlap 1.00). The representation change and the change in effective input cannot be separated within a frozen-model design.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code: https://github.com/Parvptl/shap-lime-representation-sensitivity

</details>

### 261. [DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21162v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21162

**作者：** Christof Leitgeb、Thomas Puchleitner、Max Peter Ronecker、Daniel Watzenig

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21162v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21162v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出用于车载多雷达点云编码的 DRaGAN，通过传感器相对的角—距傅里叶编码、沿视线的短/长程 hub 节点以及注意力引导的动态重连，实现更高效的局部—全局消息传递。

**相关性简评：** 该文属 3D 感知编码而非推理，但「剪除弱边并加入有限数量 latent 连接」的动态重连机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中随深度自适应调整内部状态连接结构与计算量的做法。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DRaGAN: Dynamic Graph Attention Network for Multi-Radar Point Cloud Encoding in Automotive Radar Perception

**abstract/A1：** Radar represents a key modality for weather-robust perception. Unlike optical sensors such as camera and LiDAR, radar can penetrate fog, rain and snow due to its longer wavelength, and recent hardware advances have steadily improved its spatial resolution, thus making it increasingly relevant for autonomous systems. While processing raw radar data requires substantial memory computation, most existing work has focused on preprocessed point-cloud data similar to LiDAR. However, the sparse radar points and sensor-relative anisotropy make LiDAR-oriented encoders suboptimal. To address this problem, we present DRaGAN, a dynamic graph attention network for multi-radar point clouds. DRaGAN introduces a sensor-relative Fourier encoding of angle and range to capture fixed-aperture radar characteristics, gated short- and long-range hub nodes along each sensor's line of sight for efficient local-global message passing, and attention-guided dynamic rewiring that prunes weak edges and adds a bounded number of latent connections restricted to two-hop neighborhoods. This reduces the number of processed edges in deeper layers while preserving representation quality. On TruckScenes, DRaGAN improves test NDS by 10.10 points over the evaluated RadarGNN baseline and reduces the reported model FLOP count by 63.7%. This trade-off includes an increase in model latency from 40 to 53.16 ms and in trainable parameters from 1.2M to 1.7M on the evaluated implementations. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/chr-is-tof/DRaGAN.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)

</details>

### 262. [RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21177v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21177

**作者：** Ruofeng Mei、Xiangyu Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21177v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21177v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对无反转、基于 flow 的图像编辑中非编辑区域漂移问题，将源保真控制表述为沿编辑轨迹施加残差选择性保真项的随机最优控制问题，导出「残差门控原理」：每个 latent 分量按局部残差幅度指数衰减的增益被拉回源图，从而抑制小偏差、放行语义性大编辑，并以每步一次轻量门控插值实现 RAGE。

**相关性简评：** 其逐 latent 分量、按残差幅度调制的回拉增益本质上是一种状态更新规则，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态该保留哪些视觉细节、何时允许改写提供可核查的门控线索，但该工作属图像编辑、不涉及推理，联系需自行核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAGE: Residual-Adaptive Gating for Flow-Based Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Recent inversion-free, flow-based image editing methods evolve the source image toward the target via a differential velocity field. We observe that this velocity field does not explicitly account for which regions should be preserved, leading to unintended drift in non-editing regions. To address this, we formulate source fidelity control as a stochastic optimal control problem in which a selective fidelity term on the editing residual is enforced along the editing trajectory. Solving this problem and approximating its solution yields the Residual Gating Principle: each latent component is pulled back toward the source with a gain that decays exponentially with the local residual magnitude, so that small deviations are suppressed while large, semantically meaningful edits pass through unimpeded. The proposed method, RAGE, requires only one lightweight gated interpolation per sampling step, involves no mask estimation, attention maps, retraining, or architecture-specific modifications, and is applied on top of FlowEdit-based editors. On PIE-Bench, RAGE achieves the best overall rank among 17 methods and substantially improves background preservation on both Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX backbones while maintaining competitive editing quality.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21178

**作者：** Erkan Bayram、Debanjan Ghosh、Li Zhu、Sambarta Dasgupta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21178v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21178v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TRACK 将时间序列编码器与小语言模型结合，用于电力管理系统多负载故障诊断：通过调用工具完成精确可核验的计算，生成结构化、具物理依据的诊断报告，并提出按结构、信号保真度、物理推理、诊断与可行动性逐项给出判定的 rubric 评估框架。

**相关性简评：** 「调用外部工具做可核验计算」以及 rubric 中将「信号保真」与「物理推理」「诊断」分开打分的做法，可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 中推理是否真正使用模态证据及贡献分配的评价方式；但该工作属时序故障诊断应用，与视觉 latent 推理无直接联系，迁移性需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRACK: Tool-Augmented Reasoning over Time Series for Fault Diagnosis in Power Management System

**abstract/A1：** Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. We present TRACK, which pairs a time series encoder with a Small Language Model to produce structured, physics-grounded diagnostic reports, calling tools for exact, verifiable calculations. It operates on-device, keeping proprietary sensor data local and avoiding expensive API calls. We introduce a rubric-based framework that evaluates these reports by scoring structure, signal fidelity, physics reasoning, diagnosis, and actionability through per-criterion verdicts. On a 15-class multi-load simulated benchmark, TRACK achieves over 95% fault-category accuracy and generalizes to out-of-distribution faults, whereas the best encoder-probing baseline reaches only 58% accuracy.

</details>

### 264. [Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21235v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21235

**作者：** Jinwei Hu、Qisong He、Xinmiao Huang、Youcheng Sun、Yi Dong、Xiaowei Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.MA、cs.SI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21235v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21235v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究语言模型智能体如何把真实信息片段拼接成误导性叙事并产生 narrative overfitting，通过 Generative Montage 在多起谣言事件上量化其过度自信接受，并提出检查直接证据支持的运行时监控器 Grounded Monitor。

**相关性简评：** 其区分「直接证据支持」与「推断关系造成的信念影响」的监控思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推断是否有证据支撑及何时应停止或回退到显式证据，但该工作并非视觉多模态研究，需进一步检查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel

**abstract/A1：** Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. To explain this susceptibility, fragment interventions identify posts that influence belief within complete narratives. Synthetic controls then show that similar response patterns arise from valid evidence, separating belief influence from evidential support. This distinction motivates Grounded Monitor, a proof-of-concept neuro-symbolic runtime monitor that checks direct evidential support to guide agents' judgements, improving decision accuracy by 5.6 to 29.0 percentage points across original and anonymized settings. These findings expose a cognitive route to rumour amplification and support monitoring inferred relationships before agent-generated conclusions guide public decisions.

**comment/C1：** Under Review

</details>

**abstract/A1：** In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.

### 266. [In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21268v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21268

**作者：** Abdullah Ahmed、Yun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、math.NA、math.ST、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21268v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21268v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究 transformer 对参数化 ODE 的 in-context 参数估计与轨迹预测：构造模型以两阶段近似极大似然（粗搜索初始化后接局部梯度下降）从含噪轨迹中估参，再与 ODE 解映射的神经近似组合，并通过参数共享让单个 transformer 同时完成估计与预测，给出非渐近保证与划分预训练数据、上下文长度和模型容量误差的 oracle 不等式。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，但其「在上下文中迭代精化连续隐变量估计」的构造及对上下文长度、预训练量与容量误差的分解，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的循环更新与长度泛化预测线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs

**abstract/A1：** Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. For prediction, we compose this estimator with a neural approximation of the ODE solution map. We further show that, through parameter sharing, a single transformer can perform both parameter estimation and trajectory prediction simultaneously. For these constructions, we establish nonasymptotic guarantees and finite-pretraining oracle inequalities that separate errors due to finite pretraining data, finite context length, and finite-sized transformer approximation. Numerical experiments on linear and nonlinear ODEs further show that pretrained transformers can benefit from longer inference contexts without updating their weights.

</details>

### 267. [Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21276v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21276

**作者：** Donghyeok Lee、Sangkwon Park、Munyoung Chang、Sungroh Yoon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21276v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21276v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SAGA，一种仅训练期使用的正则项，用 Centered Kernel Alignment 把分子语言模型（MolCA、Atomas）的内部表示对齐到指纹 Tanimoto 相似度，在不增加参数、推理时也无需指纹的前提下改善检索与 scaffold 划分的性质预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「用外部相似度结构约束内部表示几何、且不增加推理开销」的训练式对齐思路，可供核查是否能用于向 VLM latent 状态注入结构或视觉先验，并作为表示保真度的诊断线索；但与视觉推理主线无直接关联，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models

**abstract/A1：** Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.

**comment/C1：** 40 pages. This is the originally submitted version. The final version, revised after peer review, is published in J. Chem. Inf. Model. (2026): https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.6c02225

### 268. [The Price of Not Planning: Parallel Sampling Depth Peaks at the Reconstruction Threshold](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21285

**作者：** Chuling Wen、Weijie Liang、Jian Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21285v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究带「计划」的并行解码何时能减少采样轮数：在广播树上把内部节点视为计划、叶子视为 token，用前向 KL 度量误差，给出无计划与有计划解码器所需轮数的下界，并分析计划单元大小 m 与能否达到对数深度的关系。

**相关性简评：** 其对计划粒度与并行采样深度、重建阈值附近收益的刻画，可能为 LVR 中 latent 计划的粒度选择与并行生成轮数/计算分配提供分析视角，可供核查这些结论能否迁出合成树模型。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Price of Not Planning: Parallel Sampling Depth Peaks at the Reconstruction Threshold

**abstract/A1：** Masked diffusion models sample the tokens of one round independently. Planned decoders first generate a coarse plan, then fill in the tokens in parallel. We ask when a plan saves rounds, how many it saves, and how fine it must be. We study this on broadcast trees: the leaves are the tokens, the internal nodes are the plan, and the edge correlation $θ$ sets how strongly tokens depend on the plan. Errors are measured by the forward Kullback-Leibler divergence $\\varepsilon$, and the lower bounds hold for every deterministic value-adaptive rule, also with learned conditionals. We show that a decoder without the plan needs of order $\\min\\{n,(n/\\varepsilon)^α\\}$ rounds below the reconstruction threshold, where $α=\\log b/(4\\log(1/θ))$ rises to $1/2$ at the threshold, and that the exponent stays below $1/2$ above it (binary channel: $0.02\\leθ\\le0.98$). With the plan, $\\log\_b n+1$ rounds suffice. In the binary model below the threshold, a plan with units of $m$ tokens needs of order $\\log\_b(n/m)+\\min\\{m,(n/\\varepsilon)^α\\}$ rounds, so it gives logarithmic depth exactly when $m$ is logarithmic. A plan therefore helps most near the threshold, and only if its units are small. Exact divergence computations in the Gaussian model with up to $2^{20}$ leaves confirm these exponents below the threshold.

</details>

### 269. [Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21299v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21299

**作者：** Yang Chen、Qianyi Wang、Ronghui Yang、Zhanhao Li、Yu Cong、Chen Zhang、Hangfan Zhang、Shao Zhang、Shuai Li、Toru Takisaka、Chao Xu、Yi Zhou、Zhihao Tang、Xiao Wang、Bo Zhang、Shuyue Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21299v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21299v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Turing Agent，一个面向研究级数学端到端形式化验证的 agent 编排框架，结合定理形式化与证明形式化两类 agent，并采用结构化证明分解、并行验证、累积证明经验与选择性语义审查，在理论计算机科学任务上优于通用编码 agent。

**相关性简评：** 其中「结构化分解—并行验证—选择性语义审查」的触发与成本控制设计，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的证据筛选、验证分配与何时投入昂贵核验提供可供核查的借鉴，但原文属纯文本形式化验证，迁移性尚不确定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Turing Agent: Agentic Formal Verification for Mathematical Research

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing mathematical discovery, moving beyond benchmark-level problem solving to tackle frontier research problems. This progress is ushering mathematics into an era of proof abundance, raising a fundamental challenge: how can we ensure the correctness of the ever-growing volume of AI-generated proofs and transform them into trustworthy, machine-verified mathematical knowledge? We introduce Turing Agent, an agent harness designed to orchestrate end-to-end formal verification of research-level mathematics. Its wo-scale architecture integrates theorem formalization and proof formalization agents, empowered by structured proof decomposition, parallel verification, accumulated proof experience, and selective semantic review. Leveraging our collaborations with theoretical computer science (TCS) researchers, we focus our evaluation on TCS, a particularly demanding domain characterized by intricate quantification, complex dependencies, and stringent semantic requirements. Against direct generation and general-purpose coding harnesses, including Codex CLI and Claude Code, Turing Agent achieves approximately 57-62% faithful formalization success on Formal TCS Bench and 83% overall pass@1 on a TCS-focused subset of RLMEval, using GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro. Notably, Turing Agent, built on DeepSeek, successfully completes the formal verification of three previously unresolved TCS tasks from OpenAI's October 2026 collection. One particularly challenging TCS problem required about a hundred formally verified auxiliary claims. Moreover, by actively exploring and refining the formalization process, Turing Agent can uncover simpler alternative proofs, expose unnecessary dependencies in original proofs, and generate reusable mathematical knowledge as a byproduct of verification.

</details>

### 270. [Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21302v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21302

**作者：** Arda Cinar Demirtas、Pablo Varela Bernal、Marc Pollefeys、Sunghwan Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21302v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21302v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Déjà-Events：仅用事件相机多视图，在单次前向中预测深度、位姿与 pointmap；通过让事件学生复现冻结 RGB 教师（Déjà View）的最终 token 做蒸馏，仅训练约 1% 参数，并引入按事件密度逐 patch 调整的自适应门控，使增加迭代细化步数时精度不降。

**相关性简评：** 其「重复共享 transformer 块细化 token + 按输入密度逐 patch 门控 + 以教师末层 token 作监督」可能为 LVR 的潜状态更新、证据稀疏时的动态计算与 latent 轨迹监督提供可核查线索，但属 3D 几何任务，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating

**abstract/A1：** Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 271. [Programmable Semantic Interventions: Learning Causal Carriers from Behavioral Programs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21307v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21307

**作者：** Paolo Muratore、Mackenzie Weygandt Mathis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21307v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21307v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Programmable Semantic Interventions：让研究者用「语义程序」直接声明变量可取答案及干预后应得答案，再据此学习一个低秩激活子空间，使其交换能按声明改变冻结模型的输出；在 MIB 上无需配对数据即可比肩监督对齐，并可实现无需 donor prompt 的引导控制。

**相关性简评：** 该工作用「干预应当改变哪个答案」来定位内部状态中的因果载体，可供核查如何验证 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否真正被答案使用，以及低秩子空间的语义坐标能否用于分离内容与位置等因素；但其对象为纯文本冻结网络与行为程序，尚无视觉或多模态验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Programmable Semantic Interventions: Learning Causal Carriers from Behavioral Programs

**abstract/A1：** Causal abstraction explains a frozen network by aligning its activations with the variables of a simpler, interpretable model, and checking that interventions on the two agree. Finding such an alignment currently requires a counterfactual dataset: for every pair of prompts, the answer the network ought to give once the variable has been changed. In practice, those labels are produced by an executable algorithm for the behavior, written before studying the model supposed to implement it. However, the criterion these methods optimize only leverages the answer an intervention should produce. Here, we develop an approach that lets the investigator define that relationship directly: the answers the variable can produce, and which of them an intervention should yield. We call this interface a semantic program and introduce Programmable Semantic Interventions (PSI): a low-rank activation subspace learned so that interchanging it changes the model's answer as the program declares, with the expected answers read from the frozen model itself. On the MIB benchmark PSI performs on par with supervised alignment at matched data and training budget, without curated pairs, and it needs no ground-truth labels; while on natural science questions with gold labels withheld, it tracks the model's own answers better than a subspace trained on gold labels. The declaration also fixes a coordinate system with known semantics, enabling donor-free steering: jointly training PSI for both localization and control realizes 94.8% of held-out requests for answers the investigator chooses, without the need for donor prompts.

**comment/C1：** https://adaptivemotorcontrollab.github.io/psi/

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can AI Mature a Model's Geometry? Training-Free Weight Baking in LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Can an AI make a trained language model more mature, in the sense of a better organized latent space, by looking only at the geometry of that space? An analyst model reads a fixed-size digest of topological descriptors of the layers of a frozen target and proposes a transformation, which closed-form ridge regression writes into the feed-forward weights without gradient training. Using lightweight models, 126 runs show that category purity rose on unseen words and sentences, benchmark accuracy stayed within sampling error, and the analyst matched a category-aware heuristic with gentler edits. In a five-model round robin approach, 16 pairs raised purity and four left the target unchanged. The results provide a baseline for future work on LLM-guided, training-free model editing without using raw weights.

</details>

### 273. [MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21339v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21339

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21339v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21339v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MovieRoll 提出面向长视频流式生成的 base-to-distilled 框架，包含窗口式 teacher forcing 基座训练、按层注意力模式分层压缩 KV-cache、以及长自 rollout 上平均局部梯度的蒸馏训练，并配合推理期 KV 重算与 guidance 退火以延长生成时长。

**相关性简评：** 其浅层保留全历史、深层保留 sink 与近期历史的缓存组织方式，以及长 rollout 中仅保留单个计算图并平均局部梯度的训练监督，可能为 latent 推理的状态缓存结构与长轨迹训练提供可供核查的线索，但任务属视频生成，迁移价值需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos

**abstract/A1：** Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.

</details>

**作者：** Suchit Gupte、Zhongteng Cai、Xueru Zhang、Mohammad Mahdi Khalili

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21348v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21348v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用稀疏自编码器（SAE）追踪连续五代自消耗训练（在模型自身生成文本上递归训练）中内部表示的变化，比较合成数据谱系与同设定真实数据对照组，考察旧 SAE 的零样本迁移、微调后的重构与稀疏性，并用稀疏探针检验任务相关信息是否仍集中于少数潜变量。

**相关性简评：** 其「重构保真不等于特征可用」与「任务信息由集中转向分散」的结论，可供核查以 SAE 之类的探针判断 LVR 内部状态是否保留视觉证据时是否存在同类误判；跨代 SAE 迁移与稀疏探针的流程也可能作为分析 latent 内容集中度的工具线索，但原文为纯文本设定，需自行迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Representational Change Under Self-Consuming Training: A Sparse Autoencoder Analysis

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly exposed to model-generated text, raising the possibility that future models will be trained recursively on the outputs of their predecessors. Prior work on such self-consuming training loops has largely focused on output quality and downstream performance, leaving their effects on internal representations poorly understood. We study how representations evolve across five generations of self-consumption and whether sparse autoencoders (SAEs) remain reliable under this shift. At each generation, we compare a lineage trained on synthetic data with a matched control trained on real data under the same training settings. We evaluate how well SAEs trained before self-consumption transfer to later generations, measuring reconstruction and sparsity across SAE widths, architectures, and model layers. We then fine-tune the original SAE on each generation and use sparse probing to test whether task-relevant information remains concentrated in a small number of latents or becomes more distributed across the representation. We find that zero-shot SAE performance degrades progressively under self-consumption, with growing reconstruction and sparsity gaps that vary substantially across layers. Fine-tuning largely restores reconstruction, but not feature-level usefulness: task-relevant information remains accessible in the full latent space while becoming less concentrated in individual features. These results show that self-consumption induces representational drift and that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient to establish that an adapted SAE remains equally useful for interpretation.

</details>

**title/T1：** ALIVE: Making Streaming Video Models Interactive

**abstract/A1：** Streaming video LLMs can continuously observe the world, yet often handle user requests in isolation. We introduce ALIVE, an interactive streaming video model supporting proactive monitoring, streaming task coordination, and feedback-seeking interaction. We construct ALIVE-SFT-288K and ALIVE-RL-3K for two-stage training. Contrastive supervised fine-tuning teaches when and how to respond, while reinforcement learning with Behavior-Aligned Credit Assignment (BACA) combines trajectory-level and local advantages to refine decisions, responses, and silence across multi-turn interactions. We also introduce FSI-Bench to evaluate feedback seeking and subsequent task completion. ALIVE achieves the highest overall scores among the compared models on four public benchmarks and FSI-Bench, demonstrating strong streaming understanding and interactive capabilities.

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21372v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21372v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CHORD，针对多模态对比学习中的「成对得分」缺陷，以校准的成对模型生成负样本诱饵并学习高阶残差，使三模态联合判别真正依赖所有模态，并在多模态对齐与检索任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其以残差衡量成对模型遗漏的高阶交互，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否仅凭成对关系即可被使用、以及内部表示是否保留任务必需的多实体联合信息；但论文不涉及推理期状态生成，属于方法线索借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning What Pairs Miss for Higher-Order Multimodal Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Contrastive learning beyond two modalities now scores the whole tuple with multilinear products, volumes, and fusion heads, critics that can represent the joint distribution. In practice these critics still behave like bags of pairs. Their negatives break at least two of the three pairs, a single pairwise check rejects them, and when most samples can be solved by pairs the higher-order term receives almost no gradient. To solve this problem, we propose CHORD (Contrastive Higher-Order Residuals with Decoys), which trains a residual against decoys drawn from a calibrated pairwise model, negatives that the pairwise model finds plausible, so that rejecting them often needs all three modalities. Drawing decoys costs one inner-product query over a memory bank, and the optimal residual is the log-ratio between the data and the pairwise model, so the decoy loss also bounds what that model misses. On M3-Mix, where one in ten training samples needs all three modalities, our CHORD improves accuracy on those samples by 21.2 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines. CHORD also gives the best two-to-one results on every real dataset, and its residual improves other retrievers without retraining.

</details>

### 277. [WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21373v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21373

**作者：** Yipeng Du、Yuxi Li、Ying Zhang、Chong Sun、Chen Li、Jing Lyu、Ying Tai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21373v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21373v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WeVisForensics，一个用于 AI 生成视频检测的 agent 框架：主调查 agent 调度可自我进化的视觉与音频取证子 agent，学习检查哪类伪影、在哪个时间窗检查以及何时收尾，并以双时间尺度策略优化 DTPO 同时更新两层 agent，配合 ForenCue-30K 标注与轨迹数据。

**相关性简评：** 其「检查何种证据、取何窗口、何时停止」的策略学习及两层 agent 间的共享反馈与贡献分配，可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选、停止决策与监督分配的借鉴线索，但对象是视频取证检测而非内部推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.

</details>

### 278. [Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21412v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21412

**作者：** Kabir Hamzah Muhammad、Lorena Garcia-Foncillas Macias、Soumya Snigdha Kundu、Emily Guilhem、Jon Cleary、Amal Saleh Nour、Yodit Abraham Yaynishet、Chinasa Kalaiwo、Peter Chibuta、Ugumba Kwikima、Udunna Anazodo、Jonathan Shapey、Tom Vercauteren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21412v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21412v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MS-HVED，一个序列无关的多栈脑 MRI 超分框架：把不同朝向的可用堆栈独立编码为多尺度高斯后验，以视野感知的 Product-of-Gaussians 融合并抑制无覆盖区域的贡献，再用物理引导的域随机化模拟偏斜、部分覆盖和伪影；并在尼日利亚队列的盲评中与监督基线比较。

**相关性简评：** 其按视野覆盖加权、限制无支撑区域贡献的不确定性融合思路，可能可供核查如何用于 LVR 中多视角/部分可见视觉证据的可信度加权，以及抑制在缺乏证据处凭空生成的细节。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort

**abstract/A1：** High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p&lt;.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p&lt;.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 14 figures

</details>

### 279. [Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21419v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21419

**作者：** Nhi Nguyen、Le Nguyen、Manuel Lage Cañellas、Miguel Bordallo López、Constantino Álvarez Casado

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21419v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21419v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在四个公开数据集上系统比较 11 种无参考信号质量指标与 8 种方法间相似度度量，用于融合 7 种心率与 10 种呼吸率提取器，并以等权平均、常数速率预测、预先/事后最佳单一方法及逐窗 oracle 加置换零假设为对照；结果显示质量加权对心率有效，对呼吸率无效，相似度加权未优于平均。

**相关性简评：** 逐窗无参考质量指标与相似度加权来挑选、融合多个估计器的做法，可供核查 LVR 中多候选 latent 假设与视觉证据的筛选和加权；其「相似度加权不优于等权平均」的负结果可能提示 latent 相似度需与内容可靠性区分，属跨领域方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Quality and Similarity Indicators for Video-Based Heart Rate and Respiratory Rate Fusion: A Controlled Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Camera-based heart rate (HR) and respiratory rate (RR) estimates vary in reliability from window to window, and a common remedy is to fuse several extraction methods with weights from reference-free signal quality indicators. However, few studies test whether these indicators identify the most accurate method in each window or outperform simpler fusion. We evaluate 11 quality indicators and 8 inter-method similarity measures for fusing 7 HR and 10 RR extractors on four public datasets (75 test subjects). Filters, indicator directions, weighting parameters and a learned ridge baseline are selected on a separate five-subject set before testing. Fusion is compared with equal averaging, a constant typical-rate predictor, the best single method selected in advance and in hindsight, and a per-window oracle with a permutation-based null, using subject-level bootstrap confidence intervals. For HR, quality-weighted fusion reduced mean absolute error by 10.9% \[5.2, 18.4\] relative to averaging and by 15.6% \[8.1, 23.1\] relative to the method selected in advance, and was statistically indistinguishable from the best method selected in hindsight. Weighting methods by their agreement did not improve on averaging. For RR, the indicators could not identify the more accurate estimates: sharpened quality weighting increased error (-2.6% \[-4.8, -0.8\]), fused estimates were uncorrelated with the reference (r &lt;= 0.22), and averaging was less accurate than the typical-rate predictor (-3.1% \[-6.1, -0.4\]). With a second respiratory reference, apparent RR gains reflected estimates moving toward its typical rate. Quality-guided fusion is worthwhile for video HR; for RR, 30-s windows improved estimates but not fusion.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables; with 14 pages supplementary material included

</details>

### 280. [Emergent Steering Beyond Endpoint Alignment in Chemical Reaction Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21423v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21423

**作者：** Yili Shen、Kehan Guo、Haomin Zhuang、Xiangliang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21423v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21423v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 UniRxnAxis，把正向与逆合成统一为共享潜空间中的方向条件端点重分配，并将编码器源态 S0 到解码器态 S1 的位移分解为与端点平行的分量和正交残差（称为 emergent steering），用随机轴、打乱与原型对照检验其功能作用，并据此给出模型侧失败分类。

**相关性简评：** 其把 latent 状态更新拆为任务对齐与正交分量、并配对照干预来检验该更新是否真正承载答案信息，可能可供核查 LVR 中每个 latent 步是贡献推理内容还是仅作接口旁路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Emergent Steering Beyond Endpoint Alignment in Chemical Reaction Models

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning models for chemical reaction prediction are usually evaluated by endpoint accuracy, but endpoint correctness alone does not reveal how a model represents chemical transformation or why it fails. We introduce UniRxnAxis, a unified forward-retrosynthesis framework that models both tasks as direction-conditioned endpoint redistribution in a shared latent space. By aligning source states, transformed states, and encoded target endpoints, UniRxnAxis enables directional auditing of learned latent updates. This shared latent geometry allows the learned displacement (from the encoder source state $S\_0$ to the decoder-facing transformed state $S\_1$) to be decomposed into an endpoint-parallel component and an endpoint-orthogonal residual, which we call emergent steering. Our evaluation shows that emergent steering is functionally important: in retrosynthesis, it recovers most of the model's utility, remains effective under random, shuffled, and prototype controls, and directly affects which bond edits are promoted or suppressed. The residual-over-parallel ordering persists across alignment strengths, after decoder-interface calibration, against angle-matched random axes, and in a second graph-edit architecture, although its magnitude depends on the reference axis and optimization. The decomposition also supports a proxy taxonomy of model-side failures, showing how reaction models can be audited beyond endpoint accuracy.

</details>

### 281. [Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21432v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21432

**作者：** Matteo Fischetti

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21432v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21432v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察秩一权重编辑去除小型推理模型「思考循环」时是否需要求解稀疏 LP：改为按激活变异系数挑出 8 个神经元并均分推力，在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上取得 67.0%，与 LP 版 67.4% 的非劣检验通过，并据此认为该编辑近似为沿循环方向的常数偏置。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本、无视觉成分，但「循环方向 + 秩一编辑」以及按激活统计挑神经元的做法，可能为 LVR 中循环计算状态的定位与抑制提供可核查的干预线索；其「近似常数偏置」结论也提示 loop 收益可能与偏置项混淆，需在 latent 贡献分配上另行核验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Just sort it! A note on the LP behind rank-one anti-loop edits

**abstract/A1：** Weight-space programming removes the thinking loops of a small reasoning model by a rank-one edit W' = W + u v^T of an MLP output matrix, where u is a loop direction and v is the solution of a sparse Linear Program (LP) over the neuron activations. We investigate whether the LP is needed. We replace it by a sort: we take the 8 neurons whose activation has the smallest coefficient of variation, and give them equal shares of the push that the LP solution realizes. On Qwen3.5-0.8B the sorted edit scores 67.0% on 1000 problems (MATH-500 and GSM8K) against 67.4% for the LP edit and 9.5% for the unedited model; the paired difference is -0.4 points, with 95% confidence interval \[-2.9, +2.1\], inside a non-inferiority margin of 5 points declared before the runs. On three further sampling seeds the difference is -0.6 points, interval \[-2.0, +0.8\], and -0.8 points, interval \[-2.3, +0.6\], when the dose is set without the LP. The sort does not solve the LP, but the neurons it shares with the LP solution carry most of its mean push. The outcome is that, on this model, the edit acts as a nearly constant bias along u.

**comment/C1：** 4 pages, 3 tables. Data, code and protocols: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24286137

</details>

### 282. [A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21439v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21439

**作者：** Jacky Kumar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、hep-ex、hep-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21439v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21439v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 本文将 SMEFT 算符空间的探索建模为序列决策问题，用约 4 万参数的小型 actor-critic 策略逐步构造多算符理论，目标不是单一最优拟合，而是在 132 个观测量下发现一组多样且高质量的假设，并以随机子集与随机序列搜索作对照。

**相关性简评：** 其「序列决策逐步构建假设 + 多样性奖励 + 搜索基线对照」可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的搜索、筛选与贡献分配提供方法线索，但跨领域迁移是否可行需核查奖励设计与假设表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space

**abstract/A1：** In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models. However, exploring the enormous space of possible SMEFT operators rapidly becomes a challenging combinatorial problem: many operators can contribute simultaneously to different observables, their effects are correlated, and distinct operator combinations can provide comparably good descriptions of the data. In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL). Our RL agent employs a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters in total. Rather than searching for a single best-fit theory, our method is designed to discover a diverse set of high-quality theory hypotheses. We test the method in a complex phenomenological environment comprising 132 observables across several sectors of particle physics, including 24 measurements that deviate from their SM predictions by more than $1.5σ$. We show that the learned RL policy efficiently constructs multi-operator theories that substantially improve the global fit. Comparisons with independent random-subset and random-sequential searches demonstrate the ability of the RL policy to navigate this large combinatorial space. Our results establish RL as a systematic framework for exploring diverse patterns of new physics (NP) interactions within SMEFT.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 3 figures, GitHub Link: https://github.com/jackypheno/ReinforceSMEFT

</details>
