### 283. [\[CLS\] and \[EOS\] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21440v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21440

**作者：** Hao Sun、Tao Hu、Shixiong Kai、Siyuan Xu、Wenqian Zhao、Mingxuan Yuan、Da-Wei Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21440v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21440v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 CLIP 类增量学习，指出仅用 \[CLS\]/\[EOS\] 全局表示不足，提出 PACE：依据全局表示选出 top-k 关键视觉 patch 与文本 token，用跨模态融合模块互增强，并以投影式参数更新缓解遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 其「全局 token 不足以承载局部细节」的判断与基于全局相似度筛选关键 patch/token 的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与细节保留提供线索；但属分类式增量学习，无推理期状态生成，迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** \[CLS\] and \[EOS\] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning

**abstract/A1：** Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to empower models to continuously acquire new knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. With the advent of vision-language models like CLIP, leveraging their cross-modal alignment capabilities to address CIL challenges has emerged as a dominant paradigm. Existing methods leverage CLIP's global representations (i.e., the visual \[CLS\] token and the textual \[EOS\] token) for cross-modal alignment. While achieving effective classification, they overlook the rich patch-level visual features and token-level textual semantics inherent in CLIP. For example, the \[CLS\] token aggregates local information to capture the general concept of "cat", while the patch-level details retain specific localized features essential for recognition, such as the tail, fur, and face. We propose PACE (PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement) to uncover the long-neglected local representations within CLIP. First, based on the global representations like \[CLS\] token and \[EOS\] token, we identify the top-k most crucial visual patches and textual tokens. Subsequently, to better utilize the extracted key local features, we design a cross-modal fusion module. This module leverages local textual semantics to refine visual representations, while augmenting textual semantics with local visual features. As the fusion module is shared across all tasks, directly fine-tuning it on new tasks would interfere with the knowledge learned from previous tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To alleviate this, we employ a projection-based update strategy to effectively preserve the critical parameter space of previous tasks during the adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple CIL benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to TMM. Code is available at: https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/PACE

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 MotionSpeech 基准，并提出 DuoFlow 双流 latent flow transformer，在共享噪声水平与统一秒级时间坐标下联合去噪语音与动作，配合层级双向跨模态注意力与 CTC 音素路径实现细粒度控制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control

**abstract/A1：** An embodied speaker's expressiveness depends not only on what is said, but also on how the voice sounds and how the body moves. However, existing joint speech-motion generation models are largely driven implicitly by transcript semantics or intermediate speech representations, offering little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style. To bridge this gap, we construct MotionSpeech, a structured benchmark for controllable joint speech-motion generation that includes transcripts, voice-style descriptions, and motion conditions at two hierarchical levels. Building on this benchmark, we propose DuoFlow, a dual-stream latent flow transformer that jointly denoises speech and motion under a shared noise level and a unified second-based temporal coordinate. Modality-specific residual connectors inject structured conditions into the corresponding streams, layer-wise bidirectional cross-modal attention coordinates their generation, and a monotonic phoneme pathway combines normalized progress anchors with CTC supervision to strengthen speech temporal modeling. DuoFlow provides a unified interface for fine-grained motion and vocal-style control and demonstrates the ability to synthesize high-quality, synchronized, and instruction-consistent speech-motion sequences.

</details>

### 285. [Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21559v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21559

**作者：** Sheng Zhao、Haitian Zheng、Weikai Lin、Junjie Zhao、Yuhao Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21559v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21559v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究长视频生成中的主体与背景漂移问题，提出 Reference Forcing：以首帧为外观参考，先用分割模型配合注意力掩码构造区域对齐的教师，再蒸馏到学生的额外注意力路径，并对 KV cache 中的漂移值做参考校正。

**相关性简评：** 其「把漂移的 KV 缓存值拉回无漂移参考帧对应值」与区域级注意对齐，或可作为 LVR 中长程 latent 状态需定期锚定视觉证据、抑制状态漂移的机制线索，但属视频生成场景，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction

**abstract/A1：** Long video generation should keep the subject and background consistent while supporting rich, natural motion. However, autoregressive models are often distilled with distribution matching distillation (DMD) over short windows, which does not train them to keep this consistency over long ranges. As a result, the subject and background can drift over time. Methods that manage the key-value (KV) cache retain or retrieve history to reduce drift. Yet this history may itself have drifted. We propose Reference Forcing, which uses the initial frames as an appearance reference. We first build a teacher that uses attention masks to force each region of a new frame to attend to the same region in the initial frames. The teacher finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation models. We then distill this behavior into a separate attention path of the student, which needs no external models at inference. We further introduce value correction, which corrects drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of drift-free initial frames. Experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency among long-video methods on different base models, and its advantage grows with video length. Ablations show both components are needed to gain consistency without losing motion. More visualizations and code are available at https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/

</details>

### 286. [Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21597v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21597

**作者：** Awni Altabaa、John Lafferty、Omar Montasser

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21597v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21597v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 从长度为 T 的 CoT 演示中学习自回归下一 token 生成器，提出基于 bagging 的多数投票算法：在自助采样上训练 CoT 一致的生成器并集成，证明二值 token 下样本复杂度为 O((d\_VC+log(1/δ))/ε)、与 CoT 长度 T 无关，多类情形以 Graph 维替代并多出 log\|Σ\| 因子，且可将集成蒸馏回单个生成器。

**相关性简评：** 其「样本复杂度与 CoT 长度无关」的结论可供核查 LVR 中长轨迹监督成本、贡献分配与长度泛化的理论预期，集成蒸馏也可视为一种监督信号压缩线索；但研究对象是纯文本 AR 生成，不涉及视觉证据筛选或推理期 latent 状态，迁移需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimal Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought Learning via Bagging

**abstract/A1：** We study how to learn an autoregressive next-token generator $f\\colonΣ^\\star\\toΣ$ from a class $\\mathcal{F}$, given chain-of-thought (CoT) demonstrations of length $T$ generated by $f$. We present a simple algorithm based on bagging, which outputs a majority vote of generators that are trained to be CoT-consistent on bootstrap samples of the training data. For binary token sets, it achieves the optimal sample complexity of $O((d\_{\\mathrm{VC}}+\\log(1/δ))/ε)$, independent of the CoT length $T$, where $d\_{\\mathrm{VC}}$ is the VC dimension of $\\mathcal{F}$. For finite token sets $Σ$, the VC dimension is replaced by a multiclass analogue, the Graph dimension $d\_{\\mathrm{G}}$, and the sample complexity is optimal up to a $\\log\|Σ\|$ factor. The number of generators in the majority-vote ensemble is $O(\\log(T/δ))$, and we show that the ensemble can be distilled into a single generator in $\\mathcal{F}$ at the expense of $n\\log(nT)$ unlabeled prompts.

</details>

### 287. [FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21604v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21604

**作者：** Siran Peng、Tianshuo Zhang、Yibo Xue、Ajian Liu、Haoyuan Zhang、Weisong Zhao、Shuhuan Chen、Xiangyu Zhu、Zhen Lei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21604v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21604v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FaceJev：让 MLLM 对八个面部区域分别回答独立的二分类问题，共享一次图像编码，并从原生答案 logits 读取异常概率，任一部分异常即判为伪造；同时构建 PartForensics 数据并用 FS-GRPO 优化各部位决策。

**相关性简评：** 面部伪造检测属特定应用任务，但其「跳过文本解释、直接从答案 logits 取部位级视觉判断」以及按决策粒度做奖励比较的做法，可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正使用视觉证据、以及如何监督细粒度证据判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection

**abstract/A1：** Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.

</details>

### 288. [Latent Lattice Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21608v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21608

**作者：** Shivam Duggal、Zongze Wu、William T. Freeman、Antonio Torralba、Richard Zhang、Eli Shechtman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21608v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21608v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「Latent Lattice」架构：在纵向残差流之外加入逐层、沿时间递归的横向潜状态流，使其持续跨 token 存在，并直接条件注意力、KV-cache 写入、MLP 与解码；在 20B FineWeb-Edu 上以困惑度和多种架构变体验证其收益。

**相关性简评：** 其持久化逐层 latent state 与递归状态更新，可能为 LVR 的工作区状态维持和多假设保持提供架构线索；但工作纯文本、未涉及视觉推理，需核查这些状态是否承载可用的推理内容而非仅作序列记忆。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Lattice Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream's attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. These results identify persistent per-layer state as a complementary axis for scaling language-model computation.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://shivamduggal4.github.io/latent-lattice-language-model/

</details>

### 289. [SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18639v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18639

**作者：** Zichen Zhu、Dingye Liu、Nan Jiang、Danyang Zhang、Hang Zheng、Shijie Zheng、Situo Zhang、Kunyao Lan、Yingzi Ma、Sheng Jiang、Lu Chen、Kai Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18639v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18639v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SynthDCB，通过「世界蒸馏」把设备行为、交互约束与环境效应转成模块化可执行组件，组合成带显式状态、动作与时间动态的交互世界，用于构建可扩展的设备控制基准，并以状态正确性和工具调用轨迹评价模型。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其显式世界状态与轨迹校验的评测方式、以及可行性诊断和时间协调的错误分析，可能为核查 latent 状态是否被使用、以及停止与可行性决策的评价设计提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking

**abstract/A1：** Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both the worlds agents interact with and the tasks they must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation. World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, interaction constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components, which are composed into interactive worlds with explicit states, actions, and temporal dynamics. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis, allowing new capabilities to enter evaluation through a shared construction pipeline. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone domains with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. The stateful design enables task validation and agent evaluation through state correctness and tool-call traces. We evaluate seven models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 68.2% Pass@1. Error analysis reveals challenges in answer delivery, feasibility diagnosis, and temporal coordination. Construction experiments demonstrate scalability across domains and token efficiency: world distillation reduces token consumption by 0.9-66.0% and 46.2-92.5% relative to Codex with low and xhigh reasoning effort, respectively, while achieving broader capability coverage. SynthDCB makes executable world construction the basis of scalable device-control benchmarking, connecting an expanding space of capabilities and interactions to verifiable agent evaluation.

**comment/C1：** 65 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables. Details and access are available at: https://github.com/X-LANCE/SynthDCB

</details>

### 290. [SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18640

**作者：** Ludovic Moncla、Antoine Salazar、Yassir Lairgi、Khalid Benabdeslem、Rémy Cazabet

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18640v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18640v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 SERAG，一种知识图谱异常的监督检测器：分别用语义编码得到主谓宾三要素的文本合理性分数、用关系图卷积网络得到关系语境分数，标准化校准后融合；在 ICEWS18 子集上用 LLM 生成的合成异常验证融合优于单分支。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「局部语义合理性 + 关系语境一致性」双信号校准融合的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选或内部状态与关系语境一致性的判别方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge graphs constructed from text can contain facts that are individually plausible yet inconsistent with their relational context. We introduce SERAG, a supervised anomaly detector that combines two complementary plausibility estimates: a semantic score computed from separately encoded subject, relation, and object labels, and a relational score obtained through a relational graph convolutional network. The scores are standardized, calibrated, and fused. We evaluate the method on a subset of ICEWS18 with vocabulary-constrained synthetic anomalies generated by an LLM, using pooled and chronological splits. At 10% anomaly prevalence, SERAG achieves test AUPRCs of 0.321 and 0.258, respectively, compared with 0.159 and 0.146 for the strongest adapted baseline. Fusion improves mean test AUPRC over either branch alone, with a larger gain in the pooled protocol and a smaller validation-selected gain in the chronological protocol. Additional anomaly supervision improves performance. These results support the complementarity of textual and relational signals for detecting synthetic anomalies under the evaluated protocols.

</details>

### 291. [Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18647v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18647

**作者：** Davide Mambelli、Alessandro Rozza、Steven Motta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18647v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18647v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究模型集成中候选模型的筛选问题，利用残差几何分层与乐观二次规划实现可证明的提前拒绝，以减少对候选模型的推理调用，并在两个 LLM 面板上评估节省调用与筛选准确率的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其基于损失与残差对齐的提前拒绝和计算价值判据，可能为 LVR 中「是否继续推理/停止」及动态计算分配提供可核查的借鉴，但对象是集成成员筛选而非视觉 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Screen Before You Add: Reducing Candidate Inference in Model Ensembles

**abstract/A1：** As new models become available, existing ensembles must be updated to be competitive, making them intrinsically dynamic. Deciding whether to add a candidate model can require inference on an entire annotated dataset. Such a screening becomes prohibitive for models with costly inference especially when they ultimately add no value. Even under simple convex aggregation, relying on benchmark scores can be misleading as strong standalone performance does not guarantee ensemble improvement, and fitted ensemble weights can hurt test performance. In this work, we study candidate screening and show how early rejection can be achieved safely, exploiting residual geometry for stratification and rejecting the candidate when the best possible remaining predictions cannot achieve the necessary improvement. The key result that justifies this approach is that, under convex aggregation and squared or Brier loss, the population optimum improves if and only if a candidate induces a prediction change positively aligned with the residuals of the population-optimal existing ensemble. An optimistic quadratic program (QP) provides certified early rejection, while posterior-scenario sampling offers an alternative heuristic. We evaluate the approach by showing the tradeoff between saved calls and screening accuracy, which refers to recovering the same accept/reject result as for the entire annotated dataset. We assess empirically whether full-dataset decisions predict candidate usefulness on a held-out test set. On two LLM panels, stratified screening with certified QP rejection saves 21-23% of candidate calls while keeping 100% screening accuracy. In our experiments, sampling posterior scenarios further increases call savings to approximately 37%, with a loss of less than one percentage point in screening accuracy.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables, including appendices

</details>

### 292. [Stagewise Adaptive Boosting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18662v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18662

**作者：** Valerie R. Fu、Brayden Lu、Lu Tian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18662v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18662v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 stagewise adaptive boosting 框架：每步按结构偏好从候选更新中挑选一个，构造单调解路径，以在路径上实现稀疏、分组选择、多输出模型相似性及预测变量先验顺序等约束，并用理论与模拟、真实数据分析评估。

**相关性简评：** 距离视觉推理较远，但其「逐步选择与结构偏好一致的更新、路径长度即稀疏程度」的思路，可能为 latent 推理中的状态更新筛选与少步即足够（STOP）偏好提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stagewise Adaptive Boosting

**abstract/A1：** Stagewise algorithms and sparsity-inducing regularization are two influential approaches to high-dimensional modeling. Existing stagewise theory, however, largely centers on convex regularization, whereas stronger sparsity and other structural preferences are often pursued through fixed-level nonconvex optimization rather than generating an entire adaptive solution path. We develop stagewise adaptive boosting, a general framework that builds a monotone path by selecting the update consistent with structural preference. The framework can encourage sparsity along the path itself and also admits extensions that promote other properties of the solution, including group selection, similarity across models for multiple outcomes, and known priorities or prerequisite relations among predictors. We study its theoretical property as well as finite sample performance using simulations and real-data analyses. Across these studies, the proposed pathwise approach often achieves predictive performance comparable to commonly used baselines while selecting substantially smaller models. These results suggest that adaptive stagewise learning provides a practical route to stronger sparsity and richer structural control without repeatedly solving separate weighted or nonconvex optimization problems.

</details>

### 293. [Thinking from Another Side of the Box: Spacetime Images for Computer Vision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18671v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18671

**作者：** Jade Lambert、Sébastien Piérard、Anthony Cioppa、Marc Van Droogenbroeck

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18671v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18671v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该立场论文提出以时空图像（STI）——沿帧以外的任意像素集合切片视频体得到的表示——作为计算机视觉的通用输入，并讨论其内容解读、标注迁移、运动表现及两个初步实验。

**相关性简评：** 其将视频切片方式视为可设计变量，并据频谱选择切面完成相机运动估计，可能为 LVR 中任务相关的视觉证据筛选与输入表示选择提供概念启发，但未涉及 latent 状态、VLM 推理或生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Thinking from Another Side of the Box: Spacetime Images for Computer Vision

**abstract/A1：** Computer vision methods for video understanding, such as object detection and tracking, inherit the way videos are captured and displayed: as successive frames processed sequentially. However, a video is an inhomogeneous 2D+time volume of pixels, named voxels, and frames are only one family of cuts through it. In this frame-based representation, static backgrounds introduce computational redundancy, and motion can only be understood across several frames. In this position paper, we study another family of cuts: spacetime images (STIs), obtained by sampling any set of pixels other than frames, for instance a line of pixels followed over time. Such images are familiar in narrow forms, from line-scan inspection and kymographs to spatiotemporal slices for motion analysis, but have received little attention as a general input representation for computer vision and are often limited to (x,t) or (y,t) cuts. We define new cuts leading to STIs in their general form, explain how to read their content, and show that a family of cuts tiles the video so that existing dense annotations transfer at no cost. We also detail how motion appears in an STI, spatially and in the frequency domain, and discuss applications such as walking pedestrians, deposited objects, and dynamic scenes. Two pilot experiments illustrate the representation. The first trains a segmentation network entirely in the spacetime domain, on transferred annotations, and performs background subtraction on CDnet 2014 close to supervised frame-based methods, without explicit temporal modeling. The second recovers the pan speed of a camera as a moving cut, identified by a simple criterion on the frequency spectrum of the resulting image, turning a temporal estimation problem into the choice of a cut. Our position is not that STIs should replace frames, but that slicing the video volume is a design variable worth studying in its own right.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, 42 references

</details>

### 294. [Exists, Valid: Calibrated Validity of Stored 3D Geometry Across Long Observation Gaps](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18672v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18672

**作者：** Anwaar Ulhaq

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18672v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18672v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将「被观测过」「仍然存在」与「几何仍然有效」区分开，用覆盖持续、修改、生长、移除、替换五类转移的概率滤波，结合形状残差与 LiDAR 自由空间证据，对长期未重访的存储 3D 几何给出校准后的有效性判断，并用于重测优先级排序。

**相关性简评：** 该工作把「状态是否仍然有效」与「是否被观测」解耦并做校准，可能为 LVR 中 latent 是否仍由当前视觉证据支撑、何时需重新 LOOK 或 STOP 提供问题表述与评价思路，尚需核查其转移先验与主动重观测策略的可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exists, Valid: Calibrated Validity of Stored 3D Geometry Across Long Observation Gaps

**abstract/A1：** Repeated airborne LiDAR surveys are costly, while stored 3D geometry can become outdated between observations. Existing change-detection methods compare observed epochs. However, they do not quantify the validity of geometry that has not been revisited. We distinguish observation, existence and geometric validity using a probabilistic filter over five geometric transitions: persistence, modification, growth, removal and replacement. The framework learns class-specific continuous-time transition priors from interval-censored observations and combines shape residuals with LiDAR free-space evidence. Functional anchors enable prior sharing across sites with different survey frequencies. In controlled experiments with misspecified dynamics and 60% visibility, our method reduces combined error from 36.9% to 16.5% and expected calibration error (ECE) from 0.19-0.32 to 0.017. Cross-site sharing reduces ECE at two-survey sites from 0.156 to 0.029. On Urb3DCD-v2, the method achieves 9.8% combined error and 0.016 ECE, outperforming baselines at 12.6% and at least 0.070, respectively. Re-survey prioritisation improves only modestly over random selection with two observations. Code and an evaluation protocol are released at https://github.com/anwaarua/life4d.

**comment/C1：** 3 Pages, 1 Figure

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18690

**作者：** Chenzhi Zheng、Zhuoran Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18690v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18690v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作让 LLM 依据架构代码、部分权重、激活摘要与采样预览，在无干净参考图条件下编辑扩散超分 U-Net 的少量权重，并比较不同模型作为编辑器与人工盲评的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「反馈指标上升但未见场景变差」的观察与受限更新后独立评估的做法，可能为 latent 推理中代理奖励驱动的轨迹训练与泛化评价提供核查线索，但领域与推理期状态机制无关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Perceptual Weight Space Programming for Diffusion Super-Resolution

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models for image super-resolution can recover scene content while producing distracting artifacts or unbalanced colors. We study whether a large language model (LLM) can improve perceptual quality by editing a small subset of existing U-Net weights without a clean reference image. The proposed framework provides the editor with architecture code, selected weights, activation summaries, and sampling previews. It permits up to 1,020 candidate trials while limiting accepted changes to three layers and fewer than 0.1\\% of model parameters. The evaluation protocol uses ResShift, SinSR, and SUPIR and compares GPT-6 Astra with a specified Qwen3-VL model under matched access. Feedback metrics guide editing, while separate quality metrics and blinded human comparisons evaluate the final weights. We also report an executed color calibration experiment using real photographs and two small residual networks. This experiment demonstrates correction of a fixed color shift and reveals that an improving feedback score can accompany worse performance on unseen scenes. A separate lightweight super-resolution experiment isolates modest changes in luminance detail while preserving color. The findings motivate restricted updates and independent evaluation of perceptual weight editing.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18707

**作者：** Bryceton Bible、Hairong Qi、Masahiro Toyoura

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18707v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18707v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文利用一年期的富士山网络摄像头与气象观测档案，比较季节气候、当日图像与目标日数值预报在不同预报时程上对能见度预测的贡献，并比较按日期分组、前向时间等切分方式对评估结论的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其按时间尺度拆解并量化「当前视觉证据」增益的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉信息是否被真正使用及贡献分配，而「目标日预报可用时视觉无增益」与现有表示丢失云几何和运动，也与视觉旁路和信息坍缩问题相似。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Different Timescales, Different Signals: Multimodal Landmark-Visibility Prediction in a Long-Term Webcam Network

**abstract/A1：** Scenic visibility is not a single forecasting problem: planning a trip months ahead, deciding whether to go outside today, and judging whether tomorrow will be clear rely on different information. Using a year-scale multimodal archive of Mount Fuji webcams and meteorological observations, we identify a clear hierarchy across timescales. Seasonal climatology provides useful long-range guidance, webcam imagery is the strongest same-day observation (AUC 0.95), and the numerical forecast valid on the target day carries most of the day-specific signal one to three days ahead. Revealing this hierarchy requires evaluation that respects the dependence among cameras observing the same regional weather state: permissive splits substantially overstate multi-day performance, while date-grouped and forward-in-time evaluation reduce the apparent contribution of the current scene and current weather. On 6,575 camera-days, the current visual summary provides no measurable one-day gain once the target-day forecast is available. The remaining opportunity lies at shorter horizons, where the present visual representation discards cloud geometry and motion. These results recast scenic visibility prediction as a multi-timescale sensing problem rather than a single multimodal forecasting task.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to the MM4SciReal Workshop at ACCV 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 审计无源域自适应 flow-matching 医学分割流程的两道质量门——伪标签往返过滤与体积 Dice：在 120 例 AMOS CT 上发现整层漏检脾脏的样本大量通过过滤、且被体积指标掩盖，并提出免模型修复方法 Chain-and-Fill。

**相关性简评：** 「往返过滤因复现同一漏检而失效」「体积 Dice 只看漏多少不看漏在哪里」这一诊断可能启发 LVR 中针对视觉证据整体缺失的验证门与停止判据设计，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Whole-Slice Misses Escape Round-Trip Filtering and Volumetric Dice in a Source-Free Flow-Matching Segmenter

**abstract/A1：** SymmAdapt, a source-free flow-matching segmentation pipeline, relies on two quality gates: a round-trip filter on pseudo-labels and volumetric Dice in evaluation. We audit both on 120 AMOS CT patients unseen in training and adaptation. The model often misses the spleen on whole slices, severely so in 30.0% of patients. The round-trip filter passes 83.31% of these lost slices, because its round trip reproduces the miss and the filter scores only organs present in the pseudo-label. Volumetric Dice depends on how much volume is missed, not where, and self-training leaves 96.5% of lost slices lost (96.6% on a second noise stream). A model-free repair, Chain-and-Fill, met all pre-registered endpoints on 119 further patients and could not be distinguished from SAM 2 propagation in severe-group gain, with 1/357 rather than 63/357 harmed patient-seed pairs. Reporting lost slices next to volumetric Dice makes the error visible at no cost.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 298. [T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18715v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18715

**作者：** Qingsong Xie、Yanlin Fei、Nazhou Liu、Jiacheng Tang、Madalina Ciobanu、Navan Preet Singh、Qingqing Mao、Ritankar Das

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18715v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18715v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 T2T 自动化流水线，把无标注的软件教学视频转为带截图、定位动作和分段边界的可执行 GUI 交互轨迹，并生成导航、规划、前向动态、定位等多任务训练视图，用于微调 Qwen3-VL-8B。

**相关性简评：** 其「无标注视频→分段证据筛选→定位与动作归一化→多任务视图」的流程可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、前向动态式状态监督与轨迹训练提供数据构造参考，但本身不研究 latent 推理状态，联系需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** T2T Technical Report: Synthesizing GUI Agent Trajectories at Scale from Video Tutorials

**abstract/A1：** Training generalist GUI agents requires large volumes of interaction trajectories comprising screenshot sequences paired with grounded UI actions, yet collecting such data through human demonstration is expensive and difficult to scale. Although public software tutorial videos contain rich operational demonstrations, their continuous pixel streams lack discrete action boundaries, semantic intents, and precise spatial coordinates, making them difficult to use directly for model training. To address this, we present T2T (Tutorial-to-Trajectory), a fully automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI agent trajectories at scale. T2T spans desktop, web, and mobile platforms to convert unannotated video tutorials into structured, executable interaction trajectories. To guarantee trajectory quality, T2T combines active segment filtering, keyframe identification via localized UI change, shortcut-free observation frame selection, presence-aware grounding, and two-stage action-space normalization. These refined trajectories are then converted into multi-task training views spanning navigation, planning, forward dynamics, and grounding. We fine-tune Qwen3-VL-8B on a subset of the more than one million human-annotation-free training samples generated by this pipeline. Evaluations show that the model achieves consistent gains across multiple benchmarks covering desktop, web, and mobile environments, including OSWorld-G, ScreenSpot-Pro, AndroidControl, and AgentNetBench, indicating improved core capabilities in grounding, step-level instruction execution, and trajectory-level decision-making. Notably, all gains are achieved without any in-distribution training data from target domains. Learning exclusively from trajectories extracted from public videos via the T2T pipeline, the model exhibits cross-application and cross-task generalization capabilities.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 在冻结的 Sparse4D 多视角检测器之上，为多摄像头 3D 跟踪加入类别的多尺度输入源选择、把 3D 框投影到各标定视角匹配 2D 行人检测以聚合轨迹级 re-ID 描述子，以及带时间排斥与 3D 可达性硬约束的因果短间隙拼接加离线聚类，用于缓解身份碎片化。

**相关性简评：** 多尺度证据选择与「几何投影匹配 2D 检测再聚合描述子」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节筛选、证据与内部状态绑定提供可核查线索；但论文主体是检测后关联与身份整理工程，与 latent 推理状态的生成和使用距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Detection Is Not the Finish Line: Multiscale Decoding and Constraint-Aware Global Association for Multi-Camera 3D Tracking

**abstract/A1：** A query-based multi-view 3D detector can transfer well to a new calibrated camera network and still produce badly fragmented tracks: on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 validation set, the frozen Sparse4D detector behind the official challenge winner splits each Person identity into a median of eight fragments, and half of the gaps between fragments exceed the horizon of a causal tracker. We show that most of the remaining headroom of such a system lies after detection. Keeping the public detector frozen, we add (i) class-wise source selection between two input scales, which recovers small and distant people from a 0.75x pass while leaving large objects at the scale the detector was trained for; (ii) a geometry-to-appearance bridge that projects every 3D box into all calibrated views, matches it to 2D person detections, and aggregates robust track-level re-identification descriptors; and (iii) constraint-aware consolidation, which combines a causal short-gap stitch with offline centroid-linkage clustering under two hard constraints, temporal exclusion and metric 3D reachability, plus class-aware long-gap stitching for rigid objects. Every association stage changes object identities only. On the challenge evaluation server the system scores 62.3947 3D HOTA (DetA 57.4501, AssA 56.8131, LocA 80.1272), first on the general leaderboard snapshot of 30 October 2026 (second at the time of writing, after a competitor's detector update) and 5.63 points above our reproduction of the official winner; the constrained association stage alone contributes +3.73 HOTA through a +5.49 AssA gain at unchanged DetA. Controlled fixed-box validation studies, a constraint ablation, sensitivity curves, and a catalogue of negative results support the design.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SCALE 提出面向病理全切片的反事实解释框架，在九类癌症的九种反事实方向上生成能稳定把模型预测推向目标类别且保持生物学可行性的全切片图像，并由六位病理学家盲评。

**相关性简评：** 反事实图像生成可用于核查哪些视觉证据真正因果地影响模型判断，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「答案是否使用视觉内容」的因果评价提供思路；但其属于病理分类的可解释性工作，不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SCALE: Towards whole-slide counterfactual explanations in pathology

**abstract/A1：** Cancer diagnosis relies on histopathological evaluation, where tumor morphology guides disease classification and informs treatment decisions. Deep learning (DL) models excel at predicting diagnostic properties from histopathology images. Unlike typical medical images featuring small critical areas, histopathological images are textural, with relevant texture spanning the entire image; this makes it challenging to explain DL predictions by locating relevant image regions. Counterfactual explanations offer a promising alternative by asking "what changes in the image could have altered the model prediction." To achieve this, we propose SCALE, a framework for generating such counterfactual explanations for histopathological DL models. Across nine counterfactual directions spanning multiple cancer types, SCALE generates whole-slide counterfactual explanations that consistently shift predictions toward the intended target while maintaining biological feasibility. Blinded assessment by six board-certified pathologists showed higher morphological plausibility for SCALE (with a win rate of 91.7% over baselines) and promising counterfactual effectiveness (with a target consistency of 96.7%).

</details>

### 301. [ShiftGuard: Evaluating Confidence and Feature Distance for Risk-Controlled Image Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18732v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18732

**作者：** Mitra Varun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18732v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18732v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 CIFAR-10 上比较 MSP、熵、特征到预测类质心距离及两种 logistic 融合分数，用 Clopper-Pearson 上界在小校准集上设定接受阈值，考察风险受控下的错误检出与接受比例。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时回答、何时弃权」的校准式风险控制可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策阈值设计提供参照，特征距离信号无增益的负结果也提示需核查 latent 相似度类置信信号是否只是表面有效性；但材料限于单模态单种子，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ShiftGuard: Evaluating Confidence and Feature Distance for Risk-Controlled Image Classification

**abstract/A1：** A classifier that is usually right still makes confident mistakes, and a deployed system needs some way to decide when to answer and when to abstain. Cheap post-hoc scores such as maximum softmax probability (MSP) and predictive entropy are the standard answer. Distances in feature space are a popular alternative, and fusing several signals into one score is a natural next step. We ask whether adding a feature distance signal to MSP and entropy improves error detection, and whether it increases the share of predictions that can be accepted at a certified error rate when only a small labelled calibration set is available. We train a CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 from scratch on CIFAR-10 (92.92% test accuracy, one seed) and compare five reliability scores: MSP, entropy, distance to the predicted-class centroid, a logistic fusion of MSP and entropy, and a logistic fusion of all three signals. Acceptance thresholds are chosen on a held out calibration set with Clopper Pearson upper bounds, Bonferroni corrected over a prespecified family of 315 rules at 95% simultaneous confidence. Confidence based scores were best. Error AUROC was 0.9230 for MSP, 0.9233 for entropy and 0.9235 for MSP plus entropy, against 0.8814 for the three signal fusion and 0.8224 for distance alone. At a 5% risk target with 1,000 calibration images, entropy accepted 84.82% of test images with 2.05% observed error, while three signal fusion accepted 80.61% with 2.21%. With 250 calibration images, neither distance nor the three-signal fusion could certify the 5% target at all. The results come from one seed, one dataset and one architecture, with no corruption experiments, so they say nothing about distribution shift detection. Within these limits, the distance signal did not earn its added complexity.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 「确定性回归中心 + 学习残差 token」的状态分解，以及用 spread-误差相关性（0.78）检验集成不确定性是否校准，可能为 latent 状态更新中的残差建模与 latent 不确定性评价提供可核查的表述线索，但与 VLM 推理本身距离较远。

**title/T1：** TyphoonWorld: A Residual Token World Model for Probabilistic Forecasting of Typhoon Imagery

**abstract/A1：** A satellite forecast of a typhoon should give a low-error picture of the next two days, together with an ensemble whose members are coherent fields and whose spread responds to the storm at hand. A small direct regression network already gives the lowest squared error on held-out storms, so a generative model has to earn its cost through the part of the future that the regression smooths away. We present TyphoonWorld, a discrete-token world model that generates only that part. Conditioned on tokens of the regression forecast, the latest frames and the best-track state at forecast time, it samples residual fields lead by lead, and members add these residuals to the regression center. We compare it under one protocol with per-pixel Gaussian networks, a diffusion model of the same residuals, residuals from other storms and an unconditional token world model, on 276 forecast windows from 46 held-out storms of Digital Typhoon. TyphoonWorld matches the squared error of the regression, lowers the CRPS of the area colder than 220 K, a direct measure of deep convection, by 14 to 39% against every other ensemble, and ties its spread to forecast error as closely as the Gaussian network, with a correlation of 0.78 across windows. It uses 56% of the parameters of the unconditional world model.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作从稀疏的二维脑切片脂质测量中重建小鼠脑三维连续脂质分布，提出 Neural Latent-Space Gaussian Process：对低维脂质画像施加（Matérn 或黎曼流形核的）GP 先验，将三维坐标编码为少量 latent 体并经开 MLP 映射到具体脂质，并与线性回归、XGBoost、神经场及空间组学模型等基线比较。

**相关性简评：** 以 GP 先验约束「坐标索引的 latent 体＋MLP 解码」这一结构，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的结构化先验、表示平滑性与不确定性度量（如用于停止决策）提供核查线索；但任务属于空间组学插值，与多模态推理差距较大，仅作概念借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neural Latent Gaussian Process for 3D reconstruction of Mouse Brain Lipids

**abstract/A1：** We address the problem of reconstructing continuous three-dimensional lipid profiles of the mouse brain from lipid measurements acquired only on a sparse set of two-dimensional tissue sections. Using MALDI-MSI measurements from coronal sections of two densely sampled and six sparsely sampled mouse brains, registered to the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework (CCF), we seek to interpolate the measured hundreds of lipid profiles across the unobserved voxels of the reference brain. We introduce a Neural Latent-Space Gaussian Process (LGP) architecture for this task and critically evaluate its ability to reconstruct spatial lipid distributions, using held-out mouse brain sections to assess generalization. We propose a Gaussian Process prior for the distribution of low-dimensional lipid profiles across the mouse brain (with Matérn or a Riemann manifold kernel). This allows us to encode 3D coordinates in a small number of latent 3D volumes that are then mapped to particular lipids using a multilayer perceptron (MLP). We performed an exhaustive analysis over a range of algorithms from simple linear regression, XGBoost, MLP to state of the art models such as Neural Transcriptomic Field, graph-based SPA3D for spatial omics reconstruction and DEEPSPATIAL. We additionally evaluate GPLFR as an alternative Gaussian-process-based approach. Across 173 measured lipids, LGP outperforms all evaluated baselines, including recent spatial-omics models and GPLFR, achieving a mean correlation of 0.613 and demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach for sparse 3D lipid interpolation.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 304. [Conv-Reluplex: A Verification Framework For Convolution Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18753v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18753

**作者：** Jin Xu、Zishan Li、Miaomiao Zhang、Bowen Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18753v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18753v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文将 Reluplex 扩展至卷积层与池化层，提出 Conv-Reluplex 框架，为 CNN 输出提供形式化验证保证，并在分类被误导时生成对抗样本；在 MNIST 上的实验表明用其对抗样本可提升原模型精度。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接联系，但其基于 SMT/线性约束的层级验证与反例生成思路，可供核查能否用于检验内部 latent 状态是否满足任务约束或与视觉证据保持一致。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conv-Reluplex: A Verification Framework For Convolution Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** In recent years, machine learning has demonstrated impressive performance in many real-world tasks, especially in computer vision and natural language processing. However, to apply them in safety-critical systems one needs formal guarantees on the neural network outputs. The Reluplex tool is proposed to verify the safety of deep neural networks (DNNs), and in case the DNN fails to give a correct output, can generate adversarial examples. Since the tool can only handle DNNs, it is necessary to extend the tool to process image data. Therefore, in this paper, we propose the Conv-Reluplex framework, which is designed to verify the convolutional layer and pooling layer in convolutional neural networks (CNNs), and generate adversarial examples when classification is misguided. We conduct several experiments on MNIST to evaluate our approaches. The results show that the original CNN is improved using the adversarial examples generated by our tool, and the precision of classification can be increased significantly.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Published in SEKE 2021

</details>

### 305. [Frame First, Decode Once: Object-Centric Coordinates and Single-Pass Decoding for System-1 World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18761v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18761

**作者：** Abu Anas Ibn Samad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18761v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18761v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究单步几何基元解码器作为 System-1 世界模型的要素贡献，在 ManiSkill3 PushT 与 lerobot/pusht 上比较解码器、损失、刚体投影与坐标系，发现物体初始位姿的 SE(2) 坐标系使决策遗憾降低 1.9–2.2 倍，且单步解码在延迟与遗憾上均优于迭代扩散与 KV 缓存自回归。

**相关性简评：** 其「在物体自身坐标系中表示状态与输出」及单步并行生成与迭代生成的成本—质量对比，可能为 LVR 中任务必要几何信息的内部表示与动态计算预算选择提供可核查的参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Frame First, Decode Once: Object-Centric Coordinates and Single-Pass Decoding for System-1 World Models

**abstract/A1：** Single-pass primitive decoders such as LocateAnything and VFlash predict all quantized coordinate tokens of a geometric primitive in one forward pass, enabling fast, System-1 visual planning. We study what matters when such a decoder serves as a System-1 world model: a fast action-conditioned predictor that ranks candidate pushes by their predicted outcome. On ManiSkill3 PushT-v1 (512 held-out test families, 8,192 rollouts) and on human demonstrations from lerobot/pusht (2,384 test windows), we compare decoders, training losses, rigid-body projections and coordinate frames, using matched checkpoints, hierarchical bootstrap confidence intervals and Holm correction. Two factors of similar size dominate. First, expressing inputs and outputs in the SE(2) frame of the object's initial pose lowers decision regret by 1.9-2.2x for each of five decoders, and the object-frame model trained on 128 families matches the world-frame model trained on 512. Second, single-pass decoding outperforms iterative decoding: in the object frame, single-pass heads reach 0.020-0.021 regret at 1.6-1.8 ms per decision, against 0.046 for 10-step DDIM diffusion and 0.059 for KV-cached autoregression at 10.3 and 12.9 ms. The choice among single-pass heads has no measurable effect on regret, and our registered hypothesis that the frame effect exceeds the decoder spread is not supported. Soft-token expectation with an end-to-end 2D Kabsch projection gives the lowest trajectory error (11.35 px on ManiSkill3, 3.78 px on lerobot/pusht), exact rigid-body consistency, and lower regret than diffusion at every budget from 4 to 50 DDIM steps, at 3-29x lower latency.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, frozen configurations and per-seed results will be released

</details>

### 306. [Third-Place Solution for the UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track at ECCV 2026: Synthetic Point Cloud Generation and Sim-to-Real 3D Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18778v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18778

**作者：** Antong Deng、Yuxin Zhang、Zhongxiang Xing、Zhenzhen Lin、Jiong Mu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18778v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18778v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文是 UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Sim2Real LiDAR 赛道第三名方案，用逐轴分位数校准生成合成点云，并训练 Voxel R-CNN 做 3D 目标检测，报告官方指标与实现细节。

**相关性简评：** 属竞赛工程报告，与 LVR 主线距离较远；其用真实参考分布对齐合成观测的逐轴分位数校准，或可为视觉证据筛选与表示校准提供线索，但缺少推理期状态机制，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Third-Place Solution for the UCF UrbanTwin V2X-Real Track at ECCV 2026: Synthetic Point Cloud Generation and Sim-to-Real 3D Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** This report presents a complete technical solution for the UrbanTwin V2X-Real Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, covering both synthetic point cloud generation and 3D object detection. For data generation, we adopt per-axis quantile calibration. Public V2X-Real training data are used to construct the real reference distribution, and independent one-dimensional quantile mappings are estimated for the x, y, and z axes of the base synthetic point clouds. The calibrated point clouds are then resampled using a fixed random seed and clipped to the valid spatial range, producing 50 frames with 2,000 float32 XYZ points per frame. For detection, we use a two-stage Voxel R-CNN (VoxelRCNN) detector trained with RangeLDM-enhanced synthetic point-cloud data, point clouds downsampled to 50k points per frame, and reconstructed pedestrian data. Training is performed on four NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs with a global batch size of 16 for 40 epochs. Final testing uses direct single-model inference with the original VoxelRCNN model. On the official evaluation server, the normalized Realism score is 0.7905 and the normalized Detection score is 0.5583, with mAP@0.5 of 0.3908, BEV mAP@0.5 of 0.4219, and mAP@0.7 of 0.1047. According to the official weighting rule, the final combined score is 0.6 x 0.5583 + 0.4 x 0.7905 = 0.6512. This report documents the complete implementation details of data construction, model training, inference, submission formatting, and official evaluation.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. 3rd place, Track 7 (V2X-Real), UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge, 6th DriveX Workshop at ECCV 2026

</details>

### 307. [Setting Optimal Reserve Prices using Fine-Tuned Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18785v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18785

**作者：** Joshua Foster、Fredrik Odegaard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、econ.EM、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18785v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18785v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文微调预训练文本嵌入模型，以拍卖出价的结构似然为训练目标学习房源描述表示，再用分样本估计把描述与卖家估值映射为逐件最优保留价，并在约 6.58 万场二手车在线拍卖上做反事实评估。

**相关性简评：** 虽属拍卖定价领域，但其「以下游决策的结构似然驱动表示学习、并论证只需尾部出价信息即可识别决策量」的思路，可能为 LVR 中「哪些视觉与任务信息应被保留在内部状态、如何以决策目标监督表示」提供可核查的概念类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Setting Optimal Reserve Prices using Fine-Tuned Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Online auction houses must set reserve prices for highly differentiated products whose unstructured descriptions contain valuable demand information. Existing approaches generally require managers to specify product attributes in advance. We ask whether a language model can instead learn from listing descriptions and historical bids to set item-specific reserve prices before bidding begins. We fine-tune a pretrained text embedding language model using the structural likelihood of auction bids as its training objective. This directs representation learning toward the valuation distribution that determines the reserve decision. We show that consecutive upper bids identify the tail information needed to set an optimal reserve without observing or modeling the number of potential bidders. A split-sample estimator learns the representation on one half of the data and conducts structural estimation and inference conditional on that representation on the other. We apply the method to approximately 65,800 online used-vehicle auctions. With seller values calibrated to match the sale rate among listings, the model implies a counterfactual net increase of $165.8 million, representing a 14.6% increase above the incumbent reserve policy. The framework translates a listing description and a seller's value into an item-specific reserve recommendation without constructing a product taxonomy or requiring a bid history for the item being priced. It provides an approach to adapting language models for operational decisions in marketplaces where products are heterogeneous and demand-relevant information is recorded in text.

</details>

### 308. [Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks: Constrained Deep Learning for Sex-Specific Multi-Population Longevity Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18802v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18802

**作者：** Davide Rindori

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18802v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18802v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 AINN，用可微惩罚项把精算单调性等先验嵌入 LSTM 训练，做分性别多人口寿命预测，并重点分析约束强度 λ 带来的精度—稳定性权衡与不确定性校准、集成与可信度加权。

**相关性简评：** 其「对递归状态施加可微结构约束」以及「单步 RMSE 会误选约束强度、应按长程递归表现评价」的思路，可能为 latent 状态的轨迹训练与长程评价指标设计提供核查线索，但领域与视觉推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks: Constrained Deep Learning for Sex-Specific Multi-Population Longevity Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** We introduce Actuarial-Informed Neural Networks (AINN), a constrained deep learning framework for sex-specific multi-population longevity forecasting that embeds actuarial knowledge into LSTM training through differentiable penalty terms. Applied to a high-longevity 6-country cluster (Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, West Germany, Netherlands, Japan; 1956-2020), the framework is a challenger to the Li-Lee benchmark and unconstrained neural approaches. Our central finding is that monotonicity constraint intensity lambda functions as a continuous governance dial with a quantifiable accuracy-stability trade-off. At lambda = 0.01, 30-year forecast confidence intervals narrow by 6.5% at zero RMSE cost. At lambda = 0.1, they narrow by 25% at only +0.84% RMSE cost. This trade-off is invisible to standard hyperparameter optimizers, which select lambda by minimizing one-step RMSE, the wrong metric for structural constraints in recursive forecasting. The framework adds three contributions: (i) residual-calibrated process noise that eliminates double-counting in the dual uncertainty framework, reducing confidence intervals by 53-60%; (ii) a 5-seed model ensemble with a coefficient of variation of 1.06%; and (iii) a time-varying credibility weight Z(t) = exp(-alpha t) connecting to Buhlmann credibility theory for blending neural and actuarial predictions. A 10-year out-of-sample backtest (trained on 1956-2010, validated against observed HMD life expectancy for 2011-2020) yields a mean absolute error of 0.38 years, with 11 of 12 country x sex combinations within the 90% confidence interval. The model produces regulatory-grade outputs including Solvency Capital Requirements under the Swiss Solvency Test (ES 99.0%: +1.91 years, CHE Male) and Solvency II, reverse stress testing, and model-based stability verification (amplification ratio 1.02x).

</details>

### 309. [Clustering-Based Artificial Tree Ensembles for Random Forest Approximation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18803v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18803

**作者：** Lea L. Kronziel、Maren S. Wieder、Silke Szymczak、Björn-Hergen Laabs

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18803v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18803v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究以聚类得到的代表性树集成作为随机森林的替代模型，在模拟与回归基准上比较其保真度、预测精度、复杂度与稳定性，并考察相似度聚类相对随机划分的增量贡献。

**相关性简评：** 其「相似度聚类选择代表成员并对照随机划分、评估保真度与复杂度权衡」的实验范式，可能可供核查 latent 假设或推理轨迹的聚类筛选是否真有增益，但与 VLM 内部状态和推理决策尚无实质联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Clustering-Based Artificial Tree Ensembles for Random Forest Approximation

**abstract/A1：** Random Forests (RFs) offer strong prediction performance but are difficult to interpret. Most representative trees (MRTs) and artificial representative trees (ARTs) provide surrogate explanations, but a single tree may miss patterns within a forest. We investigate benefits and limitations of clustering-based representative tree ensembles for RF surrogate modeling and assess the contribution of similarity-based clustering relative to random tree partitions. Using linear and nonlinear simulations and regression benchmarks, we evaluate fidelity, prediction accuracy, complexity, and prediction stability against equally sized ensembles of top-ranked MRTs and randomly selected trees. Increasing ensemble size generally improves fidelity, accuracy, and prediction stability. ART ensembles show higher fidelity in simulations and often greater prediction stability for small ensembles. Compared with random tree partitions, similarity-based clustering generally improves ART fidelity in simulations and often on benchmarks. On benchmark datasets, MRT-based ensembles generally achieve higher fidelity and prediction accuracy, whereas ART ensembles have fewer terminal nodes. ART ensembles provide compact surrogates when reduced complexity matters and their fidelity and prediction accuracy meet application requirements. These findings clarify both the trade-offs of representative tree ensembles as RF surrogates and the contribution of similarity-based clustering beyond random clustering.

**comment/C1：** 5 figures

</details>

**内容简述：** 该文把此前针对 24 小时血糖（CGM）序列的 motif 字典推广到 4、6、8、12、24 小时片段，使片段可不从零点开始，并用 21 项研究、约 29 万天数据做外部验证，发现各时长 motif 集的匹配表现与原始 24 小时集合接近。

**相关性简评：** 用有限 motif 字典覆盖连续时间序列并跨数据源验证其可迁移性，或可类比 LVR 中把 latent 状态轨迹离散化为有限状态词表以及抽象的可迁移性评价，但领域与任务相差较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Identification and external validation of the sets of 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hour CGM motifs

**abstract/A1：** There is growing interest in using CGM for purposes other than those initially intended. Recent work of Lobo et al. identified $Ω$: a set of motifs such that almost any daily CGM profile (the 24-hour CGM time series starting at midnight) can be classified - matched to a motif in $Ω$. This work generalizes the prior work by identifying sets of motifs for 4-, 6-, 8-, 12-, and 24-hr CGM profiles where an $x$-hr CGM profile does not have to be 24 hours in length, and does not have to start at midnight. The prior work methods are modified to identify the five new sets of motifs using data from the same 6 studies in the original work. The newly identified sets were subjected to rigorous external validation using a data set comprised of data from 21 studies (3,455 subjects, 289,592 days of CGM data). The external validation data set has both temporal and geographic transportability and addresses limitations of the data set used to define the five new sets of motifs. The results of the external validation indicate that the prior work generalizes well: the performance of each $x$-hr set of motifs on the external validation set is almost identical to that obtained for $Ω$. The generalization of the original work broadens the potential use cases of the framework to include short term predictions (e.g., impending hypoglycemia) and diagnostics which rely on detecting changes in CGM time series which are less than 24 hours in length.

### 311. [Scaling Channel-Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18849v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18849

**作者：** Alice V. De Lorenci、Seungeun Yi、Theo Moutakanni、Piotr Bojanowski、Camille Couprie、Juan C. Caicedo、Wolfgang M. Pernice

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究科学成像（细胞显微、遥感等）中通道数量与语义异构条件下的自监督预训练，发现大规模训练时独立编码通道明显优于联合编码，并提出 DINO BoC，在分布外任务与未见通道组合上取得更好表现。

**相关性简评：** 「通道组成异构、独立编码 vs 联合编码」这一对比可能启发多模态 VLM 如何组织并保留不同来源的视觉证据；但该工作属表征预训练，未涉及推理期 latent 状态与答案使用，迁移线索可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Channel-Adaptive Self-Supervised Learning

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in self-supervised pre-training of foundation models for natural images have made them a popular choice for various visual systems and applications. Self-supervised strategies are also promising in non-RGB scientific imaging domains such as in biology, medical and satellite imagery, but their broader application is hampered by heterogeneity in channel composition and semantics between relevant datasets: two datasets may contain different numbers of channels, and these may reveal distinct aspects of an object or scene. Recent works on channel adaptive strategies report substantial advantages for those that account for variable channel compositions without sacrificing the ability to jointly encode channels; yet, how these strategies behave at scale remains unclear. We here show that, surprisingly, trained across large-scale datasets, independent-encoding of channels outperforms joint-encoding methods by a substantial margin. We validate this result along an extensive set of experiments on various datasets from cell microscopy to geospatial imagery. Our DINO BoC approach sets a new state-of-the-art across challenging benchmarks, including generalization to out-of-distribution tasks and unseen channel combinations. We open-source code and model weights for a new general-purpose feature extractor for fluorescent microscopy.

</details>

### 312. [SLICES: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Self-Supervised Learning on Sparse ICU Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18868v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18868

**作者：** Hannes Ill、Dimitrios Proios、Leo Anthony Celi、Peter J. Schüffler

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18868v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18868v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SLICES 提供一个统一的 ICU 稀疏时间序列自监督学习基准与评估框架：固定 24 小时数值与观测掩码输入、Transformer 编码器、患者级划分及两种适配协议，对比 MAE、JEPA 与对比学习，并给出可复现的参考结果与代码。

**相关性简评：** 领域远离视觉推理，但其「冻结探针 vs 微调」双协议导致方法排序变化、以及显式区分表征与适配贡献的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用、增益归因提供评价思路；JEPA 式潜在空间预测在部分观测掩码下的做法也可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SLICES: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Self-Supervised Learning on Sparse ICU Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised learning (SSL) results for intensive care unit (ICU) time series are hard to compare when data processing, encoders, and adaptation vary together. We present SLICES, a benchmark and evaluation framework for comparing and extending SSL methods under a shared clinical setup. It fixes 24-hour value and observation-mask inputs, a Transformer encoder, patient-level splits, four endpoints, two adaptation protocols, and five matched seeds across MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD, and their pooled union. Masked autoencoding (MAE), joint-embedding prediction (JEPA), and contrastive learning provide reference implementations. Among these objectives, MAE leads mean AUPRC in all nine frozen classification comparisons, also under converged probes, and in seven of nine fine-tuning comparisons. Fine-tuned MAE leads hospital mortality at full labels and scores higher than a supervised Transformer of the same architecture at every label fraction, and SSL fine-tuning gives the lowest length-of-stay error. Supervised baselines remain strong elsewhere: GRU-D leads 24-hour mortality and XGBoost leads acute kidney injury in all three regimes. Rankings depend on the adaptation protocol, the comparator set, and whether the probe loss matches the metric. A two-seed MIMIC-IV rerun with the maintained code stays within two across-seed SDs of the reference in all 48 downstream runs. The code repository supports new objectives, shared downstream evaluation, and regeneration of the reference results, so new SSL methods can be compared with these references under the same conditions. Generalization to unseen hospitals is not tested here and is the natural next extension.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) Symposium 2026, Proceedings track (PMLR 346). 28 pages, 8 figures, 21 tables. Code: https://github.com/hannesill/SLICES/tree/ml4h-2026

</details>

### 313. [Factorized Self-Supervised Speech Tokenization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18898v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18898

**作者：** Benjamin Van Niekerk、Jean-Philippe Letendre、Nicol Visser、Hugo Seute、Herman Kamper、Mirco Ravanelli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.AS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18898v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18898v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Facto，一种因子化自监督语音分词器：把内容、韵律等时变信息与说话人身份、录音条件等静态成分分离，对因子化空间聚类后用轻量解码器重建语音，并分析噪声下的 token 稳定性、收敛与随说话人数量的扩展性。

**相关性简评：** 其在聚类前剔除静态成分以提升 token 稳定性的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分任务相关视觉证据与静态上下文、以及分析 latent 相似度究竟反映哪类成分提供可供核查的概念线索，但领域与应用目标相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Factorized Self-Supervised Speech Tokenization

**abstract/A1：** Speech tokenizers convert audio into discrete units, enabling language models to process and generate speech. The goal is to learn compact, text-like representations while preserving enough detail to reconstruct a speaker's voice and delivery. We propose Facto: a factorized tokenizer that disentangles time-varying information (content and prosody) from static components (speaker identity and recording conditions). We build on a recent linear factorization method for self-supervised features, extending it to handle unseen speakers. Then, we cluster the factorized space and train a lightweight decoder to reconstruct audio from the resulting tokens. By removing the static components before clustering, our tokens are more robust to small noise perturbations. We validate this by testing token stability under various noise conditions. Next, we theoretically analyze Facto's convergence and scaling properties, quantifying how the factorization improves with the number of training speakers. Finally, we evaluate Facto on a range of downstream tasks. We show that greater token stability translates into improved text-to-speech performance and competitive results in voice conversion and spoken language modeling. Code and checkpoints at https://github.com/ubisoft/ubisoft-laforge-facto/ and demo page at https://ubisoft-laforge.github.io/speech/facto/.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 314. [Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18905v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18905

**作者：** Avik Dutta、Aayush Kumar、Zahra Ashktorab、Hosein Hasanbeig、Austin Z. Henley、Gustavo Soares

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18905v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18905v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一个以用户消歧偏好为接地、可控的模拟用户框架，用于多轮评测大模型在模糊情境下何时提问澄清、何时做假设，并定义三类可观测的不满意信号，分析澄清与假设之间的权衡，并以系统提示优化取得折中。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时追问获取信息、何时停止并作答」的权衡与评价信号，可能对应 LVR 中视觉证据不足时的 STOP 决策与澄清策略评估；但该工作为纯文本交互、无 latent 状态与视觉证据筛选，仅属较远的评价方法借鉴，需核查其信号是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ask Precisely, Assume Wisely: Interactive Evaluation of Ambiguity Resolution in Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Ambiguity is a core challenge in human--AI interaction, where models must decide when to make assumptions and when to seek clarification. Existing approaches to ambiguity evaluation largely focus on coverage over multiple interpretations using static metrics, offering limited insight into how efficiently a model converges toward a single user-intended interpretation through interaction. We introduce a preference-grounded simulated user framework for controlled, multi-turn evaluation of ambiguity resolution, grounding simulator responses strictly in user disambiguation preferences to avoid hallucination and over-disclosure. Alongside this, we define three observable dissatisfaction signals --- incorrect assumptions, repeating clarifications, and irrelevant clarifications --- that characterize interaction quality beyond task accuracy. Our analysis reveals a clear trade-off: models that frequently seek clarification tend to over-clarify and prolong interactions, while assumption-driven models are more prone to misaligning with user intent. We demonstrate that system prompts optimized on these dissatisfaction signals achieve a Pareto-optimal balance across all three metrics, reducing overall error rates by up to 7.65%, underscoring the value of our framework in designing agents that ask precisely and assume wisely.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents

</details>

### 315. [MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18908v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18908

**作者：** Syed Nazmus Sakib、Nafiul Haque、Ahnaf Tahmid Manan、M M Mahabub Morshed、Shifat E. Arman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18908v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18908v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建多模态 agent 市场模拟 MemeEconomy，让 LLM agent 在低压力与「生存」压力下选择 meme 内容与目标社群，用 BDI 日志外部化其事件理解、优先级与危害认知作为诊断工具，并基于这些日志训练 2B 验证器。

**相关性简评：** BDI 日志把中间状态外部化、并直接用这些轨迹训练检测器的做法，或可为 LVR 中 latent 状态的可读性、视觉证据筛选与过程级监督提供可核查的思路，但论文本身关注安全对齐与 agent 决策，非视觉推理机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival?

**abstract/A1：** Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent's event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation's BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page : https://syed-nazmus-sakib.github.io/MemeEconomy/

</details>

### 316. [Effects of Conventional, Adaptive, and AI-Powered Upscaling on the Legibility of License Plates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18949v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18949

**作者：** Hany Farid、Joshua D. Bucci、Emily A. Cooper

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18949v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18949v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究用两项在线实验考察 255 张不同高度（128 至 8 像素）美国车牌在八种上采样方法前后的可读性，发现传统插值仅带来约 5–9 个百分点提升、最近邻反而有害，SwinIR 最多提升 38 个百分点，而某些 AI 先验与商用上采样器却降低可读性，且未发现明显的字符幻觉。

**相关性简评：** 属人眼可读性研究，不涉及 latent 推理或多模态模型，但其关于上采样合成细节是提升还是污染细粒度证据、以及缺失细节是否被凭空生成的结论，可供核查视觉前端处理对 VLM 细粒度视觉证据筛选的潜在影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Effects of Conventional, Adaptive, and AI-Powered Upscaling on the Legibility of License Plates

**abstract/A1：** Small details in digital images -- a face, a street sign, a license plate -- are routinely upscaled in hopes of making them interpretable. Upscaling options now range from conventional interpolation, whose operations are spatially invariant and fully explainable, to AI-powered methods that synthesize detail potentially absent from the source. Here, we ask which of these techniques most reliably helps human readers. In two online experiments, we measured legibility of 255 US license plates ranging in resolution from 128 to 8 pixels tall, as well as their legibility after upscaling by eight different methods. Legibility of the un-upscaled plates collapsed from ceiling to floor across a narrow band of plate heights (32 to 10 pixels). Conventional upscaling techniques (bilinear, bicubic, and Lanczos interpolation) gave modest gains of about 5-9 percentage points within this range. Nearest-neighbor interpolation, however, was harmful, rendering unreadable many plates that were readable without any upscaling. Advanced methods diverged: SwinIR, an open-source AI enhancer, raised performance by up to 38 points relative to no upscaling, while an adaptive denoiser-based image prior and commercial AI upscaler tended to impair legibility. We found no strong evidence of consistent character hallucinations across methods. Decomposing the task, conventional interpolators mainly helped readers count characters, whereas SwinIR alone made the characters themselves more identifiable.

</details>

### 317. [SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18963v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18963

**作者：** Jai Jain、Chihyo Ahn、Yong Liu、Charles Chen、Duc N. M Hoang、Ajay Kumar Jaiswal、Fatih Ilhan、Han-Byul Kim、Lauren Hannah、Richa Dixit、Minsik Cho、Yingyan Celine Lin、Hyesoon Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18963v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18963v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出边缘-云 LLM 推理系统 SpecRelay：用异步验证流水线在等待回复期间持续发出投机解码草稿树以摊薄 RTT，并用延迟感知路由器在三种端侧推理模式与云端投机解码间按精度-延迟目标选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「本地推理是否足够、何时仍需云端验证」的延迟条件化模式路由与陈旧请求拒绝，为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算分配与获取证据收益-成本权衡提供问题表述层面的类比，可供核查；但材料未涉及视觉证据或 latent 状态，联系仅停留在决策与成本层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

</details>
