### 318. [Contextual Non-Convex Bandit Optimization with Two-Point Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18965v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.18965

**作者：** Khaled Eldowa、Pierre Gaillard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18965v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.18965v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究 Lipschitz 损失下的非随机上下文 bandit：每轮依上下文选两个动作、只观测二者损失之差并承担均值损失，借助分层离散化为 Lipschitz、Hölder 等非参数策略类改进 regret，部分情形下可达到全信息速率。

**相关性简评：** 其「两点差分反馈」与分层离散化可能为 latent 推理轨迹在仅成对比较监督下的信用分配与样本效率分析提供概念工具，但原文与视觉推理无直接联系，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Contextual Non-Convex Bandit Optimization with Two-Point Feedback

**abstract/A1：** We study a non-stochastic contextual bandit problem with Lipschitz losses. At every round, the learner observes the context then picks two actions, observes the difference between their losses, and incurs their mean. The aim is to minimize the regret against a generic non-parametric comparator class of policies mapping contexts to actions; for example, Lipschitz policies and Hölder-smooth policies. We show how relying on a hierarchical discretization technique allows us to improve upon the regret rates achievable under one-point feedback, and even recover the full-information rate in some cases; notably, for sufficiently smooth policy classes or low-dimensional instances. Additionally, for Lipschitz policies, we present an algorithm whose per-round computational complexity is only logarithmic in the time horizon.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文系统探测 LLM 内部的肿瘤学「世界模型」：仅给定肿瘤类型时生成的病例高度同质，在 12 个临床情境中多数只遵循生物标志物与治疗逻辑而在既往治疗或虚弱状态重要时失效，并提出 Clinical State Space 这一动态轨迹表示框架用于刻画真实与合成患者。

**相关性简评：** 其「状态空间」式轨迹表示与对状态随证据更新的检验思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的动态表示、信息保留与评价方式提供概念线索，但领域较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Large language models as oncology world models

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) can synthesize cancer patient cases, but their internal representation of oncology, or world model, has not been explored systematically. By only specifying tumor type, we show that LLMs tend to generate similar patients per cancer, with on average 81.0% to 93.2% of a cancer's patients sharing the most frequent value of each baseline feature. By systematically varying patient features in 12 clinical scenarios, we show that they follow biomarker and treatment logic in 29 of 36 model-scenario assessments, against 1 of 12 when previous treatment or frailty matters. Continuing real patient trajectories, an LLM predicted 89.9% 12-month survival, and 79.2% with similar patients as examples, against 72.2% observed. To represent these trajectories, we developed the Clinical State Space, a dynamic representation framework that we also applied to real patients. Despite the limits we show, improved world models may support digital twins, which our framework can evaluate.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 LLM 社会偏见评估重构为贝叶斯逆问题，从 BBQ 基准的提示—回答观测中推断刻画模型刻板倾向的低维潜在先验分布，并给出数学框架与重建算法。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revealing the Biases of Large Language Models By Inferring Prior Distributions

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) have been known to exhibit a wide range of social biases including name-nationality associations, occupation-gender associations and racial stereotypes. Existing approaches to evaluating these biases typically involve measuring surface-level behavior where a model is fed a dataset of prompts and its outputs are scored relative to ground-truth answers. Inspired by prior elicitation in cognitive science, we propose a different perspective that reconstructs latent bias as a prior underlying the model's behavior. We formulate the problem as a Bayesian inverse problem where, given prompt-response observations on a bias benchmark dataset, we infer a low-dimensional latent distribution that summarizes the model's stereotyping tendencies. This paper develops the mathematical foundation, a practical reconstruction algorithm, and experiments using the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) benchmark to infer the prior distributions of LLMs over responses in ambiguous social contexts.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** AdaMenu 针对大标签空间分类，用检索到的带标签样例为每个查询构建紧凑的候选标签菜单，只需一次决策模型调用，并默认按聚合检索分数调整菜单规模；在最多 1,016 个标签的四组标签集上优于 beam-search 层级基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「按检索分数聚合自适应决定候选集大小、避免扩大选项集」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中的候选假设筛选与停止/计算预算分配问题，但论文本身面向纯文本分类，与视觉推理和 latent 状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AdaMenu: Query-Adaptive Menus for Decision Models over Large Label Spaces

**abstract/A1：** Decision models such as Jev return probabilities over caller-defined options and are increasingly used for classification. Large label spaces challenge both accuracy and scalability: larger menus can impair decisions, increase input costs, and exceed option limits. Hierarchical classification reduces menu size but introduces serial calls and error propagation. We propose AdaMenu, which builds a compact candidate menu from retrieved labeled examples and makes a single decision-model request. Its candidate labels adapt to the query, and its default setting also adjusts menu size using aggregated retrieval scores. We evaluate AdaMenu with open and closed decision models on four label sets containing up to 1,016 labels. It outperforms TypeSafe's beam-search baseline on all 16 model and label-set pairs where both methods run, improving accuracy by 16.6-34.3 percentage points. Relative to the full menu on the three smaller label sets, accuracy differences range from -0.5 to +7.2 percentage points, while input token usage falls by factors of 3.2-22.9. AdaMenu also runs when option limits exclude the full menu, including settings where the hierarchical baseline is unavailable.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables

</details>

### 322. [Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19016v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19016

**作者：** Ishan Khire、Naren Manikandan、Tyler Hayes、Giri Krishnan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、q-bio.QM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19016v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19016v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文逐层探测 OpenFold 的 48 层 Evoformer 的 pair representation，用多种探针解码 Cα 距离并经 MDS 重建结构，同时测量三角不等式违背并做逐层消融，发现几何信息与一致性呈两阶段精修轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 其逐层追踪表示几何、距离可解码性与重复计算 motif 的方法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何随深度保留几何或任务必要信息、以及如何评价表示几何一致性提供类比线索，尚需核查能否迁移到视觉 token 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Match and Correct: A Repeated Computational Motif in Evoformer Layers

**abstract/A1：** Triangle attention and triangle multiplicative updates form key components of the Evoformer, and were introduced specifically to encourage consistency with the triangle inequality. Yet whether representational changes over layers reduce triangle inequality violations has not been tested. We probe the pair representation at each of OpenFold's 48 Evoformer layers, decoding final C$\_α$-C$\_α$ distances with four probe families (a shared linear probe, per-protein linear probes, a sequence-separation-gated linear probe, and XGBoost) and reconstructing intermediate 3D structures from the decoded distances via multidimensional scaling. Across a cohort of 552 CAMEO and ECOD proteins, distance decodability ($R^2$) and reconstruction quality (TM-score) rise in early layers, plateau in the middle of the network, and rise again in late layers. Directly measuring triangle-inequality violations in the decoded distances reveals a similar, more exaggerated pattern: violations rise to a peak, fall to a trough, rise to a second peak, and only then decline, revealing two distinct episodes of decreasing normalized triangle violations rather than one continuous improvement. Cumulative forward and reverse layer-wise ablations of the Pair Transition, MSA Transition, and triangle mechanisms localize the regions in which specific Evoformer components become essential. The two stages of geometric refinement coincide with the use of the Pair Transition MLP and the triangle mechanisms. These results characterize how distance information and decoded geometric consistency evolve across layers, and motivate hypotheses about the computations behind their trajectories.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 4 figures (main text), 16 supplementary figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Interpretability for Discovery. Code: https://github.com/ishankhire/match-and-correct-evoformer

</details>

### 323. [Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19020v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19020

**作者：** Berke Akturk、Ali Can Sahin、Rasit Cem Solatay、Emanuel Sommer、Yawei Li、David Rügamer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19020v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19020v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Asymmetric Duos：用一个强基座模型与一个较小的 sidekick 模型在 logit 空间做融合，仅用验证集优化全局缩放参数，从而以较低计算代价改善 LLM 分类器的校准（ECE、NLL），且可与已有校准方法叠加。

**相关性简评：** 其「校准-计算」帕累托前沿与廉价置信度修正思路，可能为 LVR 中基于置信度的停止决策与额外计算的收益权衡提供参照，但研究对象是文本分类校准而非 latent 推理状态，需核查其结论能否迁移到多模态推理场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Advancing the Calibration-Compute Frontier of LLM Classifiers via Asymmetric Duos

**abstract/A1：** The importance of reliable uncertainty estimation in large language models (LLMs) has become increasingly pronounced, yet modern models remain poorly calibrated and frequently overconfident. In this study, we address this by proposing an efficient method for LLM classifier calibration using the Asymmetric Duos framework. Our approach combines a strong base model with a smaller sidekick model via logit-space fusion, utilizing global scaling parameters optimized on a validation set. Across diverse benchmarks, this Asymmetric LLM Duo consistently achieves best or second-best performance on expected calibration error and negative log-likelihood, without degrading predictive accuracy. More importantly, these gains are realized at a fraction of the computational cost of more complex baselines, placing our method on the calibration-compute Pareto frontier. We further demonstrate that our method acts orthogonal to various established calibration-aware techniques, meaning it can be easily combined with them to consistently boost their performance. Finally, our analysis of the logit-space behavior illustrates how asymmetric fusion successfully mitigates base model overconfidence. Overall, our findings demonstrate that the benefits of an asymmetric fusion successfully transfer to the language domain, providing a simple, highly cost-efficient approach to improving uncertainty estimation in LLM classifiers.

</details>

### 324. [HeteroWear: Sensor-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Heterogeneous Wearable Activity Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19027v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19027

**作者：** Yasaman Mohammadpour、Pouya Shaeri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、eess.SP、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19027v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19027v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** HeteroWear 是一个传感器感知的自监督预训练框架：在八个可穿戴数据集上预训练，用传感器上下文嵌入、时序与跨传感器 Transformer 及 latent cross-attention 融合来分离传感器内与跨传感器建模，并结合结构化传感器 dropout、跨配置一致性与逐轴掩码建模，缺失传感器直接省略而不重建。

**相关性简评：** 「缺失通道省略而非重建」与异构证据的 cross-attention 融合，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据部分缺失或需筛选时的状态融合与训练监督提供核查线索；但研究对象是可穿戴活动识别，与视觉推理的迁移可行性仍需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HeteroWear: Sensor-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Heterogeneous Wearable Activity Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised learning for wearable sensing is usually confined to a single dataset or device family, leaving open whether representations transfer across heterogeneous sensor configurations and whether gains come from pretraining rather than architecture or richer sensor input. We present HeteroWear, a sensor-aware self-supervised framework pretrained on an eight-dataset wearable corpus (173 subjects, 358,261 windows) spanning inertial and physiological signals across body locations, devices, and sampling rates. HeteroWear separates within-sensor temporal modeling from cross-sensor relational modeling using sensor-context embeddings, temporal and cross-sensor Transformers, and latent cross-attention fusion. Training combines structured sensor dropout, cross-configuration consistency, and per-axis masked sensor modeling; missing sensors are omitted rather than reconstructed. Under leave-one-dataset-out pretraining and subject-disjoint evaluation on PAMAP2, WISDM, HHAR, HARTH, and UCI-HAR, HeteroWear improves mean macro-F1 from 0.688 to 0.724 over the identical architecture trained from scratch, with the largest gain on HHAR (0.823 versus 0.741), and achieves the highest macro-F1 on four of five benchmarks relative to single-accelerometer supervised baselines. Held-out-device evaluation yields a mean +0.066 macro-F1 improvement. Under 50% test-time channel removal, HeteroWear retains 73.8% of full-channel performance versus 64.1% for the same architecture trained from scratch without sensor dropout. Ablations show that structured sensor dropout primarily drives robustness, while cross-configuration consistency and sensor-context encoding contribute to transfer.

**comment/C1：** Extended version of a paper accepted at IEEE BigData 2026. Code: https://github.com/yasamanmohammdpour/HeteroWear

</details>

### 325. [Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19044v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19044

**作者：** Haolin Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19044v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19044v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 ImageNet 双重重标注验证集上用 103 个分类器测量「难样本筛选」引入的标签错误：所有 66 个监督模型都错的 1,892 张图中有 61% 标签错误（整体 11.1%），并给出可按筛选严格度预测错误富集比例的拟合曲线，以及审计工具 ScreenAudit。

**相关性简评：** 「难样本可能只是标错」这一结论与富集曲线、逐图审计可供核查 LVR/多模态推理基准的困难样本，避免把标签噪声误判为推理失败，从而影响对 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益与成本结论的解读。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors

**abstract/A1：** Hard vision benchmarks often keep images that strong classifiers get wrong. Since a classifier is also marked wrong when the label is wrong, such failure screens may collect label errors. We measure this on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers. Among the 1,892 images that all 66 supervised classifiers get wrong, 61% have a wrong label, versus 11.1% overall. The fewer images a screen lets through, the more of them are mislabeled, along approximately one curve. Fit on one model family, this curve predicts the screens of two held-out model families with a mean error of 2.4 percentage points, and replays of ImageNet-D's and ImageNet-Hard's screens within 0.1 and 6.3 points. On new pools, ImageNet-V2 and CIFAR-10, enrichment at the strictest screens is stronger than the curve predicts: on ImageNet-V2, by human relabeling, 67% of the images that all 66 classifiers get wrong are mislabeled, against 46% predicted. Screens that let models choose among only some of the classes, as ImageNet-A's does (200 of 1,000), fall below the curve. By ReImageNet, 32% of ImageNet-Hard's ImageNet images have no correct label. ScreenAudit, which comprises an audit tool, a script that rebuilds corrected answer sets for the 5,464 decided ImageNet-Hard images (of 5,646) from ReImageNet's gated release, and per-image audits of 1,198 benchmark images, will be released later.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables

</details>

### 326. [Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19078v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19078

**作者：** Dominic Klukas、Cyrus Neary

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19078v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19078v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为异构多智能体系统提出 assume/guarantee 契约框架（AGC-MAS）及 IHA-MARL 算法，将团队任务分解为带自动机、超时与成功率要求的子任务契约，并交替进行契约分配、单智能体训练与能力评估。

**相关性简评：** 契约把子任务的前提假设、成功判据与自动机进度监控显式化，可能为 LVR 中分段推理的状态接口、停止与验证提供概念参照；但其多智能体控制语境与视觉推理距离较远，可供核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Assume/Guarantee Contracts for the Compositional Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning of Heterogeneous Teams

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) problems for heterogeneous teams require agents to collaborate to complete team tasks while making the best use of diverse agent capabilities. We introduce assume/guarantee contracts for heterogeneous multi-agent systems (AGC-MAS) and Iterative Heterogeneous Assignment for MARL (IHA-MARL). AGC-MAS contracts are compositional objects that encode the assumptions provided to, and the guarantees required of, each subtask contributing to the overall team task. We formulate contracts as tuples that specify a subtask, an automaton, timeout and success-probability requirements, and dispatch behavior. The automaton tracks an agent's high-level progress through the subtask associated with its contract and provides a natural mechanism for synchronization across contracts. Our abstraction enables robust interaction across heterogeneous low-level subtask implementations, allows heterogeneous agents to substitute for one another in satisfying contracts, and supports reuse of previously satisfied contracts in new team contexts. Having defined our theoretical framework, we develop a decomposition algorithm that breaks down a team task into a set of contracts. We then propose an iterative algorithm for task assignment and MARL that alternates between assigning contracts representing subtasks to individual agents, training the assigned agents to satisfy their contracts, and assessing their resulting capabilities to inform the next round of task assignments until the team's success probability meets the desired threshold. Our experimental results demonstrate the versatility of contracts in enabling agent substitution and contract reuse. Across three benchmarks with five seeds each, IHA-MARL achieves observed $100\\%$ final evaluation success. In CPU timing pilots, comparable baselines required approximately $7$--$11\\times$ more training-loop time.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FDAM 多任务框架，用频域增强与方向特征细化模块处理细微裂缝，并结合检测框分支与网格分类分支完成路面裂缝网格定位，在自建 RoadDistress2026 及 Crack500、DeepCrack 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 频域自适应波段加权与多尺度条带方向卷积可能为 LVR 中细粒度视觉细节在内部状态的保留提供算子线索，稀疏正样本的自适应重加权也或可供核查弱证据下的监督分配，但属推测，需阅读原文判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FDAM: A Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task Framework for Pavement Crack Grid Localization

**abstract/A1：** Pavement crack grid localization remains challenging for thin and tiny cracks due to weak visual cues and background interference. Box detection often misses these cracks, while supervised semantic segmentation faces limited pixel-wise annotations and high labeling costs. In this paper, we propose a Frequency-Direction-Aware Multi-Task framework (FDAM) with box detection and grid classification branches. The core grid classification branch comprises Frequency-Domain Enhancement (FDE) and Directional Feature Refinement (DFR). FDE adaptively weights spectral bands and fuses reconstructed features with spatial features. DFR captures thin crack patterns through multi-scale strip convolutions, direction-sensitive modulation, and feature recalibration. Sparse positive cells and ambiguous local predictions motivate adaptive grid supervision. Adaptive Importance Reweighting emphasizes uncertain predictions and local label transitions, with focal supervision for all cells. Our contribution is to couple the box detection and grid classification branches through shared feature learning for pavement crack grid localization. We validate FDAM on our RoadDistress2026 dataset of thin and tiny cracks and further evaluate it on public datasets Crack500 and DeepCrack. The code is available at https://github.com/Lab-PANbin/FDAM

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出面向等距柱状投影（ERP）全景图像的 patch 级深度视觉里程计，结合球面先验初始化的可变形特征提取、接缝感知的端到端估计与球面梯度 patch 选择，以降低纬度畸变和极点采样偏置的影响。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DEFDVO: Deformable Deep Visual Odometry for Equirectangular Images

**abstract/A1：** Omnidirectional ($360^\\circ$) cameras capture the full surrounding scene in every frame, providing a strong advantage for visual odometry (VO) over pinhole sensors with a limited field of view. However, their equirectangular projection (ERP) introduces latitude-dependent distortion, an artificial seam at the image border, and a sampling bias toward the poles. Existing $360^\\circ$ VO methods address these challenges only partially. DEFDVO closes this gap with a patch-based deep VO method that operates directly on ERP imagery, combining spherically initialized deformable feature extraction, end-to-end seam-aware estimation, and spherical-gradient patch selection. The deformable feature extractor combines spherical geometric priors with learned sampling offsets, while seam-aware processing preserves ERP continuity, and spherical-gradient selection reduces polar sampling bias. Trained exclusively on synthetic TartanAirV2 ERP imagery, DEFDVO improves the best prior average absolute trajectory error (ATE) by $4.8\\times$ (0.201 m to 0.042 m) on the TartanAirV2 evaluation set defined by 360DVO and achieves the lowest average ATE on both splits of the real-world 360DVO benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/BurakSevsay/DEFDVO

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CLEAR 在推荐系统中构建一个可读、可编辑的自然语言兴趣层，把推断出的兴趣映射回用户历史中的证据事件，并让该兴趣对象同时充当检索、排序、归因与曝光控制的统一服务地址。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CLEAR: Legible and Steerable Recommendation via Grounded Natural-Language Interests

**abstract/A1：** Modern recommenders keep learned preferences in representations people cannot inspect or change. We present CLEAR (Controllable and Legible End-to-end Architecture for Recommendation), an end-to-end system deployed at Meta and built around an editable natural-language interest layer. CLEAR makes a ranked subset of inferred interests readable and stores accepted additions and suppressions as authoritative preference state. Behavioral grounding maps each inferred interest back to supporting events in the user's own history. The resulting interest object is also a serving address: its label and profile-conditioned rewrites drive lexical retrieval, its supporting events seed behavioral retrieval, its projection queries an embedding index, and its stable identity supports ranking, attribution, and exposure control. A fresh user declaration may precede behavioral support, so it enters through the same serving identity and initially draws candidates from topical retrieval. Ranking makes those candidates competitive, while a delivery controller observes attributable exposure and replenishes underexposed interests. Direct user review found that users rated about 88.5% of displayed interests accurate. In an offline benchmark using a shared evaluation protocol, the Specialized 3B generator reached 0.3967 mean-user F1@10, compared with 0.3633 for Gemini 2.5 Pro and 0.1911 for the prior generator. For a newly declared interest, a user-randomized cumulative ablation measured same-day delivery losses of 8.7 percentage points for added-interest ranking terms, 11.1 for reserved top-slot insertion, and 13.7 for interest-conditioned candidate sourcing, conditional on the tested removal sequence. CLEAR components have operated in production for over one year; the system spans four surfaces on Instagram and Facebook, with an interest layer people can inspect, correct, and use to direct recommendations.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 330. [Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19115v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19115

**作者：** Pratyush Kumar Singh、Lianghao Cao、E. Bruce Pitman、Danial Faghihi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19115v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19115v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 residual-informed Bayesian neural operator（RI-BNO），用 PDE 的 a posteriori 残差误差估计显式学习算子模型的不足，并把该修正与不确定性并入 Bayesian 训练与预测，在反应扩散基准、基于 MRI 的胶质瘤参数 MCMC 推断和三维热桥风险规避设计中验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式建模模型不足并给出局部误差界」的做法，可能与 LVR 中依据自估误差决定是否继续计算或补充证据（LOOK/STOP）以及 latent 状态中不确定性表达有概念上的呼应，但属跨领域线索，可供核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design

**abstract/A1：** Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these calculations can make numerical simulation prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. We establish local error bounds for the residual-informed estimates under stability and smoothness assumptions. We demonstrate RI-BNO on a non-linear reaction-diffusion benchmark with DeepONet and latent-subspace architectures, Markov chain Monte Carlo inference of glioma parameter fields from magnetic resonance imaging, and Monte Carlo risk-averse optimization of three-dimensional thermal breaks in building envelopes under manufacturing uncertainty. Across the evaluated examples, RI-BNO improves agreement with finite element (FE) reference predictions, parameter posteriors and optimized designs while using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as the vanilla Bayesian neural operator (vBNO). For thermal break design, online optimization time decreases from 178 hours with the FE model to 18 minutes with RI-BNO. These results demonstrate the value of explicit inadequacy modeling in neural operators for reliable PDE-based inference and design.

</details>

### 331. [From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19165v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19165

**作者：** Mostafa Darvishi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.AR、cs.ET、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19165v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19165v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一个面向边缘 AI 的因果跨层自愈框架，持续采集传感器健康、推理不确定性、处理器计数器、功耗与热状态等多源遥测，用带时序信息的因果引擎推断异常最可能的来源并量化诊断不确定性。

**相关性简评：** 其从多源证据中定位异常来源并量化归因不确定性的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分视觉证据缺失、latent 状态错误与监督问题提供概念借鉴，但领域相距较远，映射到推理期状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Sensors to Silicon: Causal Cross-Layer Self-Healing Edge AI for Secure and Energy-Adaptive IoT Systems

**abstract/A1：** The migration of artificial intelligence from centralized cloud infrastructure to resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices reduces communication latency and improves data locality, but it also tightly couples sensing quality, inference behavior, microarchitectural activity, hardware reliability, security, and energy management within the same physical node. Existing edge-intelligence solutions predominantly address these dimensions in isolation, making it difficult to determine whether an observed degradation originates from sensor malfunction, data-distribution shift, malicious execution, hardware faults, or resource and thermal stress. This paper presents a causal cross-layer self-healing Edge-AI framework that continuously observes synchronized telemetry spanning sensor health, inference uncertainty, processor hardware-performance counters, accelerator and memory activity, power and thermal state, and communication conditions. A temporally informed causal reasoning engine estimates the most probable origin of abnormal behavior and quantifies diagnostic uncertainty, including under concurrent perturbations.

**comment/C1：** 55 pages, 27 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 332. [LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19166v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19166

**作者：** S M Rayeed、Charles V. Stewart、Yao Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19166v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19166v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文统计574种药物在维基百科与PubMed文本中适应症与禁忌症被记载的频率差异，发现收益类事实约为安全限制的两倍，且Qwen2.5从0.5B扩到14B时禁忌症准确率仍近随机；但直接提供含答案的检索段落或官方FDA标签可显著提升表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「补入证据即可用」的对照设计与外部证据路由思路，或可为LVR提供诊断线索，供核查如何把失败归因于视觉证据缺失而非latent推理状态不足；但论文本身不涉及多模态推理与状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LABEL: Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits in Drug Knowledge and Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Every medication comes with two types of medical facts: indications, which describe what conditions the drug treats (benefits), and contraindications, which describe who must avoid it to prevent serious harm (safety limits). Although contraindications are critical for patient safety and FDA regulations require listing them as rigorously as indications, we find that contraindications are far less documented than indications in general prose. In this paper, we measure how often these texts contain both facts across 574 drugs from PrimeKG by comparing a drug's indications against its own contraindications. Across Wikipedia articles and PubMed abstracts, we find that reference prose names a drug's benefits about twice as often as its safety limits (within-drug odds ratio 2.19). We call this documentation gap LABEL (Literature Asymmetry between Efficacy and Limits). Language models mirror this gap. As we scale Qwen2.5 from 0.5B to 14B, accuracy on indications rises by 18.3 points, whereas accuracy on contraindications remains flat near random guessing. However, when we provide models with a retrieved passage that states the answer, they use safety facts just as effectively as benefits. Furthermore, routing safety questions to official FDA labels boosts accuracy by 15.8 points whenever the label states the fact. Overall, our findings show that models fail on medication safety not because they cannot reason about risk, but because free-text corpora lack safety facts. Clinical AI systems should therefore route medication-safety questions to official regulatory labels and structured databases rather than relying on general public records. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SMRayeed/LABEL.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages (9 main + supplementary material), 8 figures, 7 tables

</details>

### 333. [EviRef: Evidence-Specific Memories for Logical Anomaly Detection across Capture Conditions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19172v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19172

**作者：** Yaoting Huang、Wenqi Cai、Yijin Wei、Jianjian Qin、Chunzhi Gu、Haoran Xie、Chao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19172v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19172v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出免训练的 EviRef，将逻辑正常性拆成可分解约束，为每类证据建立独立参考记忆，用一次构建的部件原型与整图嵌入验证占用、关系和语义约束，并可在不改动既有记忆的情况下经任务级门控接入文本等额外证据。

**相关性简评：** 其「按证据族分离记忆＋门控接入」思路或可为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与多源证据组合提供参考，但任务属工业逻辑异常检测，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接关联，迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EviRef: Evidence-Specific Memories for Logical Anomaly Detection across Capture Conditions

**abstract/A1：** Logical anomalies arise when every component looks normal but their combination violates the scene rules. In practical inspection, these rules must hold under varying backgrounds, illumination, and imaging quality, with only a few dozen normal images per scene, whereas existing methods couple normality with appearance and merge different constraints into one reference. We model logical normality as decomposable constraints and propose EviRef, a training-free method that builds a separate reference memory for each family of evidence. Component prototypes built once per scene parse images under any capture condition into one label space, on which occupancy and relation constraints are verified. Semantic constraints are verified with whole-image embeddings independent of parsing, and additional evidence such as text is admitted through a task-level gate without modifying existing memories. On VID-AD, EviRef attains a mean image-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 92.1% (88.9% with visual evidence alone), the highest among the compared methods under each of five capture conditions, with a standard deviation of 0.5. Even with memories built from only 20 normal images per task, it surpasses all compared methods that use 50 normal images per task.

</details>

### 334. [WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19183v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19183

**作者：** Tao An、Weihang Liang、Tianqi Wang、Chuqing Cao、Wenming Tan、Kai Zhang、Haibo Lei、Tao Xie、Lijun Zhao、Ruifeng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19183v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19183v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WA-JEPA 世界-动作模型：直接生成动作提案并预测未来场景与本体检知 latent，再用「目标与预测场景 latent 的差异」以及保留的细粒度未来场景上下文两条反馈路径分块迭代修正动作，执行前反复更新同一计划，从而避免候选动作搜索。

**相关性简评：** 其「以目标 latent 差异驱动迭代修正、并跨轮保留预测上下文」的机制可能为 LVR 的 latent 假设更新、视觉证据筛选与何时停止提供概念参照，但属机器人世界模型，迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WA-JEPA: Goal-Aware Predictive Feedback Action Refinement for a World-Action Model

**abstract/A1：** JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 5 figures, including supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA

</details>

### 335. [Calibrating the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth without Labels](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19188v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19188

**作者：** Jun Seok Kim、Rui Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19188v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19188v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察自监督单目深度网络所预测逐像素不确定度的校准问题（尺度与形状），并提出 MonoCal：用立体图像对估计一个常数来校正尺度，并通过让不确定度预测两个自监督网络深度不一致的位置来重训形状，无需真值深度。

**相关性简评：** 其“无标签、以双网络分歧作为不确定度监督”的思路可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 的证据可信度估计与停止/再看的决策；但该文属稠密深度预测，未涉及推理状态，联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Calibrating the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth without Labels

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised monocular depth networks can predict a per-pixel uncertainty, which is mainly evaluated by how well it ranks pixels according to their error. Such metrics are insensitive to the magnitude of the uncertainty, so an uncertainty half as large as the actual error obtains the same score. In this paper, we investigate whether the predicted uncertainty is as large as the depth error, both on average (scale) and across confident and uncertain, near and far pixels (shape). On KITTI, the scale is miscalibrated for every uncertainty estimate we evaluate, and the error of MonoProb is nearly twice its predicted uncertainty. We propose MonoCal, which corrects both the scale and the shape without ground-truth depth. Scale calibration multiplies the uncertainty by a single constant measured from stereo pairs, requiring no retraining, and this constant closely matches the one fitted with ground truth. Since a constant cannot change the shape, we further retrain the uncertainty to predict where the depth of the network disagrees with that of a second self-supervised network. Experiments on KITTI show that MonoCal achieves better calibration across uncertainty levels and depth ranges than rescaling with ground truth, while still using a single image at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19193

**作者：** Ang Gaoa、Rui Jina、Yin Liu、Pengfei Rong、Feng Liu、G. Bruce Pike、Hongfu Sun、Yang Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、eess.IV

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PoRef-MIL 弱监督 MIL 框架用于 QSM 脑疾病分类：交替训练切片诊断网络与受试者级分类器以迭代更新伪标签，并在推理时用即插即用后验细化模块（PRM）做双向后验推断细化切片概率，再由熵导出置信度用于滑窗打分。

**相关性简评：** 切片概率的后验细化与熵置信度加权可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和实例贡献分配提供可核查线索，但该工作属医学影像弱监督分类，不含推理状态生成或停止决策机制，相关性需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ref-MIL: Plug-and-Play Posterior Refinement for Multiple Instance Learning in QSM-Based Brain Disease Classification

**abstract/A1：** Quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) is a novel quantitative MRI contrast for studying tissue susceptibility changes in brain disorders, including Parkinson's disease (PD) and multiple sclerosis (MS). However, small cohorts and the lack of local annotations make developing deep learning models for QSM-based diagnosis challenging. In this work, we propose PoRef-MIL, a weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) framework combining iterative slice relabeling and network retraining with a plug-and-play posterior refinement module (PRM). During training, a 2D dual-branch diagnosis network and a subject-level classifier were alternately trained for five rounds. The classifier was used to update slice pseudo-labels for retraining the diagnosis network. The PRM was applied during inference to refine slice probabilities through bidirectional posterior inference and calculate entropy-derived confidence from the refined probabilities, which was then used in sliding-window scoring to obtain subject-level predictions. PoRef-MIL was evaluated on an in-house PD cohort of 287 participants and a public MS cohort of 150 participants. Compared with eight classification methods, PoRef-MIL achieved the highest mean areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.942 and 0.872, and accuracies of 0.926 and 0.833, for PD and MS classification, respectively. Ablation experiments were conducted to validate the effectiveness of iterative relabeling and PRM, and the plug-and-play feature of the proposed PRM was also evaluated using four state-of-the-art MIL models. Overall, PoRef-MIL offers a promising approach to QSM-based disease classification in small cohorts without manual slice annotations.

### 337. [What Moves a LoCoMo Score? Memory Context, Answer Prompts and Judges](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19199v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**内容简述：** 该文在 LoCoMo 长程对话记忆基准上，分别量化答案提示、评判模型和基线设置对分数的单独影响，并把 Becos 记忆系统作为黑盒在该基准上评测，公开全部答案、判分与评分脚本。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是文本记忆任务的评测敏感性分析（仅换评判者可移动最高 7.2 分、仅换提示可移动 9.3 分），且系统只依据约少 90% 字符的上下文作答，可能为 LVR 中证据筛选、上下文压缩与 latent 推理评价的判分稳健性提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Moves a LoCoMo Score? Memory Context, Answer Prompts and Judges

**abstract/A1：** LoCoMo is a widely reported benchmark for long-term conversational memory, but published scores mix memory quality with choices of answer prompt, judge and baseline layout that are rarely reported together. We measure how much these choices move a score, and evaluate Becos, a team memory system for coding agents, as a black box under all of them: ten conversations (1,540 questions), two answer models (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4.1-mini), two answer prompts and three LLM judges, against a whole-conversation baseline rerun under identical conditions. Changing only the judge moves a score by up to 7.2 points and changing only the answer prompt by up to 9.3. A blind human check of 150 answers finds the judges reliable when they agree, and the primary judge's errors on disputed answers working against Becos rather than for it. Becos answers from a context with 90% fewer characters than the whole conversation. Its configuration was developed on LoCoMo itself, so there is no held-out set. With gpt-4o-mini answers it scores clearly higher than the whole conversation (79.7 vs 73.0 with the short prompt, paired 95% interval for the difference +3.8 to +9.5; 88.8 vs 77.5 with a step-by-step prompt). With gpt-4.1-mini answers the two score about the same (83.2 vs 83.1; 92.5 vs 92.1). We release every answer and verdict and the scoring script.

### 338. [STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19214v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19214

**作者：** Youngseok Yoon、Peng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19214v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19214v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 STaSBO，用 LLM 作为任务无关的元控制器为贝叶斯优化规划搜索策略并联合选择代理模型与采集函数配置，数值 BO 仍负责概率建模和候选生成，并以结构化记忆连接历史计划、配置选择与优化状态。

**相关性简评：** 其按优化状态修订行为计划、用记忆组织历史决策并借前瞻诊断暴露候选行为的做法，可能与 LVR 中动态计算分配、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的触发与停止决策及状态抽象存在概念联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. To navigate the large joint configuration space, the selection stage shortlists configurations using surrogate fit evidence. Prospective BO-action diagnostics then expose the candidate behaviors, supporting final joint selection against the behavioral plans. Across 12 synthetic mathematical and 10 scientific and engineering application tasks, STaSBO achieves the best average rank against 11 baselines: 2.17 and 2.60, compared with 4.08 and 4.10 for the strongest baseline in each suite, respectively.

</details>

### 339. [Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19237v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19237

**作者：** Bangjie Deng、Xiaoxuan Lu、Wenjun Chen、Chengge Wen、Yulin Wang、Jiayue Meng、Yao Yu、Liying Liang、Weijia Han、Ziwei Hong、Zidong Yu

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文形式化 LLM agent 审批中的「拒绝安全」与「有界授权完整性」，在模型、harness 与 workflow 三个执行边界上做配对实验与轨迹审计，定位「意图→生成调用→调度→真实效应」链条中首个可观测分叉点，并提出可独立验证的审计契约。

**相关性简评：** 该审计契约「上游已批准的决策是否真正传导到下游效应」的思路，可供核查 LVR 中「答案是否实际使用 latent 内容」的贡献分配与证据丢失定位；但其对象是 agent 授权与工作流，与视觉推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditable Authorization for LLM Agents: Empirical Evidence Across Model, Harness, and Workflow Layers

**abstract/A1：** Human approval provides effective control only if rejected work stops and authorized work completes. We formalize refusal safety and bounded authorization completeness, and audit three execution boundaries: the model selects a call, the harness schedules and resumes it, and the workflow routes the decision to a protected effect. Paired decisions, exact traces, and native business-state witnesses support experiments with three models, five prompt arms, four runtime approval designs, two additional framework replays, and 100 public workflow sources. The paired model panel leaves seven of 300 approvals unfinished despite zero denied effects; parallel confirmation loses an approved branch in three tasks per model, restoration omits 336/672 CrewAI approvals, and four of 59 comparable n8n workflows execute after Reject. Comparing intent, generated calls, dispatch, and native effects identifies the first observable divergence and its repair target. This yields a practical audit contract that makes both refusal safety and authorization completeness independently verifiable, converting human approval from a procedural formality into an enforceable control boundary between intent and real-world effect.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 340. [GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19247v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19247

**作者：** Bing He、Runze Wang、Fei Zha、Zhongyuan Wu、Ke Xu、Tao Zhuang、Yuxuan Xie、Zhongyuan Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19247v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19247v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GameWM 这一游戏系统设计：由引擎保留规则、世界状态、相机与布局等必须精确的部分，视频世界模型只负责生成画面外观与交互细节，并配套以交互为中心的数据引擎、创作内容接口，以及 5B 至 33B 的模型家族（含实时因果变体）。

**相关性简评：** 其「精确状态外置、生成模型只承担外观」的分工可作为反向对照线索，帮助核查任务必要信息是否必须留在 latent 状态中；但该工作不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent reasoning，联系较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models

**abstract/A1：** For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, technical report

</details>

### 341. [ReCALM: A Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism for Distributed Continual Service Construction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19276v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19276

**作者：** Kejia Fan、Yajiang Huang、Jianheng Tang、Jinfeng Xu、Huiping Zhuang、Anfeng Liu、Houbing Herbert Song、Yunhuai Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19276v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19276v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReCALM，用免梯度的闭式解残差块结合最小二乘的跨递归策略，在分布式持续服务构建中实现深层非线性表示并缓解异构数据下的灾难性遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 该文的残差式闭式递归状态更新可能为 LVR 中循环/潜状态模块的免反向传播训练与旧状态保持提供可供核查的线索，但与视觉证据和推理评测无直接联系，迁移性待判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReCALM: A Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism for Distributed Continual Service Construction

**abstract/A1：** Crowdsourcing has emerged as a promising paradigm for constructing AI services by harnessing the collective capabilities of distributed workers. As consumers' demands continually evolve, service models must acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned information. However, due to the inherited reliance on gradients for backpropagation, existing approaches typically suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual model updates on heterogeneous data. Recent studies have introduced analytic learning, a gradient-free paradigm that achieves invariance through recursive closed-form solutions. Nevertheless, existing analytic methods are typically constrained by single-layer linear networks, which tend to suffer from underfitting due to their inability to perform deep representation learning. To address this issue, we propose ReCALM, a Residual-enhanced Crowdsourced Analytic Learning Mechanism that achieves deep nonlinear invariance for distributed continual service construction. Inspired by the success of ResNet, we develop gradient-free residual blocks for ReCALM with closed-form solutions. To implement distributed continual training for ReCALM, we further devise a cross-recursive strategy via least squares. Both theoretical and experimental analyses verify ReCALM's dual superiority in heterogeneity invariance and deep representation. With 20 residual layers, ReCALM improves accuracy by 8.85%-9.83% over the single-layer analytic baseline, while reducing computational costs by over 94% compared with gradient-based baselines.

</details>

### 342. [Generate, Align, and Restore: MLLM-Empowered Diffusion for Generalizable Low-light Image Enhancement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19285

**作者：** Kaisheng Pang、Feng Li、Chen Zhang、Junjun Jiang、Haoang Li、Sam Kwong、Runmin Cong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19285v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MrLIE，用 MLLM 从退化夜景观测中迭代生成、诊断并修正正常光参考图，再配合置信度偏移与结构锚定注入的条件扩散，实现无监督暗光增强。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成—诊断—修正」的 MLLM 评论循环与参考可靠性校验，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与迭代状态修正提供概念参照，但输出是增强图像而非推理状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Generate, Align, and Restore: MLLM-Empowered Diffusion for Generalizable Low-light Image Enhancement

**abstract/A1：** Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is essential to numerous vision applications operating under adverse illumination. Despite substantial advances, real-world nighttime enhancement remains challenging due to the scarcity of strictly aligned day-night pairs and complex degradations involving extreme darkness and heterogeneous artificial light sources, leading to fragile generalization. To overcome these challenges, we propose MrLIE (MLLM-empowered reference Low-light Image Enhancement), a novel reference-based unsupervised LLIE framework that synergizes the generative and reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with conditional diffusion. MrLIE employs the MLLM as a high-fidelity reference synthesizer and diagnostic critic, iteratively generating, diagnosing, and correcting normal-light references directly from degraded nighttime observations. Based on this, our method governs the enhancement process through two complementary mechanisms, in which a confidence offset module rectifies spatial-geometric inconsistencies for reference reliability and a structure-anchored injection scheme harmonizes aligned reference cues, low-light structural constraints, and ControlNet additive anchoring during the denoising process. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that MrLIE achieves superior perceptual quality, natural appearance, and robust generalization.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 343. [Where Mixture Recognition Fails: An Ingredient-Level Audit of Unseen Combinations in SmellNet](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19297v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19297

**作者：** Zirui Liu、Zheming Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19297v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19297v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文审计电子鼻混合物识别基准 SmellNet：留出未见成分组合、在不告知成分数的条件下评测四种架构，并复核官方 unseen split，发现失败集中在模型无法分离的成分与高频成分偏好上，而非架构本身。

**相关性简评：** 虽属化学传感而非视觉，但其「去除 oracle 成分数先验、改用集合级错误」的评测口径与逐成分失败归因，可能为 LVR 中步骤数/停止决策先验和集合式输出评测提供可核查的思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Mixture Recognition Fails: An Ingredient-Level Audit of Unseen Combinations in SmellNet

**abstract/A1：** An electronic nose must name every ingredient of a mixture, including combinations it has never measured. SmellNet, a public benchmark for this task, scores ingredients with a hit rate that is told how many each sample contains. We audit what this protocol hides. We hold out ingredient combinations from the SmellNet training data, evaluate four architectures (MLP, CNN, LSTM and a Transformer encoder) without revealing the ingredient count, and repeat the evaluation once on the official unseen split. Under the count-informed protocol, 90-96% of mixtures receive an ingredient that is absent, on our folds and on the official split alike. On our folds, every model identifies one ingredient reliably but the second rarely, and it completes the pair with a familiar training partner about twice as often as chance. On the official split, even the first-ranked ingredient is correct in only 29-46% of binary mixtures, often because a frequent training ingredient that is absent from every test pair is ranked first, and on its combinations that are truly absent from training no model names both ingredients in more than 1.2% of them. The failures fall on the same ingredients for every architecture, and a frequency correction only moves errors between ingredients. Mixture recognition is therefore limited by ingredients the models cannot separate and by a preference for frequent ingredients, not by the architecture, and it should be evaluated with set-level errors and without oracle cardinality.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 4 tables, 2 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 NetBreaker，将 30 种（12 种学习型）网络拆解方法统一到同一分类体系，在 8 个领域共 185 个网络上按统一删点序列协议，从目标有效性、轨迹有效性、结构诊断与计算效率四方面比较，发现学习型方法并未稳定优于强非学习方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「把异构输出统一为删点序列并按轨迹评价」的协议，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据逐步筛选/剪枝的顺序决策与删除轨迹评价提供可核查的度量思路；与 latent 表示和 VLM 推理本身无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NetBreaker: Benchmarking Network Dismantling across Objectives, Scales, and Toplogoies

**abstract/A1：** Network dismantling seeks to fragment a network with as few node removals as possible, which is widely applied in vulnerability analysis, epidemic containment, and infrastructure protection. Although learning-based methods have become increasingly prominent, their progress remains difficult to assess because existing studies differ in method coverage, datasets, evaluation criteria, and experimental protocols. Thus, we introduce NetBreaker, a comprehensive benchmark designed for the learning era of network dismantling. NetBreaker organizes 30 methods (18 non-learning and 12 learning-based) under a common taxonomy and evaluates them on 185 networks from eight unified domains, ranging from 14 to 1.69 million nodes. To enable fair comparison, heterogeneous method outputs are converted into node removal sequences and assessed under a unified execution protocol. The evaluation covers four complementary dimensions: target-based effectiveness, trajectory-based effectiveness, structural diagnostics, and applicability &amp; computational efficiency. Extensive experiments show that current learningbased methods do not consistently outperform strong non-learning approaches, while exposing substantial differences in effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency across network conditions and evaluation perspectives. NetBreaker provides a reproducible basis for measuring progress and developing reliable, scalable, and computationally efficient network dismantling methods.

</details>

**abstract/A1：** A backdoored language model behaves normally until a trigger phrase appears in its input. Every published method for recovering such a trigger runs the model. **内容简述：** 该论文把 LLM 多智能体市场视为世界模型，提出只逐日公布参考路径而不干预个体决策的「软宏观控制」方法，并设计两阶段（宏观信息到微观行为、微观行为到宏观结果）评价框架，在五个单指数市场上验证追踪效果与结构性偏差。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages; 6 figures, 17 tables

**内容简述：** 这是一篇立场/展望论文，主张把越狱攻击与安全护栏视为两个相互竞争的种群，借鉴兵棋推演中的双种群竞争性协同演化（交替演化与交叉对弈评估），并引入成本、效率等多个冲突准则，讨论该机制迁移到 LM 安全与 agentic web 的开放问题。

**相关性简评：** 其「多冲突准则下的持续对抗评估」框架或可启发 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等策略的收益–成本多目标评价与动态计算预算设定，但全文不涉及视觉或多模态推理与 latent 状态，联系较远，仅供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hardening Agentic Web Populations Through Multi-Criterion Competitive Co-Evolution: Lessons from Wargame Strategy Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Agents on the open web will face adversaries that keep adapting, so a defense that is only tested once will eventually be found and broken. We propose treating jailbreak attacks and safety guardrails as two populations that evolve against each other, rather than as a fixed attacker probing a fixed defense. This idea comes directly from wargame strategy optimization, where two-population competitive co-evolution with alternating evolution cycles and cross-play evaluation has already been shown to produce strategies that are robust to a moving opponent, and where a companion line of work has shown that the same machinery can measure how much competitive pressure a population must absorb. However, real-world applications can never rely on a single criterion as a key performance indicator, rather must use multiple conflicting criteria, such as, cost and efficiency. We describe how this mechanism transfers to language model safety, argue why the resulting multi-criteria, competitive and coevolutionary arms race is a genuinely networked, population-level problem rather than a two-agent toy setting, and lay out the open problems that stand between the wargame version of this idea and an agentic web version of it.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 1st NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Agentic Web: Decentralized, Continually-Adapting Agent Ecosystems (https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/loc/atlanta/174837)

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19323v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19323v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究缺货造成的销量日志截断如何使真实需求不可识别，用嵌套缺货阈值给出兼容需求律的精确集合与策略评估的有限表示，并选一个确定性订货规则最小化相对知情最优的最大期望成本差，界定该「数据债务」与有限样本学习误差及所需样本量速率。

**相关性简评：** 「观测日志无法识别潜在信息」以及「更紧的保证不等于实际收益」这一结构，可能与 LVR 中从输出/轨迹反推 latent 内容、并区分更多计算与更紧评价的问题形成概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Data Debt of Stockouts: Partial Identification and Minimax-Regret Inventory Control

**abstract/A1：** Problem definition: Inventory decisions select which demand enters sales logs. Unrecorded forecasts can leave demand frequencies unidentified even when stocking levels are recorded. We study which multistage ordering decisions these logs can justify and what finite samples can guarantee. Methodology/results: Nested stockout thresholds yield exact sets of compatible demand laws and finite representations for policy evaluation. We choose one deterministic inventory rule to minimize its largest expected cost gap from the informed optimum under the same law. This population value is data debt for the specified information and policy class. Under independent demand, carryover can create positive debt despite common optimal actions in every isolated period. Finite samples add learning error above debt. The required sample count grows linearly with the selection bound, with upper and lower orders matching up to logarithmic factors. This rate requires fixed demand and cost bounds, sufficient revelation, and a uniformly positive probability of clearing all feasible stock across the confidence sets. Controlled and semi-synthetic studies separate policy improvements from tighter guarantees. Managerial implications: More records can tighten guarantees while debt persists. Deeper revelation can establish common optimality without fully identifying demand. Using these guarantees requires validated logging, a credible selection range, and a regret tolerance in cost units. Information acquisition must distinguish tighter assurance from operating savings.

</details>

### 349. [Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19325v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19325

**作者：** Wenwen Lou、Mingyi He、Xinyi Guo、Yining Li、Weiming Chen、Jiawen Li、Lianghui Zhu、Zhiwei Yang、Xitong Ling

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19325v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19325v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 SRDP，一种免训练的几何感知读出方式：以半步长应用冻结的 patch 投影并交错四个偏移格点，将细胞掩膜映射为分数覆盖权重，再把整体细胞池化与两个内边界池化拼接，用于从病理基础模型中提取细粒度细胞表示。

**相关性简评：** 其「按掩膜分数覆盖重加权、避免混入邻近组织」的读出思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与细节保留问题，即如何从冻结视觉特征中按区域对齐地取出任务必要信息；但原文并不涉及 latent 推理或多模态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unlocking Fine-Grained Cell Representations via Soft-Interior Rim Dense-Grid Pooling in Pathology Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Fine-grained cell representations are essential for characterizing cellular heterogeneity and tissue organization in computational pathology. Pathology foundation models (PFMs) provide powerful pretrained features for transferable tissue analysis. HoVer-Net uses task-trained segmentation and typing, whereas CellViT++ averages native-grid tokens assigned to detected nuclei. However, the former requires cell-specific training; the latter ignores fractional nuclear coverage and can mix nuclear content with neighbouring tissue. Therefore, we propose SRDP, short for Soft-interior Rim Dense-grid Pooling, a training-free geometry-aware readout. We apply the frozen patch projection at half stride, interleave four offset lattices, map the cell mask to fractional coverage weights, and concatenate whole-cell pooling with two inner boundary pools. Across four datasets and six frozen encoders, SRDP improves mean balanced accuracy by 5.68 percentage points over native token averaging across 24 settings, including 11.22 points on average for CoNIC and Lizard. SRDP converts a coarse frozen PFM lattice into a mask-aligned, fine-grained cell representation without updating the encoder.

</details>

### 350. [NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19332v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19332

**作者：** Yinghao Li、WeiHsien Lee、Zeyu Zhang、Canyang Zhao、Ke Fang、Xing Li、Bing Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19332v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19332v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出分层「脑-具身」框架：先把一段运动皮层信号一次性读取为持久的意图表示，再由视觉-本体感知的 visuomotor 策略闭环完成抓取，并在反事实抓取任务中比较全群体 latent 与 one-hot 方向标签、不同读出脑区与读出时机的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「完整 latent 作意图 token 优于离散标签」及「读出位置与时机的差异」可能为 LVR 中 latent 承载何种任务信息、以及读取 latent 状态的时机与位置提供类比线索，但属脑机接口与机器人领域，需核查是否真与视觉推理状态有关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NI-ACT: A Neural Intent Interface for Brain-Embodied Manipulation

**abstract/A1：** Intracortical brain-computer interfaces can drive robotic arms, but they keep the user inside the fast sensorimotor loop: every approach, correction, and grasp must be neurally specified. Whether intracortical population activity can instead serve as a task-level condition for a learned embodied policy, without symbolic commands or hand-designed skill libraries, remains unknown. NI-ACT addresses this question with a hierarchical brain-embodied framework: a brief motor-cortical signal is read once as a persistent intent, and a visuomotor policy then closes the perception-action loop from vision and proprioception. In a counterfactual grasping task where the scene cannot specify the target, the neural intent alone determined which object the robot grasped; replacing the intent changed the behavior accordingly. Passing the full population latent as a dedicated intent token, rather than a one-hot decoded direction, raised grasp completion from 69% to 81% over 132 held-out scenes, whereas a continuous direction alone did not improve on a one-hot label. Where the signal was read also mattered: in one dual-array session, with the readout window matched, premotor (PMd) intent completed more grasps than primary motor (M1) intent (77% vs. 53%), and the conventional post-cue M1 readout reached 42%. Preparatory activity was itself sufficient: in a center-out task, intent read only from PMd before the go cue (that is, before any movement) drove complete grasps, and in one recording it completed more grasps than the same animal's post-cue readout. These results show that how a neural signal is represented, and where and when it is read, jointly determine how effectively it conveys movement goals to an embodied agent.

</details>

### 351. [$β$-number and Its Applications to Data Science](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19379v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19379

**作者：** Pengxu Wen、Ziwei Nie、Liwen Zou、Ying Cao、Xiaoping Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19379v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19379v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「β-number」这一度量，用最优 d 维平面刻画集合的 p 阶 d 维振荡程度，给出上下界与尺度律，证明 p=2 的离散情形与 PCA 一致，并用于降维与图像分类。

**相关性简评：** 作为 PCA 的推广型子空间/振荡度量，可能为分析 latent 状态的表示几何提供工具，但其本身不涉及多模态推理，能否区分内容、深度、位置等效应可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** $β$-number and Its Applications to Data Science

**abstract/A1：** In this paper, we introduce a novel metric, $β$-number, designed to measure the "$p$-th order $d$-dimensional oscillation degree" of a set. For a given set $K$ in the Euclidean space $\\mathbb{R}^n$, $β$-number is computed by identifying an optimal $d$-dimensional plane $L$ that minimizes the average $p$-th order distance of all points in $K$ to $L$. This metric serves as a versatile tool in data science, functioning both as a dimensionality reduction technique to find the optimal $p$-th order $d$-dimensional subspace and as a measure to characterize data oscillation for classification. We conduct a thorough exploration of $β$-number through theoretical analysis and numerical experiments. Initially, we establish the upper and lower bounds of $β$-number for any set $K$, along with its scaling law. We then elucidate the relationships between $β$-number and its related parameters. A key finding of this study is that in discrete settings, when $p=2$, the $d$-dimensional plane determined by $β$-number coincides with that obtained via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), positioning $β$-number as a generalization of PCA. Furthermore, we propose two algorithms for calculating $β$-number in both continuous and discrete settings. We validate our theoretical results through a series of numerical experiments in low-dimensional cases. Finally, we demonstrate the potential of $β$-number in practical data analysis through a dimensionality reduction task and an image classification task.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 15 figures, including appendices

</details>

### 352. [Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19385v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19385

**作者：** Zhongke Qu、Yunwei Zhang、Junwei Su、Yabin Zhang、Chengwei Li、Qingxiang Shui、Hailong Qu、Zhaolin Gu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19385v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19385v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文指出 LLM agent 完成 CFD 仿真运行并不等于交付可用结果，构建了含 200 个任务的城市风环境基准（区分结构分与独立重算的数值分），并提出加入契约解析、执行溯源、确定性验证与有限验收的 WindPilot 框架。

**相关性简评：** 其「运行完成≠结果可用」的判据与把交付物合规和基于原始证据的独立重算分开打分的思路，可能为 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用视觉/latent 证据」的评测设计与停止决策提供参照，但领域相距较远，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?

**abstract/A1：** AI agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now configure and run computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, but a completed run does not ensure that delivered metrics can be recomputed from raw outputs. This gap was examined for urban wind simulation, where multi-case comparisons must hold non-target conditions fixed and reported values must be traceable to raw samples. UrbanWind-AgentBench, comprising 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, was constructed. Public task contracts specify variable factors, fixed conditions, numerical thresholds and deliverable requirements, and two-layer scoring separates a structural score for deliverables, run provenance and raw evidence from a numerical score obtained by independent recomputation against references. WindPilot was then proposed as an execution framework that incorporates contract parsing, execution provenance, deterministic verification and bounded acceptance review into the LLM execution loop. On 30 OpenFOAM tasks with independent references, at least the structural maximum of 60 points was reached by a base agent on 28 tasks, but numerical credit was obtained on only 6. With the same model name and budget, WindPilot increased the number of tasks with numerical credit to 17, full-score tasks from 0 to 3 and the mean task score from 62.5 to 72.5. Mean action steps fell from 130.4 to 104.9, and mean token consumption decreased by 12.9%. The mean gain for atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) tasks was 18.5 points. A completed simulation run is therefore not sufficient for a usable urban wind result; usability depends on checks that tie reported metrics to raw evidence during execution.

</details>

### 353. [SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19409v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19409

**作者：** Bo Wang、Dekang Zhu、Jian Li、Zhipeng Meng、Bo Wang、Dewen Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19409v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19409v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向 3D 场景流估计，提出两帧骨干 SimpleFlow3D（先解耦再耦合地分层构建 3D 运动特征），并用权重共享的多帧框架将前一帧的运动特征 splat 到当前估计中，形成 SplatFlow3D，在 KITTI 与 Spring 上降低误差并改善遮挡与非刚性运动处理。

**相关性简评：** 其做法是把跨帧抽取的几何特征 splat 并复用为当前步的估计输入，可能为 latent 推理状态在遮挡条件下如何跨步传播与更新提供可供核查的类比，但与 VLM 推理、证据筛选与停止决策无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SplatFlow3D: Learning Scene Flow via 3D Motion Feature Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Considering the motion continuity and stability of 3D objects over short inter-frame intervals, introducing multi-frame settings in scene flow estimation can potentially address occlusion. In this paper, we propose a two-frame backbone, SimpleFlow3D, which integrates dense information from the image plane and sparse information from the depth dimension in a decoupling-followed-by-coupling manner by hierarchically constructing the 3D motion feature. SimpleFlow3D achieves SOTA results with minimal parameters. We also propose a weight-sharing multi-frame framework to splat the previous 3D motion feature to the current estimation process. The framework unifies the first and non-first frame inference by constructing pseudo inputs. After combining the proposed framework and backbone, the newly born multi-frame method SplatFlow3D further advances the state of the art. It achieves lower errors than the two-frame backbone, with fewer parameters than current methods. On both KITTI and Spring, SplatFlow3D ranked 1st over all published and submitted methods. Experiments show that SplatFlow3D improves occlusion handling, non-rigid motion estimation, and generalization to real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/SplatFlow3D.

</details>

### 354. [Probing SAM Perturbations Through Statistical Replay](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19480v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19480

**作者：** Ting Han、Jens Kleesiek、Michael Kamp

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19480v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19480v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 上提出「统计回放」诊断：将参考 SAM 轨迹中的扰动按局部窗口压缩为逐元素均值与标准差，在独立 SGD 训练中重建扰动，并结合纯各向同性噪声、等半径随机方向以及来源、时间、层级干预，检验哪些扰动成分足以复现 SAM 的验证表现。

**相关性简评：** 该工作与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，但其「用轨迹统计摘要回放 + 分层干预」的因果式诊断思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配与状态更新是否必要，属于较远的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probing SAM Perturbations Through Statistical Replay

**abstract/A1：** Sharpness Aware Minimization (SAM) updates model parameters using gradients evaluated at adversarially perturbed weights, but it remains unclear which aspects of this procedure are sufficient to reproduce its generalization behavior. In our ResNet 18 experiments on CIFAR 10, simple curvature regularizers based on the Hessian trace and largest eigenvalue remain below SAM in validation accuracy, motivating a direct examination of its perturbations. We introduce statistical replay, a diagnostic that summarizes perturbations from reference SAM trajectories using elementwise means and standard deviations over local windows and constructs new perturbations during independent SGD training. Pure replay uses only these summaries, whereas mixed replay adds isotropic Gaussian noise. Pure replay does not reproduce SAM's validation behavior, while mixed replay and pure isotropic perturbations can approach its validation performance at selected scales without reproducing its training dynamics. An equal radius random direction within SAM performs similarly to SGD, and source, temporal, and layer interventions further suggest that replay behavior depends on perturbation construction. Together, these preliminary results weaken several simple explanations of SAM while leaving an important part of its mechanism unexplained.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: AXIOM - Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning

</details>
