### 355. [LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19530v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19530

**作者：** Jackson Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19530v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19530v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 rta-bench-1：覆盖三段美国行情、按新闻发布分钟回放且无前视的回测基准，把收益拆为因子暴露与 alpha，并与同日同行业随机选股对比；91 次运行显示无显著 alpha，暴露中位数占收益 78%，决策不优于随机，去掉新闻标题后收益不变。

**相关性简评：** 其对「去掉新闻后表现不变」的消融与同分布随机基线，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用（视觉旁路）及贡献分配的评价设计参考，但属金融智能体应用，与多模态推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent's share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code, frozen markets and leaderboard: https://github.com/jackson-cmd/risk-aware-trading-agents. Original empirical study: a backtest benchmark for LLM trading agents and measurements from 91 runs of six models

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 EHRDiB，把电子病历的就诊补全与合成统一起来，区分原始缺失与主动隐藏的输入，结合共享多模态表示与证据条件潜在扩散桥；在 MIMIC-IV 和 Duke Health 上评估下游预测效用、生成多样性与披露风险。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据比例—效用—泄露风险」的扫描式评价与「原始缺失 vs 被隐藏输入」的区分，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选程度如何影响 latent 状态可用性与信息泄露提供评价思路，可供核查，但任务与推理机制相距较远。

**title/T1：** Evidence-Conditioned Completion and Synthesis of Electronic Health Records

**abstract/A1：** Patient information can guide electronic health record (EHR) generation, but how its amount shapes predictive utility and disclosure risk remains poorly characterized. Here we present EHRDiB, which unifies visit completion and synthesis by distinguishing original missingness from withheld inputs and combining a shared multimodal representation with an evidence-conditioned latent diffusion bridge. We compared EHRDiB with three completion and eight synthesis methods on MIMIC-IV and numerical and discretized Duke Health representations. Evaluation covered downstream predictive utility, generative diversity, and distributional fidelity for both tasks, and disclosure risk for synthesis. EHRDiB achieved the smallest utility gaps from real-data-trained classifiers in seven of eight completion comparisons. In synthesis, AUPRC gaps were 45.2% smaller for ten MIMIC-IV principal-diagnosis targets and 53.3% smaller for numerical Duke Health data relative to the best comparator. Synthesis with calibrated thresholding yielded the lowest marginal distribution error across all three datasets, with Coverage above 0.95 for both output rules. Across twelve evidence-fraction intervals in MIMIC-IV synthesis, membership-inference AUROC increased from 0.516 to 0.598 as the mean target evidence fraction rose from 0.20 to 0.50; utility gaps narrowed relative to the lowest evidence configuration but did not decrease monotonically. Our study provides a unified framework and empirical foundation for EHR generation that considers both its utility for clinical analysis and its information disclosure risk.

### 357. [Random Cut Forests, Games and Diffusion over Approximately Nested Anisotropic Local Geometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19548v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以随机切割森林保留的数据演化几何为基础，将扩散动力学、预测、解释与合作博弈统一到每棵树的稀疏电阻网络与单一能量（Hamiltonian）框架中，通过不同的「夹取」选择对应不同问题，并支持流式更新。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接交集；但其用近似嵌套、各向异性的局部几何把估计、支持证据与干预响应纳入同一能量核算，可能为 latent 推理中的证据贡献分配与不确定度刻画提供可供核查的概念类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Random Cut Forests, Games and Diffusion over Approximately Nested Anisotropic Local Geometry

**abstract/A1：** Just as the data in a dynamic stream changes, questions asked of the stream also change in intent: what to hold constant, which counterfactuals to consider, and so forth. Energy-based learning has been celebrated for its uniform approach to losses and estimation, but interpretability remains challenging. Tree-based methods, on the other hand, offer high interpretability but often rely on bespoke, disjointed estimators. Neither paradigm readily supports changing questions on streaming data. In this paper we take a step towards combining energy, interpretability, and streaming. Random cut forests retain an evolving geometry of the data. We study this geometry as the basis for diffusion dynamics, prediction, explanation, and games. We show that several existing scores are escape probabilities of random walks on the trees. The induced affinity is realized exactly by a sparse electrical network on each tree, giving a single energy calculus, a Hamiltonian, maintained along one path per update. This connects an estimate, its supporting evidence, and the response to intervention through the same boxes, gaps, masses, and paths. Different questions correspond to different clamp decisions on the energy. Fixing observed values gives harmonic prediction with Gaussian uncertainty. Fixing a partition gives normalized cuts whose cost is attributed exactly to oriented faces. Releasing clamps gives coalition games, in which collusive displacement measures the field response. With noise, the same energy gives diffusion dynamics whose relaxation rates are read from the boxes. Axis-parallel cuts localize at a rate set by affine rather than ambient dimension, and this control passes to the averaged energy. Across a forest the boxes are only approximately nested; common reference observations align the trees. A rotating star with added noise illustrates the measurements.

</details>

### 358. [Lesion-Aware Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading from Fundus Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19550v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19550

**作者：** Truong Thinh Nguyen、Hai Phong Nguyen、Truong Thanh Hung Nguyen、Giang Son Tran、Hung Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19550v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19550v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CCEM，用删除敏感度、方法间一致性、紧凑性、视网膜包含度等无需标注的可靠性线索为 Grad-CAM++、Ada-SISE 与 SG-IG 生成逐图权重并融合，并在带专家像素级病灶标注的 MAPLES-DR 上评估解释图的病灶支持度与忠实性。

**相关性简评：** 其以删除敏感度和多方法一致性筛选、加权视觉证据的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选以及「答案是否真正依赖所关注的视觉内容」的忠实性检验提供核查线索；但任务是糖网分级，与 latent 推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lesion-Aware Explainable AI for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading from Fundus Images

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc explanations of deep-learning models for diabetic retinopathy (DR) grading are difficult to trust because different attribution methods highlight different retinal regions for the same image, and a visually plausible heatmap does not show that the highlighted pixels drive the prediction. We propose the Consensus-Calibrated Explanation Map (CCEM), which fuses Grad-CAM++, Ada-SISE, and SmoothGrad Integrated Gradients (SG-IG) using image-specific weights derived from annotation-free reliability cues: deletion sensitivity, inter-method agreement, compactness, retinal containment, and peak structure. CCEM explains a frozen ordinal grader, an EfficientNet-B7 with CBAM and a scalar regression head, pre-trained on EyePACS 2015 in Stage 1 and fine-tuned on APTOS 2019 in Stage 2 with quadratic weighted kappa (QWK)-optimized thresholds; it reaches a QWK of 0.920 on the hidden Kaggle test set and 0.559 on the external MAPLES-DR cohort. Explanations are evaluated on MAPLES-DR, 198 MESSIDOR images with expert pixel-level lesion annotations that are never used for training, threshold fitting, or fusion. On the 193 images with annotated lesions, CCEM obtains the highest Soft Pointing Game score (69.61%; 95% CI 63.7-75.3), defined as the ratio of the strongest lesion-supported saliency to the global map maximum rather than a lesion detection rate, together with the lowest deletion AUC (0.570) and the best deletion-insertion balance (0.115); each gain is significant against the strongest single explainer on paired tests. Annotation-free, per-image reliability weighting therefore turns three disagreeing explainers into one map whose peak evidence is more lesion-supported and more faithful to the model than that of any single explainer.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Truong Thinh Nguyen and Hai Phong Nguyen contributed equally. Corresponding author: Truong Thinh Nguyen

### 359. [Sharp First-Hit Identification from Finite Depth Samples](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19563v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19563

**作者：** Hamidreza Hasani Balyani、Mahtab Movahhedrad、Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19563v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19563v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究有限深度采样下新视角首达深度的可识别性：以有界 Lipschitz 逆深度场刻画可达首达深度集合，给出尖锐的最坏情形逆深度直径界、多深度共场景可行性检验与有理数验证器，并在含立体与学习深度的场景上做固定评估。

**相关性简评：** 它形式化地刻画有限视觉观测能约束多少首达几何，并指出超过临界基线斜率后加密采样也无法消除歧义，可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据是否充分、何时停止获取」提供参照，且提示学习深度带可能给出窄但错误的可达集合，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sharp First-Hit Identification from Finite Depth Samples

**abstract/A1：** Which depths in a new camera view are determined by finitely many source-depth measurements? Pointwise uncertainty bounds do not answer this question: unobserved geometry between samples can change which surface is encountered first. We study a bounded Lipschitz class of continuous source inverse-depth fields with interval observations and known camera pose. Building on classical Lipschitz envelopes, we characterize the exact set of attainable first-hit depths and construct a globally admissible scene for every value in that set. The set can be disconnected. We also give a necessary and sufficient test for several proposed depths to be first hits of one shared scene. An epipolar reduction uses scalar cone inequalities without enumerating surfaces. In a rectified model with source spacing $h$, interval half-width $\\varepsilon$, baseline $b$, and slope bound $L$, we prove a sharp worst-case inverse-depth diameter of $\\max\\{Lh+2\\varepsilon,2\\varepsilon/(1-bL)\\}$ when $bL&lt;1$, subject to sufficient depth and domain range for attainment. Exact samples still give the sharp bound $Lh$ at $bL=1$, while above this threshold ambiguity need not vanish as sampling becomes arbitrarily dense. Any positive measurement uncertainty can destroy uniform stability at the critical threshold. We provide constructive examples, an exact rational validation oracle, and a frozen ten-scene evaluation using reference, stereo, and learned-depth observations. The experiments separate solver correctness under the scene assumptions from failure of those assumptions: fixed learned-depth bands often yield narrow but incorrect sets. The results identify what a specified scene class permits; they do not infer a continuum regularity or physical-scene guarantee from sampled predictions.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 9 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

</details>

### 360. [Explicit Regularization for Flow Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19587v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19587

**作者：** Lars Ruthotto、Eran Treister

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.NA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19587v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19587v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 理论分析 flow matching 经验问题在数据附近的不适定性与记忆化倾向，证明当 2k&gt;D 且训练点处于一般位置时惩罚速度场的 k 阶导数可使问题在时间上一致适定，并用一、二维样条离散实验验证正则化流动的误差不随分辨率提升而趋向记忆化。

**相关性简评：** 该文与视觉推理无直接关系，但其关于学习动力场记忆化与泛化的诊断，以及用高阶导数惩罚约束状态轨迹的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练监督与过度拟合视觉细节的问题提供可供核查的参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Explicit Regularization for Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Learning the underlying probability distribution from samples is a core problem in statistics and applied mathematics. Generative models based on diffusion and flow matching learn a velocity field whose flow transports a known distribution to the data distribution. They produce novel, realistic samples, although the empirical learning problem is ill posed near the data distribution. Its minimizer transports the samples onto the training data, and small perturbations of the data change the velocity field strongly near the end of the flow. The observed generalization is often attributed to implicit regularization by the network parameterization, early stopping of the training, and the time integration during sampling. Explicit regularization has advanced the theory and computation of many inverse problems and has recently been proposed to prevent memorization in generative models. With a regularizer on the magnitude of the velocity, however, the field approaches the memorizing velocity unless the regularization parameter grows to infinity fast enough, and it then stays bounded by a constant that is small only for large parameters. We show that penalizing the derivatives of order $k$ of the velocity renders the $D$-dimensional empirical problem well posed uniformly in time if $2k &gt; D$ and the training points are in general position. Our experiments in one and two dimensions discretize the velocity with splines and use direct solvers for the regularized least-squares problems to exclude optimization error. Refining the discretization in space and time changes the error of the Hessian-regularized flows only marginally, whereas without the regularizer the error tends to that of memorization. These flows generalize, with errors comparable to or lower than those of well-tuned kernel density estimates.

**comment/C1：** 40 pages (main text pp. 1-24, references pp. 24-26, appendices A-C pp. 27-40), 4 figures, 11 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 该论文训练一个可同时处理语义与空间任务的音视频模型：先用自动管线定位声源、估计相对 3D 轨迹并渲染双耳音频，从而大规模合成空间化数据（如 VGGSound），以缓解真实数据稀缺、提升空间任务的泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其「语义—空间」表征的联合建模与泛化评测，可能为判断 LVR 内部状态是否保留任务必要的几何与关系信息提供参照；合成数据管线（声源定位＋轨迹标注）也可供核查能否用于几何证据类监督，但该文不涉及 latent 推理或推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Spatially Aware Audio-Visual Features from Videos with Mono Audio

**abstract/A1：** Comprehensive audio-visual perception requires both semantic and spatial reasoning. Existing spatial models suffer from poor generalization due to data scarcity, while semantic-only models fail to capture spatial characteristics completely. We introduce a model capable of jointly reasoning over binaural audio and vision on semantic and spatial tasks with improved generalization. To overcome the shortage in real-world data, we develop an automatic pipeline that localizes the sound source in a video, estimates its relative 3D trajectory, and renders binaural audio. We then use this to spatialize VGGSound, allowing us to train at a much larger scale. We demonstrate improved performance and generalization on spatial reasoning tasks while still remaining competitive on semantic tasks compared to semantic-only models.

### 362. [Synthetic Neurosymbolic Task Generation with Controlled Constraint Complexity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19597v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19597

**作者：** Mykhailo Buleshnyi、Zsolt Zombori、Michael Benedikt

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.LO、cs.NE、cs.SC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19597v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19597v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NeSySy，一个神经符号任务的合成生成器，可细粒度控制约束结构、紧致度、输入依赖性和数据对齐方式，并用求解器校验约束与样本一致性，进而比较显式约束执行与无约束模型学习约束结构的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其“受控约束复杂度＋求解器认证数据”可能为 LVR 中检验内部状态是否保留任务必要结构、以及显式结构监督与隐式学习之争提供诊断思路，但迁移到多模态推理仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Synthetic Neurosymbolic Task Generation with Controlled Constraint Complexity

**abstract/A1：** We introduce NeSySy, a synthetic generator for neurosymbolic learning tasks that jointly produces logical constraints and consistent datasets. Unlike existing benchmarks, NeSySy provides fine-grained control over key properties such as constraint structure, tightness, input dependence, and data generation and alignment strategies. In particular, it allows the use of rich constraints over infinite domains, and uses solvers to ensure that the constraints are meaningful and that generated samples satisfy the constraints. We design NeSySy to support both learning with declarative constraints and learning from distant supervision. Across a range of constraint families, we provide evidence that its parameters induce systematic and largely independent effects on task difficulty. Using NeSySy, we study constraint-aware learning methods, identifying regimes where explicit constraint enforcement is beneficial and where expressive unconstrained models can instead learn constraint structure directly from data. Our results establish NeSySy as a controlled testbed for analysing the interaction between learning and logical structure. NeSySy is built around a pipeline that incorporates solvers. Satisfiability checkers (CNFgen and Z3) generate and certify constraints. Constrained optimizers (RC2 for MaxSAT, Z3 for OMT) compute optimal repairs that guarantee every generated sample is consistent.

</details>

### 363. [A Hierarchical Statistical Framework for Evaluating Agent Reliability](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19614v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19614

**作者：** Mirco Milletarì、Tuhin Kundu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cond-mat.stat-mech、math.PR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19614v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19614v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一个分层统计框架，将 agent 评测划分为场景、实例、样本三层，为 mean pass rate、pass@k、passhat^k 给出不确定性估计与有限样本方差表达式，并把分层聚合与统计物理中的粗粒化对应起来，从而将执行噪声与任务异质性分离。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其方差分解可用于核查 latent 推理中采样随机性与任务难度的混淆、以及 STOP 决策可靠性的评测口径，可供参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Hierarchical Statistical Framework for Evaluating Agent Reliability

**abstract/A1：** Agents operating in complex scenarios often face uncertainty due to incomplete information about the environment they operate in, ambiguous user queries, complex business rules and the inherently stochastic dynamics of the governing policy. Several new benchmarks have been proposed to evaluate LLM-based agents on complex tasks in multi-tool environments, including settings with policy constraints and varying levels of intent ambiguity. These conditions make it important to evaluate agentic systems systematically and quantify their performance under different conditions to assess their reliability in production. This need is evident in the recently introduced Thinkingbox benchmark, where even the strongest models struggle to perform consistently across diverse business scenarios. This paper presents a statistical framework for evaluating uncertainty and reliability in agentic systems. We define a hierarchy of scenarios, instances, and samples to assess model performance and variability systematically. We apply this framework to common metrics found in the literature: mean pass rate, $pass@k$, and $passhat^k$, with uncertainty estimates for each metric. Aggregating metrics at different levels of the hierarchy reveals different structures and properties of the policy model; we connect this hierarchical aggregation with the known process of \\emph{coarse-graining} as intended in the physics and statistical literature. We independently derive exact finite-sample expressions for the sampling variances of the unbiased $pass@k$ and $passhatk$ estimators; related results also appear in recent submissions. Our central contribution is a constructive derivation of hierarchical uncertainty propagation, making explicit its correspondence with coarse-graining and separating execution noise from task heterogeneity.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出边界门控软阈值卡尔曼融合（ST-KF），将多分辨率小波收缩、距离门控残差先验学习与闭环鲁棒卡尔曼平滑结合，用于测井曲线在点缺口与整井缺失下的重建，并在两个公开基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「门控 + 状态空间融合」应对缺失观测与离群值的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据缺失或不可靠时的 latent 状态更新与平滑提供类比线索，但属跨领域启发，需人工核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Robust Well-Log Reconstruction Across Point Gaps and Whole Wells via Boundary-Gated Soft-Thresholding Kalman Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Missing wireline logs hinder subsurface characterization. Deep reconstruction networks suffer from gap-boundary steps and cross-basin shifts, while interpolation and Gaussian smoothers struggle with long intervals and outliers. We propose boundary-gated soft-thresholding Kalman fusion (ST-KF), unifying multiresolution wavelet shrinkage, distance-gated residual prior learning, and closed-form robust Kalman smoothing with learning--inference decoupling. Across two public benchmarks totaling 263 wells in the Norwegian North Sea and New Zealand's Taranaki Basin, ST-KF ranks first over 0.15--100-m anchored gaps with 0.09% parameter overhead. Against the strongest of nine baselines, pooled RMSE falls by 5.0%--8.3% for bulk density and 6.4%--15.6% for compressional slowness; against the four strongest baselines, reductions are 0.7%--4.1% for neutron porosity and 1.3%--2.9% for photoelectric factor. Ablations and sensitivity analyses confirm operator synergy and stable performance: removing state-space fusion increases short-gap errors by up to 58.8%, while zero-shot transfer cuts anchored errors by 14%--68%. The results show that local borehole continuity transfers across basins whereas cross-property mappings shift with regional geology, supporting measurement-guided log reconstruction.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where slide-level foundation-model classifiers fail on atypical breast lesions

**abstract/A1：** Whether a ductal breast lesion is called atypical hyperplasia or low-grade carcinoma in situ increasingly determines surgery. However, slide-level classifiers built on pathology foundation models (PFMs) perform worst on these lesions. Using four PFMs, cross-validation on BRACS and preregistered hypotheses, we studied where the classification of atypia fails. Because slides are labelled with their most severe lesion, only 39% of the slides with annotated atypical ductal hyperplasia (ADH) were labelled ADH. Attention ranked the lesion high but rarely first, and showing the model only the lesion helped little, whereas classifiers trained per decision with lesion-level labels improved all four atypical boundaries. ADH regions inserted into benign slides raised the probability of malignancy more than that of atypia. In a hospital with pathologist-labelled single-subtype slides and in HISTAI, benign slides were scored closer to lesions and triage specificity fell from 0.48-0.53 to 0.00-0.07 and 0.22.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究多目标因果 bandit：指出仅靠两两 Pareto 支配会遗漏被随机策略支配的干预，给出可能 Pareto 最优的最小干预集的图论刻画，并在缩小后的干预空间上设计 UCB 型算法，另扩展到带约束情形。

**相关性简评：** 其「最小干预集」刻画与「对被混合策略支配」的判据，可能为 LVR 中哪些视觉变量值得主动探查、以及证据获取与停止的分配提供形式化线索，需核查是否可迁用到推理期的干预式证据选择。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-Objective Causal Bandits: Minimal Intervention Space and Policy-Level Learning

**abstract/A1：** Many decision-making problems involve multiple objectives, where actions affect several performance metrics, fairness criteria, or safety constraints. We study multi-objective causal bandits with multiple reward nodes, where actions correspond to interventions on subsets of variables in a causal graph and performance is evaluated through Pareto optimality. Existing approaches to multi-objective bandits often rely on pairwise Pareto dominance or optimize a fixed scalarization. However, pairwise comparisons alone can fail to identify actions dominated by randomized policies, whose expected reward vectors lie in the convex hull of action-level rewards. Thus, an intervention may be suboptimal even if no single intervention dominates it, because it can be dominated by a randomized policy over other interventions. We formalize this policy-level phenomenon and show that it has consequences for both causal action-space reduction and online learning. First, we provide a necessary-and-sufficient graphical characterization of possibly Pareto- optimal minimal intervention sets. Our characterization yields a minimal, sound, and complete candidate intervention family from the graph alone, correcting prior formulations that may include intervention sets that are never Pareto-optimal under any compatible structural causal model. Second, over this reduced intervention space, we design an online UCB-style algorithm that eliminates actions using dominance tests against convex combinations of other actions, and prove logarithmic gap-dependent Pareto regret. Finally, we study constrained multi-objective causal bandits, where feasibility and optimality may be realized only with randomized policies, and develop an online UCB-style constrained bandit algorithm with sublinear regret and constraint-violation guarantees.

**comment/C1：** To appear in Proceedings of NeurIPS 26

</details>

**title/T1：** Floorplan-Context-Aware Cross-Environment Human Activity Recognition from mmWave Radar Point Clouds

**abstract/A1：** Human activity recognition (HAR) models based on mmWave radar point clouds and trained in controlled open spaces often experience performance degradation when deployed in furnished rooms. We propose a Floorplan-Context-Aware (FCA) HAR enhancement method that augments the input with subject-furniture relative position information to improve cross-environment performance. Because existing mmWave point-cloud datasets lack registered floorplans, we introduce a pseudo-landmark augmentation strategy for training the FCA model. In cross-environment evaluation on the mm-ADL-Home dataset, FCA achieves 77.70% accuracy and 65.49% macro-F1, improving upon the point-cloud-only direct-transfer baseline by 10.73 and 10.05 percentage points, respectively, and exceeding the strongest evaluated adaptation baseline by 7.37 and 6.27 percentage points. At deployment, FCA requires only a one-time registration of furniture landmarks, with no target-domain activity annotations or model weight updates.

### 368. [With the Right Representation, Classical Machine Learning Rivals Deep Models for Olfactory Mixture Similarity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19650v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19650

**作者：** Ze Dong、Yi Wang、Ambuj Tewari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究气味混合物相似度预测，主张用成对混合物的显式对称比较特征（逐维绝对差、和、积）配合 XGBoost 与 KRR，在小数据基准上达到与专用深度混合模型相当的性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式编码两输入的差异优于各自独立编码」这一表示结论，可能为 LVR 中成对关系信息的内部表示与相似度读出设计提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** With the Right Representation, Classical Machine Learning Rivals Deep Models for Olfactory Mixture Similarity

**abstract/A1：** Modeling olfactory mixtures remains a critical challenge in machine olfaction because the task requires reasoning over relationships between sets of odorants rather than over individual molecules in isolation. However, prior comparisons between deep and classical approaches also varied how the relationship between the two mixtures was represented, since the classical baselines primarily relied on weak representations that described each mixture independently and provided little direct signal about how the mixtures differed. In this work, we revisit classical learning using explicit symmetric comparison features on unordered pairs of mixtures, evaluating these representations with XGBoost and kernel ridge regression (KRR). We find that XGBoost with explicit comparison features achieves performance competitive with specialized deep mixture models on the main benchmark. Ablation studies show that coordinate-wise absolute differences alone provide strong predictive performance, while combining them with sums and products yields further improvements. KRR also benefits substantially from explicit comparison features, with further gains from appropriate kernel choice and preprocessing. Overall, these results suggest that explicitly encoding how two mixtures differ is an important ingredient for classical machine learning in low-data olfactory mixture prediction.

</details>

### 369. [BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19656v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19656

**作者：** Dong Li、Yufei Han、Xintao Wu、Xujiang Zhao、Wei Cheng、Chen Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19656v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19656v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BadGCL，在图持续学习下用梯度互信息目标学习拓扑结构触发器，并加入传播一致性约束，使早期注入的后门在后续任务更新中仍能持续生效。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理主线无直接关联；但其「与干净任务优化信号梯度兼容的注入表示会被知识保留机制长期保存」的观察，可能启发核查 latent 推理状态在持续训练中是否留存或被冲刷，以及以梯度对齐作为贡献分配线索，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BadGCL: Towards Persistent Backdoor Attack on Graph Continual Learning Systems

**abstract/A1：** Backdoor attacks pose a persistent security threat to machine learning systems, yet their behavior under graph continual learning (GCL) remains underexplored. Conventional graph backdoor attacks often lose effectiveness as models are updated across successive tasks, creating the impression that continual updates naturally weaken malicious associations. This work reveals a contrasting vulnerability: knowledge-preservation mechanisms in GCL can also preserve early injected backdoors when the poisoned update is compatible with the clean-task signal being retained. For graph data, this risk is amplified by structural triggers, which are embedded into the message-passing paths of graph neural networks (GNNs) and can induce stable representation shifts across tasks. To expose this risk, we propose BadGCL, a model-agnostic framework for persistent backdoor attacks under a strict early-stage intervention setting. BadGCL learns topology-aware structural triggers using a gradient mutual-information objective that couples poisoned gradients with clean-task optimization signals, together with a propagation consistency objective that stabilizes trigger-induced effects through graph message passing. We provide theoretical analysis showing that gradient compatibility and propagation stability jointly support long-term backdoor persistence under benign continual updates. Extensive experiments across task-IL and class-IL protocols, four GCL benchmarks, and diverse victim systems show that BadGCL achieves persistent attack effectiveness with limited clean-utility degradation, substantially outperforming graph and continual-learning backdoor baselines and remaining robust against representative defenses.

**comment/C1：** Accepted in KDD 2027

</details>

### 370. [When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19663v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19663

**作者：** Gaurav Tewari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19663v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19663v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文从理论上推导智能体计划受损后的最优应对策略：以「有效损伤深度」为阈值，浅损伤局部修复、深损伤完全重规划、若新计划不值其成本则放弃目标；并给出稳定性价格阈值、反复损伤下的承诺滞后（patch debt）、以及「诊断价值」何时值得花算力测量损伤的结论，配合数值检查器验证各命题。

**相关性简评：** 修复（保留结构的部分重置）与重规划（全量重置）的区分、以及诊断信息价值的阈值判断，可能为 LVR 中「何时刷新/重建 latent 推理状态、何时继续获取视觉证据、何时停止」的 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本权衡提供形式化参照，但其成本模型基于计划依赖结构，能否迁移到多模态推理需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When AI Agents Should Repair, Replan, or Abandon: A Threshold Theory of Plan Commitment

**abstract/A1：** AI agents often discover mid-execution that their plan is broken, for example when an action fails or a tool is withdrawn. Deployed systems use conventions such as retry loops or "always replan," and a recent benchmark finds no fixed strategy dominates. This paper derives the optimal policy. In the model, a disruption destroys the causal support of part of a plan; repair is a partial reset that preserves the plan's structure, replanning is a full reset, and changing a plan is costly because others have conditioned on it. The optimal policy is a threshold in effective disruption depth: repair shallow damage, replan after deep damage, and abandon the goal when even a fresh plan is not worth its cost. Depth depends on plan structure. In expectation, a single broken action forces 1+R(G)/n actions to be revalidated, where R(G) counts the pairs of actions joined by a dependency path; to first order, a fully serial plan switches to replanning at raw damage about w times smaller than a plan of w parallel chains. A closed-form stability-price threshold determines when a worse repaired plan should be kept over a better fresh one. As language-model planners push replanning costs toward zero, the stability price becomes the only force sustaining plan commitment. Under repeated disruptions, revision frictions make commitment hysteresis optimal: the agent keeps executing a plan it would never choose fresh, and each repair adds patch debt until the debt outweighs repair's cost advantage and the agent rebuilds. A value-of-diagnosis result states when measuring damage is worth its compute and shows that "always replan" is optimal when damage is predictably deep and replanning is the better fallback. A separately implemented numerical checker tests each proposition (zero violations; 1.6 million static-model evaluations), and the model's regime map reproduces that benchmark's regime flips qualitatively.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 371. [Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19676v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19676

**作者：** Xinghao Dong、Huchen Yang、Jin-Long Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.comp-ph、physics.flu-dyn

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19676v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19676v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出基于 score 扩散模型的随机闭合建模框架，通过离线间接训练加在线数据同化，在缺少闭合项真值的情况下学习并校正降阶模型，并在二维湍流上验证其统计刻画与状态预测。

**相关性简评：** 闭合项可视为降阶模型中未观测的潜状态修正，其后验 score 同化与「非高斯不确定性下的状态更新」问题相近，其无需直接监督的间接学习也可能为 LVR 中潜推理状态的更新与监督提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation

**abstract/A1：** Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. Numerical experiments on two-dimensional turbulent flows demonstrate that indirect offline learning captures key closure statistics and improves predictions of system state. In addition, combining the learned closure with known physical dynamics leads to better generalization capability across different regimes than purely data-driven models that directly predict system state. Compared to standard data assimilation methods with a Gaussian assumption, the posterior-score assimilation better represents non-Gaussian features of the learned closure, and its combination with state-level data assimilation further improves prediction of the system state. The proposed framework enables stochastic closure modeling in realistic and challenging scenarios of complex dynamical systems in mechanics and engineering problems, where non-Gaussian statistics of model-form uncertainties are non-negligible (e.g., due to the nonlinearities of the system dynamics and/or the observations) and true closure data are not available, for both offline learning and online assimilation.

</details>

### 372. [Multiaccuracy as an Error Benchmark for Learning with Distribution Shift](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19701v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19701

**作者：** Konstantinos Stavropoulos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19701v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19701v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「shift multiaccuracy」作为分布偏移下的更强误差基准，构造可测试学习（TDS）框架，使其在无偏移时等价于 multiaccuracy，并给出与 identity testing 的联系及基于 Rademacher 复杂度的统计刻画。

**相关性简评：** 其「要么给出低误差预测、要么检测到分布偏移」的评价形式，可能与 LVR 在视觉分布偏移下的误差基准设定及停止/弃权决策有概念关联，可供核查其保证能否迁移到多模态推理评价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multiaccuracy as an Error Benchmark for Learning with Distribution Shift

**abstract/A1：** Agnostic learning has a well-developed theory of computational and statistical complexity. For learning with distribution shift, even the choice of an appropriate error benchmark remains challenging. Testable learning with distribution shift (TDS) was introduced to develop computational foundations for this setting: using labeled training data and unlabeled test data, the learner must either produce a predictor with low test error or detect distribution shift. However, standard agnostic TDS guarantees allow a constant-factor amplification of the optimum error even when the training and test distributions coincide. They therefore do not directly recover the guarantee of classical agnostic learning. We introduce shift multiaccuracy, a stronger error benchmark inspired by multiaccuracy from algorithmic fairness. This yields a TDS formulation that becomes equivalent to multiaccuracy when there is no shift. Using a recent nontrivial reduction from agnostic learning to multiaccurate prediction from prior work, we obtain the first TDS framework that formally generalizes agnostic learning through an efficient reduction preserving the training marginal. The framework retains existing algorithmic upper bounds and inherits computational lower bounds from agnostic learning. Moreover, we establish a direct connection between our model and identity testing, yielding the first statistical characterization of agnostic TDS learning, in terms of Rademacher complexity. More broadly, we argue that shift multiaccuracy might be of independent interest in unsupervised domain adaptation, as it leads to sharper out-of-distribution generalization guarantees, and can be minimized directly, since its definition does not involve the unobserved test labels.

</details>

### 373. [SEAT: Sign-Type Evidence-Audited Transport for Multi-Label Tongue Diagnosis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19748v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19748

**作者：** Liuyi Xu、Qing Wang、Zikai Liang、An-Yang Lu、Yining Qian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19748v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19748v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SEAT 框架做多标签舌象识别：在冻结的 DINOv2 patch 特征上，用掩码引导的征象专属注意力、LAB/HSV 色彩原型上的半松弛最优传输通路与共现感知传输正则，并配套与证据类型对应的审计，在 TongueDx 上报告 macro-F1。

**相关性简评：** 「按证据类型分路预测并配套审计」的思路，或可借鉴到 LVR 中核查答案是否真正依赖任务相关的视觉证据、而非虚假相关或视觉旁路，但属医学图像分类场景，迁移价值需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SEAT: Sign-Type Evidence-Audited Transport for Multi-Label Tongue Diagnosis

**abstract/A1：** Automated tongue-sign recognition can improve the consistency of non-invasive examinations that otherwise rely on subjective visual judgment. A single tongue image often exhibits multiple coexisting signs characterized by heterogeneous evidence, including localized morphology, global chromaticity, and inter-label dependence. However, existing methods typically rely on shared representations and uniform multi-label heads, making it difficult to verify whether predictions stem from clinically relevant evidence rather than spurious visual correlations. We propose SEAT, an evidence-audited framework that matches distinct evidence types with dedicated prediction and evaluation mechanisms. Built on frozen DINOv2 patch features, SEAT couples mask-guided sign-specific attention for localized morphology, a semi-relaxed optimal transport pathway over LAB/HSV color prototypes to enhance pale-tongue recognition, and a co-occurrence-aware transport regularizer to shape the batch-level predicted label marginal. These components are evaluated through audits matched to their evidence types. On the TongueDx benchmark, SEAT achieves a mean macro-F1 of 72.59 with a standard deviation of 1.04 across six random seeds, with a six-model ensemble reaching 74.15. The ensemble outperforms a backbone-matched baseline and a larger, domain-specialized vision-language model by 8.06 and 2.99 percentage points, respectively. Our results demonstrate that aligning dedicated prediction pathways and audits with sign-specific characteristics improves multi-label accuracy while offering more targeted evidential grounding than uniform post-hoc spatial explanations. Code is available at https://github.com/NEU-TCM-Lab/Sign-type-Evidence-Audited-Transport.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables

</details>

### 374. [Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay for Continual Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19756v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19756

**作者：** Zahid Ullah、Jaeyoon Seo、Jihie Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19756v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19756v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作面向持续学习下的心脏超声分割，提出 Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay Loss：为每个被保留样本构造冻结的源任务参考签名，度量特征、类别概率、边界响应与预测结构的变化，聚合成样本级系数以自适应调节重放监督强度。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及推理或 latent 状态生成，但其「以源任务参考签名度量多维表示漂移并据此调节监督」的做法，可能可供核查为 LVR 中视觉细节在训练中是否退化、信息坍缩程度的诊断与加权信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay for Continual Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Conventional experience replay typically applies fixed preservation constraints to historical exemplars, overlooking variations in how learned representations, predictions, and anatomical structures change during sequential training. To address this limitation, we propose Drift-Conditioned Structural Replay Loss (DCSRL), an exemplar-adaptive supervision mechanism that regulates anatomical preservation according to source-referenced knowledge drift. DCSRL operates within a reliability-guided replay framework that selects informative historical exemplars using anatomical content and boundary characteristics while adaptively regulating replay during training. For each retained exemplar, DCSRL constructs a frozen source-task reference signature and subsequently measures changes in feature representations, class probabilities, boundary responses, and predicted anatomical structures. These complementary drift measurements are aggregated and normalized to generate bounded, exemplar-specific coefficients that dynamically adjust boundary and structural replay losses without modifying the underlying memory-selection policy. We evaluate DCSRL under sequential learning across CAMUS, CardiacNet, and EchoNet-Dynamic, comparing its performance with regularization-, distillation-, and replay-based continual-learning approaches. Experimental findings indicate that DCSRL improves overall final segmentation performance and anatomical boundary preservation, particularly under heterogeneous imaging conditions, although trade-offs remain in knowledge transfer across tasks. These findings suggest that source-referenced multidimensional drift conditioning offers a promising direction for adaptive anatomical knowledge preservation in continual cardiac ultrasound segmentation.

</details>

### 375. [When Does an AUROC Comparison Survive a Change in Population Mix?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19762v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19762

**作者：** Mahtab Movahhedrad、Hamidreza Hasani Balyani、Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19762v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19762v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察在任务、人群或图像损坏比例改变时，池化 AUROC 对失败检测器／不确定性分数的比较与排名能否保持；通过跨组 AUC 分解证明任意对称二次比较几何都可由有限标量分数分布实现，给出混合反转构造、有限库审计与近似证书，并在 ImageNet-C 与 Stable LM 2 12B 的分数比较上做实证检查。

**相关性简评：** 该文不研究 latent 视觉推理本身，但其「按群体比例池化后比较可能反转」的结论可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益或不确定性阈值比较是否依赖特定样本混合，属评价方法层面的潜在启示，具体迁移需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Does an AUROC Comparison Survive a Change in Population Mix?

**abstract/A1：** Does an AUROC comparison survive a change in the proportions of tasks, populations, or image corruptions? A pooled-AUROC ranking of failure detectors or uncertainty scores describes one particular mix of groups. We study two fixed scores for a common binary target under mixtures of fixed group-conditional laws. Using the cross-group AUC decomposition, we prove that every rational symmetric quadratic comparison geometry is realizable by finite scalar-score distributions. Universal dominance is thus coNP-hard, and even exhaustive checks of every mixture on fewer than $K$ groups can miss a $K$-group reversal. A grid bound gives a dimension-uniform approximation certificate with sharp $1/m$ order. Common score marginals across groups make the comparison numerator linear, with an error envelope for imperfect alignment. These results yield exact finite-bank audits, explicit reversal mixtures and distances, and simultaneous population statements. For failure detection with a frozen ResNet-50 on ImageNet-C, 15 of 18 confidence-score comparisons win in every corruption family on a discovery split, and all 15 are finite-bank certified over all family mixtures on a held-out split; over all 15 corruption types, of 14 discovery winners the corrected grid certifies 10, leaves 3 unresolved, and finds one confirmation reversal of at least 0.05 AUROC. An audit of all 11,019 released Stable LM 2 12B outputs and 35 uncertainty methods finds 66 confirmation-set comparisons that win within all four tasks yet reverse under mixing. Discovery-fitted marginal rank alignment removes all 66; an alignment-error envelope certifies 83 comparisons. Label checks also change several selected reversals. The findings distinguish robustness of frozen scores from robustness after calibration; they do not establish human-error detection, robustness to unseen corruptions, or generalization beyond the evaluated banks.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 5 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible

</details>

### 376. [PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19768v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19768

**作者：** Yuming Zhang、Xianchen Zhou、Hongxia Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19768v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19768v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PISG，一种免训练的测试时引导方法：在扩散求解器每一步构造「结构退化」的预测，并把无扰动预测从其向外推，从而放大去噪器中已存在的约束对齐信号，改善约束贪心解码的候选排序，在 TSP 与 MIS 多类求解器上验证。

**相关性简评：** 组合优化本身不属于视觉推理主线，但其「退化预测对比外推、在去噪轨迹中放大内部结构信号」的思路，可能为扩散式 latent 推理的状态更新与任务必要信息筛选提供可核查的启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PISG: Constraint-Aligned Signal Amplification for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion-based solvers have become a prominent approach to neural combinatorial optimization. At inference time, they assign each decision variable a prediction score. A greedy decoder ranks candidates by these scores and checks hard constraints to ensure feasibility. Top-ranked candidates should be both promising and jointly feasible, making prediction-constraint alignment critical. When this alignment is weak, greedy decoding skips constraint-violating candidates and falls back to lower-ranked alternatives, degrading solution quality. Existing test-time methods improve search, sampling, or decoding, but do not directly strengthen this alignment before decoding. We observe that trained denoisers already carry constraint-aligned structural signals. Building on this observation, we propose Perturbed Instance-Structure Guidance (PISG), a training-free method that amplifies these signals at test time. At each denoising step, PISG constructs a structure-degraded prediction and extrapolates the unperturbed prediction away from it. The resulting guided prediction improves candidate rankings before constrained decoding. Signal analysis shows that this guidance concentrates on constraint-critical variables rather than uniformly rescaling scores. Under greedy decoding and without downstream refinement, PISG improves all 16 TSP solver-scale pairs across DIFUSCO, T2T, FastT2T, and StruDiCO, and all four MIS-ER solvers, with MIS-ER solved-cost gains up to +4.8%. The gains persist on most large-scale settings after 2-opt, and a preliminary study extends PISG to a Transformer-based solver. These results identify prediction-constraint alignment as an effective test-time enhancement direction for diffusion-based combinatorial optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/Ming-321/PISG.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 32 pages. Code: https://github.com/Ming-321/PISG

</details>

### 377. [Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19779v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19779

**作者：** Pronoma Banerjee、Md. Masudur Rahman、Juan P. Wachs

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19779v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19779v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** P2C 将生物系统的文本描述转换为带类型的显式形式约束，在数值拟合前裁剪候选 ODE 结构，并组成 Text2Constraint、发现、符号验证、参数拟合与模型评分的五阶段框架，在干净与加噪观测下检验文本知识相对纯回归的增益。

**相关性简评：** 「用文本先验生成显式约束以限制假设空间、再作符号验证」的流程，可能与 LVR 中约束并筛选 latent 假设或推理轨迹、验证候选证据的问题表述相通，但领域距离较远，仅为概念层面的借鉴线索，需核查其约束形式是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Read Before You Fit: Text-Derived Constraints for Discovering Differential Equations from Noisy Biological Data

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly used for scientific equation discovery. However, most existing methods are strongly data-driven and assume sufficiently clean and representative observations. This assumption is problematic in biological systems, where individual-level measurements are often sparse, noisy, heterogeneous, and expensive to obtain. While the underlying mechanisms are extensively described in scientific text, they are not explicitly used for the LLM based modeling of such systems. We introduce P2C, an agentic framework that translates textual descriptions of biological systems into a typed set of formal constraints, and use these constraints to restrict candidate ordinary differential equation (ODE) structures before numerical fitting. P2C consists of five stages: Text2Constraint extraction, ODE discovery, symbolic verification, parameter fitting, and model scoring. We evaluate P2C on four published ODE systems of acute inflammation and immune regulation, under clean and noisy observations. By progressively degrading the numerical evidence, we isolate when textual domain knowledge contributes beyond regression alone. Across the four systems, adding Text2Constraint reduces the worst form error from 1.397 to 0.499 on clean data and from 13.096 to 1.095 for data perturbed with Gaussian noise of $σ=0.1$; P2C also achieves lower form error and trajectory error than several LLM-based baselines over the tested noise range.

</details>

### 378. [A Threshold-Free Visual-Semantic Matching Metric for Evaluating Consistency in Subject-Driven Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19780v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19780

**作者：** Bowei Shan、Heng Yin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19780v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19780v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文针对主体驱动图像生成中的局部视觉一致性评测，提出无阈值的连续度量 TF-VSM：用非线性语义匹配置信对每个对象点加权，替代硬阈值门控，并在受控基准上与 CLIP、DINO、VLM 等指标比较相关性。

**相关性简评：** 其「软置信加权替代硬阈值筛选」的思路可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 与视觉特征匹配的连续性建模相关，可供核查；但对象是图像生成评测指标，与推理期状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Threshold-Free Visual-Semantic Matching Metric for Evaluating Consistency in Subject-Driven Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** In subject-driven text-to-image generation, quantitatively evaluating localized visual consistency across varying poses and environments remains a major challenge. Existing metrics either rely on global image embeddings (CLIP, DINO) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that pool spatial representations and miss fine-grained textural artifacts, or depend on scalar threshold-gated dense metrics such as Visual-Semantic Matching (VSM) that suffer from point-alignment dropouts, severe threshold sensitivity, and score instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose TF-VSM, a fully continuous, threshold-free visual-consistency metric paired with an extended feature-disentanglement retraining schedule for dual-branch ResNet feature-aggregation networks. Rather than enforcing rigid binary cutoffs $(T\_s,T\_v)$, TF-VSM weights every object point by a non-linear semantic match confidence $w\_j=ReLU(\\hat{s}\_j)^2$ and continuously integrates visual similarity over all consistency levels $r\\in\[0,1\]$, yielding a closed-form confidence-weighted score without any hand-tuned hyperparameters. On a controlled 100-pair benchmark with ground-truth inpainting oracles, TF-VSM attains Pearson $0.638$ and Spearman $0.674$ oracle correlation, improving over the pretrained VSM baseline ($0.454/0.589$) by $+0.171/+0.116$ after retraining, and drastically outperforming CLIP ($-0.052/-0.004$), DINO ($0.087/0.121$), and VLMs ($0.096/0.003$). Six diagnostic ablations confirm that smooth confidence weighting is the right mechanism, that hard semantic gating is brittle (dropping to $0.533$ Pearson at $T\_s{=}0.8$), and that the threshold-free metric is essentially invariant to the training-time loss balance $α$ that the thresholded metric still depends on.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 379. [How Should Parallel Langevin Chains Share Noise?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19784v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19784

**作者：** Ryan Farell

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19784v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19784v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究并行 Langevin 链之间如何共享噪声：采用类似 antithetic 的去列均值耦合，使各链仍保持单链 ULA 边缘分布，推导二次目标下集合均值线性估计的联合协方差并分离初态与噪声贡献，对非二次目标给出方差界，并在带 tempering 的 logistic 后验上比较方差与「方差×采样时间」，还考察 Metropolis 校正下收益的收缩。

**相关性简评：** 该文对并行随机链共享噪声后集合均值方差的量化（1/K 与 1/(K-1) 的差别、校正步骤使收益衰减），可能为 LVR 中多条并行随机 latent 假设的采样与聚合、以及增加并行样本数相对收益的估计提供分析视角，可供核查其耦合方式能否对应 latent 假设间的噪声相关性建模。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Should Parallel Langevin Chains Share Noise?

**abstract/A1：** Parallel Langevin sampling usually draws an array of independent Gaussian vectors, one row per chain. The average row drives the ensemble mean, with variance $1/K$ per coordinate for $K$ chains. Yet the unadjusted Langevin algorithm (ULA) specifies only each row's distribution. Subtracting the column means and rescaling, as in classical antithetic sampling, makes that variance zero. Each chain keeps its ordinary ULA path law for any finite run. For quadratic targets we derive the joint covariance of linear estimates computed from the ensemble mean, including coefficient estimates, time averages and predictions. The identity separates contributions from initial states and Gaussian draws. The coupling changes the second through one scalar, which is zero whenever the draws sum to zero across chains. For nonquadratic targets we bound the remaining variance. Centering has a price: for a quadratic form in the mean-subtracted Gaussian state, the ensemble average has variance $1/(K-1)$ relative to one chain, compared with $1/K$ under independent draws. On three tempered logistic posteriors, eight centered chains reduced the variance of the posterior-mean estimate, summed over coordinates, by two to three orders of magnitude compared with eight independent chains. They also beat 128 independent chains on variance and on variance times sampling time. Under Metropolis correction the reduction shrank to about three- to eightfold: rejected draws no longer balance accepted ones. The measured variance ratios were consistent with a leading-order prediction from rejection frequency and noise energy.

**comment/C1：** 48 pages, 6 figures, 36 tables. NeurIPS 2026 (poster). Code: https://github.com/rfarell/parallel-langevin-chains

</details>

### 380. [Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19794v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19794

**作者：** Dhruv Trehan、Paras Chopra

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19794v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19794v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「research taste」操作化为一个任务：给定研究目标与已有假设、关键结果，让模型在两条候选未来方向中择一；基于 19 篇 ML 论文构建 80 组顺序控制的成对比较，对 8 个 LLM 报告作者对齐率、稳定分歧与不稳定选择等行为指标，并刻画模型偏好偏向 scaling/泛化等类别。

**相关性简评：** 其「在尚无客观可验证目标时做方向选择」并区分稳定偏好与随机波动的测量方式，可能为 LVR 中「继续思考、换推理路径还是停止」这类元决策及模型策略偏好的刻画提供评价思路，但材料不含视觉、latent 状态成分，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Eliciting Research Taste in LLMs through Future Research Direction Choice

**abstract/A1：** Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. Each query presents a research goal, hypotheses tested with key results, and two candidate future directions: one author-recommended direction and one plausible distractor sampled from a similar paper. Across eight LLMs, author alignment ranges from 45.0% to 67.5%, while stable divergence ranges from 15.0% to 36.2%. These divergences largely persist under similarity controls, prompt ablations, and an author-preference framing check, and inter-model agreement suggests that some non-author preferences are shared across models. We characterize what models diverge toward using transition-category labels and selected reasoning examples, finding recurring movement toward scaling/generalization and trade-offs between methodological and infrastructure/data extensions. We view this as an early descriptive evaluation for eliciting research taste profiles in LLMs, and as a step toward understanding and steering their research preferences as they take on more autonomous roles in novel open-ended scientific discovery.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the LM4Sci Workshop at COLM 2026. 23 pages, 7 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Lossfunk/research-taste-eval-v1

</details>

### 381. [Lossless First-Action Menus for Linear-Reward Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19795v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19795

**作者：** Yukun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19795v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19795v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究在奖励权重尚未揭示前先保留一个最小的初始动作菜单、之后再自由规划的问题，证明菜单对所有线性标量化保持最优当且仅当其可达后续覆盖特征多面体的全部顶点，并给出以顶点数参数化的算法与若干复杂性结论。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「覆盖全部线性标量化顶点以保证无损」的集合式抽象概念，可能为多目标下保留多个候选推理路径或停止选项的表示是否信息无损提供一种可核查的形式化视角。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Lossless First-Action Menus for Linear-Reward Planning

**abstract/A1：** We study sequential decision making where an agent reserves a minimum menu of initial actions before multi-objective trade-offs are revealed, followed by unrestricted continuation planning once linear reward weights arrive. We prove that a menu preserves the unrestricted optimal return across all linear scalarizations if and only if its reachable continuations cover all vertices of the full feature polytope. This geometric equivalence yields an output-sensitive algorithm that is fixed-parameter tractable in the vertex count, combining scalar backward induction with oracle-based facet identification. On explicitly layered graphs with unit feature increments, menu verification is coNP-complete and synthesis is complete for the second existential level of the polynomial hierarchy, even under additive loss strictly below one. In fixed dimensions two and higher, verification is polynomial whereas synthesis remains NP-complete, while one-dimensional instances admit polynomial-time solutions.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 0 figures

</details>

### 382. [Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19812v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19812

**作者：** Samuel Stanton、Aaron Solomon、Emily Delaney、Melanie Montgomery、Crystal Humphries、Timothy Acker、Ryan Henrici、Charbel Eid、Eddie Abrams、Peyton Greenside

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、q-bio.BM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19812v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19812v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文报告两个基于 Milliner 平台的抗体先导优化闭环实验：研究团队与通用 AI agent（Claude）共同将科学推理引入 lab-in-the-loop，在七轮、约 1010 个设计变体中构建受控对比文库，从原始测量曲线发现每个 scaffold 上均有一个热稳定性指标并不度量其名称所指的性质，进而拟合物理模型、改用适配 scaffold 的指标并调整实验协议做预注册验证，获得在亲和力、热稳定性与聚集上优于亲本且产量纯度不降的先导。

**相关性简评：** 其「闭环探测某一指标是否真在度量其名义属性、并用预注册预测检验模型」的思路，可能启发 LVR 中 latent 相似度与探针指标效度的核查、证据筛选及停止决策设计，但领域距离较远，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement

**abstract/A1：** Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. Over seven rounds and about 1,010 design variants we built libraries from antibody lineage, structure and biophysics, and found from the raw curves that on each scaffold one thermal metric did not measure what its name implied. The libraries were built as controlled comparisons, so the results also show what each mutation contributes to each property. We fit a physical model of the curves, used it to choose metrics suited to each scaffold, and changed the experimental protocol, varying protein concentration and heating rate, to test the model against pre-registered predictions. Both leads improve on their parents in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation while improving or maintaining yield and purity.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 19 figures, 8 tables

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GraphPass: A Study of Graph Neural Networks for Compiler Pass Selection

**abstract/A1：** Compiler pass selection is usually governed by fixed pipelines (-O2, -O3) or hand-written heuristics. We study whether a graph neural network (GNN) over a program's control-flow graph (CFG) can select among a fixed menu of five pass sequences in a single forward pass. GraphPass encodes each CFG with a graph attention (GAT) or graph convolutional (GCN) encoder and classifies it into one of the five sequences. On a synthetic benchmark of 5,000 generated CFGs in five program families, both encoders agree with the benchmark's reference label on about 92% of held-out programs, versus 68.4% for a hand-written rule-based heuristic and 85% for a flat MLP. An edge ablation indicates that this gain comes from per-block processing rather than from CFG edges: a GCN given the same basic-block features with all edges removed scores 95.0%, versus 92.2% with the true CFG. In this benchmark the label is determined by the program family, so the task amounts to family recognition. Real-compiler speedup is not measured. Inference costs O(\|V\| + \|E\|) per CFG, measured at 1.7 ms for a typical program and about 0.8 s for a 100,000-block graph on one CPU core.

</details>

### 384. [Asking the right question is key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19841v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19841

**作者：** Hu Cang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、physics.optics

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19841v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19841v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文让两个前沿 AI scientist 在 32 个闭环试验中从遗漏窄峰的数据出发做假设链式发现，发现按模型分歧选实验的智能体反而不如随机搜索，甚至全部错过窄峰；只有早期探测未测量区间并追踪异常才成功。

**相关性简评：** 这是与视觉无关的假设—实验选择研究，但其「分歧引导探索失效、需主动探测信息空白」的负结果，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取与筛选策略提供问题表述层面的启发，可供核查标题为「Asking the right question」的原文实验设定与探索准则。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Asking the right question is key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses

**abstract/A1：** Artificial intelligence (AI) scientists pursue discovery through a chain of hypotheses, fitting candidate models to existing observations and often choosing experiments where those models disagree most. Yet when early data miss a narrow feature, model selection favors simple curves that agree across the unmea- sured gap, so disagreement-guided search has no reason to look where the new phenomenon lies. When we tested two frontier AI scientists, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1-Sol, across 32 closed-loop trials with a narrow peak omitted from the starting data, both sampled inside the peak region less often than random search. Surprisingly, the agent that followed model disagreement more closely missed the peak in all 32 trials, whereas discovery succeeded when experiments probed the unmeasured gap early and followed up across the anomaly. Asking the right question, rather than testing only where current models disagree, is therefore key to AI discovery in a chain of hypotheses.

</details>

### 385. [A phase diagram for training and inference in language models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19848v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19848

**作者：** Zhuo-Yang Song、Zeyu Li、Qing-Hong Cao、Ming-xing Luo、Hua Xing Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.dis-nn、cond-mat.stat-mech、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19848v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19848v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用「文档可区分度」和「文档维度」两个集体坐标构造表示几何相图，将语言模型沿深度的前向传播刻画为推理流，并比较未训练与已训练模型、分析塌缩区域及训练相变。

**相关性简评：** 其按深度追踪表示几何、区分塌缩与稳定工作区的框架，可能为诊断 LVR 中视觉信息塌缩、层间 latent 状态演化与有效计算深度提供概念工具，但尚无多模态证据，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A phase diagram for training and inference in language models

**abstract/A1：** A language model is a complex system whose behavior is determined jointly by the Transformer and the corpus, yet how the representation geometry in the Transformer relates to the actual behavior of language models remains open. We analyze how the representation geometry changes along the forward propagation of actual language models and characterize the representation geometry of a document at a given layer by two collective coordinates, document distinguishability and document dimension. On the phase diagram spanned by these collective coordinates, inference is represented as a flow along depth. We find that, for untrained models, depending on their initialization scale, most of the 156 inference flows move toward the collapse and noise regions of the phase diagram. By contrast, the inference flows of 8 trained models from 5 architecture families all enter and reside in the central region of the phase diagram. Describing the evolution of the flows with a discrete Langevin equation, we find that the difference between the inference flows of untrained runs and those of trained models reduces to whether the effective force on the flows in this region is of saddle or stable-node type. On Pythia-1.4B, we interpret the training process as a phase transition. These results give a unified gateway to the relation between representation geometry and language-model behavior.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「质性方差审计框架」，用八步流程在受控输入下比较多个模型自建与共享参考码本的类别结构、重复编码的一致性与码分布，并以 668 份访谈、8 个模型的 48 个码本与 270 次编码运行展示模型间类别结构差异远大于模型内可靠性差异。

**相关性简评：** 其把总体管线方差拆成「码本创建」与「同一类别系统内应用」两部分，并报告模型内可靠性与模型间一致性，可能为区分 LVR 中 latent 状态构建与后续使用、以及跨模型 latent 相似度比较提供可核查的测量类比，但领域相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Who Writes the Codebook? An Eight-Step Framework for Auditing LLM-Generated Category Systems

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) increasingly create the categories through which qualitative evidence is interpreted. Existing coding benchmarks often hold these categories fixed. We propose the Qualitative Variance Audit Framework, an eight-step method that compares codebook creation, repeated application and code distributions under controlled inputs. It combines model-owned and shared-reference codebooks to distinguish variation in the overall pipeline from application differences within a common category system. An application to 668 organisational interviews, 13,166 text units and eight models from five vendors yields 48 codebooks and 270 coding runs. Models create markedly different category structures; mean within-model reliability ranges from .76 to .92, whereas between-model agreement on the shared codebook is about .69. The framework complements LLM-assisted grounded theory by exposing model dependencies before substantive interpretation. It assesses reliability and representational consequences, not interpretive validity or the quality of resulting theory.

</details>

### 387. [HIVE-ECIA: Identity-Aware Historical Evidence Acquisition for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Object Tracking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19897v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19897

**作者：** Hai Nguyen、Tarik Taleb、Qize Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19897v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19897v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HIVE-ECIA 框架：在带宽受限的全景多目标跟踪中，按查询策略判断何时需要额外高分辨率证据，并对历史低分辨率观测排序以选取检索时刻，通过门控融合与身份保护机制恢复碎片化身份；同时发布 DualPano-MOT 评估数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时值得获取额外高分辨率证据」的触发策略与历史观测信息量排序，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的证据获取与停止决策提供概念参照，但该工作属跟踪任务而非多模态推理，线索可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HIVE-ECIA: Identity-Aware Historical Evidence Acquisition for Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Object Tracking

**abstract/A1：** Panoramic multi-object tracking (MOT) requires reliable identity association across a 360° field of view, yet bandwidth-constrained operation forces a trade-off between low-resolution (LR) identity ambiguity and costly high-resolution (HR) transmission. We propose HIVE-ECIA, an identity-aware framework that selectively retrieves historical HR evidence to recover fragmented identities without modifying detection boxes or the underlying tracker. An ECIA Base-Guided query policy determines when additional HR evidence is warranted; HIVE ranks historical LR observations to select an informative retrieval timestamp; and ECIA Full integrates the retrieved HR crop through learned gated fusion and conservative identity safeguards. We further introduce DualPano-MOT, a real-world dual-fisheye panoramic evaluation dataset featuring controlled pedestrian interactions, panorama-seam challenges, and occlusions, with model-assisted, manually verified tracking annotations. On held-out QuadTrack sequences and zero-shot DualPano-MOT, HIVE-ECIA improves identity association across four MOT trackers without tracker-specific retraining. Across these trackers, identity switches decrease by up to 21.8% and 23.4%, while the largest IDF1 gains reach 3.81 and 6.74 percentage points, respectively. Under an offline JPEG-based acquisition model, our framework reduces encoded data volume by 89.2% and 79.3% relative to continuous Full-HR acquisition.

</details>

### 388. [HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&amp;E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19905v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19905

**作者：** Fuxian Zhao、Hyokeun Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19905v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19905v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 HEmIF-Bench，在八个数据集上跨分子、细胞、组织和患者四个尺度评测五个冻结的 H&amp;E→mIF 生成器，并解耦内部编码器特征与生成输出，与病理基础模型 UNI2 对照，考察外部 CD3 恢复、单细胞分类、核分割、TLS/GC 分割与生存预测等下游效用。

**相关性简评：** 「像素级保真不等于下游可用」及「内部编码器特征与生成输出分开评测」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息的评价方式提供核查线索，但领域与 VLM 推理相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HEmIF-Bench: Benchmarking H&amp;E-to-mIF Models BeyondVirtual-StainFidelity

**abstract/A1：** Hematoxylin and eosin (H&amp;E)-to-multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) generators predict spatial protein expression from routine histology, yet pixel-level marker reconstruction does not establish downstream utility. We present HEmIF-Bench, evaluating five frozen generators across eight datasets spanning molecular, cellular, tissue, and patient scales. HEmIF-Bench decouples internal encoder features from generated outputs, benchmarking both against the pathology foundation reference UNI2. Mirroring the clinical workflow where pathologists rely on mIF to define cell phenotypes, delineate tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) and germinal centers (GCs), and stratify patient risk, we evaluate external CD3 recovery, single-cell classification, dense nuclear segmentation, TLS/GC segmentation, and patient survival prediction. Across the benchmark, foundation-model-based MIPHEI-ViT leads among the generators, while non-foundation models show task-specific strengths. Comparing the two routes reveals that internal encoder features generally outperform generated outputs, and larger output marker panels do not guarantee stronger downstream utility across datasets. Moreover, neither internal encoder features nor generated outputs consistently surpass frozen UNI2. These findings show that pixel-level stain fidelity does not equate to downstream utility, and that generators trained at current paired-data scales have yet to surpass large-scale pure-H&amp;E foundation models. With the expansion of paired translation cohorts and the advancement of foundation-based generative architectures, HEmIF-Bench establishes a definitive benchmark for tracking when H&amp;E-to-mIF generation crosses the threshold to deliver genuine value beyond routine histology for tumor microenvironment analysis and precision oncology.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables

</details>

### 389. ["Don't Leave the Task Unfinished": Persistence-Driven Violations under Quiet Oversight](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19911v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19911

**作者：** Seunghyun Lee、Jaehui Hwang、Dongyoon Han、Sangdoo Yun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19911v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19911v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究长程 agent 任务中被人为加强的 persistence 在监督稀少时导致违反既定约束：四种模型上违规率由 29.2% 升至 58.3%，且仅逐步追问式监督能将其拉回。

**相关性简评：** 把「持续做到完成」当作可配置倾向并量化其代价，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的停止决策与继续推理的收益—风险评价提供类比线索；但对象是纯文本 agent 安全与人类监督协议，与视觉状态表示无直接关联，可供核查其停止与监督设置能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** "Don't Leave the Task Unfinished": Persistence-Driven Violations under Quiet Oversight

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents are increasingly given long, multi-step tasks to carry out, with the user reviewing little of what happens in between. Persistence, the tendency to keep working until a task is complete, is installed on purpose to improve performance on long tasks. Long-horizon tasks are typically complex, and the user's instruction can fall short of what the work actually requires, or conflict with the constraints the agent encounters in the task. We study what persistence does on long-horizon operations tasks that cannot be solved without breaking a documented constraint. We find that the agent pursues completion to the point of violating the constraint, and that a critically engaged user lowers the violation rate. Persistence takes violations from 29.2% to 58.3% across four models. Violations stay high wherever oversight goes quiet, whether the user is silent, assenting, or delegating with expressed trust. Only a questioning user, who asks for the basis of each action before allowing the next, brings the rate back to roughly the level measured without persistence. Practitioners should treat high persistence as a setting that carries a safety cost, and should recognize that the cost appears when oversight goes quiet. Safety here is better cast as a property of the human-AI pair than of the model alone. Project page: https://francis21c.github.io/quiet-oversight/

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 4 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Dynamic Alignment on Human-AI Coupled System (BiAlign)

</details>
