### 390. [Delayed Heuristic-Behavior-Target Coupling for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning in Inventory Control](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19917v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19917

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HBPO 这一 off-policy 框架，将启发式引导通过持续的行为策略学习延迟地耦合到独立更新的目标策略，并用 residual 优势估计与 emphatic weighting 支撑，在库存控制基准 DSIS/DSIS-RB 上考察冷启动与高成本初始策略的恢复与改进。

**相关性简评：** 其「启发式—行为—目标」延迟耦合链条与分离优化的行为/目标策略，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练的信号传递、贡献分配和辅助策略与主策略如何交互提供可核查的借鉴线索，但任务与控制场景差异较大，需读正文确认迁移条件。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Delayed Heuristic-Behavior-Target Coupling for Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning in Inventory Control

**abstract/A1：** Many reinforcement learning methods tie data collection to the task policy, while coordinating independently optimized behavior and target policies remains challenging. Policies learned by these methods can perform unreliably in long-horizon tasks under uncertainty, such as inventory control, where failures can incur extreme costs. We introduce Heuristic Behavior Policy Optimization (HBPO), an off-policy framework that routes heuristic guidance through persistent behavior learning, coupled with target-policy, updating separately with residual-based advantage estimation and emphatic weighting. Under matched environment interaction budgets on DSIS and its risk-augmented variant DSIS-RB, HBPO recovers many high-cost initial policies and improves most non-collapse comparison groups. Cold starts achieve competitive costs without final cost collapse across all tested seeds. We identify a transmission chain in the delayed heuristic-behavior-target coupling as a key driver of recovery and improvement. Generation-level diagnostics trace heuristic uptake and subsequent selective target responses, while component ablations support the contribution of this transmission mechanism to policy recovery and improvement.

### 391. [Evaluating Near-Perfect Accuracy Claims in Machine-Learning-Based Leak Detection for Two-Phase Pipelines: A Condition-Blocked Audit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19965v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19965

**作者：** Issah N. Suleiman、Sormeh Serpoosh、Nadine Elkholy、Hicham Ferroudji、Mohammad Azizur Rahman、Matthew Hamilton

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19965v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19965v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 审计基于压力的两相管道泄漏检测模型，改用「留一工况」分块验证后，准确率由同工况下的 93.3% 降至未见过工况的 59.1%，并通过消融将落差主要归因于数据划分协议、次要归因于把工况编码为模型输入。

**相关性简评：** 其「分块/分组验证＋拆分信息泄漏消融＋报告运行层错误率」的评测设计，可能可供核查 LVR 与 VLM 推理评测中因划分方式或条件泄漏而虚高的收益；但领域本身与视觉推理无直接联系，属远域借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evaluating Near-Perfect Accuracy Claims in Machine-Learning-Based Leak Detection for Two-Phase Pipelines: A Condition-Blocked Audit

**abstract/A1：** Reliable leak detection in gas-liquid two-phase pipelines is important for process safety, yet machine-learning studies frequently report near-perfect performance using evaluation protocols that may not represent deployment to unseen operating conditions. This study audits a pressure-based leak-detection model using condition-blocked leave-one-condition-out validation, in which the classifier is tested on a flow condition excluded from training. Accuracy decreased from 93.3% under within-condition evaluation to 59.1% across fifteen unseen-condition tests. Ablation analysis showed that most of this difference arose from the data-splitting protocol, with a smaller contribution from encoding operating conditions as model inputs. Under condition-blocked evaluation, the false-alarm and missed-detection rates increased to 34.1% and 10.2%, respectively, demonstrating that near-perfect reported accuracy did not translate into reliable operation at unseen flow conditions. The reduction persisted across all evaluated classifiers, indicating that it was caused by the evaluation design rather than a particular model architecture. Grouped evaluation of an independent acoustic pipeline dataset produced a comparable reduction toward chance-level performance. These findings show that validation units must represent the conditions encountered during deployment. Condition-blocked evaluation and explicit reporting of operational error rates are therefore necessary before machine-learning leak detectors can support process-safety decisions.

**comment/C1：** 8 figures, 8 tables. Analysis code archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24218226

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19976

**作者：** Chang Liu、Sheng Li、Zhenxing Qian、Xinpeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19976v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19976v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出视频创意抄袭检测任务与 CreaTrace 框架，通过多模态语义事件分割、粗粒度创意匹配、创意解耦与跨实现特征交换对比学习，判定创意相似度并定位证据片段。

**相关性简评：** 其把抽象创意模式与具体视觉实现分离、并用跨实现特征交换增强不变性的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要的 latent 内容与表面视觉实现提供表示解耦线索，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CreaTrace: Video Creative Plagiarism Detection and Evidence Tracing

**abstract/A1：** Video creative plagiarism refers to the unauthorized reproduction of creative ideas across videos despite substantial differences in visual appearance, posing a new challenge to video copyright protection. However, existing video copy detection methods primarily focus on visual content similarity, struggling to capture abstract creative that are entangled with specific visual realizations. To address this issue, we introduce a novel task, named Video Creative Plagiarism Detection (VCPD), and propose an iterative creative evidence tracing framework, termed CreaTrace, to verify creative similarity and accurately localize the corresponding evidence segments. Specifically, we design a Multimodal Semantic Event Segmentation strategy to divide similar long videos into coherent narrative events, facilitating event-level dataset construction and retrieving similar segments. Based on these events, CreaTrace employs Coarse Creative Matching to identify candidate event pairs through narrative semantics and camera language. Then CreaTrace presents Creative Decoupling to disentangle abstract creative patterns from specific visual realizations. Meanwhile, Creative Swap Contrastive Learning is devised to enhance creative consistency through cross-realization feature swapping. Benefiting from the above designs, our CreaTrace enables accurate creative similarity detection and temporal localization, while providing interpretable evidence report. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of CreaTrace across diverse creative plagiarism scenarios.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19985

**作者：** Mahesh Reddy Pagadala

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在无噪声的 4–10 比特分层量子电路上，用 transformer 编码器与门依赖图网络监督预测单比特 Z 与双比特 ZZ 期望值，并与恒零及训练拟合常数基线对比，发现所评估模型均未低于零预测器的误差。

**相关性简评：** 近半数目标幅值接近零、学习模型却不敌恒零基线，这一诊断思路可供核查 LVR 中「模型是否真正使用输入、是否退化为常数或先验」的基线与评估设计，但与视觉推理本体无直接关联，属较远线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Zero Is Competitive: A Descriptive Pilot of Transformer and Gate-Graph Surrogates on Random-Angle Quantum Circuits

**abstract/A1：** We examine supervised classical prediction of all one-qubit Z and two-qubit ZZ expectation values on noiseless, layered 4-10-qubit RX/RY/RZ-CNOT circuits. In a 63-cell stratified workload with disjoint circuit-template tests, we evaluate one transformer encoder and gate-dependency graph neural networks against literal-zero and training-derived constant predictors. On the Arm K training labels, 44.89% of scalar targets have absolute magnitude below 0.05. The held-out-template zero predictor has equal-instance mean absolute error 0.193399, and none of the evaluated transformer checkpoints or final graph-network endpoints achieves a lower score. A separate product-state positive control achieves MAE 0.007755 versus 0.514811 for zero, but does not explain the failure on the entangled workload. The difference between zero and a training-fitted mean constant under training MSE is only 0.14%, a descriptive point estimate without uncertainty analysis. The transformer's 815,233-parameter source identity is locally verified; detailed packed-input semantics have not been independently audited. These results constitute a descriptive pilot, not a causal explanation, formal equivalence test, or impossibility claim. Comparable circuits can be regenerated from the workload specification, but exact frozen datasets and model-run evidence remain private.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 1 figure. Descriptive pilot study. Exact experimental evidence archive currently private

</details>

### 394. [MOBO-CAPS: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-Aware Pareto Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19999v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.19999

**作者：** Hanyang Wang、Juergen Branke、Matthias Poloczek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.19999v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.19999v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把「最终只需交付固定 M 个高 hypervolume 解」的情形形式化为 MOBO-CAPS，提出两种直接面向基数约束下取值的采集策略 REHVI 与 CHO-UCB，并给出批量版 CHO-UCB 的次线性简单遗憾界与九个基准上的经验对比。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是为固定大小的最终解集直接设计采集目标、而非优化完整前沿再事后筛选，这一「价值驱动、预算受限下的定容子集选择」视角可能可供核查到 LVR 中证据／latent 假设的有限容量筛选与评估预算分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MOBO-CAPS: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-Aware Pareto Selection

**abstract/A1：** Multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) traditionally aims to approximate the entire Pareto front, but, due to resource constraints, real-world deployment is often limited to testing a small, representative subset of solutions. Hence current methods first approximate the full front before selecting solutions, potentially wasting costly evaluations. We formalize this problem as Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Cardinality-aware Pareto Selection (MOBO-CAPS), where the goal is to identify a set of exactly M solutions with high hypervolume. We propose two practical cardinality-aware acquisition strategies: REHVI, a replacement-aware approximation to expected hypervolume improvement, and CHO-UCB, which constructs an optimistic M-point set by optimizing a collective UCB-based hypervolume objective. We prove a sublinear simple regret bound for the batched version of CHO-UCB, and empirically show that cardinality-aware acquisition design improves over standard MOBO followed by post-hoc subset selection across nine benchmarks.

</details>

### 395. [Improving fine-grained expressivity of graph neural networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20020v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20020

**作者：** Yonatan Sverdlov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20020v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20020v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该博士论文研究图神经网络与对称感知架构的表达能力，涵盖几何消息传递的通用表达刻画及 EGenNet、多重置换等变线性层的表示论分析、保持包含关系的集合表示（含维度界与不可能性结果、MASNet），以及兼顾表达力与双 Lipschitz 稳定性的 FSW-GNN。

**相关性简评：** 虽与视觉推理无直接关联，但其关于保包含集合表示的维度界与不可能性结果、以及双 Lipschitz 稳定性，可能为刻画 latent 状态能否保留视觉细节与关系、以及 latent 相似度结构是否被压缩破坏提供概念与评价线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving fine-grained expressivity of graph neural networks

**abstract/A1：** This thesis investigates the expressive power of neural networks for structured data, focusing on graph neural networks and symmetry-aware architectures. We present four main contributions. First, we characterize the generic expressive power of geometric message-passing neural networks on sparse graphs and introduce EGenNet, an architecture achieving the corresponding guarantees. Second, we use representation theory to characterize linear layers equivariant to multiple permutations, including wreath-product symmetries. Third, we study permutation-invariant set representations that preserve containment, establish dimensional bounds and impossibility results, and introduce MASNet. Finally, we propose FSW-GNN, a message-passing architecture combining strong expressivity and bi-Lipschitz stability guarantees with strong empirical performance on long-range graph-learning tasks. Together, these results provide a broader understanding of how neural architectures can preserve the geometric, algebraic, order-theoretic, and metric structure of their inputs.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文在模拟分布式系统中研究何时采用自适应工具选择，提出 Query-ATLAS：用 LLM 依据客户端误差与既往候选引导符号方程搜索，并与固定 PySR-LLM 流程在多种架构和任务上比较验证通过率、误差与成本。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Agentic Scientific Discovery in Distributed Systems

**abstract/A1：** We investigate when adaptive tool selection helps identify a shared equation across clients with different input coverage. Query-ATLAS (query-conditioned Agentic Tool-based Learning for Aggregating Symbolic Equations) uses an LLM to guide symbolic search from client errors and previous proposals in a simulated distributed system. A four-architecture comparison reveals task-dependent opportunities: relative to fixed PySR-LLM, validation acceptances rise from 3/12 to 7/12 on CRK3 and from 11/12 to 12/12 on oscillator2, while MatSci3 favors the fixed workflow. Across 72 settings in a post-hoc six-task subset of eight development tasks, Query-ATLAS achieves 64 validation and 64 in-distribution passes, versus 62 and 59 for the fixed workflow; both pass 47/60 eligible out-of-distribution tests. The fixed workflow retains lower median errors and cost. Broader query coverage emerges as a promising benefit, motivating task-aware tool selection and client-aware fitting for scientific agents.

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20076

**作者：** Donghyeon Soon、Jiil Yoon、Hyeondong Kim、Daehee Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20076v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20076v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向拥挤场景中人体运动预测的未来目标歧义，SGIP 显式预测未来运动将落于场景中的对象或可通行区域，并用该先验条件化轨迹与全身姿态预测；该先验通过训练期「意图蒸馏」由 LLM 意图描述与几何特征的教师模型迁移到仅用观测运动与 3D 场景的学生模型。

**相关性简评：** 其「先从观测推断未来证据落点、再据此生成」的显式中间先验与训练期蒸馏，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK 决策、证据筛选与推理先验监督提供类比线索，需核查其落点表示是否可作为可复用的中间状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SGIP: Learning Scene-Grounded Interaction Priors for Scene-Aware Human Motion Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Human motion prediction (HMP) aims to forecast future movement from an observed motion sequence, and recent methods have incorporated 3D scene geometry and object semantics to improve long-term plausibility. However, the destination of future motion remains ambiguous in cluttered scenes: the same observed motion can lead to different interaction targets or navigation modes. Existing methods either handle this ambiguity implicitly or rely on auxiliary signals like gaze that are hard to obtain in practice. To address this, we propose SGIP, which explicitly predicts where in the scene future motion will be grounded across both objects and open navigation regions, and uses it to condition future trajectory and full-body pose prediction. This scene-grounded interaction prior is learned via intent distillation: at training time only, a teacher model scores candidate scene regions by combining an LLM prompted with a textual description of the person's intent with geometric motion-scene features. A student model learns to reproduce these scores from only the observed motion and 3D scene, making intent and LLM unnecessary at test time. Across multiple benchmark datasets, SGIP outperforms prior scene-aware baselines on both trajectory and pose accuracy in a realistic deployment setting where neither gaze nor intent is available at inference, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. The project page is available at https://sgip2026.github.io.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sgip2026.github.io

</details>

### 398. [Does Learning Order Explain Forgetting? The Lie Bracket as an Early-Warning Signal for Catastrophic Forgetting Without Old Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20087v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20087

**作者：** Ephraim Kofi Ayi Kwapong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20087v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20087v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文实证检验「两任务梯度场的 Lie bracket 非零与灾难性遗忘相关」这一猜想，在多个 Split 图像分类基准上比较训练顺序导致的损失差与遗忘，并尝试仅用旧任务结束时存储的梯度及 top-20 Hessian 特征对，在训练新任务早期预测遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「学习顺序—遗忘」及用旧任务低维摘要做无旧数据预警，可能为顺序训练 VLM 推理能力（如 THINK/LOOK 阶段）时的能力漂移监测提供概念线索；其依赖旧任务充分学习、任务增量等条件是否适用于 latent 推理状态仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does Learning Order Explain Forgetting? The Lie Bracket as an Early-Warning Signal for Catastrophic Forgetting Without Old Data

**abstract/A1：** A network trained on task A and then task B ends at different weights than one trained on B and then A. To leading order this gap is set by the Lie bracket of the two tasks' gradient fields, and Dherin (2023) conjectured that a non-vanishing bracket may be linked to catastrophic forgetting. I test this conjecture empirically. Across Split MNIST, Split Fashion-MNIST and Split CIFAR-10, the forgetting of A is almost exactly the difference in A's loss between the two training orders (Spearman rho = 0.96-1.00). I then ask whether the bracket can predict that forgetting early in training on B and without any of A's data, using only a small summary stored when A finishes: its gradient and its top 20 Hessian eigenpairs. When the old task is well learned and forgetting is slow (task-incremental), this stored bracket ranks forgetting with rho = 0.70-0.81, against 0.33-0.58 for the penalty of Elastic Weight Consolidation, and matches or exceeds re-evaluating A on its own data. When forgetting is fast (domain-incremental), the stored summary goes stale and the EWC penalty is as good or better. The bracket fails outright when the old task is only half learned; I trace this to a residual gradient on A an order of magnitude larger, which makes first-order (slope) damage matter. The bracket is therefore a useful early-warning signal for the quiet kind of forgetting, under a clear condition.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and results: https://github.com/Hackme262/lie-bracket-forgetting

</details>

### 399. [See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20089v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20089

**作者：** Shuhong Liu、Gengjia Chang、Quanfeng Xu、Ziteng Cui、Qianyu Zhou、Xiaoyu Dong、Lin Gu、Tatsuya Harada

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20089v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20089v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Cosmos4D，用引力势与共享低维力场积分每颗恒星高斯的运动，并按亮度分层（亮星跨尺度监督轨道、暗星由光流速度场携带），配合八个星系的多视角时序数据集，从图像序列重建星系的四维演化。

**相关性简评：** 其「低维共享物理约束驱动状态演化」与「强弱信号分层监督」可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否受显式约束更新、弱视觉证据是否会被弥散背景淹没或信息坍缩。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** See the Lives of Stars in a Handful of Light

**abstract/A1：** Galaxies evolve over hundreds of millions of years, and no telescope has ever watched one move. Cosmological simulations make this evolution visible as a sequence of multi-view images, inviting the question of whether a galaxy can be recovered in four dimensions from its images. This setting defeats existing dynamic scene methods, since millions of stars span only a few pixels each, faint populations blend into diffuse light, and free deformations reproduce the images without obeying gravity. We present Cosmos4D, which rests on two components. Gravitational 4D Gaussian Splatting represents each star as a self-luminous Gaussian whose motion is integrated through a gravitational potential and a low-dimensional force field shared by all stars. Luminosity-stratified dynamics give bright stars individual orbits supervised across image scales and carry faint populations with a velocity field estimated from optical flow. We further build a 4D dataset of eight galaxies from four cosmological simulations, on which Cosmos4D outperforms dynamic Gaussian baselines in both photometric quality and physical accuracy. With these advancements, we glimpse eight hundred million years of a galaxy's life in ninety-six frames.

</details>

### 400. [Geo2Gcode: From 3D Geometry to CNC Programs through Structured Machining Primitives](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20092v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20092

**作者：** Sangmin Hong、Dohee Cho、Mohsen Yavartanoo、Kyoung Mu Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文将目标三维网格直接编译为 CNC 加工程序：每个加工基元绑定加工方向、逐视角闭合重建与刀具半径、层高、清削模式等显式参数，并确定性地编译为分层刀路，再由在体素毛坯模拟器中训练的轻量选择器自动填充参数。

**相关性简评：** 虽属制造几何领域，但“学习型轻量选择器提参数 + 确定性编译器保真”的分工，可能为 LVR 中 latent 提案与确定性解码之间的贡献分配、以及最小化学习组件职责的设计提供概念参照，需较多核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Geo2Gcode: From 3D Geometry to CNC Programs through Structured Machining Primitives

**abstract/A1：** Turning a 3D shape into a Computer Numerical Control (CNC) program is still largely manual. For every part, a machinist chooses setups, tools, step-downs, and toolpath patterns. We present Geo2Gcode, which converts a target mesh directly into standard G-code through structured machining primitives. Each primitive couples an indexed machining direction, a closed per-view reconstruction of the target, and explicit tool-radius, layer-height, and clearing-pattern parameters, and compiles deterministically into layerwise toolpaths via signed-distance queries. Most of the fidelity comes from this compiler. A lightweight selector trained with a voxel stock simulator fills in primitive parameters without per-part manual settings, approaching the finest fixed setting at about a quarter of its toolpath length. In simulation on ABC parts, Geo2Gcode reaches roughing fidelity comparable to an expert-tuned commercial CAM setup with a moderately longer toolpath, and clearly improves on a default CAM configuration. Generated programs run in a commercial G-code simulator, and one part is machined on a physical CNC mill. These results demonstrate that roughing programs can be generated directly from geometry without per-part CAM tuning.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20111

**作者：** Josef Pavlíček、Petra Pavlíčková、Martin Molhanec

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20111v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20111v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以自动音乐和声为受控测试床构建 HARMONIX 框架，在同一 Viterbi 优化机制下比较基线、重复约束、功能约束及二者组合四种配置与人类参考决策的一致性，发现组合约束在稳定结构情境下提升约五个百分点的根音音程一致率，但在涉及移调跟踪的情境中下降近九个百分点，而整体精确和弦一致率仅轻微变化。

**相关性简评：** 其「约束只在特定情境下适用、聚合指标会掩盖系统性局部失败」的发现可能与 LVR 中何时调用并信任 latent 推理或视觉证据（THINK/LOOK/STOP）及贡献分配的情境化评价相关，约束设计与情境划分方式可供核查是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Valid Decisions Are Not Enough: Evaluating Structural Constraints in Knowledge-Guided Generative Systems

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge-guided generative systems use explicit domain constraints to improve decision consistency and alignment with human-created solutions. However, locally valid decisions do not necessarily preserve contextual relationships in human decision-making. This paper examines when structural constraints improve or degrade agreement with human reference solutions. We introduce HARMONIX, an experimental framework using automated musical harmonization as a controlled testbed for knowledge-guided decision-making. Four configurations share the same Viterbi-based optimization mechanism: a baseline, repetition constraints, functional constraints, and their combination. Experiments cover 19,745 records and 143,634 motif pairs across training and validation partitions. Combined constraints improve reference root-interval agreement by approximately five percentage points in stable structural contexts but reduce it by nearly nine percentage points in contexts involving transposition tracking. These opposing effects are consistent across both partitions, while overall exact chord agreement changes only marginally. Contexts are identified retrospectively using reference annotations; no adaptive constraint-selection mechanism is evaluated. The findings demonstrate that interpretable constraints can introduce systematic context-specific failures concealed by aggregate accuracy metrics. They highlight the need to evaluate relationships between decisions and the contextual applicability of constraints in knowledge-guided generative systems.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 4 tables, 1 figure

</details>

### 402. [Aerial Person Detection under Edge Constraints: Held-Out Evaluation and Edge-Ground Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20127v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20127

**作者：** Raghu Venkat、Tricha Anjali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20127v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20127v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在搜索无人机边缘算力受限的场景下研究人物检测，采用事先声明的留出评估，比较受对比度线索门控的小型检测器与 YOLO11n，并将每帧候选裁剪交给更大的地面模型复评以提高召回。

**相关性简评：** 其按虚警目标固定阈值、对候选区域追加算力复评并逐帧核算开销的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与动态计算分配提供核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 状态或生成式推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Aerial Person Detection under Edge Constraints: Held-Out Evaluation and Edge-Ground Verification

**abstract/A1：** A search drone sees a missing person as a few pixels, carries a small computer, and shares a narrow radio link. We study person detection under those limits; the primary evaluations were declared before they ran, and later analyses are marked exploratory. In an exploratory comparison, holding out recording blocks inferred from thermal frame identifiers cut recall at a fixed false-alarm target from 32.7% to 12.3%. With nothing tuned on test blocks, a 46,000-parameter detector gated by a contrast cue finds 10.4% of people against 5.7% for the same network applied everywhere. A standard detector, YOLO11n, trained under the same folds finds 54.5% at a similar false-alarm rate for about eleven times the arithmetic, and on our 4K field footage at 117 m has a walking person among its top 16 detections in up to 92% of frames against 74% for our board. Run alone, YOLO11n's thresholds set at one location overshot their false-alarm target 1.7 to 3.4 times at new locations, and its best configuration at altitude cost 4 to 24 standard passes per frame. Re-scoring its 16 best crops (154 KB per frame) with an 842,000-parameter ground model, thresholds frozen on a validation location, raised recall from 44.9% to 53.7% against the same 16 crops with YOLO's own scores; in a post hoc paired analysis over 15 test locations the gain was +8.8 points \[+2.4, +12.5\]. Pooled false detections fell from 0.86 to 0.64 per frame, but that paired change was not distinguishable from zero. Coverage of a still person in earth tones was very low for both detectors in the clips we flew.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Code, truth registers and result files: https://github.com/numberz-ai/aerial-person-detector

</details>

### 403. [HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20144v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20144

**作者：** Chirag Goel、Jacob Lavoie、Amirhossein Naghshzan、Jordan Bannister、Marzia Nouri、Mehar Bhatia、Matt Harris、Siva Reddy、Arsène Fansi Tchango、Gaétan Marceau Caron

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20144v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20144v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文把 agent 记忆系统视为用户持久信息的托管者，提出覆盖性能、效率、安全、隐私与用户主权的行为期望，并构建 HEAMS 开源评测框架与基准套件，还用原型系统 MilaMem 及可包裹任意记忆系统的治理层比较不同记忆系统与召回/保留策略的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 虽不涉及视觉或 latent reasoning，但其对「保留什么、何时召回、何时抑制」的多维权衡评测，可能可供核查 LVR 中持久潜在状态与视觉证据保留/泄露的评价口径。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HEAMS: Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems

**abstract/A1：** Memory systems allow AI agents to persist information across interactions, making them more personalized and more capable on long-horizon tasks. This persistence introduces new risks: stored information can be disclosed in inappropriate contexts, resist correction or deletion, be retained beyond what users desire, or be poisoned to influence later agent behaviour. Yet memory systems are typically evaluated on task performance and efficiency alone. We argue that a memory system should instead be understood as the custodian of its user's persistent information, with responsibilities that extend beyond helping an agent complete its tasks, and that it should be evaluated holistically against all such responsibilities. We present Holistic Evaluation of Agent Memory Systems (HEAMS), an open-source framework for evaluating agent memory systems in this way. First, we state the responsibilities of agent memory systems as explicit behavioural desiderata spanning performance, efficiency, security, privacy, and user sovereignty. Second, we assemble a benchmark suite that covers these desiderata and acknowledge the gaps that remain. Third, we develop MilaMem, a prototype memory system, and a governance layer that can wrap any memory system, enabling controlled study of memory system design choices. Fourth, we compare memory systems across the full HEAMS benchmark suite. We find that no memory system leads every performance benchmark, and strong performance scores may coexist with poor privacy, user-sovereignty, and security scores. Governance strongly influences results: recall policies can reduce inappropriate disclosure at a cost in helpfulness, while both recall and retention policies improve poisoning resistance. Performance and efficiency benchmarks alone therefore cannot reveal how well a memory system meets its responsibilities. Code: https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams

**comment/C1：** 69 pages (26 main text), 6 figures, 29 tables. Code: https://github.com/milatechtransfer/heams

</details>

### 404. [Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20150v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20150

**作者：** Bart M. N. Smets、Gijs Bellaard、Pieter Wils

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20150v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20150v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种软等变网络架构：训练时让网络自动只对数据支持的对称群保持等变，训练后读出「对称性指纹」以表明哪些对称性相关及其程度，并在图像分类任务上演示该流程。

**相关性简评：** 其可学习的对称性选择与表示几何诊断思路，可能为刻画 VLM 内部视觉状态中保留的几何与任务必要结构提供度量线索，但尚无多模态推理实验，指纹能否迁移到推理状态可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Geometric deep learning has made available a large variety of structurally equivariant neural network architectures, meaning a particular transformation of their input causes a predictable transformation of their output. But structural equivariance is a very strong inductive bias that can limit performance if chosen poorly. In contrast, choosing an architecture with low geometric bias necessitates data augmentation to obtain correct behavior; extending the training process. We propose a novel neural network architecture that is soft equivariant; we select a set of symmetry groups and during training the network will become equivariant only to those symmetry groups that are appropriate given the training data. After training we can inspect the network to obtain a symmetry fingerprint that will tell us exactly which symmetries ended up being relevant and to what degree. We show how our architecture and the fingerprinting process work in the case of an image classification task.

</details>

### 405. [AstroPIE-53: Towards Understanding Failure Modes of Human Pose Estimation in Space](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20207v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20207

**作者：** Stephanie Käs、Marten Flaig、Lukas Woyke、Osmanalp Ömeroğlu、Felix Krueckel、Onur Alp Çulha、Bastian Leibe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20207v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20207v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 发布 AstroPIE-53 数据集（53 段航天员视频，含框、难度类别与人工标注的姿态失败标签），并在零样本条件下评测现有人体检测与姿态估计模型，系统分析遮挡、异常朝向、低对比度和微重力运动导致的失败。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身不做 latent 推理，但其失败条件与失败标签可能为 LVR 中「视觉证据何时不可信、是否需继续 LOOK」的筛选信号提供参考，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AstroPIE-53: Towards Understanding Failure Modes of Human Pose Estimation in Space

**abstract/A1：** Reliable monitoring of astronauts is essential for safety, situational awareness, and autonomous assistance in space missions. While modern computer vision enables accurate human detection and pose estimation on Earth, its robustness in space environments remains largely unquantified due to limited data availability. We present AstroPIE-53, a pilot dataset of 53 annotated astronaut videos collected from publicly available mission footage. To respect copyright restrictions, we release video identifiers, reconstruction scripts, and dense annotations rather than raw videos. The dataset includes bounding boxes, challenge classes, and human-annotated pose failure tags. We benchmark state-of-the-art person detection and pose estimation models under realistic zero-shot deployment conditions and perform the first systematic failure analysis for astronaut monitoring. Our results reveal substantial performance degradation caused by occlusions, unusual body orientations, low contrast, and microgravity motion patterns.

**comment/C1：** 4 pages + references, 4 figures. Published in the Proceedings of SPAICE 2026 and i-SAIRAS 2026

### 406. [Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20258v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20258

**作者：** Nick Ryan、Peter A. Devine、Ben Sirb、Hannah Sansford、Alex Chiocchi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20258v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20258v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 microfitting：为每篇文档离线训练并缓存一个小型 adapter，由合成问题驱动，文档被查询时复用该 adapter，以参数隔离替代持续学习中的参数覆盖，并在企业文档问答上报告相对提升。

**相关性简评：** 「按文档缓存专用参数、查询时调用」的思路或可类比 LVR 中把视觉证据状态外置缓存、避免污染推理轨迹，其生成配方依历史结果迭代也可供核查训练数据分配，但该文为纯文本持续学习，无推理期 latent 状态研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Microfitting: Continual Learning via Cached Test-Time Training

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning is a promising approach to specialize language models to an organization's private data. However, current methods exhibit a number of drawbacks including catastrophic forgetting, where new training updates overwrite prior knowledge. We present microfitting, which trains and caches a small adapter for each document. Each adapter is trained once, offline, on synthetic questions targeted at demonstrated base-model shortcomings and reused whenever that document is queried. This method borrows from test-time learning literature and sidesteps the problem of continual learning through parameter isolation, allowing the system to specialize on new data without overwriting prior knowledge. The process that generates adapter training data also improves over time, revising its recipe from previous outcomes and fresh examples of the target workload. On DeepSeek V4 Flash, microfitting substantially improves accuracy over the base model. In Enterprise Document Operations (EDO), an open-book Q&amp;A environment over real-world enterprise documents, our method achieves a 38.2% relative improvement over base-model performance. Microfitting makes continual specialization practical and cost-efficient: a frozen model can adapt to an evolving private corpus overnight on local hardware, without modifying the base model or previously cached adapters.

</details>

### 407. [Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20259v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20259

**作者：** Olatunji Oni、Sanhita Sengupta、Marc De Benedetti、Nathanial Eddy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、q-bio.QM、stat.AP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20259v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20259v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 evidence-calibrated selection（ECS）人机协同框架：用临床医生已完成的判定校准 LLM 置信度，优先把支持度最低的病例交人工复审，并将已核定结果作为先例回灌模型，用于多发性骨髓瘤的治疗线数判定。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的 STOP 决策和置信校准线索相关：以外部验证结果校准置信、按支持度排序筛选待核证据、把已核验结论作为上下文先例，可能可供核查「何时依赖 latent 输出、何时再取证据」的设计；但属临床文本判定场景，迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling large language model-assisted line-of-therapy adjudication with human-in-the-loop evidence-calibrated selection

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) have enabled the ability to scale clinical adjudication tasks traditionally dependent on exhaustive manual review. Line-of-therapy (LoT) adjudication, a major bottleneck in oncology cohort construction, is a prime example. Line boundaries must be inferred from longitudinal treatment histories according to nuanced, study-specific definitions, at every regimen transition for every patient. LLMs can apply this adjudication at scale, but their reliability varies across patients. Treatment histories differ in complexity, and ambiguous or atypical patterns depend on expert clinical judgment. Reliable automation thus requires verified support for model assignments and the ability to identify cases that warrant manual review. Here, we present evidence-calibrated selection (ECS), a human-in-the-loop framework for scaling LLM-assisted LoT adjudication. ECS derives confidence from observed clinician adjudications, prioritizes patients with the least-supported assignments for follow-up review, and returns completed adjudications to the model as precedent. As the evidence base grows, ECS continuously calibrates confidence to estimate residual error, thus enabling more efficient use of clinician time. In simulations on 136 clinician adjudicated patients with multiple myeloma, ECS achieved a residual error of 5% after review of 44.6% of patients, compared to 62.2% when review was directed by LLM self-reported confidence and 81.9% under random sampling. These results support a scalable approach to study-specific LoT adjudication, using clinician evidence to inform automated predictions, minimize error, and reduce review burden.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 408. [GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Coastal Emergency Response under Extreme Water Levels](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20268v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20268

**作者：** Marcello Sano、Samuele Casagrande、Davide Ferrario、Sebastiano Vascon、Silvia Torresan、Andrea Critto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20268v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20268v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文把威尼斯利多岛建模为异构图（高程、道路、建筑、人口与1983–2024年潮位记录），用 PPO 学习市政应急预案七类行动的触发时机，并在18个历史情景上与规则系统对比：人口暴露降低幅度相近，去掉图消息传递后性能亦无明显下降。

**相关性简评：** 其「在不确定预报下何时触发行动」的时序决策与触发阈值，可能为 LVR 中何时停止/何时获取更多视觉证据的决策表述提供类比；消息传递消融未损性能这一现象也可供核查关系结构是否真被推理使用，但领域相距较远，需较多迁移判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Coastal Emergency Response under Extreme Water Levels

**abstract/A1：** When a storm surge approaches a coastal town, the emergency plan must be put into action quickly using water-level forecasts, flood extent, road access, vulnerable residents and shelters. Bringing this information together under time pressure is slow and depends on the duty officer's expertise. This paper is one step in a wider research line from data to safe decisions: machine learning to understand the hazard, reinforcement learning and planning to choose actions, large language models (LLMs) to explain and cross-check them, and an assurance layer that keeps people in charge. Here we address the action step on a real place. We ask whether a policy can learn the timing of emergency actions from decades of real events. Lido di Venezia is represented as a heterogeneous graph built from public elevation, road, building and census data and driven by hourly tide-gauge records from 1983 to 2024, with seven actions taken from the municipal emergency plan. A PPO policy is trained on this graph and compared, on storm windows unseen in training, with a rule-based system simulating the officer's discretionary decisions. On 18 historical test scenarios, PPO achieves a similar reduction in population exposure to the rule. With uncertain forecasts and limited protection it again performs similarly but does not outperform the tuned rule, and removing graph message passing does not substantially reduce performance. PPO therefore learns an effective protective response from an outcome-based reward alone: it is given the plan's actions and when each is allowed, but not the thresholds that tell the comparator when to act. Next steps test harder edge cases, move closer to a digital twin of the territory, and replace the simulated officer with assessment by emergency-management stakeholders, supported by LLM-based interpretation of each recommendation.

**comment/C1：** 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/marcellosano/coastal-emergency-drl

</details>

### 409. [PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20307v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20307

**作者：** Jianwen Wu、Meiling Wang、Junkang Zhou、Yipeng Shen、Haoran You

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20307v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20307v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架 PoCoAttn，把视频扩散 Transformer 的 3D 注意力拆成离线校准的稳定位置先验与在线检索的内容相关部分，并按去噪步自适应分配稀疏预算。

**相关性简评：** 其「位置先验与内容残差」分解可供核查 latent 相似度中位置与内容贡献的区分，按步分配预算也与 LVR 动态计算和停止决策有概念联系；但属视频生成加速工作，迁移需较多验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PoCoAttn: Position-Content Collaborative Sparse Attention for Fast and High-Fidelity Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Video diffusion transformers rely on 3D full attention over tens of thousands of spatiotemporal tokens, and its quadratic cost dominates inference latency. Sparse attention reduces this cost, but existing methods face a dilemma: static methods apply predefined masks and cannot capture input-dependent attention, whereas dynamic methods reconstruct the sparse mask repeatedly, paying online to rediscover positional structure that is largely stable across inputs. To this end, we propose PoCoAttn, a training-free sparse attention framework that separates input-stable from input-dependent attention and resolves the former offline and the latter online. PoCoAttn features: (1) A relative-offset analysis of 3D query-key pairs, which shows that video attention decomposes into an input-stable positional prior that carries most of the attention mass and a small content-dependent residual. (2) A position-content collaborative sparse attention mechanism, which retrieves positional keys from offline-calibrated tables, selects content keys online with a head-adaptive ratio between the two sources, and compensates for the discarded keys to approximate full attention. (3) A step-adaptive budget allocation algorithm, which models how early-step sparse attention errors are amplified along the denoising trajectory and derives the optimal sparsity budget per step. Extensive experiments across four video diffusion models and three tasks show that PoCoAttn consistently achieves a better speed-fidelity Pareto frontier than state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, improving PSNR by 1.9 to 5.0 dB over baselines and delivering up to 4.1$\\times$ attention and 2.0$\\times$ denoising speedups over dense FlashAttention-3 attention.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://ecoai-group.github.io/pocoattn

</details>

### 410. [Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20321v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20321

**作者：** Nikolay Dolgov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20321v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20321v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用刻意简单的单目位姿估计器在 SPEED+ 上做 backbone 适配与光度增强的 2x2 研究，发现合成数据上 90% 保形校准区间在真实域只覆盖 9–38% 的旋转误差，迁移收益呈方向不对称，且增强只在它建模的方向上有效。

**相关性简评：** 「错误位姿带着正确位姿的置信度」与域偏移下的方向性退化，可能为 LVR 中判断视觉证据是否充分、何时停止或弃权以及置信度校准提供可供核查的线索，但任务与推理状态机制相距较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 5 figures, 20 tables. Extended version of a paper at the Sim2Science workshop, NeurIPS 2026. Code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record: https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation

</details>

### 411. [Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20334v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20334

**作者：** Shyam Sundar Saravanan、Tie Luo、Sanjay Madria

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20334v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20334v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究时间序列异常检测中「稀有但正常的时段」被数据空间 flow matching 过度惩罚、异常分数与真实异常混淆的问题，提出用时序 VAE 估计残差潜变量的尾部程度，并转为有界、warmup 退火的训练权重，在七个基准上降低此类误报。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜空间稀有度估计 + 有界重加权以区分稀有有效模式与真异常」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中如何把罕见但有据的视觉证据/潜在假设与推理失败区分开。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) models are often trained on nominal data using average-risk objectives, which emphasize dominant normal patterns. However, real time series can contain rare but valid nominal regimes that are underrepresented in the training distribution. We show that data-space flow matching can over-penalize such rare-normal windows and assign them anomaly scores comparable to those of true anomalies. To address this, we propose Residual-Tail-Informed Flow Matching (RT-FM), an unsupervised framework that uses a temporal variational autoencoder to estimate residual latent tailness and converts it into bounded, warmup-annealed weights for training a data-space flow matching model. Experiments on seven TSAD benchmarks show that RT-FM improves rare-normal coverage while preserving strong anomaly discrimination, substantially reducing false alarms on such windows and resulting in improved aggregate detection performance. The code is available at: https://github.com/trustAIoT/RT-FM\_time-series-anomaly

**comment/C1：** IEEE International Conference on Big Data 2026 (December)

</details>

### 412. [EPI-SST: Renewal-Structured State-Space Transformers for Epidemic Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20352v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20352

**作者：** Yiyun Chen、Zewen Liu、Shengpu Tang、Max S. Y. Lau、Wei Jin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20352v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20352v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EPI-SST，用神经证据对内部乘子做有界更新，推进有限记忆的 renewal 状态以生成多步疫情轨迹，并以异方差高斯头配合验证集选择的 log-variance 惩罚校准不确定性，在四个监测基准上降低 RMSE 与 CRPS。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据驱动、有界更新的有限记忆状态逐步滚动」及针对预测分布的校准评价，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态迭代更新、证据筛选与不确定性评估提供参照，但该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理，属较远领域，需核查状态更新的具体机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EPI-SST: Renewal-Structured State-Space Transformers for Epidemic Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Epidemic forecasting supports public health decisions ranging from capacity planning to intervention timing, for which both point accuracy and calibrated uncertainty are essential. Although neural models have advanced point forecasting, producing reliable probabilistic predictions over multiple future horizons remains challenging. Renewal models encode epidemic propagation, while neural forecasters learn flexible multi-horizon representations; integrating these strengths within a probabilistic future rollout remains underexplored. We propose EPI-SST (Epidemic State Space Transformer), a probabilistic forecaster centered on an evidence-driven renewal transition. At each horizon, neural evidence produces a bounded update to an internal multiplier and advances a finite-memory renewal state that generates the future mean trajectory. A separate heteroscedastic Gaussian head controls predictive scale using a validation-selected log-variance penalty. Across four epidemic surveillance benchmarks, EPI-SST achieves the lowest pooled RMSE on every dataset, reducing RMSE by up to 14.2 percent relative to the strongest baseline. It also achieves the lowest continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) at horizons h = 4, 5, 6 on every dataset, with reductions of up to 43 percent relative to the strongest probabilistic baseline. During the abnormal 2019-2020 influenza season, EPI-SST reduces CRPS by 16.9 percent and calibration error by 78.9 percent; a three-seed replication preserves its distributional lead. Ablation studies and frozen-path interventions show that the renewal transition, attention conditioning, horizon coupling, and uncertainty-scale control make complementary contributions to predictive performance.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究圆与乘积环面上相位分布（振荡子网络的同步与聚类）的角向输运控制：对比 Flow Matching 学到的瞬时角速度与 MeanFlow 学到的区间平均速度，在「每次控制评估选定速率并保持到下次更新」的采样数据设定下分析位移误差，并把误差与教师速度的条件协方差联系起来，用 100 个相位的实验比较不同端点配对方式下的排序变化。

**相关性简评：** 其「区间保持平均速度 vs 瞬时速度」的位移误差及条件协方差分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态按离散间隔更新、更新粒度与状态迁移保真度、以及流量类生成器的步长设计提供概念类比，可供核查，但与原论文的推理任务无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Flow Matching for Sampled-Data Control of Angular Distributions

**abstract/A1：** Synchronization and clustering in oscillator networks depend on the joint distribution of the phases. Flow Matching can steer this distribution by learning an angular velocity field from shortest arcs between paired configurations. Each arc is traversed at constant speed, yet the resulting field can vary along its own trajectories. In this article, we study how to control angular transport on the circle and product torus when each controller evaluation selects a rate to hold until the next update. Using the same local velocity samples, Flow Matching learns the instantaneous angular rate and MeanFlow learns its average along the reference trajectory over the control interval. Under direct angular actuation, holding the exact average gives the reference displacement. We relate the displacement error of holding the instantaneous rate and the training residual of MeanFlow to the conditional covariance of the teacher velocities. Experiments with 100 phases show that endpoint pairing affects the comparison. MeanFlow gives smaller one-step errors under minibatch pairing, while permutation alignment reverses the ranking for exchangeable phase clusters.

</details>

### 414. [Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20361v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20361

**作者：** Sheng Xu、Aoduo Li、Rongli He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20361v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20361v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出结构引导的多粒度时空 Transformer，用关节、骨骼、肢体三级特征与门控空间注意力、层次池化融合及关键帧注意力做单目 3D 人体姿态估计，兼顾精度与计算效率。

**相关性简评：** 其 Keyframe Attention 依据信息量挑选运动片段以降低冗余计算，可能为 LVR 中「看哪里」的证据筛选与停止/动态计算提供线索；结构约束注入注意力也可供核查层级状态表示，但任务本身与视觉推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. Temporal Segment Fusion (TSF) aligns temporal contexts across granularities to capture both short- and long-range motion patterns. Hierarchical Cross-Attention (HCA) promotes spatiotemporal interaction between granularities, and Keyframe Attention (KFA) selects informative motion segments to reduce redundancy and computational cost. Experiments demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency over conventional Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structure-aware multi-granularity modeling for monocular 3D human pose estimation.

</details>

### 415. [Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20390v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20390

**作者：** Kazuo Aoyama、Hiroshi Sawada、Shota Kita、Akihiko Shinya、Masaya Notomi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AR、physics.app-ph、physics.optics

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20390v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20390v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究相干光学神经网络在可调参数受限时如何保持高表达能力，提出以相位器—分束器为基本单元、对数深度的 butterfly 拓扑，并用矩阵重构误差、分类准确率及图论指标量化设计原则。

**相关性简评：** 其「统计均匀性」「每参数混合能力」及跨模式快速无偏信息重分配的量化视角，可能为参数受限下 latent 状态的混合与更新结构提供概念借鉴，但对象为光学硬件，与 VLM 推理无直接联系，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Architectural Principles for Parameter-Efficient Unitary Transformations in Coherent Optical Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Coherent optical neural networks based on interferometric architectures offer a promising route toward high-throughput, energy-efficient computation by exploiting the multiple degrees of freedom of light, including spatial, temporal, and spectral modes. However, practical implementations are constrained by the number of tunable parameters due to fabrication complexity, device footprint, and control overhead. In such parameter-constrained settings, achieving high expressive power remains a central challenge. We identify two key architectural requirements for maintaining high expressive power under these constraints: (i) statistical uniformity in the implemented transformations and (ii) strong mixing capability per parameter, which enables rapid and unbiased redistribution of information across modes. To realize these requirements, we develop a logarithmic-depth butterfly-topology architecture whose fundamental building block is a single phase-shifter--beam-splitter pair, in contrast to conventional rectangular mesh architectures based on Mach-Zehnder interferometers. Computational evaluations show that, particularly at restricted parameter counts, the proposed architecture achieves lower matrix-reconstruction errors and higher classification accuracies than conventional meshes in both feedforward and recurrent networks. We further quantify these design principles using graph-theoretic measures, expected squared moduli of transformation-matrix entries, and matrix-reconstruction error. The resulting framework provides a quantitative and physically interpretable basis for parameter-efficient optical neural networks.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 28 figures

</details>

### 416. [Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20398v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20398

**作者：** Yiwei Fu、Nicholas Gabriel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20398v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20398v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 报告在两座燃气电厂内网部署控制逻辑助手的两轮原型经验：先用 VLM 从 6,979 页 PDF 图纸重建控制拓扑，连接精度仅 0.51 且耗时 3.1 小时；后用 LLM 工具调用智能体在八个图操作上反复规划，改为固定执行计划后 token 降 20 倍、延迟降 3 倍且检索节点集稳定。最终设计以版本化知识图谱和确定性软件取证为主，LLM 仅承担意图分类与基于证据的解释。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成模型负责解释、确定性软件负责构造与检索证据」的分工，以及弃权、实体消歧、有界检索与成本核算，可为本研究中视觉证据筛选、证据获取与停止决策的收益/成本权衡提供概念参照，VLM 读图低精度也提示视觉细节抽取需外部核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. Across the full 6,979-page document, extraction reached 0.51 connection precision and required 3.1 hours on 4xH200 GPUs; consultation with controls engineers then revealed a native structured export from the authoring system. The second used an LLM tool-calling agent to plan repeatedly over eight predefined graph operations. In a controlled benchmark of 40 template-generated questions, replacing this agent with explicit execution plans reduced mean token use by 20x and median latency by 3x, with identical retrieved node sets across repeated runs. The deployed design ingests the authoritative export into a versioned knowledge graph, executes bounded graph operations in fixed software, and confines the local LLM to fallback intent classification and evidence-grounded explanation. At one site, the graph contains 221K nodes across seven controllers. Our experience suggests a practical division of labor for high-consequence AI: LLMs interpret natural-language requests and explain results, while deterministic software constructs and retrieves technical evidence grounded in authoritative sources. Abstention, entity disambiguation, graph versioning, and read-only integration provide additional safeguards.

**comment/C1：** Extended version of a paper accepted at IAAI-27 (AAAI 2027). 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 417. [When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20417v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20417

**作者：** Minxuan Hu、Qishi Zhan、Ziheng Chen、Zhengtao Yao、Zihan Dong、Jiayu Yi、Wenxi Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20417v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20417v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在分离的构造、审计与测试样本下考察 cost-aware LLM 路由的「部署承诺」问题：19 个 RouterBench 任务族中，审计可行的最便宜路由有 32.22% 在留出契约上违约，并提出带服务成本容忍度的 MARC/MARC-P 规则，在保留原方案、改用备选或推迟之间做选择。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉 latent 推理无直接关联，但其「审计证据加成本容忍度」决定部署、替换或推迟的思路，可能为 LVR 中依据证据判断是否继续计算、切换策略或停止的决策提供参照，需核查其保证是否可迁移到单次推理轨迹。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When the Cheapest Feasible Router Fails: Auditing Deployment Commitments in Cost-Aware LLM Routing

**abstract/A1：** Cost-aware LLM routing often selects the cheapest policy meeting empirical risk and coverage constraints. Yet a router that passes an audit can violate its fixed service contract on new requests, even when candidate policies are constructed independently. We study this deployment-commitment decision with disjoint construction, audit, and test samples. Across 19 RouterBench task families, the cheapest audit-feasible router deploys in 91.82% of opportunities but violates the held-out contract in 32.22% of deployments. We introduce Menu-Aware Routing Commitment (MARC), which qualifies policies using audit evidence and a serving-cost tolerance to retain the apparent winner, deploy a supported alternative, or defer. Its practical policywise variant (MARC-P) reduces observed conditional failure to 0.73% at 85.79% deployment, with higher serving cost; fixed-margin and formal risk-control procedures provide competitive alternatives. Nested audits show how added evidence changes deployable policy sets, and learned semantic routing exhibits the same commitment failure. These results establish deployment commitment as a distinct operational decision connecting router evaluation, service reliability, and inference cost.

</details>

### 418. [Explainable Federated Learning via Global-Local Attribution Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20445v1>)

**作者：** Dawood Wasif、Terrence J. Moore、Chang-Tien Lu、Jin-Hee Cho

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 xFedAlign：在联邦学习中把任务优化留在参数空间，另用轻量代理模型在客户端生成每类 top-k 归因产物，由服务器稳健聚合成全局解释先验以软对齐各客户端解释，在图像、文本、表格基准上保持 FedAvg 精度的同时降低解释漂移并提升删除/插入 AUC。

**相关性简评：** 其「归因产物 + 删除/插入 AUC」可作为核查视觉证据筛选是否真正被使用的忠实性评价线索，全局先验软对齐归因的做法也可能为跨步骤的贡献分配一致性提供参考；但属联邦 XAI 场景，与 VLM latent 推理状态的距离需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Explainable Federated Learning via Global-Local Attribution Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Federated learning enables on-device training without centralizing data, yet existing systems still struggle to provide explanations that are both locally faithful and globally consistent under strict privacy and bandwidth constraints. Prior approaches either keep explanations siloed across clients, transmit heavy or sensitive artifacts, or replace expressive task models with interpretable surrogates that sacrifice accuracy. We propose xFedAlign, a model-agnostic framework that decouples task optimization in parameter space from explanation coordination in a compact group space. Each client distills a lightweight surrogate to produce private, per-class top-k attribution artifacts, which are robustly aggregated by the server into a Global Explanation Prior that softly aligns client explanations without constraining task learning. Across image, text, and tabular benchmarks with IID and non-IID partitions, xFedAlign matches FedAvg accuracy while consistently reducing explanation drift and improving deletion and insertion AUC relative to Local-XAI, FedAttr-Agg, and Fed-XAI, with only a few kilobytes of additional communication per round. Privacy and robustness evaluations further demonstrate reduced membership inference advantage and increased resistance to attribution poisoning, enabling consistent and trustworthy explanations in federated learning.

**内容简述：** 该工作构建面向汽车尾门闭合件的生成式参数化设计优化框架：将CATIA模型重构为13维参数模板，用高斯过程代理模型预测质量、位移与应力，并以diffusion与flow matching生成候选设计，在匹配评估预算下与NSGA-II比较并经原生CAE验证。

**title/T1：** Generative AI-Driven Parametric Design Optimization Framework for Vehicle Closure Systems

**abstract/A1：** This study presents a generative AI-driven parametric design optimization framework integrating performance-oriented generation with editable computer-aided design (CAD) and downstream computer-aided engineering (CAE) analysis for industrial vehicle closure systems. The framework is demonstrated on an automotive tailgate assembly with complex geometry, coupled components, and competing performance and feasibility requirements. A production-oriented CATIA model is restructured into a reference-based parametric template with a 13-dimensional design representation. An automated CAD/CAE workflow generates parametric models, performs structural analysis, and constructs a database of mass, maximum displacement, and maximum von Mises stress. Gaussian process regression surrogates predict performance, while diffusion and flow matching models generate design candidates. The design problem minimizes mass and maximum displacement, with stress assessed as an engineering feasibility constraint. Performance-guided generation using surrogate guidance and performance-aware training using a performance-aware loss incorporate engineering objectives, with sensitivity to guidance scale and loss weight evaluated. Generative search is compared with NSGA-II under matched evaluation budgets using a common surrogate model. Selected Pareto-region candidates are reconstructed in CATIA and re-evaluated through native CAE; all verified candidates are successfully regenerated and analyzed. Relative to the baseline, the knee-point design reduces mass by 7.1% and maximum displacement by 29.4%, while extreme verified solutions achieve maximum reductions of 10.3% and 37.3%, respectively. The results demonstrate performance-oriented multi-objective design exploration compatible with editable industrial CAD and native engineering verification.

### 420. [AdaModalX: Synchronization-Free MFM Inference for Distributed Multimodal Mobile Sensing via Progressive Data Orchestration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20464v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20464

**作者：** Xiangrui Xu、Sicong Liu、Zhiwen Yu、Zimu Zhou、Bin Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20464v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20464v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向分布式移动多模态感知中数据流异步到达的问题，提出 AdaModalX：用轻量探针在设备端筛选可靠样本提前退出，边缘端按信息效用决定是否激活多模态基础模型，并可结合不完整输入的补全特征完成推理。

**相关性简评：** 其「按可用信息效用而非完整性决定继续等待还是停止」的编排逻辑，可能与 LVR 中的证据充分性判断、动态计算与 STOP 决策形成概念类比，可供核查；但该文关注推理流水线时延，不涉及内部 latent 状态，联系属间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AdaModalX: Synchronization-Free MFM Inference for Distributed Multimodal Mobile Sensing via Progressive Data Orchestration

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal foundation models (MFMs) support generalizable inference in distributed mobile sensing applications by integrating heterogeneous data streams. However, existing MFM inference pipelines typically require complete and synchronized multimodal inputs, whereas mobile sensing streams arrive asynchronously due to network variability and heterogeneous data volumes across modalities. Waiting for all modalities increases end-to-end latency, while inference with incomplete inputs can reduce accuracy. We argue that multimodal inference should depend on the utility of available information rather than modality completeness. Based on this principle, we propose AdaModalX, a progressive multimodal inference framework that decouples inference execution from modality synchronization through runtime utility-aware orchestration. At each device, importance-aware data uploading uses a lightweight probe distilled from the edge-side MFM to allow reliable samples to exit locally while uncertain samples continue uploading. At the edge, on-demand MFM activation constructs candidates from fully received samples and, when needed, imputed features derived from partially received delayed inputs. A lightweight contribution assessor built on frozen MFM encoders estimates candidate utility and activates the MFM once the candidate meets its corresponding utility threshold. Experiments on four mobile sensing applications show that AdaModalX improves the accuracy-latency trade-off, achieving up to 26.97% accuracy improvement and up to 64.75% end-to-end latency reduction.

</details>

### 421. [Agent-Guided Configuration Tuning for SMT Solvers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20484v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20484

**作者：** Cong Wang、Qiaoyi Zheng、Zhaoguo Wang、Fan Long

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20484v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20484v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 用通用 LLM agent 阅读 SMT 求解器文档、源码与持久化实验记录，提出配置改动，并由确定性框架逐一测量、校验模型、按 Division 分别选优；九周内向 cvc5 提交 4,545 条提案，在 SMT-COMP ModelValidation 基准上超过官方配置。

**相关性简评：** 该工作与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，但其「基于历史测量形成假设、持续累积证据并据测度反馈决定下一步搜索」的 agent 闭环，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、假设驱动的推理控制与停止决策提供概念参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent-Guided Configuration Tuning for SMT Solvers

**abstract/A1：** SMT solvers expose many configuration choices that determine how well their existing algorithms perform on a workload. We present, to our knowledge, the first workflow that uses general-purpose LLM agents to tune SMT solver configurations. Agents read solver documentation, source code, and persistent experiment records to propose option changes, and a deterministic harness measures each proposal, validates the returned models, and selects changes separately for each competition Division. Over roughly nine weeks, our tuning campaign recorded 4,545 proposals for cvc5 across 13 Divisions and 36 logics. We evaluate the tuned configurations on the 2026 and 2025 SMT-COMP ModelValidation benchmarks under a 24-second cutoff. On problems not used for training, they validate more problems than official cvc5 in ten of the 13 Divisions in 2026 and in eight in 2025, with geometric-mean gains of 7.8% and 6.8% across Divisions. On the complete official selections, which include training problems, the tuned floating-point counts exceed those of every individual competition participant in both years. Further studies show how configuration changes make existing algorithms effective by changing access to strategies, scheduling, and option compatibility, and how benchmark families trade off against one another. The agents' experiment traces contain hypothesis-based proposals in every tuning group, and 64.3% of the extracted hypotheses draw on prior measurements. These results show that agent-guided tuning can specialize a mature SMT solver and that accumulated experimental evidence informs sustained search.

### 422. [What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20518v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20518

**作者：** Hualie Jiang、Yujie Luo、Ziyang Song、Ximeng Li、Zhiqiang Lou、Rui Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20518v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20518v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以逐图像结果为单位的单目度量深度评测：统计失败率，把结构与尺度误差分开报告，并区分跨模型的共同失败与模型特定失败；在 7 个日常场景基准、11 个架构（18 组设置）上发现剩余困难主要在尺度。

**相关性简评：** 「结构完好但尺度错误」的分解与跨模型共同失败的分层统计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留几何与尺度信息、以及共享失败诊断提供评价思路；但该工作属感知精度评测，与推理期状态生成无直接联系，可供核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale

**abstract/A1：** Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets. Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $δ\_1$ &lt; 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

**comment/C1：** https://antigravity-tech.github.io/DIMED/

### 423. [LINK: Lightweight and Inductive Node-to-Node Propagation Rule Learning for Traffic Kriging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20521v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20521

**作者：** You Shang、Yu-Kwan Ching、Weifeng Su、Guanyao Li、Ruiyuan Li、Gary Shueng-Han Chan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20521v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20521v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LINK，用显式学习的共享节点间传播规则替代 GNN 邻域聚合来重建未观测路段的交通时序，包含谱域与时域上的上下文感知传播网络，并构建配套基准 TraffiKrig。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享转移规则 + 显式状态传播」的轻量设计可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代更新与计算成本权衡提供线索，但任务域与多模态推理相距较远，迁移价值需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LINK: Lightweight and Inductive Node-to-Node Propagation Rule Learning for Traffic Kriging

**abstract/A1：** Spatio-temporal traffic kriging aims to reconstruct traffic time series at unobserved locations with no historical traffic observations by leveraging spatial and temporal dependencies across the road network. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based approaches primarily rely on neighborhood aggregation to capture spatial dependencies, thereby modeling traffic interactions implicitly and making it difficult to accurately recover traffic magnitudes at locations without historical observations. To address this limitation, we propose LINK, a Lightweight and Inductive Node-to-node propagation rule learning paradigm for traffic Kriging. LINK introduces three key designs: 1) a propagation-centric traffic kriging paradigm that explicitly learns a shared node-to-node transition rule; 2) a context-aware Spectral Propagation Network that performs traffic-state propagation in both the spectral and time domains; and 3) TraffiKrig, a realistic traffic kriging benchmark that preserves heterogeneous road-segment characteristics and road-specific metadata while enabling systematic comparison of representative kriging methods under a unified metadata-enhanced setting. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LINK achieves strong reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency. Compared with the strongest baseline on each subset, LINK achieves an average MAE reduction of 54.7% over original baselines. LINK also achieves substantial efficiency improvements, reducing training time by 66.5% and inference time by 86.6% compared with the fastest competing methods. Zero-shot experiments further demonstrate the transferability of the learned propagation rule across regions.

</details>

### 424. [SmoothShift: Disrupting Visual Adversarial Attacks on LVLMs at Test Time](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20537v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20537

**作者：** Xiaoqing Chen、Jiayi Ouyang、Dongrui Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20537v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20537v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析视觉对抗扰动在 LVLM 中的优化与传播，发现细微扰动引起的表示差异会经视觉编码器逐层放大并持续到语言模型，且扰动的有效性还依赖其与 patch 网格计算的耦合；据此提出免训练的 SmoothShift 防御，用局部平滑与空间变换削弱细粒度扰动模式。

**相关性简评：** 其对「表示差异逐层放大」与「输入模式—计算对齐」的诊断，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否被内部状态忠实保留、以及位置/结构敏感性提供问题表述，但该文面向分类鲁棒性而非推理，联系仍是概念性的。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SmoothShift: Disrupting Visual Adversarial Attacks on LVLMs at Test Time

**abstract/A1：** Visual adversarial perturbations can substantially impair large vision-language models (LVLMs) despite introducing only subtle input changes. To understand how these small changes cause substantial errors, we investigate their optimization and propagation through the model, revealing two key findings. First, stronger attacks rely on finer iterative optimization, while subtle input perturbations induce representation discrepancies that are amplified layer by layer through the vision encoder and persist in the language model. Second, disrupting the alignment between within-patch input patterns and the model's computation reduces clean-adversarial representation discrepancies and substantially weakens attacks. Together, these findings suggest that adversarial effectiveness depends on both fine-grained perturbation patterns and their coupling with the model's computation. Motivated by these findings, we propose SmoothShift, a lightweight, training-free defense that combines local smoothing and spatial transformations. Smoothing weakens fine-grained perturbation patterns, while spatial transformations disrupt their alignment with the encoder's patch grid. SmoothShift requires no model updates, auxiliary networks, or additional model inference. Experiments cover three LVLM families on four datasets and robustly fine-tuned Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models on eight classification datasets. Evaluations across eight attack methods and multiple perturbation budgets demonstrate improved robustness while largely preserving clean performance. SmoothShift also provides robustness gains under defense-aware attacks using mixed-gradient BPDA with EOT.

</details>
