### 425. [PerturbJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Cellular Perturbation Responses](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20575

**作者：** Jiangshuan Pang、Youzhe He、Yiting Deng、Wangyang Tang、Huinan Xu、Qi Lu、Shiping Liu、Zhenkun Zhuang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20575v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何从细胞响应中识别药物与剂量，提出 PerturbJEPA：以处理组与对照组的平均表达差作为效应向量，对齐潜空间中两组质心的位移，并加正则保持不同群体对之间的效应差异，避免作者所称的「interventional contrast collapse」。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜空间匹配成功却抹去干预差异」的失败刻画，与 LVR 中 latent 看似对齐答案却未保留视觉证据的担忧有概念对应，质心位移对齐与效应向量方差正则可供核查是否能约束 latent 中的任务相关差异；但领域为单细胞转录组，迁移性尚未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PerturbJEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning of Cellular Perturbation Responses

**abstract/A1：** Identifying the drug and dose that produced a cellular response requires preserving treatment effects within each cellular background. A joint-embedding predictor can match its targets while ignoring the intervention if its encoder preserves differences across backgrounds but erases differences between treated and control populations within each one. We call this failure interventional contrast collapse. PerturbJEPA encodes the difference in mean gene expression between treated and control populations as an effect vector. It aligns the displacement between their latent centroids with this vector and regularizes the vectors to preserve variation across population pairs. We show that the measured displacements cannot all coincide within a batch when effect-vector variation exceeds the root-mean-square alignment error. Trained with separate drug and dose ranking objectives, the model predicts candidate responses from a common control population and matches them to the observed response without cell pairing or expression reconstruction. We evaluate 3,592 Tahoe-100M queries on held-out combinations of known interventions and cellular backgrounds, each with over 700 drug-dose candidates in a fixed, background-specific catalog. PerturbJEPA achieves 91.46% macro joint drug-dose Recall@1, exceeding STATE by 3.40 percentage points (95% drug-cluster bootstrap interval of 1.72 to 5.07 points). Controlled diagnostics show that treatment-control differences can shrink even when representations remain globally dispersed. With the drug ranking objective fixed, adding effect-vector regularization to alignment raises joint Recall@1 from 18.57% to 87.47%.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 6 figures, 14 tables. Code: https://github.com/BGI-Hangzhou-OmicsAI/PerturbJEPA

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BiGSyn: A Bi-Level Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning Framework for Interpretable Drug Synergy Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Drug combination therapy has become a mainstream of modern medicine, with the potential to enhance efficacy, reduce toxicity, and overcome drug resistance. However, identifying synergistic drug combinations remains challenging, as it requires modeling complex interactions across multiple biological scales---from atom-level molecular structures to entity-level relations in biological networks. Existing approaches typically model these levels in isolation, overlooking complementary signals and long-range dependencies. To address these limitations, we propose BiGSyn, a Bi-level heterogeneous Graph contrastive learning framework for drug Synergy prediction. Specifically, BiGSyn leverages heterogeneous graph transformers to extract high-order dependencies from molecular graphs and biological networks, and introduces a bi-level contrastive learning objective to bridge the cross-level semantic gap. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets show that BiGSyn consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Moreover, its attention mechanism highlights key molecular substructures and biological interactions driving synergy, providing interpretable insights.

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 ASCG，用概率监测在检测到有害内容时才触发引导，并借助 Grad-CAM 做局部概念抑制，同时引入 VLM 评估框架以同时衡量安全性与语义保真度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ASCG: Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance for Surgical Concept Suppression in Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** While text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models achieve remarkable quality, they risk producing harmful content. Existing safety mechanisms often rely on indiscriminate, global interventions that induce unintended semantic drift and degrade image quality. To address this, we propose Adaptive Spatial Classifier Guidance (ASCG), a necessity-driven framework that employs probabilistic monitoring to activate guidance selectively upon harm detection. By leveraging Grad-CAM for localized suppression, ASCG effectively removes harmful concepts while preserving superior semantic fidelity compared to conventional methods. Furthermore, we overcome the limitations of traditional metrics like NudeNet---which fails to assess semantic integrity---by introducing a VLM-based evaluation framework to provide a fine-grained, robust analysis of both safety and context preservation. Our results demonstrate that ASCG not only balances safety and fidelity but also exhibits remarkable plug-and-play synergy with existing frameworks to establish state-of-the-art performance.

**内容简述：** 提出面向听障用户的移动听觉辅助智能体，以神经符号设计把连续声学与物理上下文转成结构化中间表示，实现按需触发的感知、分阶段场景推理与有界个性化引导。

**相关性简评：** 其阈值触发感知与结构化中间状态可能为 LVR 中「何时计算、选取哪些证据」及状态抽象提供类比线索，但该工作面向音频辅助且不涉及视觉 latent，迁移价值需核查。

**title/T1：** UbiHearo: Bringing Scenario-Aware Sound Guidance to DHH Users with Mobile Agents

**abstract/A1：** For Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) users, effective sound awareness goes beyond detecting \\emph{what} sound occurs; it requires understanding \\emph{what it means}, \\emph{how urgent it is}, and \\emph{what to do}. However, existing mobile assistants largely reduce acoustic scenes to isolated labels or generic alerts, failing to provide contextual guidance when the same sound implies different risks across scenarios. We present \\sysname, a mobile hearing assistant agent that closes the sensing--reasoning--action loop for \\textit{scenario-aware} and \\textit{personalized} DHH assistance. \\sysname adopts a \\textit{neuro-symbolic} design that transforms continuous acoustic and physical context streams into structured intermediate representations (IRs) for controllable reasoning and guidance. It introduces three key mechanisms. \\textit{First}, a perception-thresholded sensing mechanism enables energy-efficient always-on awareness by activating processing only for perceptually meaningful events while preserving safety-critical cues through deterministic overrides. \\textit{Second}, a staged neuro-symbolic reasoning framework performs promptless scenario understanding by conditioning an on-device audio-language model on structured IRs instead of user-authored context descriptions. \\textit{Third}, a bounded human-in-the-loop personalization mechanism adapts user-specific guidance through lightweight on-device decision-boundary updates while preserving population-aligned reasoning. We evaluate \\sysname on smartphones and in-vehicle systems across diverse scenarios. It achieves favorable accuracy--latency--energy tradeoffs and personalized guidance.

</details>

### 429. [VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20688v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20688

**作者：** Wenhan Yu、Zhaoxi Zhang、Zhilong Tan、Weikang Li、Lei Sha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20688v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20688v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** VIVID 提出一个无需训练的视觉工具框架，使现成编码智能体可按需检查视频画面、音频与转录，并把观察结果连同媒体版本和时间坐标一并保存，供其在推理中检索、调取并检查渲染输出后迭代修改，在 AgenticVBench 上显著提升 Codex 等多个基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「发现观察—结构化保存—按需取用—检查输出再修订」的外部证据循环，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、LOOK 阶段成本与停止决策提供参照，但对象是视频编辑任务而非 latent 推理状态，联系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VIVID: A Visual Harness for Agentic Video Editing

**abstract/A1：** Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. We introduce VIVID, a visual harness that supports multiple native coding agents in video post-production without additional model training. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID's potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

</details>

### 430. [Conic Structure of the Cross-Entropy Loss at the Final Layer and Its Absence in Rectifier Backbones](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20696v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20696

**作者：** Omer Nezih Gerek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SP

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20696v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20696v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文分析分类器 softmax 交叉熵的损失几何：在仿射末层权重上损失等于多面体锥加单调递减偏移，并给出「core radius」的闭式表达；在 ReLU 主干参数上，沿线的 kink 对应样本激活模式切换，作者用半代数集维数理论论证一般情形下折痕不形成，并在 ResNet 上用 CIFAR-10 做示意测量。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其关于损失沿方向的分段锥结构、kink 与 surprisal 关系及折痕可检测性的分析，可能为考察 latent 推理状态的表示几何、置信度与停止信号提供分析工具，具体可用性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conic Structure of the Cross-Entropy Loss at the Final Layer and Its Absence in Rectifier Backbones

**abstract/A1：** Slices of the loss along lines and planes in parameter space are widely used to visualize deep networks. They often show a single basin with nearly straight walls, which raises the question of whether such a loss is a cone rounded at its apex, or a lower envelope of several cones that meet along creases. We answer this question for softmax cross-entropy at two levels of a classifier. Over the weights of an affine final layer, the loss equals a polyhedral cone plus an offset that decreases monotonically and exponentially along every ray, towards a limit in closed form. The distance at which the asymptotic wall reaches the height of the starting point, which we call the core radius, equals the mean surprisal of the classes that the direction favours, divided by the slope of the wall. Over the parameters of a rectifier backbone, the loss along a line has a kink wherever the activation pattern of a sample changes. Using the dimension theory of semialgebraic sets, we show that, along almost every line, the samples that switch at one point share an irreducible factor of their pre-activation polynomials. Under a coprimality condition, each kink therefore carries the share of one sample among $n$, so creases comparable to the slope do not form. Measurements on ResNet-18 and ResNet-56 trained on CIFAR-10 illustrate both results, with a test that bounds the size of any crease that sampled loss values can hide.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 2 figures, to be submitted

</details>

### 431. [AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20711v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20711

**作者：** Sachin Gupta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20711v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20711v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 AgentFaultBench：在隔离 GitLab 环境中向 LangGraph/CrewAI agent 注入工具错误，并用文件、issue 及必需的读取与验证步骤做状态校验，以对照实验检验「恢复建议」是否真的提升任务成功率。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式对照条件 + 中间状态校验」的评估协议可能可供核查 LVR 中类似 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的提示增益是否真实，以及如何验证中间读取和停止动作被实际使用；但研究对象是 agent 工具故障恢复而非视觉推理，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AgentFaultBench: State-Verified Evaluation of Tool-Fault Recovery

**abstract/A1：** Does recovery advice help an agent finish a task after a tool fails? AgentFaultBench evaluates LangGraph and CrewAI agents performing specified tasks in an isolated GitLab installation. We inject tool errors and check both the resulting files and issues and the required reads, verification and final response. The prompt supplies the expected issue and report text, so the task tests execution rather than content generation. In the primary comparison of 1,944 planned runs, advice changes success by -8.33, 0.00 and +1.06 percentage points relative to a neutral reminder; missing outcomes leave the latter two comparisons inconclusive. Later experiments test a revised recovery policy. GPT-4o mini improves, while Sol and Claude already complete the recoverable cases. In a separate 624-run study on six related tasks not previously used by that policy, the guided condition records 161 correct final states and one unknown outcome in 192 planned runs, versus 142/192 with neutral feedback. The gain lies between +9.90 and +10.42 pp when missing outcomes are included. Removing issue IDs gives 47/48 successes versus 46/48 with IDs; other execution information remains. A second checker agrees on 1,879 observed primary outcomes and 241 constructed test cases. No human validation was collected. The findings support testing advice against explicit recovery controls rather than assuming it helps.

**comment/C1：** 63 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. Submitted to the NAACL 2027 Industry Track

</details>

### 432. [Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20732v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20732

**作者：** Ahmed Tariq、Leo Guinan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20732v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20732v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 LAB-Bench 生物题上检验推理预算内的模型路由：比较类别路由与加入六个结构特征的路由，并测试语义路由、读取首个答案后可推迟（defer）的策略与非答案升级规则对准确率和每千次查询成本的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「读完首个回答再决定是否追加更强模型」的 deferral 策略，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的继续计算与停止决策、计算价值判断相关，可供核查；但属纯文本路由研究，收益仅为约 1 个百分点的边际提升，向多模态 latent 推理的迁移需较多推断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study

**abstract/A1：** We tested whether features of biology questions or of a model's first answer can improve accuracy within an inference budget. In a LAB-Bench pilot, we compared a category router with one that adds six structural features. Neither reached the primary 80% accuracy target on development. At the 50% and 60% secondary targets, both chose Haiku for all 120 held-out questions and scored 71/120. We then froze a new comparison before collecting responses on 144 additional questions. Semantic routing scored 86/144. A policy that could defer after reading Haiku's answer scored 87/144. Both stayed within the inference budget of USD 0.678 per 1,000 queries. Against a 95% Haiku and 5% GPT mixture, the accuracy gains were 0.66 percentage points for semantic routing and 1.35 points for deferral. The paired 95% intervals were \[-0.28,2.25\] and \[-0.14,3.47\] points. A simple rule that escalated Haiku nonanswers scored 92/144 at USD 0.710 per 1,000 queries, above the budget. A retrospective nonanswer rule with a calibration-selected escalation probability gave an expected 85.63/144. At the learned deferral policy's observed inference cost, post hoc interpolation gave an expected 86.14/144. In a later development check, Astra and Gemini each scored 30/40. The best tested policy in each router family matched that score. The pair covered 33/40 in hindsight. The routers missed the 32/40 criterion, so the proposed 120-question evaluation did not start.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 3 figures. Reproduction archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24220501

</details>

### 433. [EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20779v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20779

**作者：** Haozhe Zhu、Dan Yuan、Chenghao Gu、Feike Xu、Yue Wen、Shin'ichi Konomi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20779v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20779v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 EEGProbe 基准，用 620 道题、13 个子任务与三类能力（信号分类、跨模态对齐、神经生理推理）检验通用 VLM 能否在极少预处理下直接从通道级 EEG 中提取并推理信号，并在统一零样本协议下评测 11 个模型，最强模型总分仅 41.63%，跨模态对齐是主要瓶颈，另分析 EEG 时频空结构对成败的影响及推理期神经生理引导的作用。

**相关性简评：** EEG 属远离视觉推理的模态，但其「signal-necessity testing」加专家核验的题目构造，以及跨模态对齐瓶颈的失败诊断，可能可供核查 LVR 中模型是否真正依赖输入证据（视觉旁路）与证据筛选的评价设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 12 figures

</details>

### 434. [TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20792v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20792

**作者：** Biwen Yang、Zhe Cao、Jin Zhang、Haoyang Sun、Zonglu Hu、Jintao Zhao、Zhehao Zhang、Kaizheng Chen、Chengyi Liu、Chengyu Wei、Siyuan Wu、Ruiheng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20792v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20792v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TRR 热学机器人渲染器，给接触双方附加空间与深度分辨的热状态，模拟接触热交换、搬运与分离，同步生成 RGBT 观测、状态与动作，并构建 2,224 组静态—动态配对任务的基准。

**相关性简评：** 热历史在当前观测中不可见却决定后续接触结果，这种「隐状态须跨时刻整合」的设定可能为检验模型是否真正使用历史证据而非当前画面旁路提供仿真测试床，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation

**abstract/A1：** A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \\emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\\% to 91.7\\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.

</details>

### 435. [Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Price Response](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20811v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20811

**作者：** Kathik Iyer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20811v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20811v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为零售预测类「世界模型」的基线+增量式解释设置八项事前检查（构造、稳定性、价格方向、与销量和 LightGBM 的一致性等），并在已知真值的合成数据与 Dominick's 数据上检验这些检查通过是否意味着解释正确。

**相关性简评：** 虽与视觉推理无关，但其「检查全过仍不忠实、唯有实测因果效应才能暴露偏差」的审计框架可能供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正使用视觉证据、以及如何设计忠实性评价。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing World-Model Explanations in Retail Forecasting: Faithfulness, Accuracy and Price Response

**abstract/A1：** Forecasting models that read the price and promotion plan explain each forecast as a baseline, what would sell with nothing planned, plus the lift the plan adds. We test such explanations with eight checks, six with a pass rule fixed before any result, and find that passing them does not make an explanation right. In generated store data with known effects, a world model passes the checks of construction, stability, price direction and agreement with sales and with LightGBM, yet its lifts are 1.33 to 1.40 times the truth when merchants plan into high-demand weeks, and 1.23 to 1.42 times in eight variants of that world. It still picks the right weeks to promote, but stock ordered to its lift is off by 0.44 to 0.48 of the true lift. Its stated response to a lasting regular-price change is 4.7 to 6.5 times the true -0.5, and only a measured cause finds this. On Dominick's, 38 episodes in which a store's regular prices sat apart from its zone peers give a noisy benchmark: a pooled 8-week response of -0.33 (95% interval -0.68 to 0.01). For the final tuned world models of our companion paper on nine data sets, baseline and lift add up under each model's own plan, but a deeper price cut lowers the forecast in 29% to 83% of item-week steps on Dominick's (23% to 80% within prices seen in training), and the world model and LightGBM both state about twice the measured response. Across 703 configurations from the settings searches, checks passed were not related to forecast accuracy (Spearman 0.02, 95% interval -0.02 to 0.05); with no known answer for those versions, this concerns accuracy, while whether an explanation is right is measured only in the generated data.

</details>

### 436. [Tight PAC-Bayes Generalisation Guarantees for Large Language Model Judges](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20818v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20818

**作者：** Tom A. Lamb、Philip H. S. Torr、Tim G. J. Rudner

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20818v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20818v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为评估 LLM 智能体输出的安全判定器（LLM judge）建立 PAC-Bayes 泛化证书：改进基于压缩的界与编码效率，提出跨层共享量化尺度的 LoRA-GT，在五个 guardrail 模型、四个基准上得到非空泛甚至较紧的证书，并考察量化强度与风险上升之间的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 主体是安全分类器的可靠性认证，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系；但把「适配复杂度」而非基座规模与泛化风险挂钩的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 LoRA/视觉旁路等训练监督的泛化代价与容量取舍。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tight PAC-Bayes Generalisation Guarantees for Large Language Model Judges

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used to monitor the outputs of LLM-based AI agents, yet formal guarantees on the reliability of these judges remain largely absent, limiting confidence in their use for safety-critical oversight. We consider certifying such a judge and define its risk over safety classifications of prompt--response pairs drawn from a deployed generator. We apply a PAC-Bayes framework to this setting, refining existing compression-based methodology with the use of tighter bounds and more efficient coding. We show that standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning can yield non-vacuous and even tight certificates for safety judges, for both classification and Brier risk, without holding out data for validation. We introduce LoRA-GT, which shares a single quantisation scale across layers and achieves the tightest certificates with minimal degradation in predictive performance. Across five guardrail models and four benchmarks, we find that certificate tightness is governed more by adaptation complexity than by base model scale. Finally, we show how far quantisation can be pushed before the resulting increase in risk outweighs the bound tightening gained from shorter descriptions. Together, these results provide a practical route toward certifiable scalable oversight and offer insight into how the complexity of safety adaptations shapes generalisation.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 12 figures

</details>

### 437. [Hierarchical Regime-Conditioned Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Graphs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20835v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20835

**作者：** Jeremy Baffou、Pascal Frossard、Dorina Thanou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20835v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20835v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HERON，把潜状态分解为离散的系统级 regime 与连续的实体级动态，在无 regime 标注下自监督联合学习时空图预测与 regime 推断，并支持以推断模式条件化生成与受控模拟。

**相关性简评：** 其「离散模式变量调节潜状态演化、并可切换模式做受控模拟」的表述可能与 LVR 中分解推理状态、检验某种潜内容是否真正驱动更新相关，可供核查；但该文不涉及视觉语言推理，迁移价值需进一步判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hierarchical Regime-Conditioned Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Forecasting the behavior of spatio-temporal systems often requires more than accurate predictions: models should uncover the dynamical modes governing future evolution. Existing temporal graph and latent dynamical models achieve strong forecasting performance, but their latent representations often entangle multiple dynamical patterns, limiting interpretability. Conversely, regime-inference methods explicitly model such modes but typically do not support generative forecasting over graph-structured systems. We introduce HERON, a self-supervised regime-aware generative framework that unifies graph-structured trajectory generation with regime identification. HERON factorizes the latent state into discrete system-level regimes, capturing global dynamical modes, and continuous entity-level dynamics, yielding a modular regime interface compatible with existing spatio-temporal backbones. Crucially, the inferred regime actively conditions system dynamics, enabling regime tracking and controlled simulations under alternative dynamical modes. Without regime annotations, HERON jointly learns forecasts and regime dynamics in a self-supervised manner, recovering meaningful modes across controlled synthetic and real-world datasets while maintaining competitive forecasting performance. These results open a path toward interpretable, controllable generative modeling of spatio-temporal dynamics.

</details>

### 438. [Markov-Equivalent Conditional Independence Graphs on Path Spaces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20877v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20877

**作者：** Simon Kempf、Niki Kilbertus、Georg Manten

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20877v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20877v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 W-separation：一种对有向混合图定义的非对称图形判据，允许对过去与未来成分分别条件化，并证明它对一类含隐混杂的随机微分方程满足全局 Markov 性质，同时完整刻画 W-Markov 等价类及其唯一最大元。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐变量下时序过程的因果图判据与等价类」概念或可为形式化 latent 推理状态对答案的因果贡献、以及多步状态间的混杂结构提供参照，但属连续时间 SDE 理论，与 VLM 推理无可直接迁移线索，是否可用需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Markov-Equivalent Conditional Independence Graphs on Path Spaces

**abstract/A1：** Causal discovery for continuous-time stochastic processes with latent confounding typically faces a trade-off between (i) approaches that are highly informative about the causal structure but are difficult to test statistically, and (ii) approaches that admit practical tests from data but yield more coarse-grained conclusions, potentially not leveraging the direction of time. We introduce W-separation, an asymmetric graphical criterion for directed mixed graphs defined as a quaternary relation that allows distinct conditioning on past and future components. This added flexibility yields a highly informative graphical independence model while preserving testability. W-separation satisfies a global Markov property for a broad class of stochastic differential equations with latent confounding, linking it to conditional independence relations among coordinate processes that are testable from data. A central result of this work is the full characterization of W-Markov equivalence classes: we show that every equivalence class admits a unique greatest element that serves as a canonical representative and a principled target for learning algorithms. In addition, we provide necessary and sufficient conditions under which directed or bidirected edges can be added without altering the induced independence model.

</details>

### 439. [Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20879v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20879

**作者：** Jingkai Shang、Edgar Torres、Duy Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20879v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20879v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MRFM，用于点云上采样：冻结已学速度场，在推理期为每个局部 patch 自适应选择积分步数预算，通过可微软 rollout 与输入导出的几何保真目标在线优化连续预算，再投影回离散步数执行最终求解。

**相关性简评：** 其「按局部区域分配测试时计算量、以保真目标在线决定步数」的机制，可能为 LVR 中按视觉区域动态分配推理步数与停止决策提供可核查的借鉴；但任务本身是 3D 几何生成，与多模态推理状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-Rate Flow Matching for Point Cloud Upsampling

**abstract/A1：** Flow-matching point-cloud upsamplers refine sparse inputs into dense point clouds by integrating a learned velocity field with a fixed temporal discretization. However, local reconstruction requirements vary substantially across a shape, while a shared solver budget applies the same temporal resolution everywhere. We propose Multi-Rate Flow Matching (MRFM), a patch-adaptive framework that selects an integration budget for each local patch at inference time while keeping the learned velocity field frozen. MRFM relaxes the discrete budget into a continuous variable, optimizes it online through differentiable soft rollouts using an input-derived geometric fidelity objective, and projects the result back to a discrete budget for the final solver rollout. Experiments on PU1K and PUGAN show strong reconstruction quality, while matched-budget permutation and multi-factor analyses demonstrate that the benefit depends on patch-specific allocation rather than on the step distribution alone. MRFM is accuracy-oriented and intentionally uses additional test-time optimization to obtain more suitable local temporal resolutions.

</details>

### 440. [SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20899v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20899

**作者：** Xue Yang、Haonan Cai、Xinyu Hang、Zhimeng Huang、Xuanyi Liu、Chuanmin Jia、Siwei Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20899v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20899v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SciWorldBench，用成对的科学实验（仅改动单一条件、预期结果互斥）评测 10 个文本/图像到视频模型，并由独立 VLM 在不知条件与标签的情况下判定两段视频是否各自呈现正确结果，发现模型常对需不同结果的条件给出相同结局。

**相关性简评：** 其「单条件对照＋盲评」的配对设计可能可供核查，用于检验 LVR 的 latent 状态是否真正携带任务关键条件而非依赖视觉先验，从而判断答案对视觉证据的因果使用；但研究对象是视频世界模型生成，与 VLM 推理期内部表示距离较远，迁移需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SciWorldBench: Do Video World Models Really Understand Scientific Experiments?

**abstract/A1：** While the ability of video generation models to accurately depict scientific phenomena has received growing attention, determining whether these models genuinely understand the underlying principles remains a critical challenge. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate video samples in isolation, making it difficult to expose models that simply fit superficial visual priors. In scientific experiments, a small change in one condition produces a markedly different outcome even when the rest of the setup remains fixed. Capitalizing on this sensitivity, we introduce SciWorldBench, a benchmark comprising paired scientific experiments. Each pair varies a single condition in an otherwise fixed setup, yielding two mutually exclusive expected outcomes. Each generation prompt specifies the condition but omits the expected outcome. We evaluate ten text-and-image-to-video (TI2V) models using an independent vision-language model (VLM) that assesses each video without access to the condition text or the label identifying the correct outcome. A pair is scored as correct only when both videos depict their respective scientifically correct outcomes. Across all ten models, we find that the two videos in an experimental pair frequently depict the same outcome even though the conditions require different results. This recurring failure suggests that current video world models struggle to apply the underlying scientific principles reliably during generation. We will publicly release the benchmark dataset and open-source the evaluation code.

**comment/C1：** Preprint. Benchmark paper with paired scientific experiments for evaluating video world models. 8 pages of main text, 16 pages including figures and references

</details>

### 441. [Can Image Generators Hold a Scene Together When Space Is Broken Apart?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20906v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20906

**作者：** Jhen-Ke Lin、Chung-Chun Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20906v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20906v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GJBench，要求图像生成器把场景画成分散且旋转的拼图块，并分别评测块数、咬合与重建参考场景三项要求，发现现有开放与闭源模型均难以在割裂空间中保持场景整体性。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部相邻」与「同属一个整体」的解耦思路，可能可供核查 VLM 内部视觉表示是否真正保留全局空间结构而非仅局部连续性；但对象是图像生成器而非 LVR 推理状态，故仅为概念启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Image Generators Hold a Scene Together When Space Is Broken Apart?

**abstract/A1：** Image generators are good at drawing scenes in which things that belong together appear next to each other. In almost every image they generate, and in almost every benchmark used to evaluate these images, "belonging to the same whole" and "adjacent to each other" go together. Therefore, we cannot know whether the model truly grasps the scene as a whole, or simply makes each part connect with its adjacent parts. We propose GJBench to disentangle the two. It requires the model to draw a scene as a scattered jigsaw puzzle: an image is cut into interlocking pieces, then moved apart and rotated. Thus, the spatial plausibility of the scene exists only in how these pieces collectively point to a whole. The model may have a reference image, a target layout, both, or neither. We separately evaluate three requirements: whether the scene is broken down into a specified number of separate pieces, whether the pieces interlock, and whether the pieces can reconstruct the reference scene. While every open and closed model we evaluated could draw these scenes well as a whole, none could keep them together as scattered puzzle pieces, and the three requirements categorized failures into different patterns. The models draw separate pieces but miscount them in different ways, and unless their outlines are provided, the pieces rarely interlock, and their content does not reconstruct the reference image. We also found that the target layout helps the puzzle pieces fit together, while the reference image improves neither their count nor their fit. These findings show that keeping a scene continuous across space that the canvas no longer shows remains an open problem for image generators.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20915

**作者：** Yuanyan Song、Kezhi Wang、Xinmian Xu、Yongmin Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20915v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20915v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出边缘端 supervisor-worker 多 LLM 智能体架构，将用户请求拆成子任务并按并行或串行工作流分派，配合两级重试，并用交替优化联合进行智能体选择与资源分配以最小化能耗，仿真显示能耗下降、任务成功率提升。

**相关性简评：** 其并行/串行工作流调度、重试机制与延迟-能耗约束的联合优化，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算预算分配与调用成本权衡提供建模参照，但本身不涉及视觉推理或 latent 状态，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-LLM Agentic AI at the Edge: Joint Agent Scheduling and Resource Allocation

**abstract/A1：** In this paper, an edge-enabled multi-large language model (LLM) agentic AI architecture is proposed, where one supervisor AI agent and multiple worker AI agents cooperatively execute users' requests at the edge. The supervisor AI agent decouples the user request into a series of sub-tasks and dynamically dispatches them to LLM-equipped worker AI agents via two agentic workflows, i.e., parallel and serial workflows, with a two-level retry mechanism to enhance execution reliability. To prolong the service duration of worker AI agents, the energy minimization problems are formulated by jointly considering AI agent selection and resource allocation, subject to task execution latency and quality of service (QoS) constraints. A resource allocation scheme based on alternating optimization (AO) is proposed. Specifically, for the parallel workflow, the scheme decouples the original problem into bandwidth allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems, which are iteratively solved by the proposed successive convex approximation (SCA), Lagrangian relaxation (LR), and Gale-Shapley (GS) or LLM-based algorithms, respectively. For the serial workflow, the problem is similarly decoupled into service time allocation, retrieval selection and AI agent selection sub-problems; the optimal service time allocation is obtained via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, while the latter two sub-problems are addressed by extending the proposed algorithms to the serial scenario. Simulation results show that the proposed resource allocation scheme can reduce system energy consumption compared with other benchmarks, while experiments on a multi-LLM agentic AI system based on Qwen and Llama demonstrate improved task execution success rates.

</details>

Across 73 multimodal large language models released between May 2024 and November 2026, the top score rose from 28.83% to 98.33% in 30 months, mostly before the reference answers were published. The leading models now answer almost every textbook question correctly; the hardest questions show a circuit that resembles a textbook one but works differently, or ask about behavior the obvious analysis misses. <details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Fix, Different Weights: Replicating Weight-Space Programming with Claude

**abstract/A1：** Takehi et al. (2026) report that GPT-6 Astra, given the weights of small neural networks as text, can say what they were trained to do, repair them, and write new ones without training. I re-ran the core of that study with Claude Opus 5.5 in ten pre-registered experiments, with untrained-network and permutation controls and hand audits of every sandboxed code cell. Reading was mixed: Claude named 3 of 4 Atari games from policy weights and found the measured copying heads in 15/15 character-LM runs, but its answers about training data often followed priors. Unlike the original, it identified a sycophantic Gemma 3 270M finetune from weights alone in 6/6 runs. One-shot weight edits took a failing MountainCar policy from 0% to 100% success and a hovering LunarLander policy from 0% to 85.6%; zero-shot networks beat PPO at 100k steps on 4 of 5 environments, each implementing a textbook controller. With no training or forward passes, Claude wrote a 1.48M-parameter 9x9 Go network that won 85-94% of games against three PPO opponents. Given Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights and 10, 25 or 50 forward passes of 64 practice problems, Claude raised MATH-500 from 6.7% to 51.4%, 55.2% and 58.1% (+51.4 points at 50 passes, 95% CI \[47.9, 55.0\]; original 48.1%), GSM8K from 11.6% to 68.2% and IFEval from 22.2% to 54.2%. Unlike the original, which removed an internal loop direction, every edit acted at the output: it scaled the final norm, raising the effective sampling temperature, and lowered the logit of "Wait" while raising that of &lt;/think&gt;. The norm scaling alone reaches only 20.9-22.1% on MATH-500. On Gemma 3 270M, which rarely loops, no edit helped (-0.8 points), as in the original.

</details>

**title/T1：** Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard classifiers share this blind spot, and even frontier LLM judges catch at most one of 10 human-labeled confident misses. Without a trained reward model, the probability reward with a helpfulness term lowers HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B from 0.287 to at most 0.033 at the final checkpoint.

**内容简述：** 论文在部分可观测决策中刻画「决策歧义」与零遗憾条件，并在两动作、平方终端代价的平面设定下导出由三个条件矩对比构成的三维 Hilbert 状态，论证其保持观测最优动作且维数最小，再用仿真与真实 SAR 实验检验有限数据带来的额外遗憾。

**相关性简评：** 其「哪些信息足以保持最优决策」的最小充分状态与目标投影误差分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 应保留何种任务必要信息、目标条件如何影响状态充分性提供概念参照；但设定属 POMDP 理论与 SAR 决策，与 VLM 推理距离较远，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hilbert States for Decision-Making under Partial Observability

**abstract/A1：** Decision-making under partial observability can be fundamentally limited by information, even with known dynamics: distinct physical states can induce the same observation history while favoring different actions. We study three questions: when is full-state optimality unattainable, what information exactly preserves the best observation-based decision, and how does finite-data learning affect reliability? First, we characterize decision ambiguity through conditional action preferences. We give a zero-regret criterion, a positive lower bound for conflicting uniquely optimal actions on positive-probability regions with uniformly positive cost gaps, and an exact binary-action regret formula. This also shows why physical-state ambiguity alone need not cause decision loss. Second, for two actions and squared terminal-goal costs in the plane, we derive an exact inner-product representation of conditional expected cost differences using three conditional moment contrasts and a goal-dependent feature. This Hilbert state preserves observation-optimal actions without hidden-state reconstruction. Under nondegenerate history and goal variation, its three-dimensional form is minimal among exact bilinear cost-contrast representations. Third, we relate finite-data state errors to excess decision regret via goal-projected errors, action margins, and goal geometry. Physics-based simulations verify information-limited regret, exact action preservation, and the role of second moments. Held-out real-SAR experiments demonstrate feasible goal-conditioned decisions from masked images, while finite-data evaluations reveal goal-dependent reliability. Together, these results separate irreducible information loss, exact representation sufficiency, and learning-induced excess regret.

</details>

### 447. [Explaining Cross-Label Decision Structure in Multi-Output Tree Ensembles](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20996v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.20996

**作者：** Sylvio Barbon Junior、Hiago F. F. Oliveira、Rafael Figueira Gonçalves、Jessica Fernandes Lopes、Ricardo Cerri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.20996v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.20996v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出多汇点决策谓词图 ms-DPG 与 Shared Predicate Flow（SPF），度量多输出树集成中一对标签共享决策条件的比例，并在九个多标签基准上比较原生多输出森林与 Binary Relevance 的结构共享程度。

**相关性简评：** 其负结果「高 SPF 可能只反映架构强制共享而非共享预测信息」与 LVR 中如何区分 latent 表示的结构复用和实际内容共享、避免混淆相似度指标高度同源，可供核查借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Explaining Cross-Label Decision Structure in Multi-Output Tree Ensembles

**abstract/A1：** A multi-output tree ensemble predicts several binary labels through decision paths that it largely shares across those labels, yet the attribution methods commonly used to explain such models treat each output in isolation. We propose multi-sink Decision Predicate Graphs (ms-DPGs), which extend decision predicate graphs with one sink per label: each leaf contributes to the sink of every label its in-bag positive count for that label. On this representation we define Shared Predicate Flow (SPF), the share of a label's decision mass that passes through conditions active for both labels of a pair, and a contracted view of the graph in which label-specific lifts indicate whether a shared condition raises the probability of both labels or of one at the expense of the other. Controlled experiments show that SPF captures shared decision conditions rather than mere feature overlap. On nine multi-label benchmarks, native multi-output forests share substantially more decision structure than Binary Relevance on eight, including five of the six on which the two are at predictive parity, even at equal hyperparameters, whereas per-label TreeSHAP rankings register the change of architecture without showing whether more is shared. Because a native forest routes every label through the same splits, SPF describes the fitted model rather than the data, and on eight of the nine benchmarks it rises when the feature-label signal is removed; a high SPF is therefore not evidence of shared predictive information. ms-DPG offers a global, predicate-level account of how a multi-output ensemble reuses decision conditions across its labels.

**comment/C1：** 53 pages, 22 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 448. [A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21015v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21015

**作者：** Ye Chen、Lorenzo Nava、Maximillian Van Wyk de Vries、Fawu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.geo-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21015v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21015v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作训练物理约束神经网络，按固定时间间隔自回归仿真滑坡厚度与速度场演化，用质量守恒和动能损失构造损失函数，单步与 110 步 rollout 误差可控，且比全物理模型快 50 倍以上。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其多步自回归状态演进及守恒型一致性监督，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态长程更新的稳定性与长度泛化提供可核查的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling

**abstract/A1：** Numerical simulations of landslides are commonly used to forecast impact areas. Full physics-based models provide accurate predictions, but their computational expense can preclude their use for large parameter sweeps. To achieve efficient modelling for such cases, we developed a physics-constrained neural network to emulate full landslide runout in a time-discretised manner. This emulator is trained on over 200,000 samples, each consisting of a pair of landslide thicknesses and velocities on a given DEM with a fixed time interval. To constrain the model's physical consistency, we define physics-based loss functions based on mass conservation and the system's kinetic energy loss. The model demonstrates high fidelity across the test dataset, achieving root mean square errors of approximately 0.06 m for thickness and 0.11 m/s for velocity in single-step predictions. In autoregressive rollout, these errors evolved modestly to about 0.21 m and 0.09 m/s after 110 iterations, while greatly improving computational efficiency by more than 50 times.

</details>

### 449. [What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21065v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21065

**作者：** Cehao Yang、Ziyi He、Jing Yi、Jian Guo、Hui Xiong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21065v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21065v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LightAct 框架：把交互片段总结为经验条目并固化为游戏技能以引导探索，在每个决策根上用共享冻结策略的短 rollout 比较候选动作，将环境分数增益归一化为相对动作奖励，用于强化学习训练，并在 170 个 GameWorld 任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其用短 rollout 区分「即时增益相同」的动作并构造监督信号，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、贡献分配与停止决策提供可核查的线索；但论文本身研究游戏视觉策略而非 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Makes a Good Move? Learning to Act from Experience in Visual Worlds

**abstract/A1：** Learning visual policies requires turning interaction experience into guidance for individual decisions. Trajectory outcomes obscure action quality, while unguided exploration can revisit familiar situations. We present \\textsc{LightAct}, an experience-learning framework that connects skill-guided exploration with policy internalization. Interaction segments are summarized into experience entries and consolidated into a game-specific skill that guides root collection toward broader state coverage. At each root, candidate actions are compared through short rollouts under a shared frozen policy. Environment-reported score gains are averaged across continuations and normalized into relative action rewards, producing reusable supervision for reinforcement learning. Policy training uses a compact dataset of just 1,024 decision roots collected in a single source game and paired with their action rewards. Across 170 GameWorld tasks spanning 34 games, \\textsc{LightAct} improves overall progress by 23.6, 29.2, and 13.0 percentage points at the 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, respectively, with our strongest model competitive with reported proprietary-model results. Ablations show broader root-state coverage with skill guidance and consistent gains across three policy optimizers. Case studies show how rollouts distinguish actions with identical immediate gains.

</details>

### 450. [Inference Equivalence and Quotient Coding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21096v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21096

**作者：** Zibo Meng、Andrew C. M. Austin、Alin Achim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21096v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在不完全观测下，为保留指定任务的全部有效结论，相容解释集合之间哪些区分必须保留；提出 Exact Inference Frontier、推理等价与商编码，并分析学习到的相容集合的推理误差及分布偏移下的表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留任务结论所需的最小区分」与状态抽象可为 LVR 中 latent 应保留哪些视觉细节、信息坍缩及表示等价类的讨论提供概念参照，但有限声明族设定与视觉推理任务的适配性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inference Equivalence and Quotient Coding

**abstract/A1：** Incomplete observations can admit multiple physical interpretations without making every task conclusion ambiguous. Recovering all compatible scenes is often unnecessary, whereas indiscriminate compression may change which claims are justified. We ask which distinctions among observation-compatible interpretation sets must be retained to preserve every valid conclusion of a specified task. We first define inference validity as truth across all physically compatible states and characterize it, under a closedness condition, by distances to physically realizable falsifying measurements. For a finite semantic claim family ordered by specificity, the Exact Inference Frontier forms the unique minimal antichain generating all valid claims. We then define inference equivalence between compatibility sets and construct a canonical quotient code from their frontiers. Among deterministic codes admitting exact inference decoding, it induces the coarsest partition, minimizing the number of distinguishable code values rather than storage or computation. Finally, we characterize inference errors from learned compatibility sets, derive conditions for exact inference preservation despite set errors, and evaluate an asymmetric learning surrogate under distribution shifts. On a registered finite bank, 145 compatibility sets yield 31 quotient codes with unchanged valid-claim sets. Across geometry, mechanism, and joint shifts, learned estimates exhibit different accuracy-specificity trade-offs. On 1,962 official HRSID test images, 1,913 distinct candidate sets induce only 36 seven-claim inference signatures, while a visual 3-NN baseline achieves 87.31% precision on issued claims.

</details>

### 451. [Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21102v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21102

**作者：** Yunchan Jeon、SooGon Kim、Seungwook Kim、CheolWon Lee、Jongmin Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21102v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21102v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对单图像鸟类3D姿态与形状恢复在长尾物种上的泛化，在AVES参数化鸟网格的形状编码上引入分类学Ornstein-Uhlenbeck先验：以随林奈阶元距离指数衰减的协方差构造高斯先验，取代AniMer+的家族级二值对比损失，并在未见物种基准上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 用层级距离构造连续协方差来约束latent 形状编码的做法，可能为LVR中latent状态的结构化先验与表示几何（如按推理深度或位置组织相似度）提供启发，但其任务与视觉推理相距较远，且该先验是否仅为训练期正则尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Family Labels: A Taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Prior for Avian 3D Shape Recovery

**abstract/A1：** Recovering 3D pose and shape of birds from single images is bottlenecked by the long tail of avian diversity: out of ~10,000 species, only a few dozen have 3D-labeled training data, and in-the-wild test sets routinely contain species never seen at training. Generalizing across clades is therefore a central problem. The current state of the art, AniMer+, mitigates it with a family-level contrastive loss that conveys only a binary same-family indicator per pair and discards the continuous structure of the species tree. We propose a taxonomic Ornstein-Uhlenbeck prior on the shape code of the AVES parametric bird mesh model: a multivariate Gaussian whose covariance decays exponentially with Linnaean rank distance, with a learnable selection strength and noise scale. The prior generalizes family contrastive into a continuous, generative form, exposing the graded cross- and within-family similarity that a binary indicator cannot, and brings continuous comparative phylogenetics in as a biology-grounded inductive bias for the long tail. Our method improves over AniMer+ on both metrics of the unseen-species CowBird benchmark and on CtrlAVES3D, while remaining comparable on seen-species CUB. A permutation ablation isolates taxonomic structure from generic Gaussian smoothing, and a rank-granularity ablation identifies cross-order distinctions (the structure beyond a family-vs-not indicator) as the dominant source of the unseen-species gain.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 (Oral)

</details>

### 452. [GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21104v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21104

**作者：** Jeongho Lee、Boeun Kim、Hyung Jin Chang、Jungchan Cho、Sang-Il Choi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21104v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21104v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GRAZE，以记录的眼动射线经几何感知编码（GeoGaze）和 cross-attention 条件化扩散 Transformer，从视线而非文本生成未见物体上的抓取动作，并构建 HOT3D-Grasp 物体不重叠基准。

**相关性简评：** 该文把 gaze 当作指定「抓取何处、从哪侧接近」的空间证据通道，与 LVR 关注的主动感知、视觉证据定位与筛选可能有概念联系；但其面向机器人抓取运动生成，能否启发 VLM 推理期的证据条件化仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GRAZE: Text-Free Grasp Synthesis for Unseen Objects from Human Gaze

**abstract/A1：** Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generation provides intuitive semantic control, but language is an indirect way to specify where an interaction should occur on an object. Naming the part to grasp requires object-specific words, and naming the approach side requires a reference frame that a prompt lacks. We propose GRAZE (GRAsp from gaZE), which generates hand-object grasp motion from recorded gaze instead of object and part names. Its Geometry-Aware Gaze Encoding (GeoGaze) maps gaze rays to cues on object geometry, and cross-attention conditions a diffusion Transformer on these cues. We also introduce HOT3D-Grasp, a grasp-centered benchmark with object-disjoint folds built on HOT3D recordings. On unseen objects, GRAZE grasps the target part more often than the strongest text-conditioned baseline (49.3% vs. 43.6%), achieves the highest grasp success (66.3% vs. 46.6%), and transfers without fine-tuning to GazeHOI (45.3% vs. 33.8%). Gaze conveys the approach side: when gaze is rotated around the object, the approach turns with it in 59.1% of cases, against 20.5% for a text model retrained with clock words. On the same backbone, a text prompt names parts better, but gaze adds the approach side. Given both, GRAZE keeps the prompt's part accuracy and follows gaze.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 12 figures

</details>

### 453. [Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21223v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21223

**作者：** Yuqiu Li、Jian Xue、Fan Li、Ke Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21223v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21223v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文针对旋转框半监督 DETR 检测，指出旋转框参数到矩形的映射是二对一的，导致回归损失与匹配代价在参数空间中被错误放大。作者提出交换对齐的目标选择、交换不变的可靠性代价与交换感知的伪标签去噪三项无参数改动，在 DOTA-v2.0 各标签比例上优于 DETR 类基线。

**相关性简评：** 旋转框的冗余参数化引发「同一几何、不同编码」的度量失配，且由 GMM 滤波器据此丢弃正确样本，这与 latent 相似度中编码冗余、不变性度量及证据/伪标签筛选的问题可能相通，可供核查，但论文本身不做推理过程建模。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Oriented Semi-DETR for Semi-Supervised Aerial Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Semi-supervised object detection has recently been extended to DETR, where oriented boxes introduce an ambiguity that does not arise for axis-aligned boxes: the map from parameters to rectangles is two-to-one, since $(c\_x,c\_y,w,h,θ)$ and $(c\_x,c\_y,h,w,θ+π/2)$ denote the same rotated rectangle. Losses and matching costs are computed from the parameters, so two boxes that coincide in space can be far apart in the metric that drives training. A correctly localized student box is then penalized by the regression loss, and the inflated matching cost leads the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) filter to discard it. We propose Oriented Semi-DETR, which removes this ambiguity wherever a pseudo box enters training. Swap-aligned Target Selection regresses towards the encoding closer to the student prediction. A Swap-invariant Reliability Cost minimizes over the two encodings inside the matching cost, so the filter decides on geometry alone. Swap-aware Pseudo-label Denoising starts denoising earlier, ramps its loss weight linearly, and weights each query by the teacher score and encoding margin. All three are parameter-free and require no additional forward pass. Across all label ratios of DOTA-v2.0, Oriented Semi-DETR outperforms DETR-based supervised and semi-supervised baselines, with the largest gains at the strict IoU threshold.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to ICASSP 2027

</details>

### 454. [Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning for Sample Efficient Experimentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21249v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21249

**作者：** Maximilian Bloor、Max Mowbray、Calvin Tsay、Ehecatl Antonio del Rio Chanona

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21249v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21249v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HGPQ：直接用高斯过程对 Q 函数回归，把 GP 后验等价为逐转移的 Kalman 增益学习率，并用异方差 GP 为每个 Bellman 目标设定噪声方差，从而在少量昂贵实验中实现样本高效控制，并给出值估计误差界。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线的直接联系较弱，但「按目标可靠性加权更新、由后验不确定性决定步长」的思路可能为 latent 推理轨迹的监督加权与贡献分配，以及不确定性驱动的状态更新与停止决策提供可核查的概念借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning for Sample Efficient Experimentation

**abstract/A1：** Self-driving laboratories must learn to control a process from tens to hundreds of expensive experiments, too few for deep reinforcement learning (RL). We learn the Q-function directly with a Gaussian process (GP), which avoids learning the dynamics, and show that the GP posterior supplies the learning rate of Q-learning. If each Bellman target is treated as a noisy measurement of the Q-function, the learning rate that minimises the mean squared error is the Kalman gain, and applying it to every observed transition is equivalent to GP regression. Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Q-learning (HGPQ) sets the noise variance of each target with a heteroscedastic GP, which learns how unreliable the targets are across the states and inputs. Targets from noisy operating conditions, or from regions where the value function has large gradients, then move the estimate less than targets from low-noise regions, so HGPQ learns quickly where the data are reliable without being misled where they are not. For kernel value iteration with per-target variances that are assigned when a target is collected, we prove a high-probability bound on the error of the value estimate, uniform over the explored region. Pooled over five simulated benchmarks, which include a chemical reactor and a bioprocess, HGPQ approaches the best return found by any method in fewer episodes than GP, kernel and deep RL baselines.

</details>

### 455. [QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21253v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21253

**作者：** Haiyang Xu、Ziye Zhang、Bin Pan、Xia Xu、Zhenwei Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21253v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21253v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 3D Gaussian Splatting 新视角合成的渲染可靠性，提出后处理框架 QuantileGS：为每个高斯学习上下分位数场，再用尺度归一化保形校准，得到具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的逐像素 RGB 误差上界。

**相关性简评：** 其校准后的逐像素误差上界与主动视角选择，可能为 LVR 中「候选视觉证据是否可信、何时继续 LOOK 或停止」提供不确定性度量思路，但缺乏与潜在推理状态或 VLM 的直接联系，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QuantileGS: Quantile-Based Conformal Bounds on RGB Rendering Errors for Novel View Synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Uncertainty quantification for novel view synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assesses rendering reliability at unseen viewpoints. This reliability depends on the discrepancy between rendered and true colors, which cannot be measured without ground-truth images. We therefore quantify uncertainty in this unknown discrepancy through upper bounds on per-pixel RGB mean absolute error. However, learned bounds may underestimate these errors and overstate rendering reliability, motivating calibration to a prescribed coverage level. In this paper, we propose QuantileGS, a post-hoc framework that combines learned rendering-error quantiles with scale-normalized conformal calibration to produce spatially adaptive error bounds. The framework comprises three phases. Phase 1, Rendering-Error Computation, measures RGB mean absolute error between observed images and predictions from a frozen 3DGS model. Phase 2, Ordered Gaussian Quantile Fields, learns two scalar attributes per Gaussian to predict lower and upper rendering-error quantiles. Phase 3, Scale-Normalized Conformal Calibration, calibrates the upper prediction on held-out images, using the quantile gap to scale the correction. Under the stated assumptions, the resulting bounds provide finite-sample marginal coverage. At a nominal coverage level of 90%, calibration raises mean empirical test coverage from 69.6% to 89.6% on LLFF and from 80.1% to 92.1% on Mip-NeRF 360. On LF, coverage remains conservative at 96.3% before and 96.4% after calibration. Applications to active view selection, Gaussian pruning, and RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping illustrate how these bounds inform downstream decisions.

</details>

### 456. [PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21283v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21283

**作者：** Oday Allan、Igor Ostanin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cond-mat.soft

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21283v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21283v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PLECTA 是一种确定性方法，从仅标记纤维中心线的二值图中分割彼此重叠的纤维：在每个交叉点用带未配对惩罚的精确最大权部分匹配决定哪些片段相接或终止，并允许交叉像素属于多条纤维，另用灰度图估计上下层关系。

**相关性简评：** 材料显微图像分析与 VLM 推理相距较远，但其在交叉处选择片段延续或终止、容忍多实体共享同一位置的做法，可能为 latent 状态中重叠视觉证据的实体绑定与归属提供概念参照，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PLECTA: Overlap-aware instance segmentation of dense strand networks from binary masks

**abstract/A1：** Many materials and tissues, including carbon-nanotube sheets, collagen and paper, comprise overlapping strands whose arrangement influences their effective properties. Measuring this geometry from micrographs requires individual strands to be traced through crossings and signal gaps, which merge distinct strands or split one strand into disconnected fragments. We present PLECTA (from Latin plecta, a braid), a deterministic method that segments individual strands using only a binary image whose foreground pixels mark strand centrelines. At each junction, PLECTA selects which strand segments continue into one another while allowing segments to terminate. It formulates this decision as an exact maximum-weight partial-matching problem, with an explicit penalty for unpaired segments and no restriction on the number of segments entering a junction. The output permits crossing pixels to belong to multiple strands. On synthetic scenes, PLECTA resolved strand identities more accurately than three released alternatives at every density tested. The same ranking held on an independently published generator run at its own settings. A separate stage uses the corresponding greyscale micrograph to estimate which strand lies on top at each crossing. The complete workflow is demonstrated on scanning electron micrographs of carbon nanotube sheets, from raw images to individual strand instances with estimated crossing order, without manual annotations for training or as pipeline inputs.

</details>

### 457. [FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21290v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21290

**作者：** Donghang Lyu、Marius Staring、Ruochen Gao、Jochen Keupp、Hildo J. Lamb、Mariya Doneva

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 FM-Recon，将冻结的基础模型图像编码器特征经精炼后注入展开式（unrolled）重建网络，并在心脏电影 MRI 加速重建任务上系统评估不同重建设置下的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其核心发现是基础模型可从含伪影输入中提取有用表示，与 LVR 中「视觉证据筛选与内部表示保留」的问题可能有间接联系，可供核查冻结视觉编码特征在迭代状态更新中的增益与失效条件；但不涉及多模态推理或 latent 生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.

</details>

### 458. [Benchleaking Is Accelerating: Benchmark contamination has worsened sharply in the past month -- from post-training down to pre-training base models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21315v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21315

**作者：** Yiwei Qin、Muhang Xie、Xuefeng Li、Mohan Jiang、Dayuan Fu、Tiantian Mi、Qipeng Guo、Pengfei Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21315v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21315v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文区分「benchleaking」（测试样例进入训练数据、分数反映记忆而非能力）与「benchmaxxing」，通过审计与对四个公开基座在 20 个基准上的 few-shot 续写探测量化泄漏规模，并提出把泄漏样例一律判错的 Anti-Hack 分数。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的评价环节相通：若视觉推理基准中的样例被记忆，报告的小幅增益可能只是复述而非 latent 推理，其续写探测与污染校正评分可供核查 LVR 结论稳健性；但研究对象为文本代码与 QA 基准，迁移到多模态基准需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchleaking Is Accelerating: Benchmark contamination has worsened sharply in the past month -- from post-training down to pre-training base models

**abstract/A1：** Benchmark contamination is not new, but recent model releases show it in a sharper form. We use the term benchleaking for the case in which a benchmark's own test examples enter training data, so that a score reflects recall rather than capability. This differs from benchmaxxing, which optimizes toward a benchmark without seeing its test set. We document two escalations over the past month. First, in post-training, the traces have become explicit: recent audits show an agent stating hidden test requirements it was never given in 23% of its attempts, where its predecessor did so in none, and continuing to follow them after the task is changed to contradict them (Schaeffer and Räuker, 2026; Lo and Lo, 2026). Second, the problem has reached pre-training. Using few-shot continuation on 20 benchmarks across four public base models, we find that some base models write out other test examples---complete questions, options, and answers---that appear nowhere in their input. For the recently released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base, 96% of HumanEval problems leak with their reference implementations and 85% of OpenBookQA questions leak with their answers, against 9% and none for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base. To quantify what a reported score owes to such examples, we define an Anti-Hack score: the benchmark score recomputed with every leaked example marked wrong and the number of examples unchanged. Averaged over the suite, it costs DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base 1.5 points and Hy3-preview-Base 1.3, against 5.0 for MiMo-V2.5-Base and 16.6 for ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base. Open base models are the foundation of much downstream research, so benchleaking now affects more than leaderboard rankings. We call for decontamination reports and contamination-adjusted scores to become standard practice.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages. Project: https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/Benchleaking

</details>

### 459. [Wavelet-Energy-Driven Dynamic Patching for Time Series Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21319v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21319

**作者：** Syed Hafiz Bin Salim Alsree、Stephen Roberts、Stefan Zohren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21319v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21319v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种时间序列预测器：由可学习 DWT 得到的逐尺度能量图驱动相邻窗口合并，生成变长 patch，并通过消融分别考察多分辨率分解、小波选择与滤波器学习的贡献。

**相关性简评：** 其「按能量图动态决定 token 粒度」及「边界位置不如变长本身重要」的结论，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、分辨率分配与 latent 视觉 token 的收益归因提供可核查线索，但领域较远、迁移性未经验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Wavelet-Energy-Driven Dynamic Patching for Time Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Patch-based transformers tokenise a time series into fixed-size, uniform windows, which commits the model to a single temporal resolution even though real signals are multi-scale. The discrete wavelet transform (DWT) is a natural alternative because it decomposes a signal across scales. A growing body of work makes the wavelet filter learnable, on the assumption that a more flexible wavelet forecasts better. That assumption has rarely been tested in isolation, because a single reported improvement usually credits three things at once. These are the use of any multi-resolution decomposition, the choice of wavelet and training the filter. We introduce a forecaster that turns a learnable-DWT per-scale energy map into variable-length patches by merging adjacent windows that share a dominant scale. Three findings follow. First, most of the improvement is there before any filter is learned. A frozen wavelet beats a fixed-patch baseline on eight of the nine datasets by 1.5% to 7.8%, and on four of them it recovers all of the gain. Traffic is the one exception, where it is 1.2% worse. Second, learning the filter gives a further improvement on only some datasets. It helps on three of the nine datasets and makes Traffic 2.7% worse. Third, having variable-length patches helps, but exactly where their boundaries fall does not. A fixed-size uniform grid, even with its patch size tuned per task, is worse than our variable-length patches on 27 of 36 settings. Recomputing the boundaries from the learned filter at every step, rather than caching them once, never helps. The improvement in wavelet-based forecasting comes from the multi-resolution structure and the variable-length patches it induces, not from making the wavelet learnable. In practice, start from any valid wavelet, cache the patch boundaries once and treat training the filter as a per-dataset decision rather than a default.

</details>

### 460. [TEMPO: Regime-Aware Operator Learning with Locally Adapted POD Bases](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21344v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21344

**作者：** Rodion Akinzhala、Alexander Terentyev、Alexey Golubev、Yury Maximov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.21344v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.21344v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TEMPO 两阶段框架：离线用 EM 从 PDE 解快照中发现潜在分区（regime）并为每个分区拟合专用 POD 基，在线联合训练门控网络与各分支网络，将新参数输入路由到相应分区，以应对从平滑扩散到近激波等形态差异极大的解。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜在分区发现＋门控路由」可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的分解与按输入选择、以及状态空间异质性建模提供可供核查的概念线索，但对象是 PDE 解映射，与视觉推理状态的关联尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TEMPO: Regime-Aware Operator Learning with Locally Adapted POD Bases

**abstract/A1：** Operator learning approximates the solution map of a parametric partial differential equation from data, enabling fast prediction at new parameter values without repeated simulation. The dominant approach fits a single global low-rank basis, typically a proper orthogonal decomposition (POD), to all solution snapshots. This fails when the snapshots span qualitatively different solution shapes, from smooth diffusive profiles to near-discontinuous shocks. We propose TEMPO (Trajectory Expectation-Maximization Mixture of POD Operators), a two-phase framework for regime-aware operator learning. In the offline phase, TEMPO recovers latent regimes via expectation-maximization, fitting a dedicated linear or nonlinear basis to each discovered regime. In the online phase, a gating network and per-regime branch networks are trained jointly, routing new inputs to the regimes at inference. We test TEMPO on Burgers' flow, Sod shock tubes, Coanda flow, Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes flow and the heterogeneous Helmholtz equation. With 64 total POD modes, TEMPO gives 18.61% test error on Burgers', compared with 19.61% for global POD. It also gives lower errors on Coanda and Helmholtz.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2611.21365

**作者：** Alexander Moriz、Lukas Krebs、Amon Göppert、Robert H. Schmitt

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在工业质检场景中用集成方法估计基于合成数据训练的深度学习模型的预测不确定性，发现 sim-to-real 域偏移会使不确定性升高，但性能退化主要由系统性偏差而非集成分歧主导。

**相关性简评：** 其把不确定性变化拆分为集成分歧与系统性偏差的思路，或可供核查 LVR 中依赖不确定性做出停止或弃权决策时，在视觉证据分布偏移下是否仍然可靠。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exploring the link between predictive uncertainty and the sim-to-real gap in deep learning models utilizing synthetic data

**abstract/A1：** Today, state-of-the-art methods for quality control (QC) are based on Machine Vision, combining deep learning (DL) models with camera-based inspection. Yet, the integration of such solutions in industrial applications is often impeded by data sparsity and trust in model reliability. While synthetic data offers a promising approach to generate the necessary data with perfect annotations, it poses risks related to performance degradation due to the possible occurrence of the sim-to-real gap. This study conducts experiments using the ensemble method to estimate the predictive uncertainty of DL models trained on synthetic data. The results show that predictive uncertainty increases under the sim-to-real domain shift. However, the observed performance drop is dominated by a systematic sim-to-real bias rather than by ensemble disagreement.These findings contribute to the effective utilization of synthetic data in industrial settings while highlighting the importance of risk assessment for the deployment of DL solutions for QC tasks.

</details>
